import json
from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction

from app.models import (
    Course,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
)


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = "Import mapped Abertay fees from the extracted JSON preview."

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save changes. Without this flag, preview only.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        apply = options["apply"]

        try:
            mapping = json.loads(
                (root / "abertay_course_mapping.json").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8-sig"
                )
            )
            extraction = json.loads(
                (root / "abertay_courses_preview.json").read_text(
                    encoding="utf-8-sig"
                )
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(f"Cannot read input files: {exc}") from exc

        year = mapping["academic_year"]

        if extraction["academic_year"] != year:
            raise CommandError("Mapping and extraction years differ.")

        sources = {}
        for record in extraction["records"]:
            if record.get("status") == "extracted":
                sources.setdefault(
                    record["source_url"], []
                ).append(record)

        entries = mapping["mappings"]

        if not entries:
            raise CommandError("Mapping contains no courses.")

        ids = [entry["course_id"] for entry in entries]
        urls = [entry["source_url"] for entry in entries]

        if len(ids) != len(set(ids)) or len(urls) != len(set(urls)):
            raise CommandError("Duplicate course IDs or source URLs.")

        if apply and any(
            entry.get("approved") is not True for entry in entries
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Mappings are still drafts. Review them and set "
                '"approved": true before using --apply.'
            )

        plans = []

        # Validate every record before writing any changes.
        with transaction.atomic():
            for entry in entries:
                course_id = entry["course_id"]
                source_url = entry["source_url"]

                parsed = urlsplit(source_url)
                if (
                    parsed.scheme != "https"
                    or parsed.netloc != "www.abertay.ac.uk"
                    or not parsed.path.startswith(
                        "/course-search/undergraduate/"
                    )
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unexpected source URL."
                    )

                records = sources.get(source_url, [])
                if len(records) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one extracted record."
                    )

                data = records[0]["data"]
                categories = data.get("fee_categories", [])

                international_rows = [
                    row for row in categories
                    if row.get("source_fee_category") == "International"
                ]

                if len(international_rows) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one international fee category."
                    )

                international_fee = international_rows[0]

                if (
                    international_fee.get("amount_requires_review") is not False
                    or international_fee.get("footnote_marker")
                    or international_fee.get("academic_year") != year
                    or international_fee.get("currency") != "GBP"
                    or international_fee.get("annual_tuition")
                    != data.get("annual_tuition")
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: international fee category needs review."
                    )
                fee_source_url = data.get("fee_source_url",source_url)
                central_fee_url = (
                    "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/"
                    "money-fees-and-funding/tuition-fees-2026-2027/"
                )

                if fee_source_url != source_url:
                    if(
                        fee_source_url != central_fee_url
                        or data.get("fee_method") != "reviewed_central_default"
                        or course_id not in {"C_UK001_37", "C_UK001_41"}
                        or year != "2026/27"
                    ):
                        raise CommandError( f"{course_id}: unexpected fee source.")

                    
                expected_source = {
                    "title": entry["source_title"],
                    "award_title": entry["source_award"],
                    "duration": entry["source_duration"],
                    "academic_year": year,
                    "fee_status": "International",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                }

                if any(
                    data.get(key) != value
                    for key, value in expected_source.items()
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: source differs from mapping."
                    )

                if data.get("footnote_marker"):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: fee footnote needs review."
                    )

                courses = list(
                    Course.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course_id=course_id,
                        university__name__iexact="Abertay University",
                        university__country="UK",
                    )[:2]
                )

                if len(courses) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one database course."
                    )

                course = courses[0]

                expected_course = {
                    "title": entry["expected_stored_title"],
                    "duration": entry["expected_stored_duration"],
                    "level": entry["expected_stored_level"],
                }

                if any(
                    getattr(course, key) != value
                    for key, value in expected_course.items()
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: database course changed."
                    )

                if course.start_year != int(year[:4]):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: intake year differs."
                    )

                tuitions = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )[:2]
                )

                if len(tuitions) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one INTL tuition."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]

                if tuition.currency != "GBP":
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: currency differs."
                    )

                try:
                    fee = Decimal(data["annual_tuition"])
                except (InvalidOperation, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: invalid fee."
                    ) from exc

                if (
                    not fee.is_finite()
                    or fee <= 0
                    or fee != fee.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: invalid fee amount."
                    )

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                if source and (
                    source.academic_year != year
                    or source.source_url != fee_source_url
                    or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: existing source metadata "
                        "conflicts; review before replacing it."
                    )

                metadata = {
                    "academic_year": year,
                    "source_url": fee_source_url,
                    "source_course_code": data.get("ucas_code", ""),
                    "source_course_name": data["title"],
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "student_contribution": None,
                    "published_total": None,
                    "raw_fees": {
                        "fee_status": data["fee_status"],
                        "currency": data["currency"],
                        "annual_tuition": data["raw_fee"],
                        "award_title": data["award_title"],
                        "duration": data["duration"],
                    },
                }
                if data.get("fee_method") == "reviewed_central_default":
                    metadata["raw_fees"].update({
                        "course_source_url": source_url,
                        "fee_method": data["fee_method"],
                        "fee_rule": data["fee_rule"],
                    })
                metadata["raw_fees"]["fee_categories"] = categories
                metadata["raw_fees"]["source_fee_category"] = "International"
                if (
                    len(metadata["source_course_code"]) > 100
                    or len(metadata["source_course_name"]) > 255
                    or len(source_url) > 500
                    or len(source_url)
                    > Course._meta.get_field("course_url").max_length
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: value exceeds a field length."
                    )

                before_metadata = None
                if source:
                    before_metadata = {
                        key: getattr(source, key)
                        for key in metadata
                    }
                    for key in (
                        "student_contribution",
                        "published_total",
                    ):
                        value = before_metadata[key]
                        if value is not None:
                            before_metadata[key] = str(value)

                before = {
                    "tuition_fee": str(tuition.tuition_fee),
                    "currency": tuition.currency,
                    "course_url": course.course_url,
                    "source_metadata": before_metadata,
                }
                after = {
                    "tuition_fee": str(fee),
                    "currency": tuition.currency,
                    "course_url": course.course_url,
                    "source_metadata": metadata,
                }

                # Compare amounts numerically: 16950.0 equals 16950.00.
                changed = (
                    tuition.tuition_fee != fee
                    or before_metadata != metadata
                )

                plans.append({
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "fee": fee,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": changed,
                })

            changed_count = 0

            for plan in plans:
                course = plan["course"]
                tuition = plan["tuition"]

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course.course_id}: GBP "
                    f'{plan["before"]["tuition_fee"]} '
                    f'-> {plan["after"]["tuition_fee"]}'
                    f' — {"update" if plan["changed"] else "unchanged"}'
                )

                if not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                changed_count += 1

                if not apply:
                    continue

                tuition.tuition_fee = plan["fee"]
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=plan["metadata"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course.course_id,
                    residency=tuition.residency,
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        if apply:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
                f"Import complete: {changed_count} updated, "
                f"{len(plans) - changed_count} unchanged."
            ))
        else:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
                f"Preview: {changed_count} proposed updates. "
                "No database records changed."
            ))

def serialisable(value):
    return json.loads(
        json.dumps(value, cls=DjangoJSONEncoder)
    )


def normalise(title):
    title = title.casefold().replace("&", " and ")
    title = re.sub(r"\bux\b", "user experience", title)
    title = " ".join(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", title))

    aliases = {
        "professional masters in games development mprof":
            "mprof games development",
    }

    return aliases.get(title, title)


def research_subject(title):
    title = title.casefold().replace("&", " and ")

    title = re.sub(
        r"^postgraduate research opportunities in\s+",
        "",
        title,
    )
    title = re.sub(r"\(food and drink\)", "", title)

    title = re.sub(
        r"^(msc|ma|llm)\s+by\s+research\s+(in\s+)?",
        "",
        title,
    )
    title = re.sub(
        r"\b(msc|ma|llm)\s+by\s+research\b.*$",
        "",
        title,
    )
    title = re.sub(r"^(msc|ma|llm)\s+", "", title)
    title = re.sub(r"\s+by\s+research$", "", title)

    return " ".join(re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", title))


def research_award(title):
    match = re.search(
        r"\b(MSc|MA|LLM)\b",
        title,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    return match.group(1).casefold() if match else None


def one_year(duration):
    return bool(
        re.fullmatch(
            r"1\s+years?",
            (duration or "").strip(),
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    )


def money(raw):
    """Read the leading GBP amount; preserve notes separately."""
    if not isinstance(raw, str):
        raise ValueError("Fee must be text.")

    match = re.match(
        r"^£\s*((?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)"
        r"(?:\.\d{2})?)(?![\d,.])",
        raw.strip(),
    )

    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Unsupported fee: {raw!r}")

    amount = Decimal(match.group(1).replace(",", ""))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount <= 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid tuition amount.")

    return amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01"))


def section(report, heading):
    matches = [
        item
        for item in report["sections"]
        if item["heading"] == heading
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected one section: {heading}")

    return matches[0]


def fee_table(section_data, first_header):
    matches = [
        table
        for table in section_data["tables"]
        if table
        and table[0]
        and table[0][0].casefold() == first_header.casefold()
    ]

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected one table headed {first_header!r}."
        )

    return matches[0]


def taught_policy_rows(table, title):
    """Match complete named degrees, not arbitrary substrings."""
    wanted = normalise(title)
    found = []

    for row in table[1:]:
        if len(row) != 2 or not row[1].strip():
            continue

        names = re.split(
            r"(?=\b(?:MSc|MProf|Global MBA)\b)",
            row[0],
        )

        if any(normalise(name) == wanted for name in names):
            found.append(row)

    return found


def metadata_for_comparison(metadata):
    """Ignore evidence-file changes when comparing fee metadata."""
    result = serialisable(metadata)

    if result is not None:
        raw = result.get("raw_fees")

        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw.pop("policy_sha256", None)
            raw.pop("policy_snapshot", None)

    return result


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (

    def add_arguments(self, parser):

    def handle(self, *args, **options):

            ):

                    "Unexpected source or academic year."
                )

                policy,
                "Undergraduate Tuition Fees - "
                "International Students 2026/27",
            )

                policy,
                "Postgraduate Tuition Fees - "
                "International Students 2026/27",
            )

                ug_section,
                "UNDERGRADUATE DEGREE COURSES",

                pg_section,
                "POSTGRADUATE COURSES",

                    note = (

                        "the course-page amount. Stored duration and "
                        "entry route have not been changed or verified."
                    )

                elif course.level in {"PG", "PGT", "MRES"}:
                    if "by research" in course.title.casefold():
                        award = research_award(course.title)
                        subject = research_subject(course.title)

                        matches = [
                            record
                            for record in postgraduate
                            if record.get("kind")
                            == "postgraduate_research"
                            and award is not None
                            and research_award(
                                record.get("source_title", "")
                            ) == award
                            and research_subject(
                                record.get("source_title", "")
                            ) == subject
                        ]

                        if (
                            len(matches) != 1
                            or not one_year(course.duration)
                        ):
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Research subject, award or "
                                "duration needs review.",
                            )
                            continue

                        record = matches[0]
                        source_url = record["source_url"]
                        fee = research_fee
                        kind = "masters_by_research"

                        data = {
                            "title": record["source_title"],
                            "raw_fee": research_rows[0][1],
                            "fee_categories": [
                                {
                                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                                    "currency": "GBP",
                                    "raw_annual_fee": research_rows[0][1],
                                    "annual_tuition": str(fee),
                                    "footnote_marker": "",
                                    "annotation": "",
                                    "amount_requires_review": False,
                                }
                            ],
                        }

                        note = (
                            "Masters by Research fee only. "
                            "No PhD/MPhil fee or taught postgraduate "
                            "scholarship has been applied."
                        )

                    else:
                        source_title = REVIEWED_ROUTE_TITLES.get(
                            course.course_id,
                            course.title,
                        )

                        matches = [
                            record
                            for record in postgraduate
                            if record.get("kind")
                            == "postgraduate_taught"
                            and record.get("status") == "extracted"
                            and normalise(
                                record["data"]["title"]
                            ) == normalise(source_title)
                        ]

                        if len(matches) != 1:
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Taught course identity needs review.",
                            )
                            continue

                        record = matches[0]
                        data = deepcopy(record["data"])

                        reviewed_placement_year_one = (
                            course.course_id
                            in PLACEMENT_YEAR_ONE_IDS
                            and re.fullmatch(
                                r"2\s+years?",
                                (course.duration or "").strip(),
                                flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                            ) is not None
                        )

                        if (
                            not (
                                one_year(course.duration)
                                or reviewed_placement_year_one
                            )
                            or "12 months" not in (
                                data.get("duration") or ""
                            ).casefold()
                        ):
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Duration/intake or placement "
                                "fee needs review.",
                            )
                            continue

                        rows = taught_policy_rows(
                            pg_table,
                            course.title,
                        )

                        if len(rows) != 1:
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Central named fee is ambiguous.",
                            )
                            continue

                        try:
                            fee = Decimal(data["annual_tuition"])
                            central_amount = money(rows[0][1])
                        except (
                            KeyError,
                            InvalidOperation,
                            TypeError,
                            ValueError,
                        ):
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Invalid taught postgraduate amount.",
                            )
                            continue

                        if (
                            data.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                            or data.get("currency") != "GBP"
                            or not fee.is_finite()
                            or fee != central_amount
                            or data.get("footnote_marker")
                        ):
                            block(
                                course,
                                "Course and central fee "
                                "need reconciliation.",
                            )
                            continue

                        kind = "postgraduate_taught"

                        note = (
                            "One-year taught fee corroborated by "
                            "the central named-course table. "
                            "Additional charges may apply beyond "
                            "18 months FTE. Scholarship rules "
                            "remain separate."
                        )

                        if reviewed_placement_year_one:
                            note = (
                                "First compared study-year annual "
                                "fee for the named industrial-practice "
                                "route. Not a two-year programme total; "
                                "later-year charges require separate "
                                "verification. Stored course duration "
                                "is unchanged."
                            )

                        for category in data.get(
                            "fee_categories", []
                        ):
                            if (
                                category["source_fee_category"]
                                != "International"
                            ):
                                category["amount_requires_review"] = True
                                category["annotation"] = (
                                    "Home postgraduate fee under "
                                    "review on the central "
                                    "2026/27 policy page."
                                )

                        course,

                        "Existing metadata belongs to another year.",

                    "source_url": POLICY_URL,
                    "source_course_code": (
                        data.get("ucas_code") or ""

                    "source_course_name": data["title"],
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",

                    "published_total": None,

                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": data["raw_fee"],
                        "fee_categories": data.get(
                            "fee_categories", []
                        ),
                        "course_source_url": source_url,
                        "fee_method": "reviewed_central_policy",
                        "course_kind": kind,
                        "policy_sha256": evidence_hash,
                        "review_note": note,
                    },
                }

                old_metadata = (
                    {
                        field: getattr(source, field)
                        for field in SOURCE_FIELDS
                    }
                    if source else None
                )

                changed = (
                    tuition.tuition_fee != fee
                    or metadata_for_comparison(old_metadata)
                    != metadata_for_comparison(metadata)
                )

                # Preserve existing evidence metadata when only
                # the cached policy-file hash has changed.
                if not changed:
                    metadata = old_metadata

                before = serialisable({
                    "tuition_fee": tuition.tuition_fee,
                    "source_metadata": old_metadata,
                })
                after = serialisable({
                    "tuition_fee": fee,
                    "source_metadata": metadata,
                })

                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"Review intake: {course.course_id} — "
                        f"{course.start_month} {course.start_year}; "
                        f"stored duration: {course.duration}"
                    )

                plans.append({
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "fee": fee,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                    "kind": kind,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": changed,
                })

            report = {
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                "database_changes": False,
                "committed": False,
                "proposals": [
                    {
                        "course_id": plan["course"].course_id,
                        "title": plan["course"].title,
                        "start_month": plan["course"].start_month,
                        "start_year": plan["course"].start_year,
                        "duration": plan["course"].duration,
                        "kind": plan["kind"],
                        "changed": plan["changed"],
                        "before": plan["before"],
                        "after": plan["after"],
                    }
                    for plan in plans
                ],
                "blocked": blocked,
                "skipped_other_cohorts": skipped,
                "coverage_note": (
                    "This is a 2026/27 importer report, not a "
                    "complete university coverage report. "
                    "Skipped early-2026 records may be verified "
                    "or unresolved in the separate cohort workflow."
                ),
                "undergraduate_remaining_pages": remaining[
                    "undergraduate_remaining"
                ],
                "eu_records": remaining.get("eu_records", []),
                "eu_note": (
                    "Only INTL tuition records are eligible "
                    "for updates. EU records are unchanged."
                ),
            }

            log_dir = root / "logs" / "abertay-fees"
            log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(
                "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
            )
            output = log_dir / f"remaining-{timestamp}.json"

            # Write the plan before making database changes.
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            for plan in plans:
                course = plan["course"]
                tuition = plan["tuition"]
                label = "update" if plan["changed"] else "unchanged"

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course.course_id}: "
                    f"GBP {tuition.tuition_fee} -> "
                    f"{plan['fee']} — {label}"
                )

                if not options["apply"] or not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                tuition.tuition_fee = plan["fee"]
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=plan["metadata"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course.course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        # Database transaction has completed successfully.
        if options["apply"]:
            report["database_changes"] = any(
                plan["changed"] for plan in plans
            )
            report["committed"] = True

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        changed_count = sum(
            plan["changed"] for plan in plans
        )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nMatched records: {len(plans)}")
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated records: {changed_count}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked records: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Skipped early-2026 records: {len(skipped)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Before/after report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Applied tuition and source metadata updates."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

    "ug_humanities": Decimal("20400.00"),
    "ug_sciences": Decimal("23255.00"),
    "mba": Decimal("23310.00"),
}


def prices_from_report(report):
    fees = report.get("sources", {}).get("international_fees", {})

    if (
        fees.get("status") != "collected"
        or fees.get("response_url", "").rstrip("/")
        != FEE_URL.rstrip("/")
        or "2027/2028" not in fees.get("text", "")
    ):
        raise CommandError("Reviewed 2027/28 fee evidence is missing.")

    matches = []

    for table in fees.get("tables", []):
        rows = table.get("rows", [])

        if not rows or len(rows[0]) < 4:
            continue

        headers = [
            str(cell).strip().casefold()
            for cell in rows[0]
        ]

        if (
            headers[1:3] != ["humanities", "sciences"]
            or "business administration" not in headers[3]
        ):
            continue

        bachelors = [
            row for row in rows[1:]
            if row and str(row[0]).startswith("Bachelors Programme")
        ]
        masters = [
            row for row in rows[1:]
            if row and str(row[0]).startswith("Masters Programme")
        ]

        if (
            len(bachelors) != 1
            or len(masters) != 1
            or len(bachelors[0]) < 3
            or len(masters[0]) < 4
        ):
            continue

        values = {
            "ug_humanities": money(bachelors[0][1]),
            "ug_sciences": money(bachelors[0][2]),
            "mba": money(masters[0][3]),
        }

        if values == EXPECTED:
            matches.append(values)

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise CommandError(
            "Cannot uniquely identify the reviewed tuition table. "
            "Inspect the official evidence before importing."
        )

    return matches[0]


def course_fields(course):
    return {
        "title": course.title,
        "duration": course.duration,
        "start_month": course.start_month,
        "start_year": course.start_year,
        "course_url": course.course_url,
        "level": course.level,
        "ucas_cao_code": course.ucas_cao_code,
    }


def before_snapshot(course, tuition, source):
    if tuition is None:
        return {
            "course": course_fields(course),
            "tuition": None,
            "source": None,
        }

    result = snapshot(course, tuition, source)
    result["course"] = course_fields(course)
    result["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = str(
        Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
    )
    return result


def validate_page(page, reviewed):
    title, code, award, level, group, years, path = reviewed

    if not page or page.get("status") != "collected":
        return "Collected course evidence is missing."

    if page.get("title") != title:
        return "Official title changed."

    parsed = urlsplit(page.get("source_url", ""))

    if (
        parsed.scheme != "https"
        or parsed.netloc != "courses.aber.ac.uk"
        or parsed.path.rstrip("/") != path
        or parsed.query
        or parsed.fragment
    ):
        return "Official course URL changed."

    content = page.get("text", "")

    if not re.search(
        rf"\b{re.escape(code)}-{re.escape(award)}\b",
        content,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        return "Official course code or award is not confirmed."

    if not re.search(
        rf"Course duration\s+{years}\s+years?\b",
        content,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        return "Official course duration changed."

    if page.get("advertised_intakes") != [
        {"month": "September", "year": 2027}
    ]:
        return "Reviewed September 2027 intake changed."

    return None


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview/apply four reviewed Aberystwyth courses, including "
        "creation of missing international tuition records."
    )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        directory = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"

        source_path = latest_report(directory, "source-review.json")
        paths = list(
            directory.glob("next-batch-*/next-course-evidence.json")

            )

        for report in (source_report, course_report):
            if report.get("university_id") != "UK002":
                raise CommandError("University evidence mismatch.")
            validate_age(report)

        prices = prices_from_report(source_report)
        pages = {}

            course_id = page.get("course_id")

            pages[course_id] = page

        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

            if university.name.strip().casefold() != "aberystwyth university":

            for course_id, reviewed in REVIEWED.items():

                    ]

                    for field in fields:
                        setattr(course, field, after["course"][field])

                    course.save(update_fields=fields + ["updated_at"])

                    if tuition is None:
                        # Recheck before creation. The university/course
                        # locks serialize cooperating importer runs.
                        if Tuition.objects.filter(
                            course=course,
                            residency="INTL",
                        ).exists():
                            raise CommandError(
                                f"{course_id}: international tuition "
                                "appeared during this run. Retry preview."
                            )

                        tuition = Tuition.objects.create(
                            course=course,
                            residency="INTL",
                            tuition_fee=Decimal(
                                after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                            ),
                            currency="GBP",
                            scholarship=Decimal("0.00"),
                            scholarship_source=None,
                            tuition_deposit=None,
                        )
                    else:
                        tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                        )
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    audit_after = json.loads(json.dumps(after))
                    audit_after["tuition"].update({
                        "tuition_id": tuition.pk,
                        "residency": tuition.residency,
                        "scholarship": str(tuition.scholarship),
                        "scholarship_source_id": (
                            tuition.scholarship_source_id
                        ),
                        "tuition_deposit": (
                            str(tuition.tuition_deposit)
                            if tuition.tuition_deposit is not None
                            else None
                        ),
                    })

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=proposal["before"],
                        after=audit_after,
                    )

        creates = sum(
            proposal["action"] == "create_tuition"
            for proposal in proposals
        )
        changes = sum(
            proposal["changed"] for proposal in proposals
        )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nMatched records: {len(proposals)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Missing tuition records to create: {creates}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed changes: {changes}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked in import batch: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write("Additional candidate held for review: 1")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

        self.stdout.write(
            "Applied course corrections, tuition records, "
            "source metadata and audits."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Existing scholarships, deposits and EU tuition unchanged. "
            "New tuition records use zero stored discount and no deposit amount."
        )

EXPECTED_PRICES = {
    ("bachelors", "Humanities"): Decimal("20400.00"),
    ("bachelors", "Sciences"): Decimal("23255.00"),
    ("masters", "Humanities"): Decimal("22115.00"),
    ("masters", "Sciences"): Decimal("23820.00"),
}


def extract_prices(report):
    """Validate the collected central table against reviewed amounts."""
    fees = report.get("sources", {}).get("international_fees", {})

    if (
        fees.get("status") != "collected"
        or fees.get("response_url", "").rstrip("/")
        != FEE_URL.rstrip("/")
        or "Tuition Fees for International Students 2027/2028"
        not in fees.get("text", "")
    ):
        raise CommandError("Reviewed international fee evidence is missing.")

    matches = []

    for table in fees.get("tables", []):
        rows = table.get("rows", [])

        if not rows or len(rows[0]) < 3:
            continue

        headers = [str(cell).strip().casefold() for cell in rows[0]]

        if headers[1:3] != ["humanities", "sciences"]:
            continue

        prices = {}

        for group, prefix in (
            ("bachelors", "Bachelors Programme"),
            ("masters", "Masters Programme"),
        ):
            selected = [
                row
                for row in rows[1:]
                if row and str(row[0]).startswith(prefix)
            ]

            if len(selected) != 1 or len(selected[0]) < 3:
                break

            prices[(group, "Humanities")] = money(selected[0][1])
            prices[(group, "Sciences")] = money(selected[0][2])

        if prices == EXPECTED_PRICES:
            matches.append(prices)

    # The collected tables may contain several academic years.
    # Import only the uniquely matching, reviewed set of prices.
    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise CommandError(
            "Cannot uniquely identify the reviewed 2027/28 fee table. "
            "Refresh and inspect the official fee evidence."
        )

    return matches[0]


def validate_page(page, title, group, department):
    if not page or page.get("status") != "collected":
        return "Collected course-page evidence is missing."

    if page.get("title") != title:
        return "Official course title does not match the reviewed identity."

    parsed = urlsplit(page.get("response_url", ""))
    expected_prefix = (
        "/undergraduate/" if group == "bachelors" else "/postgraduate/"
    )

    if (
        parsed.scheme != "https"
        or parsed.netloc != "courses.aber.ac.uk"
        or not parsed.path.startswith(expected_prefix)
        or parsed.query
        or parsed.fragment
    ):
        return "Unexpected official course URL."

    if not has_department_link(page, department):
        return "Reviewed department association is missing."

    if page.get("advertised_intakes") != [
        {"month": "September", "year": 2027}
    ]:
        return "The reviewed September 2027 intake changed."

    return None


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview/apply the second reviewed Aberystwyth batch: "
        "36 September 2027 international tuition records."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        directory = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"

        source_path = latest_report(directory, "source-review.json")
        course_path = latest_report(directory, "course-evidence.json")

        source_report = read_json(source_path)
        course_report = read_json(course_path)

        for report in (source_report, course_report):
            if report.get("university_id") != "UK002":
                raise CommandError("Evidence belongs to another university.")
            validate_age(report)

        prices = extract_prices(source_report)

        pages = {}
        for page in course_report.get("pages", []):
            course_id = page.get("course_id")
            if not course_id or course_id in pages:
                raise CommandError("Missing or duplicate evidence course ID.")
            pages[course_id] = page

        proposals = []
        blocked = []
        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        report_path = directory / f"batch-two-{stamp}.json"

        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    pk="UK002",
                    country="UK",
                )
            except University.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Aberystwyth UK002 was not found.") from exc

            if university.name.strip().casefold() != "aberystwyth university":
                raise CommandError("University identity mismatch.")

            for suffix, reviewed in REVIEWED_COURSES.items():
                course_id = f"C_UK002_{suffix}"
                title, group, band, department = reviewed
                page = pages.get(course_id)

                reason = validate_page(page, title, group, department)
                if reason:
                    blocked.append({"course_id": course_id, "reason": reason})
                    continue

                try:
                    course = Course.objects.select_for_update().get(
                        pk=course_id,
                        university=university,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                except Course.DoesNotExist:
                    blocked.append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": "Active database course not found.",
                    })
                    continue

                expected_levels = (
                    {"UG"} if group == "bachelors" else {"PG", "PGT"}
                )

                if (
                    course.title != page.get("stored_title")
                    or course.duration != page.get("stored_duration")
                    or course.level != page.get("stored_level")
                    or course.level not in expected_levels
                ):
                    blocked.append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": "Database course identity requires review.",
                    })
                    continue

                records = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if len(records) != 1 or records[0].currency != "GBP":
                    blocked.append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": "A unique GBP international tuition is required.",
                    })
                    continue

                tuition = records[0]
                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )
                fee = prices[(group, band)]

                before = snapshot(course, tuition, source)

                annotation = (
                    "First study-year tuition. Placement and study-abroad "
                    "years may have different charges; this is not a "
                    "whole-course total."
                )

                raw_fees = {
                    "verified": True,
                    "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "fee_band": band,
                    "programme_fee_group": group,
                    "course_kind": (
                        "undergraduate"
                        if group == "bachelors"
                        else "postgraduate_taught"
                    ),
                    "course_source_url": page["response_url"],
                    "annual_tuition": str(fee),
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "study_year": 1,
                    "fee_method": "reviewed_course_and_published_band",
                    "scholarship_status": "pending_separate_reconciliation",
                    "deposit_status": "offer_letter_amount_required",
                    "fee_categories": [{
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": str(fee),
                        "raw_annual_fee": f"£{fee:,.2f}",
                        "footnote_marker": "",
                        "annotation": annotation,
                        "amount_requires_review": False,
                    }],
                }

                after = {
                    "course": {
                        **before["course"],
                        "start_month": "September",
                        "start_year": 2027,
                        "course_url": page["response_url"],
                    },
                    "tuition": {
                        "tuition_fee": str(fee),
                        "currency": "GBP",
                    },
                    "source": {
                        "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                        "source_url": FEE_URL,
                        "source_course_name": title,
                        "source_course_code": "",
                        "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                        "raw_fees": raw_fees,
                    },
                }

                normal_before = json.loads(json.dumps(before))
                normal_before["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = str(
                    Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
                )

                changed = normal_before != after

                proposals.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

                self.stdout.write(

                    f"September 2027 — "
                    f"{'update' if changed else 'unchanged'}"
                )

            report = {

                "database_changes_requested": bool(options["apply"]),

                "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                "source_report": str(source_path),
                "course_report": str(course_path),
                "proposals": proposals,
                "blocked": blocked,
            }

            report_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            # Apply this batch only when every reviewed course passed.
            if options["apply"] and blocked:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{len(blocked)} batch records need review. "
                    f"No batch updates applied. See {report_path}"
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for proposal in proposals:
                    if not proposal["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course = Course.objects.get(pk=proposal["course_id"])
                    tuition = Tuition.objects.get(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                    after = proposal["after"]

                    course.start_month = after["course"]["start_month"]
                    course.start_year = after["course"]["start_year"]
                    course.course_url = after["course"]["course_url"]
                    course.save(update_fields=[
                        "start_month",
                        "start_year",
                        "course_url",
                        "updated_at",
                    ])

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                        after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                    )
                    tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.pk,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=proposal["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nMatched batch records: {len(proposals)}")
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed changes: {sum(p['changed'] for p in proposals)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked in batch: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

        self.stdout.write(
            "Applied international tuition, intake and source updates."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarships, EU tuition and stored deposits were unchanged."
        )

import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction

from app.models import (
    Course,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
    University,
)


COURSE_ID = "C_UK002_91"
YEAR = "2027/28"

COURSE_URL = (
    "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/postgraduate/"
    "C801-behaviour-change/"
)
DEPARTMENT_URL = (
    "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-schemes/"
    "2027-2028/departments/department/?department=W"
)
FEE_URL = (
    "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
    "fees/postgrad/fees/"
)

EXPECTED_FEE = Decimal("23820.00")


def text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def download(session, url):
    response = session.get(url, timeout=(20, 60))
    response.raise_for_status()

    if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
        raise ValueError(f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}")

    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")

    return soup, {
        "source_url": response.url,
        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(response.content).hexdigest(),
    }


def verify_sources(session):
    course, course_evidence = download(session, COURSE_URL)
    department, department_evidence = download(session, DEPARTMENT_URL)
    fees, fee_evidence = download(session, FEE_URL)

    heading = course.find("h1")
    if heading is None or text(heading) != "Behaviour Change":
        raise ValueError("Course page title does not match.")

    course_text = text(course)

    if not re.search(r"\bC801-MSC\b", course_text, re.I):
        raise ValueError("C801 MSc course identifier not found.")

    if not re.search(
        r"\bSeptember\s+start\s+2027\b",
        course_text,
        re.I,
    ):
        raise ValueError("September 2027 intake is not confirmed.")

    if not re.search(
        r"\bCourse duration\s+1\s+year\b",
        course_text,
        re.I,
    ):
        raise ValueError("One-year duration is not confirmed.")

    department_heading = department.find("h1")
    if (
        department_heading is None
        or text(department_heading) != "Psychology 2027/2028"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Wrong departmental academic year or subject.")

    department_matches = [
        link
        for link in department.find_all("a", href=True)
        if re.search(
            r"\bMSC\s+Behaviour Change\s+\[C801\]",
            text(link),
            re.I,
        )
    ]

    if len(department_matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "A unique C801 MSc entry under Psychology is required."
        )

    # Limit extraction to September 2027 international taught-master's fees.
    selected_nodes = []
    current_year = False
    selected_section = False

    for node in fees.find_all(["h2", "h3", "table"]):
        if node.name == "h2":
            current_year = (
                text(node).casefold()
                == "tuition fees for september 2027"
            )
            selected_section = False

        elif node.name == "h3":
            label = text(node).casefold()
            selected_section = (
                current_year
                and "taught" in label
                and "international" in label
            )

        elif current_year and selected_section:
            selected_nodes.append(node)

    amounts = []
    classification_found = False

    for table in selected_nodes:
        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [
                text(cell)
                for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"], recursive=False)
            ]
            if len(cells) < 2:
                continue

            if cells[0].casefold() != "science courses":
                continue

            if re.search(r"\bPsychology\b", cells[1], re.I):
                classification_found = True

            match = re.fullmatch(
                r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                cells[1],
            )
            if match:
                amounts.append(
                    Decimal(match.group(1).replace(",", "")).quantize(
                        Decimal("0.01")
                    )
                )

    if amounts != [EXPECTED_FEE]:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected one science fee of {EXPECTED_FEE}; found {amounts}."
        )

    if not classification_found:
        raise ValueError(
            "Psychology is not explicitly classified under science fees."
        )

    return {
        "course": course_evidence,
        "department": department_evidence,
        "fee_schedule": fee_evidence,
        "method": "official_department_and_published_subject_band",
        "classification": "Psychology",
        "fee_band": "Sciences",
        "academic_year": YEAR,
        "annual_tuition": str(EXPECTED_FEE),
    }


def source_values(source):
    if source is None:
        return None

    return {
        "academic_year": source.academic_year,
        "source_url": source.source_url,
        "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
        "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
        "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
        "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or import Behaviour Change international tuition "
        "using its official Psychology classification."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                evidence = verify_sources(session)
        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            courses = Course.objects.filter(
                course_id=COURSE_ID,
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                courses = courses.select_for_update()

            try:
                course = courses.get()
            except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Active course was not found.") from exc

            if (
                course.title != "MSc Behaviour Change"
                or course.level != "PG"
                or course.duration != "1 Year"
                or course.start_month != "September"
                or course.start_year != 2027
                or course.course_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL.rstrip("/")
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database course does not match the corrected route."
                )

            tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            tuitions = list(tuitions)

            if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
                raise CommandError(
                    "A unique GBP international tuition is required."
                )

            tuition = tuitions[0]

            sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
            if options["apply"]:
                sources = sources.select_for_update()
            source = sources.first()

            if source is not None and not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                raise CommandError("Source metadata requires review.")

            before = {
                "tuition_fee": str(
                    Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)).quantize(
                        Decimal("0.01")
                    )
                ),
                "currency": tuition.currency,
                "source": source_values(source),
            }

            raw = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees if source else {})

            raw.update({
                "verified": True,
                "fee_verification_status": "verified",
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "currency": "GBP",
                "annual_tuition": str(EXPECTED_FEE),
                "fee_band": "Sciences",
                "programme_fee_group": "masters",
                "course_kind": "postgraduate_taught",
                "course_source_url": COURSE_URL,
                "study_year": 1,
                "fee_method": evidence["method"],
                "fee_classification_evidence": evidence,
                "fee_review": {
                    "status": "resolved",
                    "reason": (
                        "The 2027/28 Psychology departmental register "
                        "lists C801 MSc Behaviour Change. The international "
                        "taught-master's fee schedule classifies Psychology "
                        "as Science."
                    ),
                },
                "scholarship_status": "pending_separate_reconciliation",
                "deposit_status": "offer_letter_amount_required",
                "fee_categories": [{
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": str(EXPECTED_FEE),
                    "raw_annual_fee": "£23,820",
                    "annotation": (
                        "Full-time taught master's fee, mapped through "
                        "the official Psychology departmental register."
                    ),
                    "footnote_marker": "",
                    "amount_requires_review": False,
                }],
            })

            display_notes = raw.get("display_notes", {})
            if not isinstance(display_notes, dict):
                display_notes = {}

            display_notes.pop("fee", None)
            display_notes["scholarship"] = (
                "Scholarship applicability requires separate reconciliation."
            )
            display_notes["deposit"] = (
                "Confirm the deposit amount in the individual offer letter."
            )
            raw["display_notes"] = display_notes

            after = {
                "tuition_fee": str(EXPECTED_FEE),
                "currency": "GBP",
                "source": {
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": FEE_URL,
                    "source_course_name": "Behaviour Change",
                    "source_course_code": "C801",
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "raw_fees": raw,
                },
            }

            changed = before != after
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            report_path = folder / (
                "behaviour-change-fee-"
                + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
                + ".json"
            )

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                        "mode": (
                            "apply_requested"
                            if options["apply"]
                            else "preview"
                        ),
                        "course_id": COURSE_ID,
                        "changed": changed,
                        "evidence": evidence,
                        "before": before,
                        "after": after,
                    },
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            self.stdout.write(
                f"{COURSE_ID}: GBP {before['tuition_fee']} "
                f"-> {EXPECTED_FEE}; September 2027 / {YEAR} — "
                f"{'update' if changed else 'unchanged'}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Proposed changes: {int(changed)}")
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            if changed:
                tuition.tuition_fee = EXPECTED_FEE
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=after["source"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=COURSE_ID,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=before,
                    after=after,

# Course ID: academic year, programme fee group, subject band,
# expected reviewed fee, course kind.
FEES = {
    "C_ABE002_RES_02": (
        "2027/28", "masters", "Sciences", "23820.00",
        "postgraduate_mres",
    ),
