        "tuition": {
            "tuition_fee": str(tuition.tuition_fee),
            "currency": tuition.currency,
            "scholarship": str(tuition.scholarship),
            "scholarship_source_id": tuition.scholarship_source_id,
        },
        "source": (
            {
                "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                "source_url": source.source_url,
                "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
            }
            if source is not None
            else None
        ),
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or import two reviewed ARU September 2027 "
        "campus routes and extend existing award/deposit scopes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help="Optional path to campus-intake-evidence.json.",
        )

    def read_evidence(self, supplied_path):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)

        if supplied_path:
            path = Path(supplied_path)
            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = root / path
        else:
            files = sorted(
                (root / "logs" / "aru").glob(
                    "campus-intakes-*/campus-intake-evidence.json"
                )
            )
            if not files:
                raise CommandError(
                    "No campus-intake-evidence.json found."
                )
            path = files[-1]

        try:
            data = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(data, dict)
            or data.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or data.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(data.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Evidence is invalid or contains collection errors."
            )

        return path, data

    def validate_page(self, folder, pages, target):
        url = (
            "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"
            + target["slug"]
        )

        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if isinstance(page, dict)
            and page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/")
            == url
        ]

        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Expected one collected source page: {url}"
            )

        page = matches[0]
        filename = page.get("html_file")

        if (
            not isinstance(filename, str)
            or Path(filename).name != filename
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid evidence HTML filename.")

        try:
            content = (folder / filename).read_bytes()
        except OSError as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Missing saved HTML evidence: {filename}"
            ) from exc

        digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

        if digest != page.get("sha256"):
            raise CommandError(
                f"Saved HTML hash does not match: {filename}"
            )

        # Confirm the campus and date within the same standard
        # three-year, full-time course instance.
        instances = []

        for script in page.get("scripts", []):
            parsed = script.get("parsed_json")
            if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
                continue

            values = parsed.get("hasCourseInstance", [])
            if isinstance(values, dict):
                values = [values]

            if isinstance(values, list):
                instances.extend(values)

        matched_instance = any(
            isinstance(instance, dict)
            and instance.get("name") == "Full-time"
            and instance.get("courseWorkload") == "P3Y"
            and instance.get("startdate") == "2027-09"
            and instance.get("duration", "").casefold()
            in {"3 years", "3 years full-time"}
            and any(
                isinstance(location, dict)
                and location.get("name") == target["campus"]
                for location in instance.get("location", [])
            )
            for instance in instances
        )

        if not matched_instance:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Standard September 2027 campus route "
                f"was not confirmed: {url}"
            )

        # Select the standard honours fee section, stopping
        # before the separately published placement route.
        text = page.get("text", "")
        section = re.search(
            r"International students\s+BSc \(Hons\).*?"
            r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+(.*?)"
            r"(?=\s+With placement\b)",
            text,
            flags=re.S,
        )

        if section is None:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot isolate the standard BSc fee section: {url}"
            )

        amounts = {
            Decimal(value.replace(",", ""))
            for value in re.findall(
                r"£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                r"International students starting 2027/28\s+"
                r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                section.group(1),
            )
        }

        if amounts != {Decimal(target["amount"])}:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected standard-route fee for {url}: "
                f"{sorted(str(value) for value in amounts)}"
            )

        if not re.search(
            rf"UCAS course code\s+{re.escape(target['code'])}\b",
            text,
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                f"UCAS code not confirmed: {target['code']}"
            )

        return url, digest

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        evidence_path, evidence = self.read_evidence(
            options["evidence"]
        )

        verified_pages = {
            course_id: self.validate_page(
                evidence_path.parent,
                evidence["pages"],
                target,
            )
            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
        }

        now = timezone.now()
        directory = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        output = directory / (
            "confirmed-campus-import-"
            + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        report = {
            "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
            "courses": [],
            "scholarship_rules": [],
            "deposit_policy": None,
        }

        # Validate and plan everything before making changes.
        with transaction.atomic():
            plans = []

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                course = (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        course_id=course_id,
                        university_id="UK003",
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .first()
                )

                if course is None:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: active course not found."
                    )

                if (
                    course.title != target["title"]
                    or course.level != "UG"
                    or course.location
                    != target["campus"] + " Campus"
                    or course.duration != "3 Years"
                    or course.work_placement
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: stored route differs from "
                        "the reviewed standard campus route."
                    )

                tuitions = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if (
                    len(tuitions) != 1
                    or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: one GBP international "
                        "tuition record is required."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]
                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                before = snapshot(course, tuition, source)
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)
                url, digest = verified_pages[course_id]

                after["course"].update({
                    "start_month": "September",
                    "start_year": 2027,
                    "intake_months": "September",
                    "course_url": url,
                    "ucas_cao_code": target["code"],
                })

                after["tuition"].update({
                    "tuition_fee": target["amount"],
                    "scholarship": "0.00",
                    "scholarship_source_id": None,
                })

                raw = (
                    copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
                    if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    else {}
                )

                raw.update({
                    "verified": True,
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                    "study_year": 1,
                    "course_kind": "undergraduate",
                    "fee_method": "reviewed_standard_campus_route",
                    "course_source_url": url,
                    "campus": target["campus"],
                    "intake": "September 2027",
                    "route": "standard_three_year_honours",
                    "source_sha256": digest,
                    "scholarship_status": (
                        "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                    ),
                    "deposit_status": (
                        "verified_policy_eligibility_required"
                    ),
                    "fee_note": (
                        "Published annual international tuition "
                        "for the standard three-year honours "
                        "route, September 2027. Foundation and "
                        "placement routes are excluded."
                    ),
                    "fee_categories": [{
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                        "amount_requires_review": False,
                    }],
                })
                raw.pop("verification_reason", None)

                after["source"] = {
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": url,
                    "source_course_code": target["code"],
                    "source_course_name": target["title"],
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "raw_fees": raw,
                }

                # Compare amounts numerically so Decimal display
                # differences do not create repeated updates.
                comparable_before = copy.deepcopy(before)
                for field in ("tuition_fee", "scholarship"):
                    comparable_before["tuition"][field] = (
                        f"{Decimal(before['tuition'][field]):.2f}"
                    )

                changed = comparable_before != after

                plans.append(
                    (course, tuition, after, changed)
                )
                report["courses"].append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

            rule_plans = []

            for name in RULE_NAMES:
                rules = list(
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                        scholarship__name=name,
                        verified=True,
                    )
                )

                if len(rules) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Expected one verified rule: {name}"
                    )

                rule = rules[0]
                old = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)

                if (
                    not isinstance(old, dict)
                    or old.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                    or old.get("kind") != "fixed"
                    or old.get("study_years") != [1]
                    or not isinstance(old.get("conditions"), dict)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unsupported saved rule: {name}"
                    )

                existing_ids = old["conditions"].get("course_id")
                if (
                    not isinstance(existing_ids, list)
                    or not all(
                        isinstance(value, str)
                        for value in existing_ids
                    )
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Invalid course scope: {name}"
                    )

                new = copy.deepcopy(old)
                new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(existing_ids) | set(TARGETS)
                )

                rule_plans.append((rule, new, new != old))
                report["scholarship_rules"].append({
                    "name": name,
                    "changed": new != old,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })

            policies = list(
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                )
            )

            if len(policies) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected one verified ARU GBP deposit policy."
                )

            policy = policies[0]
            old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

            if (
                not isinstance(old_policy, dict)
                or old_policy.get("schema_version") != 1
                or old_policy.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old_policy.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or old_policy.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
                or old_policy.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
                or not isinstance(
                    old_policy.get("course_ids"), list
                )
                or not all(
                    isinstance(value, str)
                    for value in old_policy["course_ids"]
                )
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Saved ARU deposit policy requires review."
                )

            try:
                deposit_amount = Decimal(
                    str(old_policy["amount"])
                )
                if (
                    not deposit_amount.is_finite()
                    or deposit_amount != Decimal("4000.00")
                ):
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected the existing GBP 4,000 policy."
                ) from exc

            new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)
            new_policy["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(old_policy["course_ids"]) | set(TARGETS)
            )
            policy_changed = new_policy != old_policy

            report["deposit_policy"] = {
                "changed": policy_changed,
                "before": old_policy,
                "after": new_policy,
            }

            proposed = (
                sum(plan[3] for plan in plans)
                + sum(plan[2] for plan in rule_plans)
                + int(policy_changed)
            )
            report["proposed_items"] = proposed

            # Save the reviewable plan before any database writes.
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for course, tuition, after, changed in plans:
                    if not changed:
                        continue

                    for field, value in after["course"].items():
                        setattr(course, field, value)

                    course.save(
                        update_fields=COURSE_FIELDS + ["updated_at"]
                    )

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                        after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                    )
                    tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                    tuition.scholarship_source_id = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "tuition_fee",
                        "scholarship",
                        "scholarship_source",
                    ])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    entry = next(
                        item
                        for item in report["courses"]
                        if item["course_id"] == course.course_id
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=entry["after"],
                    )

                for rule, new, changed in rule_plans:
                    if changed:
                        rule.rules = new
                        rule.save(update_fields=["rules"])

                if policy_changed:
                    policy.rules = new_policy
                    policy.save(
                        update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"]
                    )

        # The transaction has committed successfully here.
        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_items"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["courses"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{entry['before']['tuition']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{entry['after']['tuition']['tuition_fee']}; "
                f"September 2027 — {state}"
            )

        for entry in report["scholarship_rules"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            count = len(
                entry["after"]["conditions"]["course_id"]
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['name']}: {count} courses — {state}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Deposit scope: "
            f"{len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {report['proposed_items']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Reviewed tuition, source metadata and applicable "
                "scholarship/deposit scopes saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Eligibility questions preserved. Scholarship "
            "deductions remain conditional. Numeric stored "
            "deposits unchanged."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Law and Construction Management remain pending."
        )

def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {
        name: copy.deepcopy(getattr(obj, name))
        for name in fields
    }


def standard_fee_evidence(body):
    """
    Return the standard international route's fee block.

    Optional placement, foundation, accelerated and part-time
    sections are excluded.
    """
    marker = body.rfind("Fees and funding")
    if marker < 0:
        raise ValueError("Fee section is missing.")

    section = body[marker:]
    international = re.search(
        r"\bInternational students\b", section
    )
    if international is None:
        raise ValueError("International fee section is missing.")

    section = section[international.end():]

    first_price = section.find("£")
    if first_price < 0:
        raise ValueError("No international price was captured.")

    # Route-tab labels occur before the first price.
    section = section[first_price:]

    boundaries = [
        " With placement",
        " With foundation",
        " 2 years accelerated",
        " Part-time",
        " 5 years",
        " Placement year fee",
        " Additional course costs",
        " Living costs",
        " Apply for ",
    ]

    ends = [
        position
        for boundary in boundaries
        if (position := section.find(boundary)) >= 0
    ]

    return section[:min(ends)] if ends else section


class Command(BaseCommand):

                        body,
                    ):
                        # A word boundary after ')' is unsuitable
                        # when followed by whitespace: use plain prefix.
                        expected_prefix = (
                            f"Undergraduate {new_award} (Hons)"
                        )
                        if not body.strip().startswith(expected_prefix):
                            raise ValueError(
                                "Published honours award differs."
                            )

                    fee_excerpt = standard_fee_evidence(body)

                    amounts = {
                        Decimal(value.replace(",", ""))
                        for value in re.findall(
                            r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)"
                            r"\s+International students starting"
                            r"\s+2027/28"
                            r"\s+\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                            fee_excerpt,
                            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                        )
                    }

                    amount = Decimal(expected_fee)

                    if amounts != {amount}:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The standard-route international "
                            f"fee differs or is ambiguous: "
                            f"{sorted(amounts)}."
                        )

                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university_id="UK003",
                        )
                    )

                    old_title = f"{old_award} (Hons) {subject}"
                    new_title = f"{new_award} (Hons) {subject}"

                    if (
                        course.title not in {old_title, new_title}
                        or course.level != "UG"
                        or course.duration.strip().casefold()
                        != "3 years"
                        or not course.is_active
                        or course.work_placement
                        or course.location not in {
                            f"{old_campus} Campus",
                            f"{new_campus} Campus",
                        }
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Stored title, campus, duration or "
                            "placement status needs review."
                        )

                    rows = list(
                        Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                            course=course,
                            residency="INTL",
                        )
                    )

                    if (
                        len(rows) != 1
                        or rows[0].currency != "GBP"
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Exactly one GBP international "
                            "tuition record is required."
                        )

                    tuition = rows[0]
                    source = (
                        TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                        .filter(tuition=tuition)
                        .first()
                    )

                    before = {
                        "course": snapshot(course, COURSE_FIELDS),
                        "tuition_fee": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)), ".2f"
                        ),
                        "source": snapshot(source, SOURCE_FIELDS),
                    }

                    after_course = {
                        **before["course"],
                        "title": new_title,
                        "location": f"{new_campus} Campus",
                        "start_month": "September",
                        "start_year": 2027,
                        "course_url": url,
                        "ucas_cao_code": ucas,
                    }

                    corrections = {
                        key: {
                            "before": before["course"][key],
                            "after": after_course[key],
                        }
                        for key in ("title", "location")
                        if before["course"][key] != after_course[key]
                    }

                    raw = {
                        "verified": True,
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "course_kind": "undergraduate_taught",
                        "study_year": 1,
                        "study_mode": "full_time",
                        "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "campus": new_campus,
                        "source_course_code": ucas,
                        "course_source_url": url,
                        "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                        "source_checked_at": page.get("checked_at"),
                        "fee_method": (
                            "reviewed_standard_route_fee"
                        ),
                        "standard_route_fee_evidence": fee_excerpt,
                        "scholarship_status": (
                            "pending_scope_extension"
                        ),
                        "deposit_status": (
                            "pending_scope_extension"
                        ),
                        "fee_note": (
                            f"Published annual international fee "
                            f"for the standard three-year "
                            f"{new_award} (Hons) route at "
                            f"{new_campus}, September 2027. "
                            "Foundation, accelerated and placement "
                            "routes are excluded."
                        ),
                        "fee_categories": [{
                            "source_fee_category": "International",
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "currency": "GBP",
                            "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                            "amount_requires_review": False,
                        }],
                    }

                    # Keep original correction history on repeat runs.
                    existing_raw = (
                        source.raw_fees
                        if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                        else {}
                    )
                    history = copy.deepcopy(
                        existing_raw.get(
                            "reviewed_course_corrections", {}
                        )
                    )
                    for key, value in corrections.items():
                        history.setdefault(key, value)

                    if history:
                        raw["reviewed_course_corrections"] = history

                    after = {
                        "course": after_course,
                        "tuition_fee": str(amount),
                        "source": {
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "source_url": url,
                            "source_course_code": ucas,
                            "source_course_name": subject,
                            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                            "raw_fees": raw,
                        },
                    }

                    record = {
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "changed": before != after,
                        "before": before,
                        "after": after,
                    }
                    report["records"].append(record)
                    pending.append((course, tuition, record))

                except (ValueError, Course.DoesNotExist) as exc:
                    report["blocked"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

            if report["blocked"]:
                save_report()
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{len(report['blocked'])} records blocked. "
                    f"No changes applied. Report: {output}"
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for course, tuition, record in pending:
                    if not record["changed"]:
                        continue

                    after = record["after"]
                    changed_fields = []

                    for key, value in after["course"].items():
                        if getattr(course, key) != value:
                            setattr(course, key, value)
                            changed_fields.append(key)

                    if changed_fields:
                        course.save(update_fields=[
                            *changed_fields, "updated_at"
                        ])

                    amount = Decimal(after["tuition_fee"])
                    if tuition.tuition_fee != amount:
                        tuition.tuition_fee = amount
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                report["database_changes"] = any(
                    row["changed"] for row in report["records"]
                )

        save_report()

        for record in report["records"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{record['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{record['before']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{record['after']['tuition_fee']} — "
                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

            for field in ("title", "location"):
                old = record["before"]["course"][field]
                new = record["after"]["course"][field]
                if old != new:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {old} -> {new}"
                    )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nMatched records: {len(report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Proposed/updated records: "
            f"{sum(r['changed'] for r in report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Blocked: {len(report['blocked'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed course corrections and tuition sources saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship and deposit scope extensions are pending. "
            "Stored discounts and deposits unchanged."
        )

def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {
        name: copy.deepcopy(getattr(obj, name))
        for name in fields
    }


def extract_configuration(page):
    """Parse the JSON assignment without executing JavaScript."""
    configurations = []

    for script in page.get("embedded_scripts", []):
        text = script.get("text", "")
        match = re.search(
            r"\b(?:var|let|const)\s+configOptions\s*=\s*",
            text,
        )
        if not match:
            continue

        try:
            value, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(
                text[match.end():].lstrip()
            )
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot parse the embedded course configuration."
            ) from exc

        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            raise ValueError("Course configuration is not an object.")

        configurations.append(value)

    if len(configurations) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "Exactly one embedded course configuration is required."
        )

    return configurations[0]


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply 10 reviewed ARU postgraduate annual "
        "fees from embedded course configuration."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--report",
            help="Path to remaining-evidence.json.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        logs = root / "logs" / "aru"
        logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if options["report"]:
            evidence_path = Path(options["report"])
            if not evidence_path.is_absolute():
                evidence_path = root / evidence_path
        else:
            files = list(
                logs.glob(
                    "remaining-evidence-*/remaining-evidence.json"
                )
            )
            if not files:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Run inspect_aru_remaining_evidence first."
                )
            evidence_path = max(
                files, key=lambda path: path.parent.name
            )

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                evidence_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError("Evidence is not for UK003.")

        pages = {}
        for page in evidence.get("pages", []):
            requested = page.get("requested_url", "").rstrip("/")
            if requested:
                if requested in pages:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Duplicate page evidence: {requested}"
                    )
                pages[requested] = page

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        output = logs / f"embedded-pg-import-{stamp}.json"

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path.resolve()),
            "records": [],
            "blocked": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

def normalise_url(value):
    return value.rstrip("/")


def snapshot_source(source):
    if source is None:
        return None

    return {
        name: copy.deepcopy(getattr(source, name))
        for name in (
            "academic_year",
            "source_url",
            "source_course_code",
            "source_course_name",
            "fee_basis",
            "raw_fees",
        )
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply 15 reviewed ARU postgraduate "
        "international annual fees for September 2027."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--report",
            help="Path to the collected course-evidence.json.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        logs = root / "logs" / "aru"
        logs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        if options["report"]:
            evidence_path = Path(options["report"])
            if not evidence_path.is_absolute():
                evidence_path = root / evidence_path
        else:
            files = list(
                logs.glob("courses-*/course-evidence.json")
            )
            if not files:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Run inspect_aru_courses first."
                )
            evidence_path = max(
                files, key=lambda item: item.parent.name
            )

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                evidence_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read course evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError("Evidence is not for UK003.")

        # Use requested URLs to avoid confusing redirected pages.
        pages = {}
        for page in evidence.get("pages", []):
            requested = page.get("requested_url")
            if not requested:
                continue

            key = normalise_url(requested)
            if key in pages:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Duplicate requested-page evidence: {key}"
                )
            pages[key] = page

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        output = logs / f"pg-import-{stamp}.json"

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path.resolve()),
            "records": [],
            "blocked": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            pending = []

            for (
                suffix, slug, stored_title,
                heading, campus, expected_fee
            ) in BATCH:
                course_id = f"C_UK003_{suffix}"
                url = BASE + slug

                try:
                    page = pages.get(normalise_url(url))
                    if page is None:
                        raise ValueError("Course evidence is missing.")

                    if normalise_url(
                        page.get("source_url", "")
                    ) != normalise_url(url):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The page redirected to a different route."
                        )

                    if not page.get("sha256"):
                        raise ValueError("Source hash is missing.")

                    if page.get("title", "").strip() != heading:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The published course heading differs."
                        )

                    if course_id not in page.get(
                        "candidate_course_ids", []
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The page is not a recorded candidate "
                            "for this course."
                        )

                    body = page.get("text", "").split(
                        "End of main navigation."
                    )[-1]

                    route = re.search(
                        r"Start date\s+(.*?)\s+Location\s+(.*?)"
                        r"\s+Award\s+(.*?)\s+Duration"
                        r"\s+1 year full-time\b",
                        body,
                        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                    )

                    if route is None:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The standard one-year full-time "
                            "route is not confirmed."
                        )

                    if "September 2027" not in route.group(1):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "September 2027 intake is not confirmed."
                        )

                    if route.group(2).strip().casefold() != campus.casefold():
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The advertised campus differs."
                        )

                    award = "MBA" if suffix == "80" else "MSc"
                    if route.group(3).strip() != award:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The advertised award differs."
                        )

                    fee_marker = body.rfind("Fees and funding")
                    if fee_marker < 0:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The fee section is missing."
                        )

                    amounts = {
                        Decimal(value.replace(",", ""))
                        for value in re.findall(
                            r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)"
                            r"\s+International students starting"
                            r"\s+2027/28"
                            r"\s+\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                            body[fee_marker:],
                            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                        )
                    }

                    amount = Decimal(expected_fee)
                    if amounts != {amount}:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "The international annual fee differs "
                            f"or is ambiguous: {sorted(amounts)}."
                        )

                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university_id="UK003",
                        )
                    )

                    if (
                        course.title != stored_title
                        or course.level not in {"PG", "PGT"}
                        or course.duration.strip().casefold()
                        != "1 year"
                        or not course.is_active
                        or course.location.split()[0].casefold()
                        != campus.casefold()
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Stored title, level, duration, campus "
                            "or active status needs review."
                        )

                    tuitions = list(
                        Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                        .filter(course=course, residency="INTL")
                    )

                    if (
                        len(tuitions) != 1
                        or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Exactly one GBP international "
                            "tuition record is required."
                        )

                    tuition = tuitions[0]
                    source = (
                        TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                        .filter(tuition=tuition)
                        .first()
                    )

                    before_course = {
                        name: getattr(course, name)
                        for name in (
                            "title", "level", "duration",
                            "location", "start_month",
                            "start_year", "course_url",
                        )
                    }

                    before = {
                        "course": before_course,
                        "tuition_fee": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)),
                            ".2f",
                        ),
                        "source": snapshot_source(source),
                    }

                    after_course = {
                        **before_course,
                        "start_month": "September",
                        "start_year": 2027,
                        "course_url": url,
                    }

                    raw = {
                        "verified": True,
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "course_kind": "postgraduate_taught",
                        "study_year": 1,
                        "study_mode": "full_time",
                        "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "course_source_url": url,
                        "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                        "source_checked_at": page.get("checked_at"),
                        "fee_method": "reviewed_named_course_fee",
                        "scholarship_status": "pending_separate_review",
                        "deposit_status": "pending_scope_extension",
                        "fee_note": (
                            "Published 2027/28 international annual "
                            "fee for the standard September 2027 "
                            "one-year full-time course. Optional "
                            "professional-experience routes are "
                            "excluded."
                        ),
                        "fee_categories": [{
                            "source_fee_category": "International",
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "currency": "GBP",
                            "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                            "amount_requires_review": False,
                        }],
                    }

                    after_source = {
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "source_url": url,
                        "source_course_code": "",
                        "source_course_name": heading,
                        "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                        "raw_fees": raw,
                    }

                    after = {
                        "course": after_course,
                        "tuition_fee": str(amount),
                        "source": after_source,
                    }

                    record = {
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "changed": before != after,
                        "before": before,
                        "after": after,
                    }
                    report["records"].append(record)
                    pending.append((course, tuition, record))

                except (ValueError, Course.DoesNotExist) as exc:
                    report["blocked"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

            if report["blocked"]:
                save_report()
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{len(report['blocked'])} records blocked. "
                    f"No changes applied. Report: {output}"
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for course, tuition, record in pending:
                    if not record["changed"]:
                        continue

                    after = record["after"]
                    changed_fields = []

                    for name, value in after["course"].items():
                        if getattr(course, name) != value:
                            setattr(course, name, value)
                            changed_fields.append(name)

                    if changed_fields:
                        course.save(
                            update_fields=[
                                *changed_fields, "updated_at"
                            ]
                        )

                    amount = Decimal(after["tuition_fee"])
                    if tuition.tuition_fee != amount:
                        tuition.tuition_fee = amount
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                report["database_changes"] = any(
                    row["changed"]
                    for row in report["records"]
                )

        save_report()

        for record in report["records"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{record['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{record['before']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{record['after']['tuition_fee']}; "
                "September 2027 — "
                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nMatched records: {len(report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Proposed/updated records: "
            f"{sum(row['changed'] for row in report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Blocked: {len(report['blocked'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed tuition, intake and source updates applied."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarships and deposit scope require separate "
            "reconciliation. Stored discounts and deposits unchanged."
        )

def read_json(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CommandError(f"Cannot read {path}: {exc}") from exc


def canonical_url(value):
    return value.rstrip("/")


def course_snapshot(course):
    fields = [
        "title",
        "level",
        "duration",
        "location",
        "start_month",
        "start_year",
        "course_url",
        "ucas_cao_code",
        "is_active",
    ]
    return {name: getattr(course, name) for name in fields}


def source_snapshot(source):
    if source is None:
        return None

    return {
        "academic_year": source.academic_year,
        "source_url": source.source_url,
        "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
        "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
        "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
        "raw_fees": source.raw_fees,
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply 24 reviewed ARU undergraduate "

    )

            help="Path to course-evidence.json.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):

                except (
                    ValueError,
                    Course.DoesNotExist,
                ) as exc:
                    report["blocked"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

            # Validate every record before changing any record.
            if report["blocked"]:
                save_report()
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{len(report['blocked'])} records blocked. "
                    f"No changes applied. Review: {output}"
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for record in report["records"]:
                    if not record["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course = Course.objects.get(
                        course_id=record["course_id"]
                    )
                    tuition = Tuition.objects.get(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                        currency="GBP",
                    )
                    after = record["after"]

                    changed_fields = []

                    for name, value in after["course"].items():
                        if getattr(course, name) != value:
                            setattr(course, name, value)
                            changed_fields.append(name)

                    if changed_fields:
                        course.save(
                            update_fields=[
                                *changed_fields, "updated_at"
                            ]
                        )

                    new_fee = Decimal(after["tuition_fee"])
                    if tuition.tuition_fee != new_fee:
                        tuition.tuition_fee = new_fee
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                report["database_changes"] = any(
                    row["changed"] for row in report["records"]
                )

        save_report()

        for record in report["records"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{record['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{record['before']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{record['after']['tuition_fee']}; "
                f"September 2027 — "
                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nMatched records: {len(report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Proposed/updated records: "
            f"{sum(row['changed'] for row in report['records'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Reviewed tuition, intake and source updates applied."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarships and deposit policies require "
            "separate reconciliation."
        )

            with open(courses_file, newline='', encoding='utf-8') as f:
                reader = csv.DictReader(f)
                courses_imported = 0
                courses_skipped = 0
                
                for row in reader:
                    try:
                        university = University.objects.get(university_id=row['university_id'])
                        subject = Subject.objects.filter(subject_code=row['subject_code']).first()
                        
                        # Ensure level is set to TOPUP (the CSV should have "topup" or "TOPUP" in level column)
                        level_value = row['level'].upper()
                        if level_value not in ['TOPUP', 'TOP-UP']:
                            level_value = 'TOPUP'
                        
                        Course.objects.update_or_create(
                            course_id=row['course_id'],
                            defaults={
                                'university': university,
                                'subject': subject,
                                'title': row['title'],
                                'level': 'TOPUP',  # Force TOPUP level

                                'location': row['location'],
                                'start_year': row['start_year'],
                                'start_month': row.get('start_month', ''),

                                'intake_months': row.get('start_month', ''),

FILE: app\management\commands\inspect_aberystwyth_courses.py
import hashlib
import json
import re
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from app.models import Course


def clean_text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def normalise(value):
    value = value.casefold().replace("&", " and ")
    return " ".join(
        re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", value).split()
    )


def read_json(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(
            path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        )
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CommandError(
            f"Cannot read {path}: {exc}"
        ) from exc


def extract_page(html, response_url):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    heading = soup.find("h1")

    if heading is None:
        raise ValueError("Course heading missing.")

    title = clean_text(heading)

    if not title:
        raise ValueError("Course heading is empty.")

    main = (
        soup.find("main")
        or soup.find(attrs={"role": "main"})
        or soup.body
    )

    if main is None:
        raise ValueError("Course content missing.")

    for element in main.find_all(
        ["script", "style", "nav", "footer", "noscript"]
    ):
        element.decompose()

    content = clean_text(main)

    intakes = sorted(set(
        re.findall(
            r"(?:Available for|viewing this course for)"
            r"\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+start\s+(20\d{2})",
            content,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    ))

    links = []
    seen = set()

    for link in main.find_all("a", href=True):
        url = urljoin(response_url, link["href"])
        parsed = urlsplit(url)

        if (
            parsed.scheme != "https"
            or parsed.hostname not in (
                "www.aber.ac.uk",
                "aber.ac.uk",
                "courses.aber.ac.uk",
            )
        ):
            continue

        label = clean_text(link)
        key = (label, url)

        if key in seen:
            continue

        seen.add(key)
        links.append({"text": label, "url": url})

    tables = []

    for table in main.find_all("table"):
        rows = []

        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])

            if cells:
                rows.append([
                    clean_text(cell)
                    for cell in cells
                ])

        if rows:
            tables.append(rows)

    return {
        "title": title,
        "page_title": (
            clean_text(soup.title)
            if soup.title
            else ""
        ),
        "advertised_intakes": [
            {"month": month, "year": int(year)}
            for month, year in intakes
        ],
        "text": content,
        "links": links,
        "tables": tables,
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Collect course-page evidence for unique Aberystwyth "
        "catalogue candidates. No database updates."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--matches",
            type=Path,
            help="Path to an existing course-matches.json report.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        base_directory = root / "logs" / "aberystwyth"

        matches_path = options["matches"]

        if matches_path is None:
            paths = list(
                base_directory.glob("*/course-matches.json")
            )

            if not paths:
                raise CommandError(
                    "No course-matches.json found. Run "
                    "preview_aberystwyth_matches first."
                )

            matches_path = max(
                paths,
                key=lambda path: path.parent.name,
            )

        matches = read_json(matches_path)

        if matches.get("university_id") != "UK002":
            raise CommandError(
                "The match report is not for Aberystwyth."
            )

        records = matches.get("records")

        if not isinstance(records, list):
            raise CommandError("Invalid match-report records.")

        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        directory = base_directory / stamp
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        courses = {
            course.course_id: course
            for course in Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            )
        }

        report = {
            "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK002",
            "database_changes": False,
            "matches_file": str(matches_path),
            "pages": [],
            "held": [],
        }

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )

            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for row in records:
                course = courses.get(row["course_id"])

                if course is None:
                    continue

                candidates = [
                    candidate
                    for candidate in row.get("candidates", [])
                    if not any(
                        flag in candidate.get("flags", [])
                        for flag in (
                            "award_mismatch",
                            "duration_mismatch",
                        )
                    )
                ]

                if len(candidates) != 1:
                    report["held"].append({
                        "course_id": course.course_id,
                        "title": course.title,
                        "reason": (
                            "No unique candidate matching "
                            "title, award and duration."
                        ),
                    })
                    continue

                # Do not collapse a research MSc into a taught MSc.
                if re.search(
                    r"\(\s*research\s*\)|\bby research\b",
                    course.title,
                    flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                ):
                    report["held"].append({
                        "course_id": course.course_id,
                        "title": course.title,
                        "reason": (
                            "Research-route identity needs "
                            "separate confirmation."
                        ),
                    })
                    continue

                candidate = candidates[0]
                url = candidate["source_url"]
                parsed = urlsplit(url)

                if (
                    parsed.scheme != "https"
                    or parsed.hostname != "courses.aber.ac.uk"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unexpected candidate URL: {url}"
                    )

                page = {
                    "course_id": course.course_id,
                    "stored_title": course.title,
                    "stored_level": course.level,
                    "stored_duration": course.duration,
                    "stored_intake": {
                        "month": course.start_month,
                        "year": course.start_year,
                    },
                    "catalogue_candidate": candidate,
                    "source_url": url,
                    "approved": False,
                }

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"Reading {course.course_id}: {url}"
                )

                try:
                    response = session.get(
                        url,
                        timeout=(30, 60),
                    )
                    response.raise_for_status()

                    final = urlsplit(response.url)

                    if (
                        final.scheme != "https"
                        or final.hostname != "courses.aber.ac.uk"
                        or final.path.rstrip("/")
                        != parsed.path.rstrip("/")
                        or final.query != parsed.query
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                        )

                    html = response.content.decode("utf-8-sig")
                    extracted = extract_page(
                        html,
                        response.url,
                    )

                    if (
                        normalise(extracted["title"])
                        != normalise(candidate["subject_title"])
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Course-page title differs from "
                            "the catalogue candidate."
                        )

                    snapshot = directory / (
                        f"{course.course_id}.html"
                    )
                    snapshot.write_bytes(response.content)

                    intake_matches = any(
                        intake["year"] == course.start_year
                        and intake["month"].casefold()
                        == course.start_month.casefold()
                        for intake in extracted["advertised_intakes"]
                    )

                    page.update(extracted)
                    page.update({
                        "response_url": response.url,
                        "status": "collected",
                        "stored_intake_advertised": intake_matches,
                        "html_snapshot": str(snapshot),
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                            response.content
                        ).hexdigest(),
                        "review_note": (
                            "Intake found; award, route and fee band "
                            "still require verification."
                            if intake_matches
                            else
                            "Stored intake was not found in the "
                            "recognised page wording. Review required."
                        ),
                    })

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    UnicodeDecodeError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    page["status"] = "needs_review"
                    page["error"] = str(exc)

                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"Needs review: {exc}"
                    )

                report["pages"].append(page)
                time.sleep(1)

        report["summary"] = {
            "pages_attempted": len(report["pages"]),
            "pages_collected": sum(
                page["status"] == "collected"
                for page in report["pages"]
            ),
            "pages_needing_review": sum(
                page["status"] != "collected"
                for page in report["pages"]
            ),
            "stored_intake_advertised": sum(
                page.get("stored_intake_advertised") is True
                for page in report["pages"]
            ),
            "held_courses": len(report["held"]),
        }

        output = directory / "course-evidence.json"

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(report["summary"], indent=2)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "No mappings approved. No database records changed."
        )

CANDIDATES = {
    "C_ABE002_01": (
        "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/undergraduate/"

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Collect official evidence for five remaining Aberystwyth "
        "course candidates. No database changes."
    )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aberystwyth"
            / f"next-batch-{stamp}"
        )
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        pages = []

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for course_id, url in CANDIDATES.items():
                course = Course.objects.filter(
                    pk=course_id,
                    university_id="UK002",
                    is_active=True,
                ).first()

                record = {
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "source_url": url,
                    "approved": False,
                }

                if course is None:
                    record.update({
                        "status": "needs_review",
                        "error": "Active database course not found.",
                    })
                    pages.append(record)
                    continue

                record["stored"] = {
                    "title": course.title,
                    "level": course.level,
                    "duration": course.duration,
                    "start_month": course.start_month,
                    "start_year": course.start_year,
                    "course_url": course.course_url,
                    "ucas_cao_code": course.ucas_cao_code,
                    "work_placement": course.work_placement,
                }

                self.stdout.write(f"Reading {course_id}: {url}")

                try:
                    html, main = download(session, url)
                    heading = main.find("h1")

                    if heading is None:
                        raise ValueError("Official course heading missing.")

                    content = text(main)

                    intake_matches = re.findall(
                        r"(?:Available for|viewing this course for)"
                        r"\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+start\s+(\d{4})",
                        content,
                        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                    )

                    intakes = [
                        {"month": month.title(), "year": year}
                        for month, year in sorted({
                            (month, int(year))
                            for month, year in intake_matches
                        })
                    ]

                    if not intakes:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Advertised intake could not be extracted."
                        )

                    snapshot_path = directory / f"{course_id}.html"
                    snapshot_path.write_bytes(html)

                    record.update({
                        "status": "collected",
                        "title": text(heading),
                        "advertised_intakes": intakes,
                        "text": content,
                        "headings": [
                            text(item)
                            for item in main.find_all(
                                ["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"]
                            )
                        ],
                        "links": [
                            {
                                "text": text(link),
                                "href": link["href"],
                            }
                            for link in main.find_all("a", href=True)
                        ],
                        "tables": [
                            [
                                [
                                    text(cell)
                                    for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"])
                                ]
                                for row in table.find_all("tr")
                            ]
                            for table in main.find_all("table")
                        ],
                        "html_snapshot": str(snapshot_path),
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest(),
                    })

                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"Collected: {record['title']} — {intakes}"
                    )

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    UnicodeDecodeError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    record.update({
                        "status": "needs_review",
                        "error": str(exc),
                    })
                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"{course_id}: review required — {exc}"
                    )

                pages.append(record)

        collected = sum(
            page["status"] == "collected" for page in pages
        )

        report = {
            "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK002",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "pages_attempted": len(pages),
            "pages_collected": collected,
            "pages_needing_review": len(pages) - collected,
            "pages": pages,
        }

        output = directory / "course-evidence.json"
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nCollected: {collected}/{len(pages)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "No mappings approved. No database records changed."
        )
