import hashlib
import json
import re
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import Course, TuitionSource
from .reconcile_aberystwyth_awards import download, text


CATALOGUE_URL = "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/atoz/"

POLICY_URLS = {
    "international_fees": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/fees-scholarships/"
    ),
    "postgraduate_fees": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "fees/postgrad/fees/"
    ),
    "scholarships": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/international/"
        "scholarships/global-citizens-scholarship/"
    ),
    "deposit": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/cas-and-deposit-information/"
    ),
}


def normalise(value):
    value = value.casefold()
    value = value.replace("&", " and ").replace("/", " and ")
    value = re.sub(
        r"\b(?:bsc|ba|llb|llm|msc|ma|mba|mres|mphil|phd|bvsc)\b",
        " ",
        value,
    )
    value = re.sub(r"\b(?:hons|honours)\b", " ", value)
    value = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", value)
    return " ".join(value.split())


def page_data(main):
    content = text(main)
    heading = main.find("h1")

    intakes = sorted({
        (month.title(), int(year))
        for month, year in re.findall(
            r"(?:Available for|viewing this course for)"
            r"\s+([A-Za-z]+)\s+start\s+(\d{4})",
            content,
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )
    })

    return {
        "title": text(heading) if heading else "",
        "advertised_intakes": [
            {"month": month, "year": year}
            for month, year in intakes
        ],
        "text": content,
        "headings": [
            text(item)
            for item in main.find_all(["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"])
        ],
        "tables": [
            [
                [text(cell) for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"])]
                for row in table.find_all("tr")
            ]
            for table in main.find_all("table")
        ],
        "links": [
            {
                "text": text(link),
                "url": urljoin(
                    "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/",
                    link["href"],
                ),
            }
            for link in main.find_all("a", href=True)
        ],
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Inspect every active Aberystwyth course without a verified "
        "international fee. No mappings approved or database writes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--candidates-per-course",
            type=int,
            default=3,
            help="Maximum candidate pages per course; default 3.",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        limit = options["candidates_per_course"]

        if not 1 <= limit <= 5:
            raise CommandError(
                "--candidates-per-course must be between 1 and 5."
            )

        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aberystwyth"
            / f"remaining-review-{stamp}"
        )
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        courses = list(
            Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            )
            .order_by("course_id")
            .prefetch_related("tuitions")
        )

        sources = {
            source.tuition_id: source
            for source in TuitionSource.objects.filter(
                tuition__course__university_id="UK002",
                tuition__residency="INTL",
            )
        }

        remaining = []

        for course in courses:
            tuitions = [
                record
                for record in course.tuitions.all()
                if record.residency == "INTL"
            ]

            source = (
                sources.get(tuitions[0].pk)
                if len(tuitions) == 1 else None
            )
            raw = source.raw_fees if source else None

            verified = (
                len(tuitions) == 1
                and tuitions[0].currency == "GBP"
                and source is not None
                and bool(source.academic_year)
                and bool(source.source_url)
                and isinstance(raw, dict)
                and raw.get("verified") is True
            )

            if not verified:
                remaining.append(course)

        self.stdout.write(f"Active courses: {len(courses)}")
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Courses requiring fee review: {len(remaining)}"
        )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        records = []
        evidence_cache = {}
        policy_evidence = {}

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            try:
                html, main = download(session, CATALOGUE_URL)
                (directory / "catalogue.html").write_bytes(html)
            except (
                requests.RequestException,
                UnicodeDecodeError,
                ValueError,
            ) as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Catalogue collection failed: {exc}"
                ) from exc

            catalogue = {}

            for link in main.find_all("a", href=True):
                url = urljoin(CATALOGUE_URL, link["href"])
                parsed = urlsplit(url)

                if (
                    parsed.scheme != "https"
                    or parsed.netloc != "courses.aber.ac.uk"
                    or parsed.query
                    or parsed.fragment
                    or not parsed.path.startswith(
                        ("/undergraduate/", "/postgraduate/")
                    )
                    or len(parsed.path.strip("/").split("/")) != 2
                ):
                    continue

                label = text(link)

                # Require a catalogue label containing an award.
                if not re.search(
                    r"\b(?:BA|BSc|LLB|LLM|MA|MSc|MBA|MRes|"
                    r"MPhil|PhD|BVSc)\b",
                    label,
                    flags=re.IGNORECASE,
                ):
                    continue

                canonical_url = (
                    f"https://courses.aber.ac.uk"
                    f"{parsed.path.rstrip('/')}/"
                )

                catalogue[canonical_url] = {
                    "catalogue_title": label,
                    "source_url": canonical_url,
                    "normalised_title": normalise(
                        re.sub(r"\([^()]*\)\s*$", "", label)
                    ),
                }

            if not catalogue:
                raise CommandError(
                    "No catalogue course links found; page structure changed."
                )

            self.stdout.write(
                f"Catalogue candidates: {len(catalogue)}"
            )

            # Preserve earlier candidate suggestions as additional evidence.
            # They remain unapproved.
            previous_candidates = {}
            root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            previous_paths = list(root.glob("*/course-matches.json"))

            if previous_paths:
                previous_path = max(
                    previous_paths,
                    key=lambda path: path.parent.name,
                )
                try:
                    previous = json.loads(
                        previous_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
                    )
                    if previous.get("university_id") == "UK002":
                        previous_candidates = {
                            row["course_id"]: row.get("candidates", [])
                            for row in previous.get("records", [])
                        }
                except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
                    self.stderr.write(
                        "Earlier candidate report could not be read; "
                        "using the refreshed catalogue."
                    )

            for position, course in enumerate(remaining, start=1):
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"\n[{position}/{len(remaining)}] "
                    f"{course.course_id}: {course.title}"
                )

                undergraduate = course.level in ("UG", "TOPUP")
                prefix = (
                    "/undergraduate/"
                    if undergraduate else "/postgraduate/"
                )
                query = normalise(course.title)
                ranked = []

                for candidate in catalogue.values():
                    if not urlsplit(
                        candidate["source_url"]
                    ).path.startswith(prefix):
                        continue

                    score = SequenceMatcher(
                        None,
                        query,
                        candidate["normalised_title"],
                    ).ratio()

                    if score >= 0.52:
                        ranked.append({
                            **candidate,
                            "similarity": round(score, 4),
                        })

                ranked.sort(
                    key=lambda item: item["similarity"],
                    reverse=True,
                )

                selected = {}

                # Prefer previously identified official candidates,
                # but retain them only if still in the refreshed catalogue.
                for candidate in previous_candidates.get(
                    course.course_id, []
                ):
                    url = candidate.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") + "/"

                    if url in catalogue:
                        selected[url] = {
                            **catalogue[url],
                            "origin": "previous_candidate",
                        }

                for candidate in ranked:
                    if len(selected) >= limit:
                        break
                    selected.setdefault(
                        candidate["source_url"],
                        {**candidate, "origin": "title_similarity"},
                    )

                selected_items = list(selected.values())[:limit]
                candidates = []

                for candidate in selected_items:
                    url = candidate["source_url"]

                    if url not in evidence_cache:
                        self.stdout.write(f"  Reading: {url}")

                        try:
                            html, course_main = download(session, url)
                            digest = hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest()
                            filename = (
                                hashlib.sha256(
                                    url.encode("utf-8")
                                ).hexdigest()[:20]
                                + ".html"
                            )
                            snapshot_path = directory / filename
                            snapshot_path.write_bytes(html)

                            evidence_cache[url] = {
                                "status": "collected",
                                "source_url": url,
                                "sha256": digest,
                                "html_snapshot": str(snapshot_path),
                                **page_data(course_main),
                            }

                        except (
                            requests.RequestException,
                            UnicodeDecodeError,
                            ValueError,
                        ) as exc:
                            evidence_cache[url] = {
                                "status": "request_or_content_review",
                                "source_url": url,
                                "error": str(exc),
                            }

                    candidates.append({
                        **candidate,
                        "approved": False,
                        "evidence": evidence_cache[url],
                    })

                records.append({
                    "course_id": course.course_id,
                    "stored": {
                        "title": course.title,
                        "level": course.level,
                        "duration": course.duration,
                        "start_month": course.start_month,
                        "start_year": course.start_year,
                        "course_url": course.course_url,
                        "ucas_cao_code": course.ucas_cao_code,
                        "work_placement": course.work_placement,
                    },
                    "status": (
                        "candidates_require_review"
                        if candidates else "no_catalogue_candidate"
                    ),
                    "approved": False,
                    "candidates": candidates,
                })

            for name, url in POLICY_URLS.items():
                self.stdout.write(f"\nReading policy: {url}")

                try:
                    html, policy_main = download(session, url)
                    filename = f"policy-{name}.html"
                    (directory / filename).write_bytes(html)

                    policy_evidence[name] = {
                        "status": "collected",
                        "source_url": url,
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest(),
                        "html_snapshot": str(directory / filename),
                        **page_data(policy_main),
                    }

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    UnicodeDecodeError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    policy_evidence[name] = {
                        "status": "needs_review",
                        "source_url": url,
                        "error": str(exc),
                    }

        report = {
            "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK002",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "active_courses": len(courses),
            "remaining_courses": len(remaining),
            "courses_with_candidates": sum(
                bool(row["candidates"]) for row in records
            ),
            "courses_without_candidates": sum(
                not row["candidates"] for row in records
            ),
            "unique_pages_collected": sum(
                page["status"] == "collected"
                for page in evidence_cache.values()
            ),
            "records": records,
            "policies": policy_evidence,
            "display_notes": {
                "scholarship_unconfirmed": (
                    "Scholarship information is not confirmed for this "
                    "course and intake. No discount has been included."
                ),
                "deposit_amount_unknown": (
                    "Deposit amount is not available for comparison. "
                    "Check your university offer letter."
                ),
            },
        }

        output = directory / "remaining-course-review.json"
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nRemaining courses inspected: {len(records)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"With candidates: {report['courses_with_candidates']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Without candidates: {report['courses_without_candidates']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Candidates only. No mappings approved. "
            "No database records changed."
        )

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder

from app.models import Course, Scholarship, Tuition, University


SOURCES = {
    "international_fees": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/fees-scholarships/"
    ),
    "scholarship_index": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/scholarships/"
    ),
    "global_citizens_scholarship": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/scholarships/global-citizens-scholarship/"
    ),
    "deposits": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
        "international/cas-and-deposit-information/"
    ),
}


def clean_text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def extract_page(html, response_url):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
    heading = soup.find("h1")

    if heading is None or not clean_text(heading):
        raise ValueError("The source page has no course/policy title.")

    title = clean_text(heading)

    # Prefer the page's main content over navigation and footer text.
    main = soup.find("main") or soup.find(
        attrs={"role": "main"}
    ) or soup.body

    if main is None:
        raise ValueError("The source page has no readable content.")

    for element in main.find_all(
        ["script", "style", "nav", "footer", "noscript"]
    ):
        element.decompose()

    tables = []

    for table in main.find_all("table"):
        rows = []

        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])

            if cells:
                rows.append([
                    clean_text(cell)
                    for cell in cells
                ])

        if rows:
            tables.append({
                "rows": rows,
                "links": [
                    {
                        "text": clean_text(link),
                        "url": urljoin(response_url, link["href"]),
                    }
                    for link in table.find_all("a", href=True)
                ],
            })

    links = []
    seen = set()

    for link in main.find_all("a", href=True):
        url = urljoin(response_url, link["href"])

        if urlsplit(url).scheme not in ("https", "http"):
            continue

        label = clean_text(link)
        key = (label, url)

        if key in seen:
            continue

        seen.add(key)
        links.append({"text": label, "url": url})

    return {
        "title": title,
        "headings": [
            {
                "level": element.name,
                "text": clean_text(element),
            }
            for element in main.find_all(["h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"])
            if clean_text(element)
        ],
        "text": clean_text(main),
        "tables": tables,
        "links": links,
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (

    )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            university = University.objects.get(
                pk="UK002",
                country="UK",
            )
        except University.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                "Aberystwyth University UK002 was not found."
            ) from exc

        if university.name.casefold() != "aberystwyth university":
            raise CommandError(
                "UK002 does not identify Aberystwyth University."
            )

        generated_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        stamp = generated_at.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aberystwyth"
            / stamp
        )
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        report = {
            "generated_at": generated_at.isoformat(),
            "university_id": university.pk,
            "database_changes": False,
            "sources": {},
            "courses": list(
                Course.objects.filter(
                    university=university,
                ).order_by("course_id").values()
            ),
            "tuitions": list(
                Tuition.objects.filter(
                    course__university=university,
                ).values()
            ),
            "scholarships": list(
                Scholarship.objects.filter(
                    university=university,
                ).values()
            ),
            "review_notes": [
                "Do not infer fee bands from award abbreviations.",
                "Match academic year and intake before assigning fees.",
                "Verify scholarship identity and source university.",
                "Accommodation benefits are not tuition deductions.",
                "An offer-specific deposit is not a published fixed amount.",
                "This collection does not approve course mappings.",
            ],
        }

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            connect=3,
            read=3,
            status=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        failures = []

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )

            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for name, url in SOURCES.items():
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                record = {
                    "requested_url": url,
                    "status": "pending",
                }

                try:
                    response = session.get(
                        url,
                        timeout=(30, 60),
                    )
                    response.raise_for_status()

                    parsed = urlsplit(response.url)

                    if (
                        parsed.scheme != "https"
                        or parsed.hostname not in (
                            "www.aber.ac.uk",
                            "aber.ac.uk",
                        )
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Redirected outside the official website."
                        )

                    record["response_url"] = response.url

                    html = response.content.decode("utf-8-sig")
                    snapshot = directory / f"{name}.html"
                    snapshot.write_bytes(response.content)

                    record.update(
                        extract_page(html, response.url)
                    )

                    record.update({
                        "status": "collected",
                        "html_snapshot": str(snapshot),
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                            response.content
                        ).hexdigest(),
                    })

                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"Collected: {record['title']} "
                        f"— {len(record['tables'])} tables"
                    )

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    UnicodeDecodeError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    record["status"] = "needs_review"
                    record["error"] = str(exc)
                    failures.append(name)

                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"Needs review: {name}: {exc}"
                    )

                report["sources"][name] = record
                time.sleep(1)

        report["collection_complete"] = not failures

        output = directory / "source-review.json"

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nDatabase courses: {len(report['courses'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Tuition records: {len(report['tuitions'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Scholarships: {len(report['scholarships'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Sources collected: {len(SOURCES) - len(failures)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Sources needing review: {len(failures)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write("No database records changed.")

        if failures:
            raise CommandError(
                "Some sources could not be collected. "
                "The report contains the errors."
            )

import hashlib
import json
import re
from collections import deque
from difflib import SequenceMatcher
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import (
    parse_qs,
    urldefrag,
    urljoin,
    urlparse,
)

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import (
    Course,
    DepositPolicy,
    Scholarship,
    TuitionSource,
)


START_URLS = [
    "https://arden.ac.uk/international-students/find-a-course",
    "https://arden.ac.uk/our-courses",
    (
        "https://arden.ac.uk/international-students/"
        "fees-for-international-students"
    ),
    (
        "https://arden.ac.uk/international-students/"
        "scholarships-funding"
    ),
    (
        "https://arden.ac.uk/studying-with-us/fees-and-funding/"
        "all-scholarships"
    ),
    "https://arden.ac.uk/terms-and-conditions",
]

CATALOGUE_PATHS = {
    "/international-students/find-a-course",
    "/our-courses",
}

ARU_FOLLOWUP_IDS = [
    "C_UK003_01",
    "C_UK003_05",
    "C_UK003_31",
    "C_UK003_36",
    "C_UK003_95",
]


def normalise(value):
    value = value.casefold()
    value = re.sub(
        r"\b(?:bsc|ba|beng|llb|llm|msc|ma|mba|hons)\b",
        " ",
        value,
    )
    value = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", " ", value)
    return " ".join(value.split())


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Collect Arden catalogue and policy evidence. "
        "No mappings approved or database updates applied."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--max-pages",
            type=int,
            default=30,
            help="Maximum source/catalogue pages to collect.",
        )

    @staticmethod
    def allowed(url):
        parsed = urlparse(url)

        return (
            parsed.scheme == "https"
            and parsed.hostname in {"arden.ac.uk", "www.arden.ac.uk"}
            and parsed.username is None
            and parsed.password is None
        )

    def fetch(self, session, url):
        current = url
        redirects = []

        for _ in range(6):
            if not self.allowed(current):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Unsupported source URL: {current}"
                )

            response = session.get(
                current,
                timeout=(30, 60),
                allow_redirects=False,
            )

            if response.status_code in {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}:
                location = response.headers.get("Location")

                if not location:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Redirect has no Location header."
                    )

                destination = urljoin(current, location)

                redirects.append({
                    "from": current,
                    "to": destination,
                })

                current = destination
                continue

            response.raise_for_status()

            if "html" not in response.headers.get(
                "Content-Type", ""
            ).casefold():
                raise ValueError("Expected an HTML source page.")

            return response, current, redirects

        raise ValueError("Too many redirects.")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        max_pages = options["max_pages"]

        if max_pages < len(START_URLS):
            self.stderr.write(
                f"--max-pages must be at least {len(START_URLS)}."
            )
            return

        courses = list(
            Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK004"
            ).order_by("course_id").values()
        )

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "arden"
            / f"source-review-{stamp}"
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        pages = []
        errors = []
        course_links = {}
        queue = deque(START_URLS)
        queued = set(START_URLS)
        visited = set()

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            connect=3,
            read=3,
            status=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            while queue and len(visited) < max_pages:
                url = queue.popleft()

                if url in visited:
                    continue

                visited.add(url)
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                try:
                    response, final_url, redirects = self.fetch(
                        session,
                        url,
                    )

                    html_path = (
                        folder / f"page-{len(visited):03d}.html"
                    )
                    html_path.write_bytes(response.content)

                    soup = BeautifulSoup(
                        response.content,
                        "html.parser",
                    )

                    links = []

                    for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True):
                        href = urldefrag(
                            urljoin(final_url, link["href"])
                        )[0]

                        label = " ".join(
                            link.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
                        )

                        links.append({
                            "text": label,
                            "href": href,
                        })

                        if not self.allowed(href):
                            continue

                        parsed = urlparse(href)
                        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/")
                        query = parse_qs(parsed.query)

                        # Follow advertised pagination only.
                        if (
                            path in CATALOGUE_PATHS
                            and "page" in query
                            and href not in queued
                        ):
                            queued.add(href)
                            queue.append(href)

                        # These are candidate links, not approved
                        # course identities or campus mappings.
                        if (
                            re.match(
                                r"^/our-courses/"
                                r"(undergraduate|postgraduate)/",
                                path,
                            )
                            and label
                        ):
                            clean_url = href.split("?", 1)[0]

                            course_links.setdefault(
                                clean_url,
                                {
                                    "url": clean_url,
                                    "labels": [],
                                },
                            )

                            if label not in course_links[
                                clean_url
                            ]["labels"]:
                                course_links[clean_url][
                                    "labels"
                                ].append(label)

                    scripts = []

                    for script in soup.find_all("script"):
                        text = (
                            script.string or script.get_text()
                        )

                        if not text.strip():
                            continue

                        parsed_json = None

                        try:
                            parsed_json = json.loads(text)
                        except (ValueError, TypeError):
                            pass

                        scripts.append({
                            "id": script.get("id"),
                            "type": script.get("type"),
                            "text": text,
                            "parsed_json": parsed_json,
                        })

                    tables = []

                    for table in soup.find_all("table"):
                        rows = []

                        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
                            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])

                            if cells:
                                rows.append([
                                    " ".join(
                                        cell.get_text(
                                            " ", strip=True
                                        ).split()
                                    )
                                    for cell in cells
                                ])

                        if rows:
                            tables.append(rows)

                    heading = soup.find("h1")

                    for element in soup.find_all(
                        ["script", "style"]
                    ):
                        element.decompose()

                    pages.append({
                        "requested_url": url,
                        "source_url": final_url,
                        "redirects": redirects,
                        "heading": (
                            heading.get_text(" ", strip=True)
                            if heading else ""
                        ),
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                            response.content
                        ).hexdigest(),
                        "html_file": str(html_path.resolve()),
                        "text": " ".join(
                            soup.get_text(
                                " ", strip=True
                            ).split()
                        ),
                        "tables": tables,
                        "links": links,
                        "scripts": scripts,
                    })

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    OSError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    errors.append({
                        "requested_url": url,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

        matches = []

        for course in courses:
            title = normalise(course["title"])
            candidates = []

            for item in course_links.values():
                best = max(
                    (
                        SequenceMatcher(
                            None,
                            title,
                            normalise(label),
                        ).ratio()
                        for label in item["labels"]
                    ),
                    default=0,
                )

                if best >= 0.60:
                    candidates.append({
                        **item,
                        "title_similarity": round(best, 4),
                        "mapping_approved": False,
                    })

            candidates.sort(
                key=lambda item: item["title_similarity"],
                reverse=True,
            )

            matches.append({
                "database_course": course,
                "candidates": candidates[:5],
                "review_required": True,
            })

        # Read the five ARU deposit-label discrepancies without
        # changing ARU records while starting Arden.
        aru_sources = list(
            TuitionSource.objects.filter(
                tuition__course__university_id="UK003",
                tuition__course_id__in=ARU_FOLLOWUP_IDS,
                tuition__residency="INTL",
            ).values(
                "id",
                "tuition__course_id",
                "academic_year",
                "raw_fees",
            )
        )

        aru_followup = [
            {
                "course_id": row["tuition__course_id"],
                "source_id": row["id"],
                "academic_year": row["academic_year"],
                "course_kind": (
                    row["raw_fees"].get("course_kind")
                    if isinstance(row["raw_fees"], dict)
                    else None
                ),
            }
            for row in aru_sources
        ]

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK004",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "summary": {
                "database_courses": len(courses),
                "pages_collected": len(pages),
                "candidate_course_links": len(course_links),
                "courses_with_candidates": sum(
                    bool(row["candidates"]) for row in matches
                ),
                "courses_without_candidates": sum(
                    not row["candidates"] for row in matches
                ),
                "collection_errors": len(errors),
                "queued_pages_not_collected": len(queue),
            },
            "courses": matches,
            "pages": pages,
            "errors": errors,
            "catalogue_collection_note": (
                "Only links exposed by captured pages were collected. "
                "Dynamic or unexposed catalogue results may be missing. "
                "No candidate does not prove discontinuation."
            ),
            "stored_scholarships": list(
                Scholarship.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK004"
                ).values()
            ),
            "stored_deposit_policies": list(
                DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK004"
                ).values()
            ),
            "aru_deposit_label_followup": aru_followup,
        }

        output = folder / "source-review.json"

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(report["summary"], indent=2)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Candidates only. No mappings approved. "
            "No database records changed."
        )

FILE: app\management\commands\inspect_aru_campus_intakes.py
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError

from app.models import Course


COURSES = {
    "C_UK003_65": "computer-games-programming",
    "C_UK003_94": "3d-animation",
    "C_ARU003_RES_01": "../postgraduate/school-of-allied-health",
    "C_UK003_26": (
        "https://london.aru.ac.uk/courses/master-of-public-health"
    ),
}

BASE_URL = "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"


def clean_text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def permitted_url(url):
    parsed = urlparse(url)
    return (
        parsed.scheme == "https"
        and parsed.hostname in {"aru.ac.uk", "www.aru.ac.uk"}
        and parsed.username is None
        and parsed.password is None
    )


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Collect ARU course and application evidence for four "
        "campus-specific intake reviews. No database changes."
    )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(
            "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
        )
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"campus-intakes-{stamp}"
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        report = {
            "generated_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "courses": [],
            "pages": [],
            "errors": [],
        }

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        def collect(session, url):
            if not permitted_url(url):
                raise ValueError(f"Unexpected source URL: {url}")

            self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")
            self.stdout.flush()

            # Validate every redirect before following it.
            current = url
            for _ in range(6):
                response = session.get(
                    current,
                    timeout=(30, 60),
                    allow_redirects=False,
                )
                if response.is_redirect:
                    current = urljoin(
                        current, response.headers["Location"]
                    )
                    if not permitted_url(current):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {current}"
                        )
                    continue
                response.raise_for_status()
                break
            else:
                raise ValueError("Too many redirects.")

            if "html" not in response.headers.get(
                "Content-Type", ""
            ).casefold():
                raise ValueError("Source did not return HTML.")

            content = response.content
            digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()
            filename = f"{len(report['pages']) + 1:02d}-{digest[:12]}.html"
            (folder / filename).write_bytes(content)

            soup = BeautifulSoup(content, "html.parser")
            scripts = []

            for script in soup.find_all("script"):
                body = script.get_text()
                item = {
                    "id": script.get("id"),
                    "type": script.get("type"),
                    "src": (
                        urljoin(current, script["src"])
                        if script.get("src")
                        else None
                    ),
                    "text": body,
                }
                try:
                    item["parsed_json"] = json.loads(body)
                except (ValueError, TypeError):
                    pass
                scripts.append(item)

            links = [
                {
                    "text": clean_text(link),
                    "url": urljoin(current, link["href"]),
                }
                for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True)
            ]

            for element in soup(["script", "style"]):
                element.decompose()

            page = {
                "requested_url": url,
                "source_url": current,
                "sha256": digest,
                "html_file": filename,
                "text": clean_text(soup),
                "links": links,
                "scripts": scripts,
            }
            report["pages"].append(page)
            return page

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "UniversityTuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
            )

            for course_id, slug in COURSES.items():
                course = Course.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    course_id=course_id,
                ).values(
                    "course_id",
                    "title",
                    "level",
                    "location",
                    "duration",
                    "start_month",
                    "start_year",
                    "work_placement",
                    "course_url",
                    "is_active",
                ).first()

                if course is None:
                    report["errors"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "error": "Database course not found.",
                    })
                    continue

                entry = {
                    "database_course": course,
                    "course_source_url": urljoin(BASE_URL, slug),
                    "application_urls": [],
                    "status": "review_required",
                }
                report["courses"].append(entry)

                try:
                    page = collect(
                        session, entry["course_source_url"]
                    )

                    application_urls = sorted({
                        link["url"]
                        for link in page["links"]
                        if (
                            permitted_url(link["url"])
                            and urlparse(
                                link["url"]
                            ).path.rstrip("/")
                            == "/study/apply-online"
                        )
                    })
                    entry["application_urls"] = application_urls

                    if not application_urls:
                        report["errors"].append({
                            "course_id": course_id,
                            "error": (
                                "No application link found; "
                                "manual route review required."
                            ),
                        })

                    for url in application_urls:
                        try:
                            collect(session, url)
                        except (
                            requests.RequestException,
                            ValueError,
                            KeyError,
                        ) as exc:
                            report["errors"].append({
                                "course_id": course_id,
                                "source_url": url,
                                "error": str(exc),
                            })

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    ValueError,
                    KeyError,
                ) as exc:
                    report["errors"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "error": str(exc),
                    })

        output = folder / "campus-intake-evidence.json"
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nDatabase courses: {len(report['courses'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Pages collected: {len(report['pages'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Collection issues: {len(report['errors'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Evidence collected only. No mappings approved."
        )
        self.stdout.write("No database records changed.")

        if report["errors"]:
            raise CommandError(
                "Some evidence needs review. "
                "Details were saved in the report."
            )

import json
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import CommandError
from django.utils import timezone

from app.management.commands.inspect_aru_sources import (
    Command as SourceInspector,
    official_url,
)


class Command(SourceInspector):
    help = (
        "Collect ARU candidate course pages for identity, "
        "intake and tuition review. No database changes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--report",
            help=(
                "Path to source-review.json. "
                "Defaults to the latest ARU source report."
            ),
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        log_root = root / "logs" / "aru"

        if options["report"]:
            source = Path(options["report"])
            if not source.is_absolute():
                source = root / source
        else:
            available = list(
                log_root.glob("*/source-review.json")
            )

            if not available:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Run inspect_aru_sources first."
                )

            source = max(
                available,
                key=lambda path: path.parent.name,
            )

        try:
            data = json.loads(
                source.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read source report: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if data.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError(
                "The source report is not for UK003."
            )

        if data.get("errors"):
            raise CommandError(
                "Resolve the source report's collection "
                "errors before continuing."
            )

        rows = data.get("course_candidates")

        if not isinstance(rows, list) or not rows:
            raise CommandError(
                "No course candidates found in the report."
            )

        # Collect all suggested pages, once per URL.
        # Candidates remain unapproved regardless of score.
        targets = {}

        for row in rows:
            course = row.get("stored_course", {})
            course_id = course.get("course_id")

            if not course_id:
                raise CommandError(
                    "A candidate row has no course ID."
                )

            for candidate in row.get("candidates", []):
                url = candidate.get("source_url")

                if (
                    not isinstance(url, str)
                    or official_url(url) != url
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Invalid candidate URL for {course_id}: "
                        f"{url!r}"
                    )

                targets.setdefault(url, set()).add(course_id)

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime(
            "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
        )
        folder = log_root / f"courses-{stamp}"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        report = {
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "source_report": str(source.resolve()),
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "course_candidates": rows,
            "pages": [],
            "errors": [],
        }

        output = folder / "course-evidence.json"

        def save_report():
            temporary = output.with_suffix(".tmp")
            temporary.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            temporary.replace(output)

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[
                429, 500, 502, 503, 504
            ],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        save_report()

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers.update({
                "User-Agent": (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                ),
            })
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for number, url in enumerate(
                sorted(targets), start=1
            ):
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"\nPage {number}/{len(targets)}"
                )

                try:
                    response, soup = self.get_page(
                        session, url
                    )

                    evidence = self.evidence(
                        response, soup
                    )

                    evidence.update({
                        "requested_url": url,
                        "candidate_course_ids": sorted(
                            targets[url]
                        ),
                        "mapping_approved": False,
                    })

                    html_file = (
                        folder / f"page-{number:04}.html"
                    )
                    html_file.write_bytes(
                        response.content
                    )

                    evidence["html_file"] = (
                        html_file.name
                    )

                    report["pages"].append(evidence)

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    report["errors"].append({
                        "source_url": url,
                        "candidate_course_ids": sorted(
                            targets[url]
                        ),
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"Needs review: {url}: {exc}"
                    )

                # Preserve completed evidence if interrupted.
                save_report()

        report["summary"] = {
            "database_courses": len(rows),
            "candidate_pages": len(targets),
            "pages_collected": len(report["pages"]),
            "pages_needing_review": len(
                report["errors"]
            ),
            "courses_without_candidates": sum(
                not row.get("candidates")
                for row in rows
            ),
        }
        save_report()

        self.stdout.write("")
        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(report["summary"], indent=2)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "No mappings approved. "
            "No database records changed."
        )

class Command(EvidenceCollector):

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        courses = list(
            Course.objects.filter(

            .order_by("course_id")
            .values()
        )

        found = {
            course["course_id"]: course
            for course in courses
        }

        missing = sorted(set(TARGETS) - set(found))

        if missing:
            raise CommandError(
                "Missing database courses: " + ", ".join(missing)
            )

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"

        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "courses": [],
            "pages": [],
            "errors": [],
        }

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            connect=3,
            read=3,
            status=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for index, (course_id, target) in enumerate(
                TARGETS.items(),
                start=1,
            ):
                url = target["source_url"]

                entry = {
                    "database_course": found[course_id],
                    "candidate_url": url,
                    "purpose": target["purpose"],
                    "note": target["note"],
                    "mapping_approved": False,
                    "status": "collection_pending",
                }

                report["courses"].append(entry)
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading {course_id}: {url}")

                try:
                    page = self.fetch_page(
                        session,
                        url,
                        folder,
                        index,
                    )

                    report["pages"].append(page)

                    entry["status"] = (
                        "redirect_requires_review"
                        if page["redirect_review_required"]
                        else "evidence_collected"
                    )

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    OSError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    entry["status"] = "collection_failed"

                    report["errors"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "requested_url": url,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"{course_id}: collection issue: {exc}"
                    )

        report["summary"] = {
            "database_courses": len(courses),
            "pages_collected": len(report["pages"]),
            "redirected_pages": sum(
                page["redirect_review_required"]
                for page in report["pages"]
            ),
            "collection_errors": len(report["errors"]),
        }

        output = folder / "four-route-evidence.json"

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(report["summary"], indent=2)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Evidence collected only. No replacements accepted. "
            "No database records changed."
        )

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urljoin, urlparse

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import Course


COURSE_IDS = [
    "C_UK003_18",
    "C_UK003_22",
    "C_UK003_26",
    "C_UK003_41",
    "C_UK003_43",
    "C_UK003_46",
    "C_UK003_52",
    "C_UK003_56",
    "C_UK003_64",
    "C_UK003_66",
    "C_UK003_81",
    "C_UK003_82",

    "C_UK003_88",
    "C_UK003_89",
    "C_UK003_94",
    "C_UK003_104",
]

# These are investigation candidates, not approved mappings.
CANDIDATE_URLS = {
    "C_UK003_22": (
        "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/"
        "applied-data-science"
    ),
    "C_UK003_26": (
        "https://london.aru.ac.uk/courses/"
        "master-of-public-health"
    ),
    "C_UK003_66": (
        "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"
        "music-performance"
    ),
    "C_UK003_81": (
        "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"
        "politics-and-international-relations"
    ),
    "C_UK003_82": (
        "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"
        "politics-and-international-relations"
    ),
}

ALLOWED_HOSTS = {
    "www.aru.ac.uk",
    "aru.ac.uk",
    "london.aru.ac.uk",
}


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Collect current evidence for the 17 pending ARU courses. "
        "Does not approve mappings or modify database records."
    )

    @staticmethod
    def allowed_url(url):
        parsed = urlparse(url)

        return (
            parsed.scheme == "https"
            and parsed.hostname in ALLOWED_HOSTS
            and parsed.username is None
            and parsed.password is None
        )

    def fetch_page(self, session, requested_url, folder, index):
        current_url = requested_url
        redirects = []

        # Follow only explicitly allowed university hosts.
        for _ in range(6):
            if not self.allowed_url(current_url):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Unsupported source URL: {current_url}"
                )

            response = session.get(
                current_url,
                timeout=(30, 60),
                allow_redirects=False,
            )

            if response.status_code in {301, 302, 303, 307, 308}:
                location = response.headers.get("Location")

                if not location:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Redirect response has no Location header."
                    )

                next_url = urljoin(current_url, location)

                redirects.append({
                    "from": current_url,
                    "to": next_url,
                    "status_code": response.status_code,
                })

                current_url = next_url
                continue

            response.raise_for_status()
            break

        else:
            raise ValueError("Too many redirects.")

        if "html" not in response.headers.get(
            "Content-Type", ""
        ).casefold():
            raise ValueError("Source did not return HTML.")

        html_path = folder / f"page-{index:02d}.html"
        html_path.write_bytes(response.content)

        soup = BeautifulSoup(
            response.content,
            "html.parser",
        )

        scripts = []

        for script in soup.find_all("script"):
            script_text = script.string or script.get_text()

            if not script_text.strip():
                continue

            parsed_json = None

            try:
                parsed_json = json.loads(script_text)
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                pass

            scripts.append({
                "id": script.get("id"),
                "type": script.get("type"),
                "src": script.get("src"),
                "text": script_text,
                "parsed_json": parsed_json,
            })

        links = [
            {
                "text": " ".join(
                    link.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
                ),
                "href": urljoin(current_url, link["href"]),
            }
            for link in soup.find_all("a", href=True)
        ]

        for element in soup.find_all(["script", "style"]):
            element.decompose()

        heading = soup.find("h1")
        title = soup.find("title")

        return {
            "requested_url": requested_url,
            "source_url": current_url,
            "redirects": redirects,
            "redirect_review_required": bool(redirects),
            "status_code": response.status_code,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                response.content
            ).hexdigest(),
            "html_file": str(html_path.resolve()),
            "page_title": (
                title.get_text(" ", strip=True)
                if title else ""
            ),
            "heading": (
                heading.get_text(" ", strip=True)
                if heading else ""
            ),
            "text": " ".join(
                soup.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
            ),
            "links": links,
            "scripts": scripts,
        }

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        courses = list(
            Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK003",
                course_id__in=COURSE_IDS,
            )
            .order_by("course_id")
            .values()
        )

        found = {course["course_id"] for course in courses}
        missing = sorted(set(COURSE_IDS) - found)

        if missing:
            raise CommandError(
                "Missing database courses: " + ", ".join(missing)
            )

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"remaining-17-evidence-{stamp}"
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "database_changes": False,
            "mappings_approved": False,
            "courses": [],
            "pages": [],
            "errors": [],
        }

        requested_urls = []

        for course in courses:
            course_id = course["course_id"]
            url = CANDIDATE_URLS.get(course_id)

            if not url:
                stored_url = course.get("course_url") or ""

                if self.allowed_url(stored_url):
                    url = stored_url

            status = (
                "candidate_capture_required"
                if url
                else "current_route_not_identified"
            )

            report["courses"].append({
                "database_course": course,
                "candidate_url": url,
                "status": status,
                "mapping_approved": False,
            })

            if url and url not in requested_urls:
                requested_urls.append(url)

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            connect=3,
            read=3,
            status=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )

            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for index, url in enumerate(requested_urls, start=1):
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                try:
                    page = self.fetch_page(
                        session,
                        url,
                        folder,
                        index,
                    )
                    report["pages"].append(page)

                except (
                    requests.RequestException,
                    OSError,
                    ValueError,
                ) as exc:
                    report["errors"].append({
                        "requested_url": url,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })
                    self.stderr.write(
                        f"Collection issue: {url}: {exc}"
                    )

        captured = {
            page["requested_url"]: page
            for page in report["pages"]
        }

        for entry in report["courses"]:
            url = entry["candidate_url"]

            if not url:
                continue

            page = captured.get(url)

            if page is None:
                entry["status"] = "collection_failed"

            elif page["redirect_review_required"]:
                entry["status"] = "redirect_requires_review"

            else:
                entry["status"] = "candidate_evidence_collected"

        report["summary"] = {
            "database_courses": len(courses),
            "unique_candidate_urls": len(requested_urls),
            "pages_collected": len(report["pages"]),
            "courses_without_current_route": sum(
                entry["candidate_url"] is None
                for entry in report["courses"]
            ),
            "redirected_pages": sum(
                page["redirect_review_required"]
                for page in report["pages"]
            ),
            "collection_errors": len(report["errors"]),
        }

        output = folder / "remaining-17-evidence.json"

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(report["summary"], indent=2)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Evidence collected only. No mappings approved. "
            "No database records changed."
        )
