import hashlib
import json
import re
from copy import deepcopy
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.core.serializers.json import DjangoJSONEncoder
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import (
    Course,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
)


COURSE_ID = "C_UK003_64"

SOURCE_URL = (
    "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/computing"
)

NEW_COURSE = {
    "title": "BSc (Hons) Computing",
    "level": "UG",
    "location": "Peterborough Campus",
    "duration": "3 Years",
    "start_month": "September",
    "start_year": 2027,
    "intake_months": "September",
    "ucas_cao_code": "I118",
    "course_url": SOURCE_URL,
}

FEE_NOTE = (
    "Annual international tuition for the standard three-year "
    "BSc Computing route at Peterborough, September 2027 / 2027/28. "
    "Foundation and placement routes are excluded. This is an "
    "explicit replacement of the stored Cambridge Computing and "
    "Information Systems record, not a verified course rename."
)

HELD_REVIEWS = {
    "C_UK003_18": (
        "The captured Writtle veterinary listing describes college "
        "qualifications. It does not verify the stored BSc route."
    ),
    "C_UK003_41": (
        "Historical Marine Biology evidence does not verify a "
        "current intake or applicable international fee."
    ),
    "C_UK003_43": (
        "The former Ecology course URL redirects to a subject "
        "listing. A current course-specific intake and fee "
        "remain unverified."
    ),
}


def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value).replace(",", ""))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")

    return format(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")), ".2f")


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply an explicit replacement with the "
        "reviewed Peterborough BSc Computing route."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help="Path to four-route-evidence.json.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save the reviewed replacement and tuition.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacements",
            action="store_true",
            help="Accept the explicit course and campus replacement.",
        )

    def find_evidence(self, supplied):
        if supplied:
            path = Path(supplied)

            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / path

            if not path.is_file():
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Evidence file not found: {path}"
                )

            return path.resolve()

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"

        paths = list(
            folder.glob(
                "four-unidentified-*/four-route-evidence.json"
            )
        )

        if not paths:
            raise CommandError(
                "No four-route evidence found. Supply --evidence."
            )

        return max(
            paths,
            key=lambda path: path.parent.name,
        ).resolve()

    def verify_evidence(self, path):
        report = json.loads(
            path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )

        if report.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise ValueError("Evidence is not for ARU.")

        entries = [
            entry
            for entry in report.get("courses", [])
            if entry.get("database_course", {}).get("course_id")
            == COURSE_ID
            and entry.get("candidate_url", "").rstrip("/")
            == SOURCE_URL
        ]

        if len(entries) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Expected one Computing candidate entry."
            )

        pages = [
            page
            for page in report.get("pages", [])
            if page.get("requested_url", "").rstrip("/")
            == SOURCE_URL
        ]

        if len(pages) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Expected one Computing source capture."
            )

        page = pages[0]

        if (
            page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") != SOURCE_URL
            or page.get("redirects")
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Computing source redirected; review required."
            )

        html_path = Path(page["html_file"])

        if not html_path.is_absolute():
            html_path = path.parent / html_path

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            html_path.read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()

        if digest != page["sha256"]:
            raise ValueError(
                "Saved HTML checksum does not match."
            )

        schemas = [
            script["parsed_json"]
            for script in page.get("scripts", [])
            if isinstance(script.get("parsed_json"), dict)
            and script["parsed_json"].get("@type") == "Course"
            and script["parsed_json"].get("name") == "Computing"
            and script["parsed_json"].get("award") == "BSc (Hons)"
        ]

        if len(schemas) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the Computing course and award."
            )

        instances = schemas[0].get("hasCourseInstance", [])

        if isinstance(instances, dict):
            instances = [instances]

        matches = []

        for instance in instances:
            if not isinstance(instance, dict):
                continue

            locations = instance.get("location", [])

            if isinstance(locations, dict):
                locations = [locations]

            start = (
                instance.get("startdate")
                or instance.get("startDate")
                or ""
            )

            if (
                instance.get("name") == "Full-time"
                and instance.get("courseMode") == "Onsite"
                and instance.get("courseWorkload") == "P3Y"
                and str(start).startswith("2027-09")
                and any(
                    isinstance(location, dict)
                    and location.get("name") == "Peterborough"
                    for location in locations
                )
            ):
                matches.append(instance)

        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the standard three-year "
                "Peterborough September 2027 route."
            )

        text = " ".join(page["text"].split())

        if not re.search(r"\bI118\b", text):
            raise ValueError("UCAS code I118 not found.")

        # Isolate the standard BSc fee section before the placement
        # section. The source contains more than one academic year.
        section_pattern = (
            r"International students\s+"
            r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+With placement\s+"
            r"With foundation year\s+"
            r"5 years with foundation and placement\s+"
            r"BSc \(Hons\)(.*?)"
            r"(?=With placement\s+£)"
        )

        sections = re.findall(
            section_pattern,
            text,
            re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
        )

        if len(sections) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot isolate the standard BSc international "
                "fee section."
            )

        fee_pattern = (
            r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
            r"International students starting\s+"
            r"(\d{4}/\d{2})\s+"
            r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)"
        )

        fees = [
            money(amount)
            for amount, year in re.findall(
                fee_pattern,
                sections[0],
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )
            if year == "2027/28"
        ]

        if fees != ["19750.00"]:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unexpected standard 2027/28 fees: {fees}"
            )

        return {
            "source_sha256": digest,
            "evidence_generated_at": report.get("generated_at"),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def snapshot(course, tuition, source):
        return {
            "course": {
                field: getattr(course, field)
                for field in NEW_COURSE
            },
            "tuition": {
                "id": tuition.pk,
                "residency": tuition.residency,
                "currency": tuition.currency,
                "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
            },
            "source": (
                {
                    "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                    "source_url": source.source_url,
                    "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                    "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                    "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                    "raw_fees": deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                }
                if source is not None
                else None
            ),
        }

    def build_source(self, before, evidence):
        previous_source = before["source"]

        if previous_source is not None:
            if not isinstance(previous_source["raw_fees"], dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Existing source metadata requires review."
                )

            raw = deepcopy(previous_source["raw_fees"])
        else:
            raw = {}

        course_changed = before["course"] != NEW_COURSE

        source_changed = (
            previous_source is None
            or previous_source["source_url"] != SOURCE_URL
            or previous_source["academic_year"] != "2027/28"
        )

        if course_changed:
            history = raw.get("route_review_history", [])

            if not isinstance(history, list):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Existing route history requires review."
                )

            old_evidence = deepcopy(previous_source)

            if old_evidence:
                old_evidence["raw_fees"].pop(
                    "route_review_history",
                    None,
                )

            history.append({
                "recorded_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                "mapping": "explicit_replacement",
                "replacement_accepted": True,
                "not_a_confirmed_rename": True,
                "before_course": deepcopy(before["course"]),
                "after_course": deepcopy(NEW_COURSE),
                "previous_tuition_source": old_evidence,
                "evidence_generated_at": evidence[
                    "evidence_generated_at"
                ],
            })

            raw["route_review_history"] = history

        raw.update({
            "verified": True,
            "academic_year": "2027/28",
            "currency": "GBP",
            "source_fee_category": "International",
            "annual_tuition": "19750.00",
            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
            "course_kind": "undergraduate_taught",
            "course_source_url": SOURCE_URL,
            "source_course_name": "Computing",
            "source_course_code": "I118",
            "source_sha256": evidence["source_sha256"],
            "mapping": "explicit_replacement",
            "replacement_accepted": True,
            "not_a_confirmed_rename": True,
            "fee_note": FEE_NOTE,
            "fee_categories": [{
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "academic_year": "2027/28",
                "currency": "GBP",
                "annual_tuition": "19750.00",
                "raw_annual_fee": "£19,750",
                "annotation": FEE_NOTE,
                "footnote_marker": "",
                "amount_requires_review": False,
            }],
        })

        raw.pop("verification_reason", None)

        # Preserve later award reconciliation on repeat imports.
        if course_changed or source_changed:
            raw["scholarship_status"] = "applicability_pending"
            raw["deposit_status"] = "applicability_pending"

        return {
            "academic_year": "2027/28",
            "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
            "source_course_name": "Computing",
            "source_course_code": "I118",
            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
            "raw_fees": raw,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def write_report(path, data):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                data,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if (
            options["apply"]
            and not options["accept_replacements"]
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Use both --apply and --accept-replacements."
            )

        evidence_path = self.find_evidence(options["evidence"])

        try:
            evidence = self.verify_evidence(evidence_path)
        except (
            OSError,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
            KeyError,
            ArithmeticError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        output = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"computing-replacement-{stamp}.json"
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                course = Course.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    course_id=COURSE_ID,
                )

                if course.title not in {
                    "BSc (Hons) Computing and Information Systems",
                    NEW_COURSE["title"],
                }:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Unexpected stored title: {course.title!r}"
                    )

                duplicates = list(
                    Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_url__in=[
                            SOURCE_URL,
                            SOURCE_URL + "/",
                        ],
                    )
                    .exclude(course_id=COURSE_ID)
                    .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
                )

                if duplicates:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Another record already uses this route: "
                        + ", ".join(duplicates)
                    )

                tuitions = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if (
                    len(tuitions) != 1
                    or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                ):
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Expected one GBP international tuition."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                before = self.snapshot(course, tuition, source)
                source_values = self.build_source(before, evidence)

                after = {
                    "course": deepcopy(NEW_COURSE),
                    "tuition": {
                        **before["tuition"],
                        "tuition_fee": "19750.00",
                    },
                    "source": deepcopy(source_values),
                }

                changed = before != after

                report = {
                    "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                    "university_id": "UK003",
                    "course_id": COURSE_ID,
                    "mode": "preview",
                    "database_changes": False,
                    "proposed_changes": int(changed),
                    "mapping": "explicit_replacement_proposal",
                    "replacement_accepted": False,
                    "not_a_confirmed_rename": True,
                    "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "other_courses_unchanged": HELD_REVIEWS,
                }

                self.write_report(output, report)

                if options["apply"] and changed:
                    fields = [
                        field
                        for field, value in NEW_COURSE.items()
                        if getattr(course, field) != value
                    ]

                    for field in fields:
                        setattr(course, field, NEW_COURSE[field])

                    if fields:
                        update_fields = list(fields)

                        if any(
                            field.name == "updated_at"
                            for field in Course._meta.fields
                        ):
                            update_fields.append("updated_at")

                        course.save(update_fields=update_fields)

                    if money(tuition.tuition_fee) != "19750.00":
                        tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal("19750.00")
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    if before["source"] != source_values:
                        source, _ = (
                            TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                                tuition=tuition,
                                defaults=source_values,
                            )
                        )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=COURSE_ID,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=before,
                        after=after,
                    )

            except (
                OSError,
                ValueError,
                TypeError,
                KeyError,
                ArithmeticError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
            ) as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Import stopped: {exc}. "
                    "No changes from this batch were committed."
                ) from exc

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = changed
            report["mapping"] = "explicit_replacement"
            report["replacement_accepted"] = True

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database operation completed, but the final "
                    f"report could not be updated: {exc}"
                ) from exc

        self.stdout.write(
            f"{COURSE_ID}: GBP "
            f"{before['tuition']['tuition_fee']} -> 19750.00; "
            "September 2027 / 2027/28"
        )

        for field, value in NEW_COURSE.items():
            if before["course"][field] != value:
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  {field}: {before['course'][field]} -> {value}"
                )

        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    f"Applied changed records: {int(changed)}"
                )
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "Accepted Computing replacement, international fee, "
                "source evidence and audit saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Proposed changes: {int(changed)}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "The other three courses remain unchanged and unresolved. "
            "Scholarship rules, stored discounts and deposit policies "
            "unchanged. Computing applicability requires reconciliation."
        )

def amount_string(value):
    if value is None:
        return None

    amount = Decimal(str(value).replace(",", ""))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")

    return format(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")), ".2f")


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply reviewed ARU Games Programming, Allied "
        "Health MPhil and 3D Animation replacements."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help="Path to the saved campus-intake evidence JSON.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save the reviewed replacements and tuition evidence.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacements",
            action="store_true",
            help="Explicitly accept the course replacements.",
        )

    @staticmethod
    def read_report(path):
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))

    def find_evidence(self, supplied_path):
        if supplied_path:
            path = Path(supplied_path)

            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / path

            if not path.is_file():
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Evidence report not found: {path}"
                )

            return path.resolve()

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        candidates = []

        for path in folder.glob(
            "campus-intakes-*/campus-intake-evidence.json"
        ):
            try:
                report = self.read_report(path)

                ids = {
                    entry["database_course"]["course_id"]
                    for entry in report.get("courses", [])
                }

                if (
                    report.get("university_id") == "UK003"
                    and set(TARGETS).issubset(ids)
                ):
                    candidates.append(path)

            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                continue

        if not candidates:
            raise CommandError(
                "No matching evidence report found. "
                "Supply --evidence explicitly."
            )

        return max(
            candidates,
            key=lambda path: path.parent.name,
        ).resolve()

    def validate_schema(self, page, target):
        schemas = []

        def collect(value):
            if isinstance(value, list):
                for item in value:
                    collect(item)

            elif isinstance(value, dict):
                schemas.append(value)

                if "@graph" in value:
                    collect(value["@graph"])

        for script in page.get("scripts", []):
            collect(script.get("parsed_json"))

        matching_courses = [
            item
            for item in schemas
            if item.get("@type") == "Course"
            and item.get("name") == target["schema_name"]
            and item.get("award") == target["schema_award"]
        ]

        if len(matching_courses) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot isolate the expected course name and award "
                "in the saved structured data."
            )

        instances = matching_courses[0].get(
            "hasCourseInstance", []
        )

        if isinstance(instances, dict):
            instances = [instances]

        matches = []

        for instance in instances:
            if not isinstance(instance, dict):
                continue

            start = (
                instance.get("startdate")
                or instance.get("startDate")
                or ""
            )

            locations = instance.get("location", [])

            if isinstance(locations, dict):
                locations = [locations]

            campus_matches = any(
                isinstance(location, dict)
                and location.get("name") == target["schema_campus"]
                for location in locations
            )

            if (
                not str(start).startswith(target["schema_start"])
                or instance.get("courseMode") != "Onsite"
                or not campus_matches
            ):
                continue

            if target["kind"] == "postgraduate_research":
                if "full-time" not in str(
                    instance.get("name", "")
                ).casefold():
                    continue

            elif (
                instance.get("name") != "Full-time"
                or instance.get("courseWorkload")
                != target["schema_workload"]
            ):
                continue

            matches.append(instance)

        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot isolate the reviewed intake, campus "
                "and standard study route."
            )

        if target["kind"] == "postgraduate_research":
            if not re.search(
                r"MPhil:\s*full-time\s*1\s*[-–]\s*3\s*years",
                page["text"],
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot verify the MPhil full-time duration."
                )

    def extract_fee(self, course_id, page, target):
        text = " ".join(page["text"].split())

        if course_id == "C_UK003_65":
            pattern = (
                r"International students\s+"
                r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+With placement\s+"
                r"With foundation year\s+BSc \(Hons\)\s+"
                r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                r"International students starting\s+"
                r"(\d{4}/\d{2})\s+"
                r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)"
            )

            matches = re.findall(
                pattern,
                text,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot isolate the standard Games Programming fee."
                )

            amount, year = matches[0]

        elif course_id == "C_ARU003_RES_01":
            pattern = (
                r"International students,\s*"
                r"(\d{4}/\d{2})\s*"
                r"\(per year\)\s*"
                r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)"
            )

            matches = re.findall(
                pattern,
                text,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            )

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot isolate the full-time international "
                    "research fee."
                )

            year, amount = matches[0]

       
        else:
            # Inspect the fee section only. Navigation and general
            # scholarship guidance do not verify international tuition.
            fee_section = re.search(
                r"\bFees and funding\b(.*?)(?:"
                r"\bPlacement year fee\b|"
                r"\bLiving costs\b|"
                r"\bBursaries, scholarships and part-time work\b|"
                r"\Z)",
                text,
                re.IGNORECASE | re.DOTALL,
            )

            if fee_section is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot isolate the Animation fee section."
                )

            fee_text = fee_section.group(1)

            if re.search(
                r"\bInternational students\b",
                fee_text,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "The Animation fee section contains international "
                    "fee information. Review it before assigning a price."
                )

            if not re.search(
                r"£\s*[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?\s+"
                r"UK students starting\s+\d{4}/\d{2}",
                fee_text,
                re.IGNORECASE,
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Cannot confirm the captured Animation "
                    "UK-only fee presentation."
                )

            # International tuition remains unavailable.
            # Never substitute the published UK amount.
            return None, None

        amount = amount_string(amount)

        if (
            amount != target["expected_fee"]
            or year != target["academic_year"]
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unexpected fee/period: GBP {amount}, {year}."
            )

        return amount, year

    def snapshot(self, course, tuition, source, fields):
        return {
            "course": {
                field: getattr(course, field)
                for field in fields
            },
            "tuition": {
                "id": tuition.pk,
                "residency": tuition.residency,
                "currency": tuition.currency,
                "tuition_fee": amount_string(
                    tuition.tuition_fee
                ),
            },
            "source": (
                {
                    "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                    "source_url": source.source_url,
                    "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                    "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                    "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                    "raw_fees": deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                }
                if source is not None
                else None
            ),
        }

    def load_records(self, course_id, lock=False):
        courses = Course.objects
        tuitions = Tuition.objects
        sources = TuitionSource.objects

        if lock:
            courses = courses.select_for_update()
            tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            sources = sources.select_for_update()

        course = courses.get(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id=course_id,
        )

        tuition_rows = list(
            tuitions.filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
        )

        if (
            len(tuition_rows) != 1
            or tuition_rows[0].currency != "GBP"
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Exactly one GBP international tuition is required."
            )

        tuition = tuition_rows[0]
        source = sources.filter(tuition=tuition).first()

        return course, tuition, source

    def make_proposal(self, report, evidence_path, course_id):
        target = TARGETS[course_id]
        validator = EvidenceValidator()

        # Retains the existing saved-HTML checksum, URL and
        # course-entry checks.
        page, _, source_url = validator.load_page(
            report,
            evidence_path,
            course_id,
            target,
        )

        self.validate_schema(page, target)
        amount, year = self.extract_fee(
            course_id,
            page,
            target,
        )

        course, tuition, source = self.load_records(course_id)

        if course.title not in {
            target["old_title"],
            target["changes"]["title"],
        }:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unexpected stored title: {course.title!r}"
            )

        duplicate_ids = list(
            Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK003",
                course_url__in=[
                    source_url.rstrip("/"),
                    source_url.rstrip("/") + "/",
                ],
            )
            .exclude(course_id=course_id)
            .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
        )

        if duplicate_ids:
            raise ValueError(
                "Another record already uses this route: "
                + ", ".join(duplicate_ids)
            )

        after_course = {
            **target["changes"],
            "course_url": source_url,
        }

        before = self.snapshot(
            course,
            tuition,
            source,
            list(after_course),
        )

        changes = {
            field: {
                "before": before["course"][field],
                "after": value,
            }
            for field, value in after_course.items()
            if before["course"][field] != value
        }

        return {
            "course_id": course_id,
            "mapping": "explicit_replacement_proposal",
            "replacement_accepted": False,
            "before": before,
            "after_course": after_course,
            "course_changes": changes,
            "tuition": {
                "stored_amount": amount_string(tuition.tuition_fee),
                "proposed_amount": amount,
                "currency": "GBP",
                "academic_year": year,
                "fee_basis": (
                    "annual_tuition"
                    if amount is not None
                    else "unavailable"
                ),
                "source_fee_verified": amount is not None,
                "note": target["fee_note"],
            },
            "source": {
                "source_url": source_url,
                "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                "source_course_name": target["schema_name"],
                "source_course_code": (
                    target["changes"]["ucas_cao_code"]
                ),
                "course_kind": target["kind"],
                "evidence_generated_at": report.get("generated_at"),
            },
        }

    def save_proposal(self, proposal, records):
        course, tuition, source = records

        course_id = proposal["course_id"]
        after_course = proposal["after_course"]
        fee = proposal["tuition"]
        evidence = proposal["source"]

        before = self.snapshot(
            course,
            tuition,
            source,
            list(after_course),
        )

        if before != proposal["before"]:
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course_id}: database records changed after preview. "
                "Run the command again."
            )

        changed_fields = [
            field
            for field, value in after_course.items()
            if getattr(course, field) != value
        ]

        for field in changed_fields:
            setattr(course, field, after_course[field])

        if changed_fields:
            update_fields = list(changed_fields)

            if any(
                field.name == "updated_at"
                for field in Course._meta.fields
            ):
                update_fields.append("updated_at")

            course.save(update_fields=update_fields)

        if (
            source is not None
            and not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course_id}: existing source metadata requires review."
            )

        raw = deepcopy(source.raw_fees) if source else {}
        academic_year = fee["academic_year"] or ""
        verified = fee["source_fee_verified"]

        source_changed = (
            source is None
            or source.source_url != evidence["source_url"]
            or source.academic_year != academic_year
        )

        if changed_fields:
            history = raw.get("route_review_history", [])

            if not isinstance(history, list):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{course_id}: route history requires review."
                )

            # Keep the previous evidence without repeatedly nesting
            # the entire accumulated route history.
            previous_source = deepcopy(before["source"])

            if previous_source:
                previous_source["raw_fees"].pop(
                    "route_review_history",
                    None,
                )

            history.append({
                "recorded_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                "mapping": "explicit_replacement",
                "replacement_accepted": True,
                "before_course": before["course"],
                "after_course": deepcopy(after_course),
                "previous_tuition_source": previous_source,
                "evidence_generated_at": evidence[
                    "evidence_generated_at"
                ],
            })

            raw["route_review_history"] = history

        raw.update({
            "verified": verified,
            "academic_year": academic_year,
            "currency": "GBP",
            "source_fee_category": "International",
            "course_kind": evidence["course_kind"],
            "course_source_url": evidence["source_url"],
            "source_sha256": evidence["source_sha256"],
            "source_course_name": evidence["source_course_name"],
            "source_course_code": evidence["source_course_code"],
            "fee_basis": fee["fee_basis"],
            "annual_tuition": fee["proposed_amount"],
            "fee_note": fee["note"],
            "mapping": "explicit_replacement",
            "replacement_accepted": True,
        })

        if verified:
            amount = fee["proposed_amount"]

            raw["fee_categories"] = [{
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "academic_year": academic_year,
                "currency": "GBP",
                "annual_tuition": amount,
                "raw_annual_fee": amount,
                "annotation": fee["note"],
                "footnote_marker": "",
                "amount_requires_review": False,
            }]

            raw.pop("verification_reason", None)

            if amount_string(tuition.tuition_fee) != amount:
                tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(amount)
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

        else:
            # The old numeric fee remains historical. The saved
            # metadata marks it unavailable for the replacement.
            raw["fee_categories"] = []
            raw["verification_reason"] = fee["note"]

        # Preserve later scholarship/deposit reconciliation when
        # this importer is repeated for the same route and year.
        if changed_fields or source_changed:
            raw["scholarship_status"] = "applicability_pending"
            raw["deposit_status"] = "applicability_pending"

        defaults = {
            "academic_year": academic_year,
            "source_url": evidence["source_url"],
            "source_course_name": evidence["source_course_name"],
            "source_course_code": evidence["source_course_code"],
            "fee_basis": fee["fee_basis"],
            "raw_fees": raw,
        }

        if source is None or any(
            getattr(source, field) != value
            for field, value in defaults.items()
        ):
            source, _ = TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                tuition=tuition,
                defaults=defaults,
            )

        after = self.snapshot(
            course,
            tuition,
            source,
            list(after_course),
        )

        changed = before != after

        if changed:
            TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                tuition=tuition,
                course_identifier=course_id,
                residency="INTL",
                before=before,
                after=after,
            )

        return {
            "course_id": course_id,
            "changed": changed,
            "replacement_accepted": True,
            "fee_verified": verified,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
        }

    @staticmethod
    def write_report(path, data):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                data,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        if (
            options["apply"]
            and not options["accept_replacements"]
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Use both --apply and --accept-replacements "
                "to save these replacements."
            )

        evidence_path = self.find_evidence(options["evidence"])

        try:
            report = self.read_report(evidence_path)
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if report.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError("Evidence is not for ARU UK003.")

        proposals = []
        blocked = []

        for course_id in TARGETS:
            try:
                proposal = self.make_proposal(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    course_id,
                )

                proposals.append(proposal)
                fee = proposal["tuition"]

                if fee["source_fee_verified"]:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"{course_id}: "
                        f"GBP {fee['stored_amount']} -> "
                        f"{fee['proposed_amount']}; "
                        f"{fee['academic_year']} — "
                        "verified-fee replacement proposal"
                    )
                else:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"{course_id}: route-only replacement; "
                        "international fee unavailable"
                    )

                for field, change in proposal[
                    "course_changes"
                ].items():
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {change['before']} -> "
                        f"{change['after']}"
                    )

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  Fee note: {fee['note']}"
                )

            except (
                OSError,
                ValueError,
                TypeError,
                KeyError,
                ArithmeticError,
                CommandError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
                Course.MultipleObjectsReturned,
            ) as exc:
                blocked.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "reason": str(exc),
                })

                self.stderr.write(
                    f"{course_id}: BLOCKED — {exc}"
                )

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        preview_path = folder / f"games-health-preview-{stamp}.json"

        preview = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "mode": "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
            "collection_issues": report.get("errors", []),
            "proposals": proposals,
            "blocked": blocked,
            "excluded_course_ids": ["C_UK003_26"],
            "excluded_note": (
                "London MPH remains outside this batch."
            ),
        }

        try:
            self.write_report(preview_path, preview)
        except OSError as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot save preview report: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        verified_count = sum(
            proposal["tuition"]["source_fee_verified"]
            for proposal in proposals
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nVerified-fee proposals: {verified_count}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Route-only proposals: "
            f"{len(proposals) - verified_count}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Preview report: {preview_path}")

        if blocked:
            raise CommandError(
                "Some proposals require review. "
                "No database records changed."
            )

        if not options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "To save, run with "
                "--apply --accept-replacements."
            )
            return

        if {p["course_id"] for p in proposals} != set(TARGETS):
            raise CommandError(
                "The complete three-course preview is required. "
                "No database records changed."
            )

        ordered = sorted(
            proposals,
            key=lambda proposal: proposal["course_id"],
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            locked_records = {}

            # Lock every target before changing any target.
            for proposal in ordered:
                course_id = proposal["course_id"]

                locked_records[course_id] = self.load_records(
                    course_id,
                    lock=True,
                )

            # Recheck evidence and database state after locking.
            for proposal in ordered:
                refreshed = self.make_proposal(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    proposal["course_id"],
                )

                if refreshed != proposal:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{proposal['course_id']}: evidence or database "
                        "records changed after preview. "
                        "No changes from this batch were committed."
                    )

            results = [
                self.save_proposal(
                    proposal,
                    locked_records[proposal["course_id"]],
                )
                for proposal in ordered
            ]

        changed_count = sum(
            result["changed"]
            for result in results
        )

        applied_path = folder / (
            "games-health-applied-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        applied_report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "mode": "apply",
            "database_changes": changed_count > 0,
            "changed_records": changed_count,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
            "preview_report": str(preview_path),
            "results": results,
            "scholarship_scopes_changed": False,
            "deposit_policies_changed": False,
        }

        try:
            self.write_report(applied_path, applied_report)
        except OSError as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                "Database changes were committed and database audit "
                "records saved, but the applied JSON report could "
                f"not be written: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                f"Applied changed records: {changed_count}"
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Applied report: {applied_path}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Accepted replacements and tuition evidence saved. "
            "3D Animation international tuition remains unavailable."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship rules, stored discounts and deposit "
            "policies unchanged. Applicability requires reconciliation."
        )

class Command(RouteValidator):
    help = (
        "Preview three explicit ARU replacements using saved evidence. "
        "No database updates."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help=(
                "Optional evidence path. Otherwise find the newest "
                "campus-intake report containing these three courses."
            ),
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save the reviewed replacements and tuition evidence.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacements",
            action="store_true",
            help="Explicitly accept all three course replacements.",
        )

    def read_report(self, path):
        return json.loads(
            path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
        )

    def find_evidence(self, supplied):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)

        if supplied:
            path = Path(supplied)
            return path if path.is_absolute() else root / path

        candidates = []

        for path in (root / "logs" / "aru").glob(
            "campus-intakes-*/campus-intake-evidence.json"
        ):
            try:
                report = self.read_report(path)
                ids = {
                    entry["database_course"]["course_id"]
                    for entry in report.get("courses", [])
                }
            except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                continue

            if (
                report.get("university_id") == "UK003"
                and set(TARGETS).issubset(ids)
            ):
                candidates.append(path)

        if not candidates:
            raise CommandError(
                "No evidence report containing the three courses "
                "was found. Supply --evidence explicitly."
            )

        return max(candidates, key=lambda item: item.parent.name)

    def validate_schema(self, page, target):
        schemas = []

        for script in page.get("scripts", []):
            value = script.get("parsed_json")

            if isinstance(value, dict):
                schemas.append(value)
            elif isinstance(value, list):
                schemas.extend(
                    item for item in value
                    if isinstance(item, dict)
                )

        course_schemas = [
            item for item in schemas
            if item.get("@type") == "Course"
            and item.get("name") == target["schema_name"]
            and item.get("award") == target["schema_award"]
        ]

        if len(course_schemas) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Expected one matching course name and award "
                "in the saved structured data."
            )

        instances = course_schemas[0].get("hasCourseInstance", [])

        if isinstance(instances, dict):
            instances = [instances]

        matching = []

        for instance in instances:
            if not isinstance(instance, dict):
                continue

            locations = instance.get("location", [])

            if isinstance(locations, dict):
                locations = [locations]

            campus_matches = any(
                isinstance(location, dict)
                and location.get("name") == target["schema_campus"]
                for location in locations
            )

            start = (
                instance.get("startdate")
                or instance.get("startDate")
                or ""
            )

            if (
                instance.get("name") == "Full-time"
                and instance.get("courseMode") == "Onsite"
                and str(start).startswith("2027-09")
                and instance.get("courseWorkload")
                == target["schema_workload"]
                and campus_matches
            ):
                matching.append(instance)

        if len(matching) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot isolate the September 2027 standard "
                "full-time route, duration and campus."
            )

    def apply_proposals(self, proposals, report, evidence_path):
        def money(value):
            amount = Decimal(str(value))

            if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
                raise ValueError("Invalid tuition amount.")

            return str(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")))

        def source_state(source):
            if source is None:
                return None

            return {
                "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                "source_url": source.source_url,
                "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
            }

        applied = []

        with transaction.atomic():
            # Lock ARU courses before checking for duplicate route URLs.
            list(
                Course.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(university_id="UK003")
                .order_by("course_id")
            )

            list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    course__university_id="UK003",
                    course_id__in=TARGETS,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                .order_by("course_id")
            )

            list(
                TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    tuition__course__university_id="UK003",
                    tuition__course_id__in=TARGETS,
                    tuition__residency="INTL",
                )
                .order_by("tuition_id")
            )

            # Revalidate every proposal before making any changes.
            for proposal in proposals:
                course_id = proposal["course_id"]
                target = TARGETS[course_id]

                page, _, source_url = self.load_page(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    course_id,
                    target,
                )
                self.validate_schema(page, target)

                duplicates = list(
                    Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_url__in=[
                            source_url.rstrip("/"),
                            source_url.rstrip("/") + "/",
                        ],
                    )
                    .exclude(course_id=course_id)
                    .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
                )

                if duplicates:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: another record uses this route: "
                        + ", ".join(duplicates)
                        + ". Nothing was applied."
                    )

                fresh = self.make_proposal(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    course_id,
                    target,
                )

                original = {
                    key: value
                    for key, value in proposal.items()
                    if key != "reviewed_route"
                }

                if fresh != original:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: database inputs changed during "
                        "the run. Nothing was applied."
                    )

            for proposal in proposals:
                course_id = proposal["course_id"]
                target = TARGETS[course_id]

                course = Course.objects.get(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    course_id=course_id,
                )
                tuition = Tuition.objects.get(
                    course=course,
                    residency="INTL",
                    currency="GBP",
                )
                source = TuitionSource.objects.filter(
                    tuition=tuition
                ).first()

                course_fields = sorted(
                    set(target["changes"]) | {"course_url"}
                )

                before_course = {
                    field: getattr(course, field)
                    for field in course_fields
                }

                before_source = source_state(source)

                before = {
                    "course": before_course,
                    "tuition": {
                        "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
                        "currency": tuition.currency,
                    },
                    "source": before_source,
                }

                for field, change in proposal["course_changes"].items():
                    setattr(course, field, change["after"])

                published_amount = money(
                    proposal["tuition"]["proposed_amount"]
                )
                evidence = proposal["evidence"]

                raw = (
                    copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
                    if source is not None
                    and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    else {}
                )

                history = raw.get("route_review_history", [])

                if not isinstance(history, list):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: existing replacement history "
                        "requires review. Nothing was applied."
                    )

                history = copy.deepcopy(history)

                if proposal["course_changes"]:
                    history.append({
                        "mapping": "explicit_replacement",
                        "replacement_accepted": True,
                        "before": before_course,
                        "after": {
                            field: getattr(course, field)
                            for field in course_fields
                        },
                        "source_url": evidence["source_url"],
                        "source_sha256": evidence["source_sha256"],
                        "evidence_generated_at": (
                            evidence["evidence_generated_at"]
                        ),
                    })

                route_changed = (
                    bool(proposal["course_changes"])
                    or source is None
                    or source.academic_year != "2027/28"
                    or source.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    != evidence["source_url"].rstrip("/")
                )

                note = (
                    "Published annual international tuition for "
                    "September 2027 entry on the reviewed standard "
                    "full-time route. Foundation, part-time and "
                    "distance-learning options are excluded."
                )

                if course_id == "C_UK003_54":
                    note += (
                        " This comparison uses the one-year September "
                        "route, not the longer January route."
                    )

                raw.update({
                    "verified": True,
                    "fee_verification_status": "verified",
                    "verification_reason": "",
                    "academic_year": "2027/28",
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": published_amount,
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "fee_method": "reviewed_explicit_replacement",
                    "course_kind": (
                        "undergraduate_taught"
                        if course.level == "UG"
                        else "postgraduate_taught"
                    ),
                    "study_mode": "full_time",
                    "study_year": 1,
                    "campus": target["schema_campus"],
                    "intake": "September 2027",
                    "course_source_url": evidence["source_url"],
                    "source_sha256": evidence["source_sha256"],
                    "fee_note": note,
                    "reviewed_route": proposal["reviewed_route"],
                    "route_review_history": history,
                    "fee_categories": [{
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "academic_year": "2027/28",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": published_amount,
                        "raw_annual_fee": (
                            f"£{Decimal(published_amount):,.2f}"
                        ),
                        "annotation": note,
                        "amount_requires_review": False,
                    }],
                })

                # Remove contradictory fee-review messages while retaining
                # unrelated scholarship/deposit notes and prior evidence.
                fee_review = raw.get("fee_review")

                if isinstance(fee_review, dict):
                    raw["fee_review"] = {
                        **fee_review,
                        "status": "resolved_by_explicit_replacement",
                        "reason": note,
                    }

                display_notes = raw.get("display_notes")

                if isinstance(display_notes, dict):
                    raw["display_notes"] = {
                        **display_notes,
                        "fee": note,
                    }

                # Reset applicability only when the course identity/period
                # changes. A repeat run preserves later reconciliation.
                if route_changed:
                    previous_review = raw.get("scholarship_review")
                    if not isinstance(previous_review, dict):
                        previous_review = {}

                    previous_deposit = raw.get("deposit_review")
                    if not isinstance(previous_deposit, dict):
                        previous_deposit = {}

                    raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                        "applicability_unconfirmed"
                    )
                    raw["scholarship_review"] = {
                        **previous_review,
                        "status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
                        "note": target["scholarship_note"],
                    }

                    raw["deposit_status"] = "applicability_pending"
                    raw["deposit_review"] = {
                        **previous_deposit,
                        "status": "applicability_pending",
                        "note": (
                            "The course page publishes a £4,000 "
                            "deposit or sponsorship-letter requirement. "
                            "Saved policy scope requires separate "
                            "reconciliation for this replacement route."
                        ),
                    }

                after_source = {
                    "academic_year": "2027/28",
                    "source_url": evidence["source_url"],
                    "source_course_code": (
                        course.ucas_cao_code or ""
                    ),
                    "source_course_name": course.title,
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "raw_fees": raw,
                }

                after = {
                    "course": {
                        field: getattr(course, field)
                        for field in course_fields
                    },
                    "tuition": {
                        "tuition_fee": published_amount,
                        "currency": tuition.currency,
                    },
                    "source": after_source,
                }

                if before == after:
                    continue

                if proposal["course_changes"]:
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=[
                            *proposal["course_changes"],
                            "updated_at",
                        ]
                    )

                if money(tuition.tuition_fee) != published_amount:
                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(published_amount)
                    tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                if before_source != after_source:
                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after_source,
                    )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=before,
                    after=after,
                )

                applied.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

        return applied

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        evidence_path = self.find_evidence(options["evidence"])

        try:
            report = self.read_report(evidence_path)
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if report.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError("Evidence is not for ARU UK003.")

        proposals = []
        blocked = []

        for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
            try:
                page, _, source_url = self.load_page(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    course_id,
                    target,
                )

                self.validate_schema(page, target)

                duplicates = list(
                    Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_url__in=[
                            source_url.rstrip("/"),
                            source_url.rstrip("/") + "/",
                        ],
                    )
                    .exclude(course_id=course_id)
                    .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
                )

                if duplicates:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Another stored course already uses this URL: "
                        + ", ".join(duplicates)
                    )

                proposal = self.make_proposal(
                    report,
                    evidence_path,
                    course_id,
                    target,
                )

                proposal["reviewed_route"] = {
                    "entry": "September 2027",
                    "academic_year": "2027/28",
                    "mode": "full_time",
                    "campus": target["schema_campus"],
                    "excluded_routes": [
                        "foundation",
                        "part_time",
                        "distance_learning",
                    ],
                }

                proposals.append(proposal)

                fee = proposal["tuition"]

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course_id}: GBP {fee['stored_amount']} -> "
                    f"{fee['proposed_amount']}; September 2027 / "
                    "2027/28 — explicit replacement proposal"
                )

                for field, change in proposal["course_changes"].items():
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {change['before']} -> "
                        f"{change['after']}"
                    )

            except (
                ValueError,
                OSError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
                Course.MultipleObjectsReturned,
            ) as exc:
                blocked.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "reason": str(exc),
                })
                self.stderr.write(
                    f"{course_id}: BLOCKED — {exc}"
                )

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        output = folder / (
            "land-engineering-preview-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                    "university_id": "UK003",
                    "mode": "preview",
                    "database_changes": False,
                    "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
                    "proposals": proposals,
                    "blocked": blocked,
                    "scholarship_scopes_changed": False,
                    "deposit_policies_changed": False,
                },
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nVerified fee proposals: {len(proposals)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        if blocked:
            self.stdout.write(
                "No database records changed."
            )
            raise CommandError(
                "Some proposals require review. See the saved report."
            )

        if not options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "Replacements require explicit acceptance. Scholarship "
                "and deposit scopes have not been extended."
            )
            return

        if not options["accept_replacements"]:
            raise CommandError(
                "Use --apply --accept-replacements to accept "
                "the three reviewed course replacements. "
                "No database records changed."
            )

        applied = self.apply_proposals(
            proposals,
            report,
            evidence_path,
        )

        saved_report = json.loads(
            output.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        )
        saved_report.update({
            "mode": "apply",
            "database_changes": bool(applied),
            "replacements_accepted": True,
            "changed_records": len(applied),
            "applied_changes": applied,
        })

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                saved_report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Applied changed records: {len(applied)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Accepted replacements, international tuition, source "
            "evidence and audit records saved."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship rules, stored scholarship amounts and "
            "deposit policies unchanged. Replacement-route "
            "scholarship/deposit scopes require reconciliation."
        )
