                "See the saved report."
            )

    def get_page(self, folder, pages, url):
        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") == url
        ]

        if not matches:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Collected source page not found: {url}"
            )

        # Validate every capture against its own saved HTML.
        for page in matches:
            filename = page.get("html_file")

            if (
                not isinstance(filename, str)
                or Path(filename).name != filename
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Invalid saved HTML filename."
                )

            try:
                content = (folder / filename).read_bytes()
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Cannot read saved HTML: {filename}"
                ) from exc

            digest = hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()

            if digest != page.get("sha256"):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Saved HTML hash mismatch: {filename}"
                )

        if len(matches) > 1:
            reference_text = " ".join(
                matches[0].get("text", "").split()
            )
            reference_config = read_config(matches[0])

            for page in matches[1:]:
                current_text = " ".join(
                    page.get("text", "").split()
                )
                current_config = read_config(page)

                if (
                    current_text != reference_text
                    or current_config != reference_config
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate captures contain different "
                        "course text or configuration; "
                        "manual review is required."
                    )

        return matches[0]
    
    def plan_course(self, folder, pages, course_id, target):
        url = "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/" + target["slug"]
        page = self.get_page(folder, pages, url)

        course = Course.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id=course_id,
            is_active=True,
        ).first()

        if course is None:
            raise CommandError("Active database course not found.")

        if (
            course.title
            not in {target["old_title"], target["title"]}
            or course.level != target["level"]
            or course.duration != target["duration"]
            or course.location != target["campus"] + " Campus"
            or course.work_placement
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Stored title, level, campus or route "
                "differs from the reviewed mapping."
            )

        tuitions = list(
            Tuition.objects.filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
        )
        if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
            raise CommandError(
                "One GBP international tuition is required."
            )

        tuition = tuitions[0]
        source = TuitionSource.objects.filter(
            tuition=tuition
        ).first()

        if target["level"] == "UG":
            self.validate_banking(page, target)
        else:
            self.validate_education(page, target)

        fields = [
            "title",
            "level",
            "duration",
            "location",
            "start_month",
            "start_year",
            "intake_months",
            "course_url",
            "ucas_cao_code",
            "work_placement",
        ]

        before = {
            "course": {
                field: getattr(course, field)
                for field in fields
            },
            "tuition": {
                "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
                "currency": tuition.currency,
                "scholarship": money(tuition.scholarship),
                "scholarship_source_id": (
                    tuition.scholarship_source_id
                ),
            },
            "source": (
                {
                    "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                    "source_url": source.source_url,
                    "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                    "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                    "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                    "raw_fees": source.raw_fees,
                }
                if source
                else None
            ),
        }

        after = copy.deepcopy(before)
        after["course"].update({
            "title": target["title"],
            "start_month": "September",
            "start_year": 2027,
            "intake_months": "September",
            "course_url": url,
            "ucas_cao_code": target["code"],
        })
        after["tuition"].update({
            "tuition_fee": target["amount"],
            "scholarship": "0.00",
            "scholarship_source_id": None,
        })

        raw = (
            copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
            if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
            else {}
        )

        raw.update({
            "verified": True,
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "source_fee_category": "International",
            "currency": "GBP",
            "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
            "study_year": 1,
            "course_kind": (
                "undergraduate"
                if target["level"] == "UG"
                else "postgraduate_taught"
            ),
            "course_source_url": url,
            "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
            "mapping_kind": target["mapping_kind"],
            "campus": target["campus"],
            "intake": "September 2027",
            "fee_method": "reviewed_named_route",
            "scholarship_status": (
                "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
            ),
            "deposit_status": (
                "verified_policy_eligibility_required"
            ),
            "fee_note": (
                "Published annual international tuition for "
                "September 2027, full-time campus study. "
                "Distance learning, APCL, foundation and "
                "placement routes are excluded."
            ),
            "fee_categories": [{
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "currency": "GBP",
                "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                "amount_requires_review": False,
            }],
        })

        raw.pop("verification_reason", None)

        if target["mapping_kind"] == "explicit_replacement":
            # Keep a stable replacement record across reruns.
            if "route_replacement" not in raw:
                raw["route_replacement"] = {
                    "previous_title": target["old_title"],
                    "replacement_title": target["title"],
                    "reason": (
                        "Explicit replacement with the currently "
                        "advertised Banking, Finance and Fintech "
                        "standard honours route."
                    ),
                    "source_url": url,
                }
        else:
            raw["named_pathway"] = target["title"]
            raw["parent_course"] = "MA Education"

        after["source"] = {
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "source_url": url,
            "source_course_code": target["code"],
            "source_course_name": target["title"],
            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
            "raw_fees": raw,
        }

        return {
            "course_id": course_id,
            "mapping_kind": target["mapping_kind"],
            "changed": before != after,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
        }

    def validate_banking(self, page, target):
        instances = []

        for script in page.get("scripts", []):
            parsed = script.get("parsed_json")
            if isinstance(parsed, dict):
                values = parsed.get("hasCourseInstance", [])
                if isinstance(values, dict):
                    values = [values]
                if isinstance(values, list):
                    instances.extend(values)

        found = any(
            isinstance(item, dict)
            and item.get("name") == "Full-time"
            and item.get("courseWorkload") == "P3Y"
            and item.get("startdate") == "2027-09"
            and item.get("duration", "").casefold() == "3 years"
            and any(
                location.get("name") == target["campus"]
                for location in item.get("location", [])
                if isinstance(location, dict)
            )
            for item in instances
        )

        if not found:
            raise CommandError(
                "September 2027 standard Banking route "
                "not confirmed."
            )

        text = page.get("text", "")
        section = re.search(
            r"International students\s+BSc \(Hons\).*?"
            r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+(.*?)"
            r"(?=\s+With placement\b)",
            text,
            flags=re.S,
        )

        if section is None:
            raise CommandError(
                "Standard Banking fee section not found."
            )

        amounts = {
            money(value.replace(",", ""))
            for value in re.findall(
                r"£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                r"International students starting 2027/28\s+"
                r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                section.group(1),
            )
        }

        if amounts != {target["amount"]}:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected Banking fee: {sorted(amounts)}"
            )

        if not re.search(
            r"UCAS course code\s+N309\b",
            text,
        ):
            raise CommandError("Banking UCAS code not confirmed.")

    def validate_education(self, page, target):
        text = page.get("text", "")
        pathway = (
            target["title"]
            + " (available in "
        )

        if pathway not in text:
            raise CommandError(
                "Named Education pathway not found."
            )

        start = text.index(pathway)
        availability = text[start:].split(")", 1)[0]

        if target["campus"] not in availability:
            raise CommandError(
                "Chelmsford pathway availability not confirmed."
            )

        config = read_config(page)
        options = [
            option
            for option in config.get("CourseOptions", [])
            if (
                option.get("Duration", {}).get("Name")
                == "1 year full-time"
                and any(
                    date.get("Name") == "September 2027"
                    for date in option.get("StartDate", [])
                )
                and any(
                    location.get("ShortName") == target["campus"]
                    for location in option.get("Location", [])
                )
            )
        ]

        if len(options) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                "Expected one full-time September 2027 "
                "campus Education option."
            )

        amounts = set()
        for fee in options[0].get("TuitionFees", []):
            band = fee.get("FeeBand") or {}
            if band.get("Description") == (
                "International students starting 2027/28 "
                "(full-time, per year)"
            ):
                amounts.add(money(band["Value"]))

        if amounts != {target["amount"]}:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected Education campus fee: "
                f"{sorted(amounts)}"
            )

    def plan_scholarships(self, report):
        for name, additions in RULE_SCOPES.items():
            rules = list(
                ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
                    scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                    scholarship__name=name,
                    verified=True,
                )
            )

            if len(rules) != 1:
                report["blocked"].append({
                    "course_id": "scholarship_scope",
                    "reason": (
                        f"Expected one verified rule: {name}"
                    ),
                })
                continue

            rule = rules[0]
            old = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)

            if (
                not isinstance(old, dict)
                or old.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or not isinstance(old.get("conditions"), dict)
                or not isinstance(
                    old["conditions"].get("course_id"), list
                )
                or not all(
                    isinstance(value, str)
                    for value in old["conditions"]["course_id"]
                )
            ):
                report["blocked"].append({
                    "course_id": "scholarship_scope",
                    "reason": f"Unsupported saved rule: {name}",
                })
                continue

            expected_kind = (
                "fixed_maximum"
                if "Postgraduate" in name
                else "fixed"
            )

            if (
                old.get("kind") != expected_kind
                or old.get("study_years") != [1]
                or (
                    "Postgraduate" in name
                    and old["conditions"].get("aru_graduate")
                    != [True]
                )
            ):
                report["blocked"].append({
                    "course_id": "scholarship_scope",
                    "reason": (
                        f"Saved eligibility structure "
                        f"requires review: {name}"
                    ),
                })
                continue

            new = copy.deepcopy(old)
            new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                set(old["conditions"]["course_id"]) | additions
            )

            report["scholarship_rules"].append({
                "rule_id": rule.pk,
                "name": name,
                "changed": old != new,
                "before": old,
                "after": new,
            })

    def apply_plan(self, report, evidence_folder, pages):
        with transaction.atomic():
            # Lock the courses before rechecking the proposed plan.
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }

            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Course records changed after preview."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    course_id__in=TARGETS,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                .order_by("pk")
            )

            tuition_by_course = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_by_course:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_by_course[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if set(tuition_by_course) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "International tuition records changed."
                )

            list(
                TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                .order_by("pk")
            )

            # Revalidate evidence and current database values while
            # the affected records are locked.
            for entry in report["courses"]:
                course_id = entry["course_id"]
                current = self.plan_course(
                    evidence_folder,
                    pages,
                    course_id,
                    TARGETS[course_id],
                )

                if (
                    current["before"] != entry["before"]
                    or current["after"] != entry["after"]
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: values changed during "
                        "the run. Run the preview again."
                    )

            locked_rules = {}
            for entry in report["scholarship_rules"]:
                rule = (
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .get(pk=entry["rule_id"])
                )

                if not rule.verified or rule.rules != entry["before"]:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Scholarship rules changed during the run."
                    )

                locked_rules[rule.pk] = rule

            deposit_entry = report["deposit_policy"]
            if deposit_entry is None:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Validated deposit policy is required."
                )

            policy = (
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update()
                .get(pk=deposit_entry["policy_id"])
            )

            if (
                not policy.verified
                or policy.university_id != "UK003"
                or policy.academic_year != YEAR
                or policy.currency != "GBP"
                or policy.rules != deposit_entry["before"]
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Deposit policy changed during the run."
                )

            for entry in report["courses"]:
                if not entry["changed"]:
                    continue

                course_id = entry["course_id"]
                course = courses[course_id]
                tuition = tuition_by_course[course_id]
                after = entry["after"]

                for field, value in after["course"].items():
                    setattr(course, field, value)

                course.save(
                    update_fields=(
                        list(after["course"]) + ["updated_at"]
                    )
                )

                tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                    after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                )
                tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                tuition.scholarship_source_id = None
                tuition.save(update_fields=[
                    "tuition_fee",
                    "scholarship",
                    "scholarship_source",
                ])

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=after["source"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=entry["before"],
                    after=after,
                )

            for entry in report["scholarship_rules"]:
                if entry["changed"]:
                    rule = locked_rules[entry["rule_id"]]
                    rule.rules = entry["after"]
                    rule.save(update_fields=["rules"])

            if deposit_entry["changed"]:
                policy.rules = deposit_entry["after"]
                policy.save(
                    update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"]
                )

                
    def plan_deposit(self, report):
        policies = list(
            DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK003",
                academic_year=YEAR,
                currency="GBP",
                verified=True,
            )
        )

        if len(policies) != 1:
            report["blocked"].append({
                "course_id": "deposit_policy",
                "reason": (
                    "Expected one verified GBP deposit policy."
                ),
            })
            return

        policy = policies[0]
        old = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

        if (
            not isinstance(old, dict)
            or old.get("schema_version") != 1
            or old.get("kind") != "fixed"
            or old.get("currency") != "GBP"
            or old.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
            or old.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
            or not isinstance(old.get("course_ids"), list)
            or not all(
                isinstance(value, str)
                for value in old["course_ids"]
            )
        ):
            report["blocked"].append({
                "course_id": "deposit_policy",
                "reason": "Unsupported saved deposit policy.",
            })
            return

        try:
            valid_amount = money(old["amount"]) == "4000.00"
        except (KeyError, ValueError, InvalidOperation, TypeError):
            valid_amount = False

        if not valid_amount:
            report["blocked"].append({
                "course_id": "deposit_policy",
                "reason": "Expected the saved GBP 4,000 amount.",
            })
            return

        new = copy.deepcopy(old)
        new["course_ids"] = sorted(
            set(old["course_ids"]) | set(TARGETS)
        )

        report["deposit_policy"] = {
            "policy_id": policy.pk,
            "changed": old != new,
            "before": old,
            "after": new,
        }

import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction

from app.models import Course


COURSE_ID = "C_UK001_70"

OLD_TITLE = "MA Technical Art and Visual Effects"
NEW_TITLE = "MSc Technical Art and Visual Effects"

SOURCE_URL = (
    "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/course-search/"
    "postgraduate-taught/technical-art-and-visual-effects/"
)

FIELDS = (
    "title",
    "level",
    "duration",
    "start_month",
    "start_year",
    "course_url",
    "is_active",
)


def snapshot(course):
    return {
        field: getattr(course, field)
        for field in FIELDS
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply evidence-backed Abertay "
        "course-record corrections."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)

        # Reuse the source preview already collected.
        preview_path = root / "abertay_remaining_preview.json"

        try:
            preview = json.loads(
                preview_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )

            if preview["academic_year"] != "2026/27":
                raise ValueError(
                    "Expected the 2026/27 source preview."
                )

            matches = [
                record
                for record in preview["postgraduate"]
                if record.get("kind") == "postgraduate_taught"
                and record.get("status") == "extracted"
                and record.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/")
                == SOURCE_URL.rstrip("/")
            ]

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Expected one Technical Art source record."
                )

            data = matches[0]["data"]

            if data.get("title") != NEW_TITLE:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Source title does not match the reviewed MSc."
                )

            if (
                data.get("academic_year") != "2026/27"
                or data.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or Decimal(str(data["annual_tuition"]))
                != Decimal("19950.00")
                or data.get("footnote_marker")
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Source fee evidence requires review."
                )

            if "12 months" not in (
                data.get("duration") or ""
            ).casefold():
                raise ValueError(
                    "Source full-time duration requires review."
                )

        except (
            OSError,
            KeyError,
            TypeError,
            ValueError,
            ArithmeticError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        log_dir = root / "logs" / "abertay-course-corrections"
        log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(
            "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
        )
        report_path = log_dir / f"courses-{timestamp}.json"

        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                course = (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .get(
                        course_id=COURSE_ID,
                        university__name__iexact=(
                            "Abertay University"
                        ),
                        university__country="UK",
                    )
                )
            except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected Abertay course was not found."
                ) from exc

            if course.title not in {OLD_TITLE, NEW_TITLE}:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database title changed since review."
                )

            if (
                course.level not in {"PG", "PGT"}
                or course.start_year != 2026
                or course.start_month.strip().casefold()
                != "september"
                or course.duration.strip().casefold()
                not in {"1 year", "1 years"}
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Stored level, intake or duration "
                    "does not match the reviewed record."
                )

            duplicates = list(
                Course.objects.filter(
                    university_id=course.university_id,
                    title__iexact=NEW_TITLE,
                    start_year=course.start_year,
                    start_month__iexact=course.start_month,
                    level__in=["PG", "PGT"],
                )
                .exclude(pk=course.pk)
                .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
            )

            if duplicates:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Possible duplicate records require review: "
                    + ", ".join(duplicates)
                )

            before = snapshot(course)
            after = dict(before)

            # The stored one-year duration already agrees
            # with the published 12-month full-time duration.
            after["title"] = NEW_TITLE
            after["course_url"] = SOURCE_URL

            changed_fields = [
                field
                for field in FIELDS
                if before[field] != after[field]
            ]

            report = {
                "mode": (
                    "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview"
                ),
                "database_changes": False,
                "committed": False,
                "course_id": course.course_id,
                "evidence": {
                    "course_url": SOURCE_URL,
                    "academic_year": "2026/27",
                    "source_preview": preview_path.name,
                    "source_title": data["title"],
                    "source_duration": data["duration"],
                    "published_international_fee": (
                        data["annual_tuition"]
                    ),
                },
                "before": before,
                "after": after,
                "changed_fields": changed_fields,
                "tuition_changes": False,
                "scholarship_changes": False,
                "deposit_changes": False,
            }

            # Save the plan before applying changes.
            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"] and changed_fields:
                for field in changed_fields:
                    setattr(course, field, after[field])

                course.save(
                    update_fields=[
                        *changed_fields,
                        "updated_at",
                    ]
                )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["database_changes"] = bool(changed_fields)
            report["committed"] = True

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "course_id": COURSE_ID,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed_fields": changed_fields,
                },
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            )
        )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nReport: {report_path}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Applied corrections: {len(changed_fields)} fields."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

def text(element):
    return " ".join(
        element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
    )


def fetch_policy():
    response = requests.get(
        SOURCE_URL,
        headers={
            "User-Agent": "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0",
        },
        timeout=(30, 60),
    )
    response.raise_for_status()

    if response.url.rstrip("/") != SOURCE_URL.rstrip("/"):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
        )

    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")

    heading = soup.find("h1")

    if heading is None or not (
        "2025-2026" in text(heading)
        or "2025-26" in text(heading)
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Unexpected academic year on the source page."
        )

    headings = soup.find_all(
        lambda tag: tag.name in ("h2", "h3", "h4")
        and text(tag) == (
            "Postgraduate Tuition Fees - "
            "International Students 2025/26"
        )
    )

    if len(headings) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "Expected one international postgraduate section."
        )

    section = headings[0].find_parent(
        "div",
        class_="e-item",
    )

    if section is None:
        raise ValueError(
            "Could not isolate the international fee section."
        )

    tables = []

    for table in section.find_all("table"):
        rows = []

        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = row.find_all(["th", "td"])

            if cells:
                rows.append([
                    text(cell) for cell in cells
                ])

        if (
            rows
            and len(rows[0]) == 2
            and rows[0][0].casefold()
            == "postgraduate courses"
            and "tuition fees per year"
            in rows[0][1].casefold()
        ):
            tables.append(rows)

    if len(tables) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "Expected one international postgraduate fee table."
        )

    return response.content, tables[0], text(section)


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile reviewed January/February 2026 "
        "international fees against the 2025/26 policy."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            html, table, policy_text = fetch_policy()

            research_rows = [
                row
                for row in table[1:]
                if len(row) == 2
                and row[0]
                == "Masters by Research (all subjects)"
            ]

            if len(research_rows) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Research fee is missing or ambiguous."
                )

            research_fee = money(research_rows[0][1])

            if str(research_fee) != "22000.00":
                raise ValueError(
                    "Research fee changed; review the source."
                )

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            ValueError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(str(exc)) from exc

        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        log_dir = root / "logs" / "abertay-fees"
        evidence_dir = log_dir / "source-evidence"

        evidence_dir.mkdir(
            parents=True,
            exist_ok=True,
        )

        digest = hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest()

        evidence_file = evidence_dir / (
            f"abertay-2025-26-{digest[:12]}.html"
        )
        evidence_file.write_bytes(html)

        plans = []
        expected_ids = set(TAUGHT) | set(RESEARCH)

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = list(
                Course.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    course_id__in=expected_ids,
                    university__name__iexact=(
                        "Abertay University"
                    ),
                    university__country="UK",
                )
                .order_by("course_id")
            )

            if {
                course.course_id for course in courses
            } != expected_ids:
                raise CommandError(
                    "One or more reviewed courses are missing."
                )

            for course in courses:
                taught = course.course_id in TAUGHT
                expected_month = (
                    "january" if taught else "february"
                )

                if (
                    course.start_year != 2026
                    or course.start_month.strip().casefold()
                    != expected_month
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course.course_id}: intake changed."
                    )

                expected_title = (
                    TAUGHT[course.course_id][0]
                    if taught
                    else RESEARCH[course.course_id]
                )

                if normalise(course.title) != normalise(
                    expected_title
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course.course_id}: title changed."
                    )

                if taught:
                    if (
                        course.level not in {"PG", "PGT"}
                        or course.duration.strip().casefold()
                        != "1.3 years"
                    ):
                        raise CommandError(
                            f"{course.course_id}: "
                            "level or duration changed."
                        )

                    rows = taught_policy_rows(
                        table,
                        course.title,
                    )

                    if len(rows) != 1:
                        raise CommandError(
                            f"{course.course_id}: "
                            "named fee is ambiguous."
                        )

                    source_label, raw_fee = rows[0]
                    fee = money(raw_fee)

                    if str(fee) != TAUGHT[course.course_id][1]:
                        raise CommandError(
                            f"{course.course_id}: "
                            "published fee changed."
                        )

                    kind = "postgraduate_taught"

                else:
                    if (
                        course.level not in {"PG", "MRES"}
                        or course.duration.strip().casefold()
                        not in {"1 year", "1 years"}
                    ):
                        raise CommandError(
                            f"{course.course_id}: "
                            "research level or duration changed."
                        )

                    source_label, raw_fee = research_rows[0]
                    fee = research_fee
                    kind = "masters_by_research"

                fees = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if len(fees) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course.course_id}: "
                        "expected one international tuition."
                    )

                tuition = fees[0]

                if tuition.currency != "GBP":
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course.course_id}: currency is not GBP."
                    )

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                if source and (
                    source.academic_year
                    not in {"2025/26", "2026/27"}
                    or source.source_url not in {
                        SOURCE_URL,
                        PREVIOUS_SOURCE_URL,
                    }
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course.course_id}: "
                        "existing source needs separate review."
                    )

                note = (
                    "2025/26 entrant fee for the stored "
                    f"{course.start_month} 2026 intake. "
                    "Course details and stored discounts "
                    "have not been changed. Scholarship "
                    "eligibility for this cohort requires "
                    "separate verified rules."
                )

                metadata = {
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
                    "source_course_code": "",
                    "source_course_name": source_label,
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "student_contribution": None,
                    "published_total": None,
                    "raw_fees": {
                        "fee_status": "International",
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": raw_fee,
                        "course_kind": kind,
                        "fee_method": "reviewed_cohort_policy",
                        "cohort_academic_year": YEAR,
                        "matched_database_title": course.title,
                        "policy_sha256": digest,
                        "policy_snapshot": str(evidence_file),
                        "review_note": note,
                        "fee_categories": [{
                            "source_fee_category": "International",
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "currency": "GBP",
                            "raw_annual_fee": raw_fee,
                            "annual_tuition": str(fee),
                            "footnote_marker": "",
                            "annotation": note,
                            "amount_requires_review": False,
                        }],
                    },
                }

                old_metadata = (
                    {
                        field: getattr(source, field)
                        for field in SOURCE_FIELDS
                    }
                    if source else None
                )

                # Compare fee data separately from download evidence.
                old_comparison = serialisable(old_metadata)
                new_comparison = serialisable(metadata)

                for comparison in (
                    old_comparison,
                    new_comparison,
                ):
                    if comparison is None:
                        continue

                    raw = comparison.get("raw_fees", {})
                    raw.pop("policy_sha256", None)
                    raw.pop("policy_snapshot", None)

                changed = (
                    tuition.tuition_fee != fee
                    or old_comparison != new_comparison
                )

                # Keep the saved metadata when only download
                # evidence changed. The new HTML is still archived.
                if not changed:
                    metadata = old_metadata

                before = serialisable({
                    "tuition_fee": tuition.tuition_fee,
                    "source_metadata": old_metadata,
                })

                after = serialisable({
                    "tuition_fee": fee,
                    "source_metadata": metadata,
                })
                plans.append({
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "fee": fee,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": changed,
                })

            report = {
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "mode": (
                    "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview"
                ),
                "status": "prepared",
                "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
                "source_sha256": digest,
                "policy_text": policy_text,
                "proposals": [
                    {
                        "course_id": plan["course"].course_id,
                        "title": plan["course"].title,
                        "start_month": plan["course"].start_month,
                        "start_year": plan["course"].start_year,
                        "changed": plan["changed"],
                        "before": plan["before"],
                        "after": plan["after"],
                    }
                    for plan in plans
                ],
            }

            output = log_dir / (
                "early-2026-"
                + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
                + ".json"
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            for plan in plans:
                course = plan["course"]
                tuition = plan["tuition"]

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course.course_id}: "
                    f"GBP {tuition.tuition_fee} -> "
                    f"{plan['fee']} — "
                    f"{'update' if plan['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
                )

                if not options["apply"] or not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                tuition.tuition_fee = plan["fee"]
                tuition.save(
                    update_fields=["tuition_fee"]
                )

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=plan["metadata"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course.course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        report["status"] = (
            "committed" if options["apply"] else "preview_only"
        )

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nMatched records: {len(plans)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Proposed/updated records: "
            f"{sum(plan['changed'] for plan in plans)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Before/after report: {output}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Applied tuition/source updates."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

"""One reviewed 2026/27 pilot record, preview by default."""
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone
from app.models import Tuition, Scholarship, ScholarshipRule

FEE_SOURCE = 'https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/money-fees-and-funding/tuition-fees-2026-2027/'
AWARD_SOURCE = 'https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/money-fees-and-funding/scholarships/abertay-international-scholarship/'
TERMS_SOURCE = 'https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/money-fees-and-funding/terms-conditions/'

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'Preview or reconcile Abertay course C_UK001_01 and scholarship 85 only.'
    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument('--apply', action='store_true')
    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        with transaction.atomic():
            tuition = Tuition.objects.select_for_update().select_related('course__university').get(pk=4703)
            award = Scholarship.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=85)
            if (tuition.course.course_id != 'C_UK001_01' or tuition.residency != 'INTL'
                or tuition.currency != 'GBP' or tuition.course.level != 'UG'
                or tuition.course.start_year != 2026
                or tuition.course.university.name != 'Abertay University'
                or award.university_id != tuition.course.university_id
                or award.name != 'Abertay International Scholarship' or award.level != 'UG'):
                raise CommandError('Pilot IDs do not match the reviewed course/award.')
            if tuition.tuition_fee not in (Decimal('15500'), Decimal('16950')) or tuition.scholarship != Decimal('3000'):
                raise CommandError('Amounts changed since review; stopped rather than overwrite.')
            if tuition.scholarship_source_id not in (None,85):
                raise CommandError('A different scholarship is linked.')
            rule = {
                'fee_basis_confirmed': True, 'benefit': 'tuition', 'kind': 'fixed',
                'value': '3000', 'currency': 'GBP', 'academic_year': '2026/27',
                'study_years': [1], 'percentage_basis': 'original_tuition',
                'award_status': 'conditional', 'stacking': 'exclusive', 'compatible_ids': [],
                'conditions': {'course_id':['C_UK001_01'], 'level':['UG'], 'fee_status':['INTL'],
                    'new_entrant':[True], 'full_time':[True], 'on_campus_dundee':[True],
                    'academic_conditions_met':[True], 'partner_discount':[False], 'repeat_year':[False]},
                'fee_source_url': FEE_SOURCE, 'terms_source_url': TERMS_SOURCE,
                'review_notes': 'Pilot annual deduction only. No combined awards or early-payment discounts. Award notification and acceptance still required.'
            }
            before = {'tuition_id':tuition.pk, 'tuition_fee':str(tuition.tuition_fee),
                      'scholarship':str(tuition.scholarship), 'scholarship_source_id':tuition.scholarship_source_id,
                      'scholarship_id':award.pk, 'deadline':str(award.deadline) if award.deadline else None,
                      'rule': list(ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(scholarship=award).values())}
            after = {'tuition_fee':'16950.00', 'legacy_scholarship':'3000.00',
                     'scholarship_source_id':85, 'deadline':None, 'rules':rule}
            self.stdout.write(json.dumps({'before':before,'proposed':after},indent=2,default=str))
            if not options['apply']:
                self.stdout.write('Preview only: no records changed. Use --apply after reviewing.')
                return
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)/'logs'/'scholarship-reconciliation'
            folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            backup = folder/(timezone.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%f')+'.json')
            with backup.open('x',encoding='utf-8') as f:
                json.dump({'before':before,'proposed':after,'recorded_at':timezone.now().isoformat()},f,indent=2,default=str)
            tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal('16950')
            tuition.scholarship_source = award
            tuition.save(update_fields=['tuition_fee','scholarship_source'])
            # Official scholarship is assessed with course application; imported July deadline is unsupported.
            award.deadline = None
            award.save(update_fields=['deadline'])
            ScholarshipRule.objects.update_or_create(scholarship=award,defaults={
                'verified':True, 'source_url':AWARD_SOURCE,'reviewed_at':timezone.now(),'rules':rule})
            self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(f'Pilot reconciled. Before/after record: {backup}'))

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction

from app.models import (
    Course,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
)

from .import_abertay_remaining_fees import (
    SOURCE_FIELDS,
    fee_table,
    money,
    section,
    serialisable,
)


YEAR = "2026/27"

POLICY_URL = (
    "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/"
    "money-fees-and-funding/tuition-fees-2026-2027/"
)

TARGETS = {
    "C_ABE001_RES_06": {
        "stored_title": "Food Science and Technology MSc by Research",
        "url": (
            "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/course-search/"
            "postgraduate-research/food-drink-science-technology/"
        ),
        "heading_words": ("food", "science", "technology"),
    },
    "C_ABE001_RES_08": {
        "stored_title": "Mental Health Nursing MSc by Research",
        "url": (
            "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/course-search/"
            "postgraduate-research/"
            "professional-development-in-mental-health-nursing-and-counselling/"
        ),
        "heading_words": ("mental", "health", "nursing", "counselling"),
    },
}

APPLICATION_NOTE = (
    "Published annual Masters by Research fee. "
    "The course page currently states that international "
    "Masters by Research/MPhil applications are not being "
    "accepted because of CAS availability. "
    "A published fee does not confirm that applications are open."
)


def clean_text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def course_snapshot(course):
    return {
        "title": course.title,
        "level": course.level,
        "duration": course.duration,
        "start_month": course.start_month,
        "start_year": course.start_year,
        "course_url": course.course_url,
        "is_active": course.is_active,
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile two reviewed October 2026 Abertay "
        "research-course fee records. Preview by default."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(
            "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
        )

        log_dir = root / "logs" / "abertay-fees"
        evidence_dir = log_dir / "source-evidence"
        evidence_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        try:
            policy_path = root / "abertay_remaining_policy.json"
            policy_text = policy_path.read_text(
                encoding="utf-8-sig"
            )
            policy = json.loads(policy_text)

            if (
                policy["source_url"] != POLICY_URL
                or policy["page_title"] != "Tuition Fees (2026-2027)"
            ):
                raise ValueError("Unexpected fee-policy source.")

            pg_section = section(
                policy,
                "Postgraduate Tuition Fees - "
                "International Students 2026/27",
            )
            table = fee_table(
                pg_section,
                "POSTGRADUATE COURSES",
            )

            rows = [
                row
                for row in table[1:]
                if len(row) == 2
                and row[0] == "Masters by Research (all subjects)"
            ]

            if len(rows) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    "Expected one international Masters by Research fee."
                )

            raw_fee = rows[0][1]
            fee = money(raw_fee)

            if fee != Decimal("22000.00"):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Published research fee changed; review required."
                )

        except (
            OSError,
            KeyError,
            TypeError,
            ValueError,
            ArithmeticError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Fee-policy validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        evidence = {}

        # Complete network requests before opening a DB transaction.
        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers.update({
                    "User-Agent": "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                })

                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                    response = session.get(
                        target["url"],
                        timeout=(15, 60),
                    )
                    response.raise_for_status()

                    if (
                        response.url.rstrip("/")
                        != target["url"].rstrip("/")
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: unexpected redirect."
                        )

                    soup = BeautifulSoup(
                        response.text,
                        "html.parser",
                    )
                    heading = soup.find("h1")

                    if heading is None:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: missing course heading."
                        )

                    source_title = clean_text(heading)

                    if not all(
                        word in source_title.casefold()
                        for word in target["heading_words"]
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: research-area heading changed."
                        )

                    if len(source_title) > 255:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: source title is too long."
                        )

                    details = {}

                    for item in soup.select("div.e-item"):
                        label = item.find("h4")
                        value = item.find("span", recursive=False)

                        if label is not None and value is not None:
                            details[clean_text(label)] = clean_text(value)

                    if "msc by research" not in details.get(
                        "Award Title", ""
                    ).casefold():
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: MSc by Research award unconfirmed."
                        )

                    if "1 year full-time" not in details.get(
                        "Duration", ""
                    ).casefold():
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: one-year duration unconfirmed."
                        )

                    if "october" not in details.get(
                        "Start Date", ""
                    ).casefold():
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: October intake unconfirmed."
                        )

                    page_text = clean_text(soup).casefold()

                    if (
                        "not accepting international applications"
                        not in page_text
                        or "cas" not in page_text
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"{course_id}: application-status notice "
                            "changed; inspect before continuing."
                        )

                    digest = hashlib.sha256(
                        response.content
                    ).hexdigest()

                    snapshot_path = (
                        evidence_dir
                        / f"{course_id}-{digest[:12]}.html"
                    )
                    snapshot_path.write_text(
                        response.text,
                        encoding="utf-8",
                    )

                    evidence[course_id] = {
                        "source_title": source_title,
                        "source_url": response.url,
                        "snapshot": str(snapshot_path),
                        "sha256": digest,
                        "details": details,
                    }

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            OSError,
            ValueError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Course-page validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        plans = []

        with transaction.atomic():
            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                try:
                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university__name__iexact="Abertay University",
                            university__country="UK",
                        )
                    )
                except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: course not found."
                    ) from exc

                if (
                    course.title != target["stored_title"]
                    or course.level != "MRES"
                    or course.start_year != 2026
                    or (course.start_month or "").strip().casefold()
                    != "october"
                    or (course.duration or "").strip().casefold()
                    not in {"1 year", "1 years"}
                    or not course.is_active
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: database identity/intake "
                        "changed since review."
                    )

                tuitions = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if len(tuitions) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one INTL tuition."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]

                if tuition.currency != "GBP":
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected GBP."
                    )

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                if source and source.academic_year != YEAR:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: existing source belongs "
                        "to another academic year."
                    )

                old_metadata = (
                    {
                        field: getattr(source, field)
                        for field in SOURCE_FIELDS
                    }
                    if source else None
                )

                metadata = {
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": POLICY_URL,
                    "source_course_code": "",
                    "source_course_name": (
                        evidence[course_id]["source_title"]
                    ),
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "student_contribution": None,
                    "published_total": None,
                    "raw_fees": {
                        "fee_status": "International",
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "annual_tuition": raw_fee,
                        "course_kind": "masters_by_research",
                        "course_source_url": target["url"],
                        "fee_method": "reviewed_research_subject",
                        "international_applications_open": False,
                        "review_note": APPLICATION_NOTE,
                        "fee_categories": [
                            {
                                "source_fee_category": "International",
                                "academic_year": YEAR,
                                "currency": "GBP",
                                "raw_annual_fee": raw_fee,
                                "annual_tuition": str(fee),
                                "footnote_marker": "",
                                "annotation": APPLICATION_NOTE,
                                "amount_requires_review": False,
                            }
                        ],
                    },
                }

                before_course = course_snapshot(course)
                after_course = dict(before_course)
                after_course["course_url"] = target["url"]

                before = serialisable({
                    "course": before_course,
                    "tuition_fee": tuition.tuition_fee,
                    "source_metadata": old_metadata,
                })
                after = serialisable({
                    "course": after_course,
                    "tuition_fee": fee,
                    "source_metadata": metadata,
                })

                changed = (
                    before_course != after_course
                    or tuition.tuition_fee != fee
                    or serialisable(old_metadata)
                    != serialisable(metadata)
                )

                plans.append({
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "metadata": metadata,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": changed,
                })

            report = {
                "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                "database_changes": False,
                "committed": False,
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "policy_url": POLICY_URL,
                "policy_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                    policy_text.encode("utf-8")
                ).hexdigest(),
                "evidence": evidence,
                "proposals": [
                    {
                        "course_id": plan["course"].course_id,
                        "changed": plan["changed"],
                        "before": plan["before"],
                        "after": plan["after"],
                    }
                    for plan in plans
                ],
            }

            report_path = (
                log_dir / f"research-batch-{timestamp}.json"
            )
            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            for plan in plans:
                course = plan["course"]
                tuition = plan["tuition"]

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course.course_id}: "
                    f"GBP {tuition.tuition_fee} -> {fee} — "
                    f"{'update' if plan['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
                )

                if not options["apply"] or not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                if course.course_url != TARGETS[
                    course.course_id
                ]["url"]:
                    course.course_url = TARGETS[
                        course.course_id
                    ]["url"]
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=["course_url", "updated_at"]
                    )

                tuition.tuition_fee = fee
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    defaults=plan["metadata"],
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=course.course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["database_changes"] = any(
                plan["changed"] for plan in plans
            )
            report["committed"] = True

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nProposed/updated records: "
            f"{sum(plan['changed'] for plan in plans)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "International applications currently closed "
            "according to the inspected course pages."
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

        self.stdout.write(
            "Applied course URL, tuition and source updates."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
