FILE: app\management\commands\reconcile_aberystwyth_corrected_awards.py
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import (
    Scholarship,
    ScholarshipRule,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
    University,
)

from .import_aberystwyth_corrected_fees import FEES
from .correct_aberystwyth_remaining_courses import MATCHES
from .reconcile_aberystwyth_awards import (
    SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
    download,
    parse_scholarships,
)


PLANS = [
    {
        "level": "UG",
        "band": "Humanities",
        "verified": True,
        "value": "3000.00",
        "course_ids": [
            "C_UK002_10",
            "C_UK002_41",
            "C_UK002_60",
        ],
    },
    {
        "level": "PG",
        "band": "Humanities",
        "verified": True,
        "value": "3000.00",
        "course_ids": ["C_ABE002_RES_04"],
    },
    {
        "level": "UG",
        "band": "Sciences",
        "verified": False,
        "value": "4500.00",
        "course_ids": ["C_UK002_84"],
    },
]

PENDING = {
    "C_ABE002_RES_02": (
        "MRes programme eligibility under the published Global Citizens "
        "award categories has not been explicitly confirmed."
    ),
    "C_ABE002_RES_06": (
        "January 2027 is in 2026/27. Global Citizens starts from "
        "2027/28; other scholarship applicability remains unconfirmed."
    ),
}


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Extend saved scholarship rules to accepted corrected courses "
        "and record unresolved applicability for two research programmes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )
                html, main = download(session, SCHOLARSHIP_URL)
                published, _content = parse_scholarships(main)

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            UnicodeDecodeError,
            ValueError,
            ArithmeticError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Scholarship source verification stopped: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aberystwyth"
            / f"corrected-awards-{stamp}"
        )
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (directory / "scholarship.html").write_bytes(html)

        rule_proposals = []
        source_proposals = []
        locked_sources = {}
        locked_rules = {}
        decisions = {}

        with transaction.atomic():
            university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                pk="UK002",
                country="UK",
            )

            if university.name.strip().casefold() != "aberystwyth university":
                raise CommandError("University identity mismatch.")

            # Require all seven accepted identities and imported fees.
            for course_id, details in FEES.items():
                year, group, band, expected_fee, kind = details
                match = MATCHES[course_id]

                records = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                    .select_related("course")
                    .filter(
                        course_id=course_id,
                        course__university=university,
                        course__is_active=True,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if len(records) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unique international tuition required."
                    )

                tuition = records[0]
                course = tuition.course
                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )
                raw = source.raw_fees if source else None
                identity = (
                    raw.get("course_identity", {})
                    if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
                )

                if (
                    course.title != match[3]
                    or course.level != match[4]
                    or course.duration != match[5]
                    or course.start_month != match[6]
                    or course.start_year != match[7]
                    or source is None
                    or source.academic_year != year
                    or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                    or not isinstance(raw, dict)
                    or raw.get("verified") is not True
                    or raw.get("fee_band") != band
                    or identity.get("status")
                    != "accepted_current_catalogue_match"
                    or identity.get("official_code") != match[1]
                    or tuition.currency != "GBP"
                    or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(expected_fee)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: apply the corrected tuition import "
                        "first, or review changed course evidence."
                    )

                locked_sources[course_id] = (tuition, source)

            # Extend existing scopes without dropping earlier courses.
            for plan in PLANS:
                level = plan["level"]
                band = plan["band"]
                name = (
                    f"Global Citizens Scholarship — "
                    f"{band} {level} (2027/28)"
                )

                awards = list(
                    Scholarship.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        university=university,
                        name=name,
                        level=level,
                    )
                )

                if len(awards) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unique existing scholarship required: {name}"
                    )

                rule = (
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(scholarship=awards[0])
                    .first()
                )

                if (
                    rule is None
                    or rule.source_url != SCHOLARSHIP_URL
                    or rule.verified is not plan["verified"]
                    or rule.rules.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
                    or rule.rules.get("kind") != "fixed"
                    or rule.rules.get("study_years") != [1]
                    or Decimal(str(rule.rules.get("value")))
                    != Decimal(plan["value"])
                    or Decimal(published[(level, band)]["award"])
                    != Decimal(plan["value"])
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{name}: published or saved rules require review."
                    )

                before = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)
                ids = after.get("conditions", {}).get("course_id")

                if not isinstance(ids, list) or not all(
                    isinstance(value, str) for value in ids
                ):
                    raise CommandError(f"{name}: invalid course scope.")

                after["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(ids) | set(plan["course_ids"])
                )

                rule_proposals.append({
                    "name": name,
                    "rule_id": rule.pk,
                    "verified": plan["verified"],
                    "scope_count": len(after["conditions"]["course_id"]),
                    "changed": before != after,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })
                locked_rules[rule.pk] = rule

                for course_id in plan["course_ids"]:
                    decisions[course_id] = {
                        "status": (
                            "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                            if plan["verified"]
                            else "pending_fee_source_discrepancy"
                        ),
                        "rule_id": rule.pk,
                        "reason": (
                            "Existing verified conditional award extended "
                            "to the accepted course and fee year."
                            if plan["verified"]
                            else "Undergraduate science tuition differs "
                            "between official fee and scholarship pages. "
                            "The award remains unverified and unapplied."
                        ),
                    }

            for course_id, reason in PENDING.items():
                decisions[course_id] = {
                    "status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
                    "rule_id": None,
                    "reason": reason,
                }

            for course_id, decision in decisions.items():
                tuition, source = locked_sources[course_id]
                before = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)

                after["scholarship_status"] = decision["status"]
                after["scholarship_review"] = {
                    **decision,
                    "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                }

                notes = after.get("display_notes")
                if isinstance(notes, dict):
                    notes["scholarship"] = (
                        "A scholarship estimate is available when "
                        "the eligibility conditions are confirmed."
                        if decision["status"]
                        == "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                        else "Scholarship information is not confirmed for "
                        "this course and intake. No unverified discount "
                        "has been included."
                    )

                source_proposals.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": before != after,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

            output = directory / "reconciliation.json"
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                        "university_id": "UK002",
                        "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                        "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest(),
                        "scholarship_rules": rule_proposals,
                        "course_reviews": source_proposals,
                        "tuition_prices_changed": False,
                        "stored_discounts_changed": False,
                        "deposit_amounts_changed": False,
                    },
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for proposal in rule_proposals:
                    if not proposal["changed"]:
                        continue

                    rule = locked_rules[proposal["rule_id"]]
                    rule.rules = proposal["after"]
                    rule.reviewed_at = now
                    rule.save(update_fields=["rules", "reviewed_at"])

                # Audit rule-scope changes alongside the affected course.
                changed_rule_ids = {
                    proposal["rule_id"]
                    for proposal in rule_proposals
                    if proposal["changed"]
                }

                for proposal in source_proposals:
                    course_id = proposal["course_id"]
                    tuition, source = locked_sources[course_id]
                    decision = decisions[course_id]

                    rule_changes = [
                        item for item in rule_proposals
                        if item["rule_id"] == decision["rule_id"]
                        and item["rule_id"] in changed_rule_ids
                    ]

                    if proposal["changed"]:
                        source.raw_fees = proposal["after"]
                        source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

                    if proposal["changed"] or rule_changes:
                        TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                            tuition=tuition,
                            course_identifier=course_id,
                            residency="INTL",
                            before={
                                "raw_fees": proposal["before"],
                                "scholarship_rules": [
                                    {
                                        "rule_id": item["rule_id"],
                                        "rules": item["before"],
                                    }
                                    for item in rule_changes
                                ],
                            },
                            after={
                                "raw_fees": proposal["after"],
                                "scholarship_rules": [
                                    {
                                        "rule_id": item["rule_id"],
                                        "rules": item["after"],
                                    }
                                    for item in rule_changes
                                ],
                            },
                        )

        for proposal in rule_proposals:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{proposal['name']}: "
                f"{proposal['scope_count']} total courses; "
                f"{'verified' if proposal['verified'] else 'REVIEW REQUIRED'}"
                f" — {'update' if proposal['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

        for course_id, decision in decisions.items():
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{course_id}: {decision['status']}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship scopes and course review metadata saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Tuition prices, stored discounts and deposit amounts unchanged."
        )

COURSE_ID = "C_UK002_25"
YEAR = "2027/28"

COURSE_URL = (
    "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/postgraduate/"
    "M190-international-commercial-law/"

SCHOLARSHIP_URL = (
    "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/international/"
    "scholarships/global-citizens-scholarship/"
)
RULE_NAME = "Global Citizens Scholarship — Humanities PG (2027/28)"

REQUIRED_CONDITIONS = {
    "fee_status": ["INTL"],
    "new_entrant": [True],
    "academic_conditions_met": [True],
    "offer_received": [True],
    "applied_by_deadline": [True],
    "external_funding": [False],

def verify_award(soup):
    heading = soup.find("h1")
    if heading is None or text(heading) != "Global Citizens Scholarship":
        raise ValueError("Wrong scholarship page.")

    matches = []

    for table in soup.find_all("table"):
        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [
                text(cell)
                for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"], recursive=False)
            ]

            if len(cells) < 4 or cells[0].casefold() != "humanities":
                continue

            values = [
                value.replace(",", "").replace(" ", "")
                for value in cells[1:4]
            ]

            if (
                values[0] == "£22115"
                and values[1] == "£3000"
                and values[2].startswith("£19115")
            ):
                matches.append(cells)

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "A unique postgraduate Humanities row "
            "£22,115 / £3,000 / £19,115 is required."
        )

    content = text(soup).casefold()

    for phrase in (
        "new student from the academic year 2027/28 onwards",
        "international fee-paying",
        "academic entry requirements",
        "received an offer",
        "external scholarships",
        "1st august",
        "distance learning",
        "law and criminology",
    ):
        if phrase not in content:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Published scholarship terms require review: {phrase!r}"
            )

    return matches[0]


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Add International Commercial Law to the verified "

    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:

                )

                )
                session.mount(

                )

                page, evidence = download(session, SCHOLARSHIP_URL)
                published_row = verify_award(page)

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            courses = Course.objects.filter(
                course_id=COURSE_ID,
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                courses = courses.select_for_update()

            try:
                course = courses.get()
            except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Active Law course not found.") from exc

            if (
                course.title != "LLM International Commercial Law"
                or course.level != "PG"
                or course.duration != "1 Year"
                or course.start_month != "September"
                or course.start_year != 2027
                or course.course_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL.rstrip("/")
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Law course does not match the corrected route."
                )

            tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            tuitions = list(tuitions)

            if (
                len(tuitions) != 1
                or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                or Decimal(str(tuitions[0].tuition_fee))
                != Decimal("22115.00")
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "A unique GBP 22,115 international tuition is required."
                )

            tuition = tuitions[0]

            sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
            if options["apply"]:
                sources = sources.select_for_update()

            try:
                source = sources.get()
            except TuitionSource.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Verified fee source is missing.") from exc

            raw = source.raw_fees
            if (
                not isinstance(raw, dict)
                or raw.get("verified") is not True
                or source.academic_year != YEAR
                or source.source_course_code != "M190"

                or raw.get("course_kind") != "postgraduate_taught"

            if options["apply"]:
                rules = rules.select_for_update()
            rules = list(rules)

            if len(rules) != 1:

            if (

            ):

            before = {

                "study_year": 1,
                "note": (

            }
            updated_raw["deposit_status"] = (
                "offer_letter_amount_required"
            )

            notes = updated_raw.get("display_notes", {})
            if not isinstance(notes, dict):
                notes = {}

            notes["scholarship"] = (

            )
            notes["deposit"] = (
                "Deposit amount is specified in your individual offer letter."

            updated_raw["display_notes"] = notes

            after = {
                "scholarship_rule_id": rule.pk,
                "rules": updated_rule,
                "raw_fees": updated_raw,
            }
            changed = before != after

            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            report_path = folder / (

                + ".json"
            )

            report_path.write_text(

                    "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]

                    ),

                    "changed": changed,
                    "evidence": evidence,
                    "published_row": published_row,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            self.stdout.write(
                f"{COURSE_ID}: "
                f"{'update' if changed else 'unchanged'}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(

            )
            self.stdout.write(

            )
            self.stdout.write(

                f"{len(updated_rule['conditions']['course_id'])}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Proposed changes: {int(changed)}")
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            if changed:
                rule.rules = updated_rule
                rule.save(update_fields=["rules", "reviewed_at"])

                source.raw_fees = updated_raw
                source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees", "checked_at"])

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=COURSE_ID,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=before,
                    after=after,
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "Law scholarship scope and course metadata saved."
                if changed
                else "Already current. No database updates needed."
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Gross tuition, stored discounts and numeric deposits unchanged."
        )

    "duration",
    "start_month",
    "start_year",
    "course_url",
    "is_active",
)


def verify_sources(session):
    law, law_evidence = download(session, LAW_URL)
    arts, arts_evidence = download(session, ARTS_URL)
    fees, fee_evidence = download(session, FEE_URL)

    law_heading = law.find("h1")
    if (
        law_heading is None
        or text(law_heading) != "International Commercial Law"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Law course title does not match.")

    law_text = text(law)

    for pattern in (
        r"\bM190-LLM\b",
        r"\bCourse duration\s+1\s+year\b",
        r"\bSeptember\s+start\s+2027\b",
    ):
        if not re.search(pattern, law_text, re.I):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Law course evidence does not match: {pattern}"
            )

    arts_heading = arts.find("h1")
    if (
        arts_heading is None
        or text(arts_heading) != "BA Creative Arts [WW48]"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Creative Arts scheme does not match.")

    if not re.search(
        r"\bLast intake year is\s+2024/2025\b",
        text(arts),
        re.I,
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Creative Arts last-intake evidence has changed."
        )

    current_year = False
    international_taught = False
    amounts = []
    law_classified = False

    for node in fees.find_all(["h2", "h3", "table"]):
        if node.name == "h2":
            current_year = (
                text(node).casefold()
                == "tuition fees for september 2027"
            )
            international_taught = False
            continue

        if node.name == "h3":
            label = text(node).casefold()
            international_taught = (
                current_year
                and "taught" in label
                and "international" in label
            )
            continue

        if not (current_year and international_taught):
            continue

        for row in node.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [
                text(cell)
                for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"], recursive=False)
            ]
            if len(cells) < 2:
                continue

            if cells[0].casefold() != "arts and social science courses":
                continue

            if "law and criminology" in cells[1].casefold():
                law_classified = True

            match = re.fullmatch(
                r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                cells[1],
            )
            if match:
                amounts.append(
                    Decimal(
                        match.group(1).replace(",", "")
                    ).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
                )

    if amounts != [Decimal("22115.00")] or not law_classified:
        raise ValueError(
            "The 2027 international taught-master's Law/Humanities "
            "classification and £22,115 fee must both be confirmed."
        )

    return {
        "law_course": law_evidence,
        "creative_arts_scheme": arts_evidence,
        "fee_schedule": fee_evidence,
    }


def snapshot(course, tuition, source):
    return {
        "course": {
            field: getattr(course, field)
            for field in COURSE_FIELDS
        },
        "tuition": {
            "tuition_fee": str(
                Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)).quantize(
                    Decimal("0.01")
                )
            ),
            "currency": tuition.currency,
        },
        "source": {
            "academic_year": source.academic_year,
            "source_url": source.source_url,
            "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
            "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
            "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
            "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
        },
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply a reviewed current Law course replacement "
        "and deactivate the unsupported Creative Arts intake."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                retry = Retry(
                    total=3,
                    connect=3,
                    read=3,
                    status=3,
                    backoff_factor=1,
                    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                    allowed_methods=["GET"],
                    respect_retry_after_header=True,
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )
                evidence = verify_sources(session)

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            plans = []

            for course_id in (LAW_ID, ARTS_ID):
                queryset = Course.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK002",
                    course_id=course_id,
                )
                if options["apply"]:
                    queryset = queryset.select_for_update()

                try:
                    course = queryset.get()
                except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: course not found."
                    ) from exc

                if course_id == LAW_ID:
                    if (
                        course.title not in {
                            "LLM International Business Law",
                            "LLM International Commercial Law",
                        }
                        or course.level != "PG"
                        or course.duration != "1 Year"
                        or not course.is_active
                    ):
                        raise CommandError(
                            "Law record differs from the reviewed route."
                        )

                    if Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK002",
                        is_active=True,
                        course_url=LAW_URL,
                    ).exclude(course_id=LAW_ID).exists():
                        raise CommandError(
                            "Another active course already uses the "
                            "International Commercial Law URL."
                        )

                else:
                    if (
                        course.title != "BA (Hons) Creative Arts"
                        or course.level != "UG"
                        or course.start_year <= 2024
                    ):
                        raise CommandError(
                            "Creative Arts record differs from the "
                            "reviewed unsupported intake."
                        )

                tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                    course=course,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                if options["apply"]:
                    tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
                tuitions = list(tuitions)

                if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unique GBP international "
                        "tuition required."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]
                sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
                if options["apply"]:
                    sources = sources.select_for_update()

                try:
                    source = sources.get()
                except TuitionSource.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: existing review metadata missing."
                    ) from exc

                if not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: invalid source metadata."
                    )

                before = snapshot(course, tuition, source)
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)
                raw = after["source"]["raw_fees"]

                if course_id == LAW_ID:
                    after["course"].update({
                        "title": "LLM International Commercial Law",
                        "start_month": "September",
                        "start_year": 2027,
                        "course_url": LAW_URL,
                    })
                    after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = "22115.00"

                    raw.update({

                        "fee_verification_status": "verified",

                        "source_fee_category": "International",

                        "currency": "GBP",

                            "official_title": "International Commercial Law",
                            "official_code": "M190",
                            "official_award": "LLM",
                            "source_url": LAW_URL,
                            "note": (
                                "Current catalogue replacement for the "
                                "stored listing; historical rename not asserted."
                            ),
                        },
                        "fee_review": {

                            "reason": (

                                "2027 Law/Humanities international fee band."
                            ),
                        },
                        "fee_evidence": {
                            "course": evidence["law_course"],
                            "fees": evidence["fee_schedule"],
                        },
                        "scholarship_status": (
                            "pending_separate_reconciliation"
                        ),
                        "deposit_status": "offer_letter_amount_required",
                        "fee_categories": [{
                            "source_fee_category": "International",
                            "academic_year": "2027/28",
                            "currency": "GBP",
                            "annual_tuition": "22115.00",
                            "raw_annual_fee": "£22,115",
                            "annotation": (
                                "Full-time taught-master's Law/Humanities fee."
                            ),
                            "footnote_marker": "",
                            "amount_requires_review": False,
                        }],
                    })

                    notes = raw.get("display_notes", {})
                    if not isinstance(notes, dict):
                        notes = {}

                    notes.pop("fee", None)
                    notes["scholarship"] = (
                        "Scholarship applicability requires reconciliation."
                    )
                    notes["deposit"] = (
                        "Deposit amount is specified in your individual "
                        "offer letter."
                    )
                    raw["display_notes"] = notes

                    after["source"].update({
                        "academic_year": "2027/28",
                        "source_url": FEE_URL,
                        "source_course_name": "International Commercial Law",
                        "source_course_code": "M190",
                        "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    })

                else:
                    after["course"]["is_active"] = False
                    raw["intake_review"] = {
                        "status": "stored_intake_after_last_published_intake",
                        "last_intake_academic_year": "2024/25",
                        "source_url": ARTS_URL,
                        "evidence": evidence["creative_arts_scheme"],
                        "action": "deactivate_stored_new_entrant_listing",
                        "note": (
                            "The stored intake is later than the scheme's "
                            "published last intake. Historical course and "
                            "tuition records are retained."
                        ),
                    }

                plans.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "source": source,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": before != after,
                })

            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            report_path = folder / (
                "law-creative-arts-"
                + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
                + ".json"
            )

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps({
                    "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]
                        else "preview"
                    ),
                    "evidence": evidence,
                    "records": [
                        {
                            key: plan[key]
                            for key in (
                                "course_id", "changed", "before", "after"
                            )
                        }
                        for plan in plans
                    ],
                }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            for plan in plans:
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{plan['course_id']}: "
                    f"{'update' if plan['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
                )

                for field in COURSE_FIELDS:
                    old = plan["before"]["course"][field]
                    new = plan["after"]["course"][field]
                    if old != new:
                        self.stdout.write(f"  {field}: {old} -> {new}")

                if plan["course_id"] == LAW_ID:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        "  International tuition: GBP "
                        f"{plan['before']['tuition']['tuition_fee']} "
                        "-> 22115.00; 2027/28"
                    )
                else:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        "  Last published intake: 2024/25. "
                        "No fee imported; historical records retained."
                    )

            self.stdout.write(
                "\nProposed changes: "
                + str(sum(plan["changed"] for plan in plans))
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            for plan in plans:
                if not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                course = plan["course"]
                changed_fields = []

                for field, value in plan["after"]["course"].items():
                    if getattr(course, field) != value:
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                        changed_fields.append(field)

                if changed_fields:
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=[*changed_fields, "updated_at"]
                    )

                tuition = plan["tuition"]
                if plan["course_id"] == LAW_ID:
                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal("22115.00")
                    tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                source = plan["source"]
                for field, value in plan["after"]["source"].items():
                    setattr(source, field, value)

                source.save(
                    update_fields=[
                        *plan["after"]["source"].keys(),
                        "checked_at",
                    ]
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=plan["course_id"],
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "Law replacement/fee and Creative Arts intake correction saved."
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Stored scholarships and deposits unchanged. "
            "No course or tuition records deleted."
        )

from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

    "global_citizens": (
        "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/international/"

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Review scholarships for ten January 2027 research courses "
        "and save the applicable offer-letter deposit policy."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aberystwyth"
            / f"research-awards-{stamp}"
        )
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        evidence = {}
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )

                for name, url in URLS.items():
                    self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")
                    html, main = download(session, url)
                    content = text(main)

                    (directory / f"{name}.html").write_bytes(html)

                    evidence[name] = {
                        "source_url": url,
                        "text": content,
                        "sha256": hashlib.sha256(html).hexdigest(),
                    }

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            UnicodeDecodeError,
            ValueError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source collection stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        global_text = evidence["global_citizens"]["text"].casefold()
        deposit_text = evidence["deposit"]["text"]
        deposit_lower = deposit_text.casefold()

        if "2027/28 onwards" not in global_text:
            raise CommandError(
                "Global Citizens start-year terms changed; review required."
            )

        if not all(
            phrase in deposit_lower
            for phrase in (
                "offer letter",
                "amount",
                "tuition fee",
                "exempt",
            )
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Deposit policy wording changed; review required."
            )

        scholarship_review = {
            "status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "intake": {"month": "January", "year": 2027},
            "automatic_deduction_verified": False,
            "findings": [
                {
                    "name": "Global Citizens Scholarship",
                    "status": "outside_published_start_year",
                    "source_url": URLS["global_citizens"],
                    "reason": (
                        "Published eligibility starts with new students "
                        "from 2027/28 onward."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "AberGrad Scholarship",
                    "status": "requires_cohort_and_eligibility_confirmation",
                    "source_url": URLS["abergrad"],
                    "reason": (
                        "Do not transfer a published 2026 enrolment award "
                        "to January 2027 without confirming applicability "
                        "and the applicant's alumni eligibility."
                    ),
                },
                {
                    "name": "AberDoc Scholarship",
                    "status": "requires_intake_and_award_confirmation",
                    "source_url": URLS["aberdoc"],
                    "reason": (
                        "Published competition refers to September 2026. "
                        "January 2027 applicability and an individual "
                        "award have not been confirmed."
                    ),
                },
            ],
            "note": (
                "This is a review record, not confirmation that no "
                "scholarships exist. No new calculable award is created."
            ),
        }

        deposit_after = {
            "currency": "GBP",
            "rules": {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "kind": "offer_letter",
                "fee_status": "INTL",
                "payment_stage": "before_cas",
                "amount": None,
                "percentage": None,
                "currency": "GBP",
                "amount_requires_individual_confirmation": True,
                "exemptions_require_confirmation": True,
                "reviewed_intake": {
                    "month": "January",
                    "year": 2027,
                },
                "note": (
                    "Where a deposit is required, the amount is specified "
                    "in the applicant's offer letter. It forms part of "
                    "tuition payments. Exemptions require confirmation."
                ),
            },
            "source_url": URLS["deposit"],
            "verified": True,
        }

        proposals = []
        locked_sources = {}

        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    pk="UK002",
                    country="UK",
                )
            except University.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Aberystwyth UK002 not found.") from exc

            if university.name.strip().casefold() != "aberystwyth university":
                raise CommandError("University identity mismatch.")

            for suffix in COURSES:
                course_id = f"C_UK002_{suffix}"

                records = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course_id=course_id,
                        course__university=university,
                        course__is_active=True,
                        course__start_month="January",
                        course__start_year=2027,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if len(records) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: apply the research tuition batch "
                        "first; one international record is required."
                    )

                tuition = records[0]
                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )
                raw = source.raw_fees if source else None

                if (
                    source is None
                    or source.academic_year != YEAR
                    or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                    or not isinstance(raw, dict)
                    or raw.get("verified") is not True
                    or raw.get("course_kind") != "postgraduate_research"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: verified research fee evidence required."
                    )

                before = copy.deepcopy(raw)
                after = copy.deepcopy(raw)
                after["scholarship_status"] = "applicability_unconfirmed"
                after["scholarship_review"] = scholarship_review
                after["deposit_status"] = "offer_letter_amount_required"

                proposals.append({
                    "type": "course_review",
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": before != after,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })
                locked_sources[course_id] = (tuition, source)

            policy = DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                university=university,
                academic_year=YEAR,
            ).first()

            deposit_before = (
                {key: getattr(policy, key) for key in deposit_after}
                if policy else None
            )

            proposals.append({
                "type": "deposit_policy",
                "changed": deposit_before != deposit_after,
                "before": deposit_before,
                "after": deposit_after,
            })

            report_path = directory / "reconciliation.json"
            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                        "university_id": "UK002",
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                        "evidence": evidence,
                        "proposals": proposals,
                        "tuition_prices_changed": False,
                        "stored_discounts_changed": False,
                        "stored_deposit_amounts_changed": False,
                    },
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                    default=str,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for proposal in proposals:
                    if (
                        proposal["type"] != "course_review"
                        or not proposal["changed"]
                    ):
                        continue

                    tuition, source = locked_sources[proposal["course_id"]]
                    source.raw_fees = proposal["after"]
                    source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=proposal["course_id"],
                        residency="INTL",
                        before={"raw_fees": proposal["before"]},
                        after={"raw_fees": proposal["after"]},
                    )

                DepositPolicy.objects.update_or_create(
                    university=university,
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    defaults={
                        **deposit_after,
                        "source_text": deposit_text,
                        "source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                            deposit_text.encode("utf-8")
                        ).hexdigest(),
                        "checked_at": now,
                    },
                )

        for proposal in proposals:
            label = proposal.get("course_id", "2026/27 deposit policy")
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{label}: "
                f"{'update' if proposal['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Saved research scholarship review and deposit policy."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "No scholarship deduction was newly verified. "
            "Tuition prices and stored discount/deposit amounts unchanged."
        )

def normalise(value):
    return " ".join(str(value).split())


def read_report(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
    except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CommandError(f"Cannot read evidence report: {exc}") from exc


def find_report(root, supplied):
    if supplied:
        path = Path(supplied)
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = root / path
        if not path.is_file():
            raise CommandError(f"Evidence report not found: {path}")
        return path

    folder = root / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
    matches = []

    for path in folder.glob("remaining-review-*/remaining-course-review.json"):
        report = read_report(path)
        ids = {
            row.get("course_id")
            for row in report.get("records", [])
            if isinstance(row, dict)
        }
        if set(COURSES).issubset(ids):
            matches.append(path)

    if not matches:
        raise CommandError(
            "No collected remaining-course report covers all six courses. "
            "Pass its path using --evidence."
        )

    return max(matches, key=lambda path: path.parent.name)


def validate_report(report):
    if report.get("university_id") != "UK002":
        raise CommandError("Evidence report is not for UK002.")

    try:
        generated = datetime.fromisoformat(
            report["generated_at"].replace("Z", "+00:00")
        )
        if generated.tzinfo is None:
            raise ValueError("Timestamp has no timezone.")
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        raise CommandError("Invalid evidence timestamp.") from exc

    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)

    if generated > now + timedelta(minutes=5):
        raise CommandError("Evidence timestamp is in the future.")

    if now - generated > timedelta(days=7):
        raise CommandError(
            "Evidence is older than seven days. Refresh the source review "
            "before applying these time-sensitive intake restrictions."
        )


def course_values(course):
    return {field: getattr(course, field) for field in FIELDS}


def source_values(source):
    return {
        "academic_year": source.academic_year,
        "source_url": source.source_url,
        "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
        "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
        "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
        "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
    }


def snapshot(course, tuition, source):
    return {
        "course": course_values(course),
        "tuition": {
            "tuition_fee": str(tuition.tuition_fee),
            "currency": tuition.currency,
            "scholarship": str(tuition.scholarship),
            "tuition_deposit": (
                str(tuition.tuition_deposit)
                if tuition.tuition_deposit is not None
                else None
            ),
        },
        "source": source_values(source),
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile six confirmed Aberystwyth course identities and "
        "save unresolved fee/application restrictions."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help="Path to the collected remaining-course-review JSON.",
        )

    def build_plan(self, report, lock=False):
        records = report.get("records")
        if not isinstance(records, list):
            raise CommandError("Evidence records must be a list.")

        plans = []
        blocked = []

        for course_id, config in COURSES.items():
            try:
                matching_records = [
                    row for row in records
                    if row.get("course_id") == course_id
                ]
                if len(matching_records) != 1:
                    raise ValueError("A unique evidence record is required.")

                record = matching_records[0]
                url = "https://courses.aber.ac.uk" + config["path"]

                candidates = [
                    candidate
                    for candidate in record.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidate.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/")
                    == url.rstrip("/")
                ]
                if len(candidates) != 1:
                    raise ValueError("A unique matching course page is required.")

                evidence = candidates[0].get("evidence", {})
                if evidence.get("status") != "collected":
                    raise ValueError("The course page was not collected.")

                if normalise(evidence.get("title", "")).casefold() != (
                    config["official_title"].casefold()
                ):
                    raise ValueError("Official page title does not match.")

                page_text = normalise(evidence.get("text", ""))
                lower = page_text.casefold()

                token = f'{config["code"]}-{config["award"]}'
                if token.casefold() not in lower:
                    raise ValueError(f"Missing source course identifier: {token}")

                if "september start 2027" not in lower:
                    raise ValueError("September 2027 intake is not evidenced.")

                duration_pattern = (
                    rf"\bcourse duration\s+{config['years']}\s+years?\b"
                )
                if not re.search(duration_pattern, lower):
                    raise ValueError("Published duration does not match.")

                for required in config.get("required_text", ()):
                    if required not in lower:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Application restriction not evidenced: {required}"
                        )

                queryset = Course.objects.filter(
                    course_id=course_id,
                    university_id="UK002",
                    is_active=True,
                )
                if lock:
                    queryset = queryset.select_for_update()
                course = queryset.get()

                stored = record.get("stored", {})
                if course.title not in {
                    stored.get("title"),
                    config["title"],
                }:
                    raise ValueError("Current title differs from reviewed titles.")

                if Course.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK002",
                    is_active=True,
                    course_url=url,
                ).exclude(course_id=course_id).exists():
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Another active course already uses this source URL."
                    )

                tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                    course=course,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                if lock:
                    tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
                tuitions = list(tuitions)

                if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
                    raise ValueError(
                        "A unique GBP international tuition is required."
                    )
                tuition = tuitions[0]

                sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
                if lock:
                    sources = sources.select_for_update()
                source = sources.get()

                if not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                    raise ValueError("Source metadata must be a JSON object.")

                if source.raw_fees.get("verified") is True:
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Fee is already verified; this review command "
                        "will not downgrade it."
                    )

                before = snapshot(course, tuition, source)
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)

                after["course"].update({
                    "title": config["title"],
                    "level": config["level"],
                    "duration": f'{config["years"]} '
                                f'{"Year" if config["years"] == 1 else "Years"}',
                    "start_month": "September",
                    "start_year": 2027,
                    "course_url": url,
                })

                # Course Code is not necessarily a UCAS code:
                # YD105 is retained as a source code, not assigned as UCAS.
                if config["level"] == "UG" and config["award"] == "BSC":
                    after["course"]["ucas_cao_code"] = config["code"]

                raw = after["source"]["raw_fees"]
                raw.update({
                    "verified": False,
                    "fee_verification_status": "needs_review",
                    "course_source_url": url,
                    "course_identity": {
                        "status": "confirmed_current_catalogue_match",
                        "official_title": config["official_title"],
                        "official_code": config["code"],
                        "official_award": config["award"],
                        "source_url": url,
                        "evidence_generated_at": report["generated_at"],
                    },
                    "fee_review": {
                        "status": "pending",
                        "target_academic_year": "2027/28",
                        "reason": config["reason"],
                    },
                    "application_review": {
                        "status": config["application_status"],
                        "source_url": url,
                        "evidence_generated_at": report["generated_at"],
                        "note": config["reason"],
                    },
                    "scholarship_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
                    "deposit_status": "individual_policy_review_required",
                    "display_notes": {
                        "fee": config["reason"],
                        "scholarship": (
                            "Scholarship eligibility has not been confirmed "
                            "for this course; no verified deduction established."
                        ),
                        "deposit": (
                            "A course-applicable deposit amount has not "
                            "been confirmed. Check the university's offer."
                        ),
                    },
                })

                # Do not label the existing stored price as a verified
                # 2027/28 fee merely because the course intake was corrected.
                after["source"].update({
                    "source_course_name": config["official_title"],
                    "source_course_code": config["code"],
                    "fee_basis": "unverified",
                })

                plans.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": before != after,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "course": course,
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "source": source,
                })

            except (
                ValueError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
                TuitionSource.DoesNotExist,
            ) as exc:
                blocked.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "reason": str(exc),
                })

        return plans, blocked

    def write_report(self, root, evidence_path, plans, blocked, apply):
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        folder = root / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = folder / (
            "six-course-review-"
            + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        report = {
            "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply_requested" if apply else "preview",
            "university_id": "UK002",
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
            "records": [
                {
                    key: plan[key]
                    for key in ("course_id", "changed", "before", "after")
                }
                for plan in plans
            ],
            "blocked": blocked,
        }

        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )
        return path

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        evidence_path = find_report(root, options.get("evidence"))
        evidence = read_report(evidence_path)
        validate_report(evidence)

        # Lock and re-check records inside the applying transaction.
        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            plans, blocked = self.build_plan(
                evidence,
                lock=options["apply"],
            )

            report_path = self.write_report(
                root,
                evidence_path,
                plans,
                blocked,
                options["apply"],
            )

            for plan in plans:
                status = "update" if plan["changed"] else "unchanged"
                self.stdout.write(f'{plan["course_id"]}: {status}')

                if plan["changed"]:
                    for field in FIELDS:
                        old = plan["before"]["course"][field]
                        new = plan["after"]["course"][field]
                        if old != new:
                            self.stdout.write(f"  {field}: {old} -> {new}")

                self.stdout.write(
                    "  Review: "
                    + plan["after"]["source"]["raw_fees"]["fee_review"]["reason"]
                )

            for item in blocked:
                self.stderr.write(
                    f'{item["course_id"]}: BLOCKED — {item["reason"]}'
                )

            self.stdout.write(f"\nMatched records: {len(plans)}")
            self.stdout.write(
                "Proposed changes: "
                + str(sum(plan["changed"] for plan in plans))
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Blocked: {len(blocked)}")
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if blocked:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Review stopped. No database changes were applied."
                )

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            for plan in plans:
                if not plan["changed"]:
                    continue

                course = plan["course"]
                changed_fields = []

                for field, value in plan["after"]["course"].items():
                    if getattr(course, field) != value:
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                        changed_fields.append(field)

                if changed_fields:
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=[*changed_fields, "updated_at"]
                    )

                source = plan["source"]
                for field, value in plan["after"]["source"].items():
                    setattr(source, field, value)

                source.save(
                    update_fields=[
                        *plan["after"]["source"].keys(),
                        "checked_at",
                    ]
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=plan["tuition"],
                    course_identifier=plan["course_id"],
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=plan["before"],
                    after=plan["after"],
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "Course corrections and review restrictions saved."
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Tuition prices, stored scholarships and deposits unchanged. "
            "These six fees remain unresolved."
        )
