WELSH_ID = "C_ABE002_RES_09"
EDUCATION_ID = "C_UK002_68"

SCHOLARSHIP_URL = (
    "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/international/"
    "scholarships/global-citizens-scholarship/"
)

AWARD_NAME = (
    "Global Citizens Scholarship — Humanities Research PG (2027/28)"
)


def verify_award_page(soup):
    heading = soup.find("h1")
    if heading is None or text(heading) != "Global Citizens Scholarship":
        raise ValueError("Wrong scholarship page.")

    matches = []

    for table in soup.find_all("table"):
        for row in table.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [
                text(cell)
                for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"], recursive=False)
            ]

            if len(cells) < 4:
                continue

            label = cells[0].casefold()
            if not (
                "humanities" in label
                and "mphil" in label
                and "phd" in label
            ):
                continue

            values = [
                value.replace(",", "").replace(" ", "")
                for value in cells[1:4]
            ]

            if (
                values[0] == "£20270"
                and values[1] == "£3000"
                and values[2].startswith("£17270")
            ):
                matches.append(cells)

    if len(matches) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "A unique Humanities research award row "
            "£20,270 / £3,000 / £17,270 is required."
        )

    content = text(soup).casefold()

    for phrase in (
        "new student from the academic year 2027/28 onwards",
        "international fee-paying",
        "received an offer",
        "academic entry requirements",
        "external scholarships",
        "1st august",
        "distance learning",
    ):
        if phrase not in content:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Scholarship conditions need review: {phrase!r}."
            )

    return matches[0]


def desired_rules(course_ids):
    return {
        "benefit": "tuition",
        "kind": "fixed",
        "value": "3000.00",
        "currency": "GBP",
        "academic_year": "2027/28",
        "study_years": [1],
        "fee_basis_confirmed": True,
        "percentage_basis": "original_tuition",
        "award_status": "conditional",
        "stacking": "exclusive",
        "compatible_ids": [],
        "conditions": {
            "course_id": sorted(set(course_ids)),
            "fee_status": ["INTL"],
            "new_entrant": [True],
            "academic_conditions_met": [True],
            "offer_received": [True],
            "applied_by_deadline": [True],
            "external_funding": [False],
        },
        "application_deadline": "2027-08-01",
        "scope_note": (
            "First compared study year only. Restricted to reviewed "
            "Humanities research courses starting in 2027/28."
        ),
        "combination_note": (
            "Other tuition awards require separately verified combination "
            "rules. Accommodation benefits are excluded."
        ),
        "published_scholarship_table": {
            "gross": "20270.00",
            "award": "3000.00",
            "net": "17270.00",
        },
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile Welsh 2027/28 scholarship eligibility and record "
        "Education January 2027 scholarship review status."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                retry = Retry(
                    total=3,
                    connect=3,
                    read=3,
                    status=3,
                    backoff_factor=1,
                    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                    allowed_methods=["GET"],
                    respect_retry_after_header=True,
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )

                fee_page, fee_evidence = download(session, FEE_URL)
                award_page, award_evidence = download(
                    session,
                    SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                )
                published_row = verify_award_page(award_page)

                course_evidence = {}

                for course_id, config in COURSES.items():
                    page, evidence = download(session, config["url"])
                    verify_course(page, config)
                    verify_fee_table(
                        fee_page,
                        config["academic_year"],
                        config["amount"],
                    )
                    course_evidence[course_id] = evidence

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            records = {}

            for course_id, config in COURSES.items():
                courses = Course.objects.filter(
                    course_id=course_id,
                    university_id="UK002",
                    is_active=True,
                )
                if options["apply"]:
                    courses = courses.select_for_update()

                try:
                    course = courses.get()
                except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: active course missing."
                    ) from exc

                if (
                    course.title != config["title"]
                    or course.level != "PG"
                    or course.duration != config["duration"]
                    or course.start_month != config["month"]
                    or course.start_year != config["year"]
                    or course.course_url.rstrip("/")
                    != config["url"].rstrip("/")
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: corrected route does not match."
                    )

                tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                    course=course,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                if options["apply"]:
                    tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
                tuitions = list(tuitions)

                if (
                    len(tuitions) != 1
                    or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                    or Decimal(str(tuitions[0].tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(config["amount"])
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected verified tuition missing."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]
                sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
                if options["apply"]:
                    sources = sources.select_for_update()

                try:
                    source = sources.get()
                except TuitionSource.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: fee source missing."
                    ) from exc

                raw = source.raw_fees
                if (
                    not isinstance(raw, dict)
                    or raw.get("verified") is not True
                    or source.academic_year != config["academic_year"]
                    or raw.get("course_kind") != "postgraduate_research"
                    or raw.get("fee_band") != "Humanities"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: verified research metadata required."
                    )

                records[course_id] = {
                    "tuition": tuition,
                    "source": source,
                    "before": copy.deepcopy(raw),
                }

            awards = Scholarship.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK002",
                name=AWARD_NAME,
                level="PG",
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                awards = awards.select_for_update()
            awards = list(awards)

            if len(awards) > 1:
                raise CommandError("Duplicate Humanities research awards.")

            award = awards[0] if awards else None
            rule = None

            if award is not None:
                rules = ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(scholarship=award)
                if options["apply"]:
                    rules = rules.select_for_update()
                rule = rules.first()

                if rule is None or not isinstance(rule.rules, dict):
                    raise CommandError("Existing research rule needs review.")

            existing_ids = []
            if rule is not None:
                existing_ids = rule.rules.get(
                    "conditions", {}
                ).get("course_id", [])

                if (
                    not isinstance(existing_ids, list)
                    or not all(isinstance(item, str) for item in existing_ids)
                ):
                    raise CommandError("Existing research scope is invalid.")

                # Permit only a scope extension of the same reviewed rule.
                expected_existing = desired_rules(existing_ids)
                if (
                    rule.rules != expected_existing
                    or rule.verified is not True
                    or rule.source_url != SCHOLARSHIP_URL
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Existing research rule differs from this reviewed "
                        "configuration; no overwrite performed."
                    )

            # Prevent a second Global Citizens rule for the same course/year.
            other_rules = ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
                scholarship__university_id="UK002",
                verified=True,
            )
            if award is not None:
                other_rules = other_rules.exclude(scholarship=award)

            for other in other_rules:
                data = other.rules
                if (
                    isinstance(data, dict)
                    and data.get("academic_year") == "2027/28"
                    and other.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == SCHOLARSHIP_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and WELSH_ID in data.get(
                        "conditions", {}
                    ).get("course_id", [])
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Welsh already appears in another verified "
                        "Global Citizens rule. Review that scope first."
                    )

            new_rules = desired_rules([*existing_ids, WELSH_ID])

            award_values = {
                "award_type": "Tuition Reduction",
                "award_value": "3000.00",
                "currency": "GBP",
                "deadline": None,
                "eligibility": (
                    "New international students on reviewed Humanities "
                    "research courses for 2027/28."
                ),
                "requirements": (
                    "Offer received; academic entry requirements met; "
                    "course application by 1 August 2027; no external "
                    "scholarship, funding or bursary."
                ),
                "description": (
                    "Published annual tuition award: GBP 3000.00. "
                    "First study year modelled. Eligibility must be confirmed."
                ),
                "url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
            }

            before_award = None if award is None else {
                key: getattr(award, key)
                for key in award_values
            }
            if before_award and before_award["deadline"] is not None:
                before_award["deadline"] = (
                    before_award["deadline"].isoformat()
                )

            before_rule = None if rule is None else {
                "verified": rule.verified,
                "source_url": rule.source_url,
                "rules": copy.deepcopy(rule.rules),
            }
            after_rule = {
                "verified": True,
                "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                "rules": new_rules,
            }

            for course_id, record in records.items():
                updated = copy.deepcopy(record["before"])

                if course_id == WELSH_ID:
                    status = "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                    note = (
                        "GBP 3000.00 Global Citizens tuition award if "
                        "eligible; net tuition GBP 17270.00 for the first "
                        "compared study year."
                    )
                    review = {
                        "status": status,
                        "award_name": AWARD_NAME,
                        "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                        "academic_year": "2027/28",
                        "gross": "20270.00",
                        "award": "3000.00",
                        "net_if_eligible": "17270.00",
                        "study_year": 1,
                    }
                else:
                    status = "applicability_unconfirmed"
                    note = (
                        "No scholarship deduction has been verified for "
                        "this January 2027 intake. Global Citizens applies "
                        "to new entrants from 2027/28 onwards."
                    )
                    review = {
                        "status": status,
                        "academic_year": "2026/27",
                        "global_citizens_applicable": False,
                        "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                        "reason": note,
                    }

                updated["scholarship_status"] = status
                updated["scholarship_review"] = review
                updated["deposit_status"] = "offer_letter_amount_required"

                notes = updated.get("display_notes", {})
                if not isinstance(notes, dict):
                    notes = {}

                notes["scholarship"] = note
                notes["deposit"] = (
                    "Deposit amount is specified in your individual "
                    "offer letter."
                )
                updated["display_notes"] = notes
                record["after"] = updated

            award_changed = (
                before_award != award_values
                or before_rule != after_rule
            )
            metadata_changed = any(
                record["before"] != record["after"]
                for record in records.values()
            )

            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            report_path = folder / (
                "welsh-education-awards-"
                + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
                + ".json"
            )

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps({
                    "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]
                        else "preview"
                    ),
                    "evidence": {
                        "scholarship": award_evidence,
                        "published_row": published_row,
                        "fees": fee_evidence,
                        "courses": course_evidence,
                    },
                    "award_before": before_award,
                    "award_after": award_values,
                    "rule_before": before_rule,
                    "rule_after": after_rule,
                    "courses": {
                        course_id: {
                            "before": record["before"],
                            "after": record["after"],
                        }
                        for course_id, record in records.items()
                    },
                }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            self.stdout.write(
                "MPhil Welsh: conditional award GBP 3000.00; "
                "net if eligible GBP 17270.00."
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "PhD Education January 2027: Global Citizens does not "
                "apply; other scholarship applicability remains pending."
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "Award rule: "
                + ("update" if award_changed else "unchanged")
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                "Course metadata: "
                + ("update" if metadata_changed else "unchanged")
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            if award_changed:
                if award is None:
                    award = Scholarship.objects.create(
                        university_id="UK002",
                        name=AWARD_NAME,
                        level="PG",
                        **award_values,
                    )
                else:
                    for key, value in award_values.items():
                        setattr(award, key, value)
                    award.save(update_fields=list(award_values))

                ScholarshipRule.objects.update_or_create(
                    scholarship=award,
                    defaults=after_rule,
                )

            for course_id, record in records.items():
                raw_changed = record["before"] != record["after"]

                if raw_changed:
                    source = record["source"]
                    source.raw_fees = record["after"]
                    source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees", "checked_at"])

                if raw_changed or (
                    course_id == WELSH_ID and award_changed
                ):
                    before = {"raw_fees": record["before"]}
                    after = {"raw_fees": record["after"]}

                    if course_id == WELSH_ID:
                        before.update({
                            "award": before_award,
                            "rule": before_rule,
                        })
                        after.update({
                            "award": award_values,
                            "rule": after_rule,
                        })

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=record["tuition"],
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=before,
                        after=after,
                    )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "Scholarship reconciliation saved."
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Gross tuition, stored discounts and numeric deposits unchanged."
        )

def question(key, text, kind="boolean", note=None):
    result = {
        "key": key,
        "type": kind,
        "question": text,
    }

    if note:
        result["note"] = note

    return result

def merge_questions(*groups):
    result = {}

    for group in groups:
        if not isinstance(group, list):
            continue

        for item in group:
            if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("key"):
                value = copy.deepcopy(item)

                if "question" not in value and value.get("label"):
                    value["question"] = value["label"]

                result.setdefault(value["key"], value)

    return list(result.values())


def make_rule(value, conditions, questions, note):
    return {
        "kind": "fixed",
        "value": value,
        "benefit": "tuition",
        "currency": "GBP",
        "stacking": "exclusive",
        "compatible_ids": [],
        "percentage_basis": "original_tuition",
        "fee_basis_confirmed": True,
        "academic_year": YEAR,
        "study_years": [1],
        "award_status": "conditional",
        "conditions": conditions,
        "scope_note": note,
        "source_period_note": (
            "Current published policy does not explicitly name "
            "an academic year. Associated with the reviewed "
            "2027/28 cohort; individual confirmation is required."
        ),
        "combination_note": (
            "Combination with other scholarships has not been verified. "
            "The calculator selects the best eligible single award."
        ),
        "eligibility_questions": questions,
    }

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview/apply advanced-entry and London scholarship rules "
        "for six reviewed ARU courses."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def fetch_sources(self):
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        result = {}

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionCompareScholarshipReview/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for url in [UG_URL, LONDON_URL]:
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                response = session.get(url, timeout=(30, 60))
                response.raise_for_status()

                if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                    )

                soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")

                if soup.find("h1") is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"Missing page heading: {url}")

                main = soup.find("main") or soup

                text = " ".join(
                    main.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
                )

                result[url] = {
                    "source_url": response.url,
                    "text": text,
                    "html_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        response.content
                    ).hexdigest(),
                }

        ug = result[UG_URL]["text"]
        london = result[LONDON_URL]["text"]

        if not re.search(
            r"starting in Year 2 or Year 3.{0,100}£1,000",
            ug,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the £1,000 advanced-entry award."
            )

        if (
            "APCL" not in ug
            or "pro-rata" not in ug
            or "work-based" not in ug
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Advanced-entry adjustment/exclusion terms changed."
            )

        if not re.search(
            r"alumni of ARU London.{0,120}£2,000",
            london,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the £2,000 ARU London alumni award."
            )

        if not re.search(
            r"First Class honours degree.{0,200}£1,000",
            london,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the £1,000 London entry award."
            )

        if not re.search(
            r"not available for international students",
            london,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "The London Master's Scholarship Programme "
                "exclusion requires review."
            )

        return result

    def build_plan(self, lock=False):
        courses = Course.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=TARGETS,
        ).order_by("course_id")

        tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
            course__university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=TARGETS,
            residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("course_id")

        source_rows = TuitionSource.objects.filter(
            tuition__course__university_id="UK003",
            tuition__course_id__in=TARGETS,
            tuition__residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("tuition_id")

        if lock:
            courses = courses.select_for_update()
            tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            source_rows = source_rows.select_for_update()

        course_map = {item.course_id: item for item in courses}
        tuition_rows = list(tuitions)
        source_map = {
            item.tuition_id: item for item in source_rows
        }

        if set(course_map) != set(TARGETS):
            raise ValueError("One or more reviewed courses are missing.")

        award_changes = []

        for spec in specifications():
            queryset = Scholarship.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK003",
                name=spec["name"],
            )

            if lock:
                queryset = queryset.select_for_update()

            existing = list(queryset)

            if len(existing) > 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Duplicate scholarship name: {spec['name']}"
                )

            scholarship = existing[0] if existing else None
            rule = None

            if scholarship is not None:
                rule_query = ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
                    scholarship=scholarship
                )

                if lock:
                    rule_query = rule_query.select_for_update()

                rule = rule_query.first()

                if (
                    rule is not None
                    and rule.source_url
                    and rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    != spec["url"].rstrip("/")
                ):
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Existing rule has a different source: "
                        f"{spec['name']}"
                    )

            defaults = {
                "level": spec["level"],
                "award_type": "Tuition Reduction",
                "award_value": spec["amount"],
                "currency": "GBP",
                "deadline": None,
                "url": spec["url"],
                "eligibility": spec["rule"]["scope_note"],
                "requirements": (
                    "All saved conditions must be satisfied. "
                    "Unknown answers do not establish eligibility."
                ),
                "description": (
                    "Conditional scholarship for the reviewed course "
                    "scope. Gross tuition is retained separately. "
                    "Net tuition is calculated at comparison time."
                ),
            }

            before = {
                "scholarship": (
                    {
                        key: getattr(scholarship, key)
                        for key in defaults
                    }
                    if scholarship is not None
                    else None
                ),
                "rule": (
                    {
                        "verified": rule.verified,
                        "source_url": rule.source_url,
                        "rules": rule.rules,
                    }
                    if rule is not None
                    else None
                ),
            }

            rule_data = copy.deepcopy(spec["rule"])

            if rule is not None and isinstance(rule.rules, dict):
                rule_data["eligibility_questions"] = merge_questions(
                    rule_data["eligibility_questions"],
                    rule.rules.get("eligibility_questions", []),
                )

            after = {
                "scholarship": defaults,
                "rule": {
                    "verified": True,
                    "source_url": spec["url"],
                    "rules": rule_data,
                },
            }

            if before != after:
                award_changes.append({
                    "name": spec["name"],
                    "scholarship_id": (
                        scholarship.pk if scholarship else None
                    ),
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

        course_changes = []

        for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
            course = course_map[course_id]

            if (
                course.title != target["title"]
                or course.course_url.rstrip("/")
                != target["url"].rstrip("/")
                or course.start_year != 2027
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: stored route differs from "
                    "the reviewed course."
                )

            matches = [
                item for item in tuition_rows
                if item.course_id == course_id
            ]

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: expected one international tuition."
                )

            tuition = matches[0]
            source = source_map.get(tuition.pk)

            if source is None or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: source metadata is missing."
                )

            raw = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)

            if (
                tuition.currency != "GBP"
                or source.academic_year != YEAR
                or raw.get("verified") is not True
                or raw.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or raw.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or raw.get("source_fee_category") != "International"
                or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                != Decimal(target["amount"])
                or Decimal(str(raw.get("annual_tuition")))
                != Decimal(target["amount"])
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: verified tuition differs "
                    "from the reviewed record."
                )

            old_review = raw.get("scholarship_review")
            if not isinstance(old_review, dict):
                old_review = {}

            old_award_review = raw.get("award_review")
            if not isinstance(old_award_review, dict):
                old_award_review = {}

            topup = course_id in TOPUPS

            review = {
                "status": (
                    "conditional_advanced_entry_rule_requires_confirmation"
                    if topup
                    else "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                ),
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "source_url": UG_URL if topup else LONDON_URL,
                "source_period": "current_undated_policy",
                "note": (
                    "Published £1,000 advanced-entry rule saved. "
                    "ARU must confirm exact course coverage and "
                    "entry classification. APCL-adjusted amounts "
                    "are not calculated by this standard rule."
                    if topup
                    else (
                        "Published London entry/alumni rules saved. "
                        "Applicant qualification, alumni status and "
                        "award confirmation determine the deduction. "
                        "Awards are not combined automatically. "
                        "The 50% Master's Scholarship Programme "
                        "is excluded for international students."
                    )
                ),
                "eligibility_questions": merge_questions(
                    TOPUP_QUESTIONS if topup else LONDON_QUESTIONS,
                    old_review.get("eligibility_questions", []),
                    old_award_review.get("eligibility_questions", []),
                    old_award_review.get("questions", []),
                ),
            }

            raw["scholarship_status"] = review["status"]
            raw["scholarship_review"] = review

            if "award_review" in raw:
                raw["award_review"] = copy.deepcopy(review)

            if raw != source.raw_fees:
                course_changes.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "tuition_id": tuition.pk,
                    "source_id": source.pk,
                    "before": source.raw_fees,
                    "after": raw,
                })

        return {
            "award_changes": award_changes,
            "course_changes": course_changes,
        }

    def save_plan(self, plan):
        for change in plan["award_changes"]:
            scholarship, _ = Scholarship.objects.update_or_create(
                university_id="UK003",
                name=change["name"],
                defaults=change["after"]["scholarship"],
            )

            ScholarshipRule.objects.update_or_create(
                scholarship=scholarship,
                defaults={
                    **change["after"]["rule"],
                    "reviewed_at": timezone.now(),
                },
            )

        for change in plan["course_changes"]:
            source = TuitionSource.objects.get(
                pk=change["source_id"]
            )
            source.raw_fees = change["after"]
            source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

            TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                tuition_id=change["tuition_id"],
                course_identifier=change["course_id"],
                residency="INTL",
                before={"raw_fees": change["before"]},
                after={"raw_fees": change["after"]},
            )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / (
                "advanced-london-awards-"
                + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            )
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"

        try:
            sources = self.fetch_sources()

            with transaction.atomic():
                if options["apply"]:
                    University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                        pk="UK003"
                    )

                plan = self.build_plan(lock=options["apply"])

                report = {
                    "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]
                        else "preview"
                    ),
                    "database_changes": False,
                    "university_id": "UK003",
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "sources": sources,
                    "plan": plan,
                }

                output.write_text(
                    json.dumps(
                        report,
                        cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                        indent=2,
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    ),
                    encoding="utf-8",
                )

                if options["apply"]:
                    self.save_plan(plan)

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            OSError,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
            ArithmeticError,
            University.DoesNotExist,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Reconciliation stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        count = (
            len(plan["award_changes"])
            + len(plan["course_changes"])
        )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = count > 0

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Advanced-entry £1,000 rule: 2 top-up courses; "
            "course/entry confirmation required; APCL adjustments excluded."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "London entry £1,000 rule: 4 courses; conditional."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "London alumni £2,000 rule: 4 courses; conditional."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "London 50% Master's Scholarship Programme: "
            "excluded for international students."
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed/updated items: {count}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Scholarship rules and course review metadata saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Gross tuition, stored scholarship fields and deposit "
            "policies unchanged. Applicable deductions are calculated "
            "from the saved rules when the comparison runs."
        )

import copy
import json
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import (
    Course,
    DepositPolicy,
    ScholarshipRule,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
)

from app.management.commands.preview_aru_business_psychology_fees import (
    Command as FeeEvidenceValidator,
    TARGETS,
)


YEAR = "2027/28"

RULE_SCOPES = {
    (
        "ARU International Undergraduate Scholarship "
        "— Lower — Year 1 (2027/28)"
    ): {"C_UK003_05"},
    (
        "ARU International Undergraduate Scholarship "
        "— Higher — Year 1 (2027/28)"
    ): {"C_UK003_05"},
    (
        "ARU International Postgraduate Scholarship "
        "— ARU graduate eligibility (2027/28)"
    ): {"C_UK003_30"},
}


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Extend saved ARU scholarship/deposit scopes to the "
        "reviewed Business and Psychology routes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        path = Path(options["evidence"])
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = root / path

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(evidence, dict)
            or evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or evidence.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(evidence.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid course evidence.")

        validator = FeeEvidenceValidator()
        pages = {}

        # Reuse the validated route and fee extraction.
        for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
            try:
                page = validator.validated_page(
                    path.parent,
                    evidence["pages"],
                    target,
                )
            except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{course_id}: invalid source evidence: {exc}"
                ) from exc

            if (
                "deposit of £4,000 or a sponsorship letter"
                not in page.get("text", "")
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{course_id}: deposit evidence not found."
                )

            pages[course_id] = page

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "scholarship_rules": [],
            "deposit_policy": None,
            "courses": [],
        }

        folder = root / "logs" / "aru"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / (
            "business-psychology-awards-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }

            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Both active reviewed courses are required."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    course_id__in=TARGETS,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
                .order_by("pk")
            )

            tuition_map = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Both international tuition records are required."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            source_plans = []

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                course = courses[course_id]
                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)

                if (
                    course.title != target["title"]
                    or course.location != target["location"]
                    or course.level != target["level"]
                    or course.duration != target["duration"]
                    or course.start_month != "September"
                    or course.start_year != 2027
                    or course.work_placement
                    or tuition.currency != "GBP"
                    or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(target["amount"])
                    or source is None
                    or source.academic_year != YEAR
                    or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                    or source.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    != target["url"]
                    or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    or source.raw_fees.get("verified") is not True
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: apply the reviewed fee "
                        "and course correction first."
                    )

                old = {
                    "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                    "scholarship": str(tuition.scholarship),
                    "scholarship_source_id": (
                        tuition.scholarship_source_id
                    ),
                }

                new = copy.deepcopy(old)
                raw = new["raw_fees"]
                raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                    "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                )
                raw["deposit_status"] = (
                    "verified_policy_eligibility_required"
                )
                raw["scholarship_scope_note"] = (
                    "Existing first-year UG lower/higher rules; "
                    "ARU must confirm the applicable award tier."
                    if target["level"] == "UG"
                    else
                    "Existing first-year International PG rule "
                    "for eligible ARU graduates. The award is "
                    "a conditional maximum, not guaranteed."
                )
                raw["published_deposit_evidence"] = {
                    "amount": "4000.00",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "alternative": "sponsorship_letter",
                    "source_url": target["url"],
                    "source_sha256": pages[course_id]["sha256"],
                }

                # Remove legacy numeric deductions so that the
                # saved eligibility rules govern the calculation.
                new["scholarship"] = "0.00"
                new["scholarship_source_id"] = None

                comparable_old = copy.deepcopy(old)
                comparable_old["scholarship"] = (
                    f"{Decimal(str(tuition.scholarship)):.2f}"
                )
                changed = comparable_old != new

                source_plans.append(
                    (source, tuition, new, changed)
                )
                report["courses"].append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })

            rule_plans = []

            for name, additions in RULE_SCOPES.items():
                matches = list(
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                        scholarship__name=name,
                        verified=True,
                    )
                )

                if len(matches) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Expected one verified rule: {name}"
                    )

                rule = matches[0]
                old = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)

                if (
                    not isinstance(old, dict)
                    or old.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                    or old.get("study_years") != [1]
                    or not isinstance(old.get("conditions"), dict)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unsupported saved rule: {name}"
                    )

                conditions = old["conditions"]
                scope = conditions.get("course_id")

                if (
                    not isinstance(scope, list)
                    or not all(isinstance(v, str) for v in scope)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Invalid saved course scope: {name}"
                    )

                is_pg = "Postgraduate" in name

                if (
                    old.get("kind")
                    != ("fixed_maximum" if is_pg else "fixed")
                    or (
                        is_pg
                        and conditions.get("aru_graduate") != [True]
                    )
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unexpected eligibility structure: {name}"
                    )

                new = copy.deepcopy(old)
                new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(scope) | additions
                )

                rule_plans.append((rule, new, old != new))
                report["scholarship_rules"].append({
                    "name": name,
                    "changed": old != new,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })

            policies = list(
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                )
            )

            if len(policies) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected one verified ARU deposit policy."
                )

            policy = policies[0]
            old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

            if (
                not isinstance(old_policy, dict)
                or old_policy.get("schema_version") != 1
                or old_policy.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old_policy.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or old_policy.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
                or old_policy.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
                or not isinstance(
                    old_policy.get("course_ids"), list
                )
                or not all(
                    isinstance(v, str)
                    for v in old_policy["course_ids"]
                )
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Saved deposit policy requires review."
                )

            try:
                amount = Decimal(str(old_policy["amount"]))
                if not amount.is_finite() or amount != Decimal("4000"):
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected the saved GBP 4,000 deposit."
                ) from exc

            new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)
            new_policy["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(old_policy["course_ids"]) | set(TARGETS)
            )

            source_urls = new_policy.setdefault(
                "course_source_urls", {}
            )
            if not isinstance(source_urls, dict):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Deposit source map requires review."
                )

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                source_urls[course_id] = target["url"]

            policy_changed = old_policy != new_policy
            report["deposit_policy"] = {
                "changed": policy_changed,
                "before": old_policy,
                "after": new_policy,
            }
            report["proposed_items"] = (
                sum(plan[3] for plan in source_plans)
                + sum(plan[2] for plan in rule_plans)
                + int(policy_changed)
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for source, tuition, new, changed in source_plans:
                    if not changed:
                        continue

                    source.raw_fees = new["raw_fees"]
                    source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

                    tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                    tuition.scholarship_source_id = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "scholarship",
                        "scholarship_source",
                    ])

                    entry = next(
                        item
                        for item in report["courses"]
                        if item["course_id"] == tuition.course_id
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=tuition.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=entry["after"],
                    )

                for rule, new, changed in rule_plans:
                    if changed:
                        rule.rules = new
                        rule.save(update_fields=["rules"])

                if policy_changed:
                    policy.rules = new_policy
                    policy.save(
                        update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"]
                    )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_items"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True

        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["scholarship_rules"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['name']}: "
                f"{len(entry['after']['conditions']['course_id'])} "
                f"courses — {state}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Deposit scope: {len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {report['proposed_items']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship conditions and frontend questions preserved."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Gross tuition and numeric stored deposits unchanged."
        )

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Scholarship scopes, deposit scope and metadata saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

from copy import deepcopy
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import requests

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.utils import timezone

from app.models import (
    Course,
    DepositPolicy,

from .reconcile_aru_games_health_awards import (

    DEPOSIT_URL,
)


COURSE_ID = "C_UK003_64"

COURSE_URL = (
    "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/computing"
)


def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")

    return format(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")), ".2f")


class Command(PolicyTools):
    help = (
        "Reconcile 2027/28 Computing scholarship deductions "
        "and deposit applicability."
    )

    def prepare_computing(self):
        updates = []

        course = Course.objects.select_for_update().get(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id=COURSE_ID,
        )

        expected = {
            "title": "BSc (Hons) Computing",
            "level": "UG",
            "location": "Peterborough Campus",
            "duration": "3 Years",
            "start_month": "September",
            "start_year": 2027,
            "ucas_cao_code": "I118",
        }

        for field, value in expected.items():
            if getattr(course, field) != value:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Unexpected course field: {field}. "
                    "Apply the Computing replacement first."
                )

        if course.course_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL:
            raise CommandError("Unexpected Computing course URL.")

        tuitions = list(
            Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
        )

        if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
            raise CommandError(
                "Expected one GBP international tuition."
            )

        tuition = tuitions[0]

        source = TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update().get(
            tuition=tuition
        )

        raw = deepcopy(source.raw_fees)

        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise CommandError("Invalid tuition source metadata.")

        if (
            source.academic_year != "2027/28"
            or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
            or source.source_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL
            or raw.get("verified") is not True
            or raw.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
            or raw.get("course_kind") != "undergraduate_taught"
            or money(raw.get("annual_tuition")) != "19750.00"
            or money(tuition.tuition_fee) != "19750.00"
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Saved tuition does not match the verified "
                "Computing 2027/28 replacement."
            )

        rules = list(
            ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                verified=True,
            )
        )

        summary = {}
        scholarship_questions = None

        for tier, award in [
            ("lower", "2000.00"),
            ("higher", "4000.00"),
        ]:
            matches = []

            for rule in rules:
                data = rule.rules

                if not isinstance(data, dict):
                    continue

                conditions = data.get("conditions", {})

                if not isinstance(conditions, dict):
                    continue

                if (
                    rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == UG_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and data.get("academic_year") == "2027/28"
                    and data.get("kind") == "fixed"
                    and data.get("currency") == "GBP"
                    and money(data.get("value")) == award
                    and conditions.get("aru_ug_award_tier")
                    == [tier]
                ):
                    matches.append(rule)

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Expected one verified {tier} undergraduate "
                    "rule for 2027/28."
                )

            rule = matches[0]
            data = deepcopy(rule.rules)
            conditions = data["conditions"]

            required = {
                "fee_status": ["INTL"],
                "new_entrant": [True],
                "full_time": [True],
                "entry_year": [1],
                "apcl": [False],
                "registration_conditions_met": [True],
                "aru_funding_eligibility_confirmed": [True],
                "aru_ug_award_confirmed": [True],
            }

            for key, value in required.items():
                if conditions.get(key) != value:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{tier} rule has an unexpected "
                        f"condition: {key}"
                    )

            if (
                data.get("stacking") != "exclusive"
                or data.get("study_years") != [1]
                or data.get("fee_basis_confirmed") is not True
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} scholarship rule requires review."
                )

            questions = data.get("eligibility_questions")

            if not isinstance(questions, list) or not questions:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} rule is missing eligibility questions."
                )

            scope = conditions.get("course_id")

            if not isinstance(scope, list) or not all(
                isinstance(value, str) for value in scope
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} rule has an invalid course scope."
                )

            if COURSE_ID not in scope:
                conditions["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(scope) | {COURSE_ID}
                )

            self.add_update(
                updates,
                "ScholarshipRule",
                rule,
                {"rules": data},
            )

            summary[f"{tier}_ug_scope"] = len(
                conditions["course_id"]
            )

            if tier == "lower":
                scholarship_questions = deepcopy(questions)

        policy = DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().get(
            university_id="UK003",
            academic_year="2027/28",
            currency="GBP",
            verified=True,
        )

        deposit_rules = deepcopy(policy.rules)

        if not isinstance(deposit_rules, dict):
            raise CommandError("Invalid deposit policy.")

        if (
            policy.source_url.rstrip("/")
            != DEPOSIT_URL.rstrip("/")
            or deposit_rules.get("kind") != "fixed"
            or deposit_rules.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
            or deposit_rules.get("currency") != "GBP"
            or money(deposit_rules.get("amount")) != "4000.00"
            or deposit_rules.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
            or deposit_rules.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
            or deposit_rules.get("requires_student_visa") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get("full_fee_paying") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit"
            ) is not False
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "sponsorship_letter_requires_review"
            ) is not True
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "offer_letter_confirmation_required"
            ) is not True
            or "undergraduate_taught"
            not in deposit_rules.get("course_kinds", [])
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "The saved deposit policy requires review."
            )

        scope = deposit_rules.get("course_ids")
        deposit_questions = deposit_rules.get(
            "eligibility_questions"
        )

        if not isinstance(scope, list) or not all(
            isinstance(value, str) for value in scope
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid deposit course scope.")

        if (
            not isinstance(deposit_questions, list)
            or not deposit_questions
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Deposit eligibility questions are missing."
            )

        if COURSE_ID not in scope:
            deposit_rules["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(scope) | {COURSE_ID}
            )

        self.add_update(
            updates,
            "DepositPolicy",
            policy,
            {"rules": deposit_rules},
        )

        raw["scholarship_status"] = (
            "verified_rule_eligibility_required"

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            sources = self.collect_sources()

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        output = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"computing-awards-{stamp}"
            / "reconciliation.json"
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                updates, summary = self.prepare_computing()

            except (
                ValueError,
                TypeError,
                KeyError,
                ArithmeticError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
                TuitionSource.DoesNotExist,
                DepositPolicy.DoesNotExist,
                DepositPolicy.MultipleObjectsReturned,
            ) as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Saved-rule verification stopped: {exc}. "
                    "No database records changed."
                ) from exc

            report = {
                "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                "university_id": "UK003",
                "mode": "preview",
                "database_changes": False,
                "sources": sources,
                "summary": summary,
                "updates": updates,
            }

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)

            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Cannot save preview report: {exc}. "
                    "No database records changed."
                ) from exc

            if options["apply"]:
                self.apply_updates(updates)

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = bool(updates)

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)

            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database changes were committed, but the "
                    f"final report could not be updated: {exc}"
                ) from exc

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Lower UG scholarship scope: "
            f"{summary['lower_ug_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Higher UG scholarship scope: "
            f"{summary['higher_ug_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"2027/28 deposit scope: "
            f"{summary['deposit_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Computing lower award: £19,750 - £2,000 = £17,750 "
            "if eligible."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Computing higher award: £19,750 - £4,000 = £15,750 "
            "if eligible."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Deposit: £4,000 subject to payment eligibility."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {len(updates)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    "Computing scholarship scopes, deposit scope "
                    "and review metadata saved."
                )
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Eligibility questions and replacement history preserved. "
            "Gross tuition and numeric stored discounts/deposits "
            "unchanged. The comparison calculates eligible "
            "scholarship deductions from the saved rules."
        )

FIELDS = [
    "title",
    "level",
    "duration",
    "location",
    "start_month",
    "start_year",
    "intake_months",
    "course_url",
    "ucas_cao_code",
