]


def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))
    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")
    return f"{amount:.2f}"


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile Computing research, two Nursing routes "
        "and Horticulture review metadata."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence")
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacement",
            action="store_true",
            help="Accept the explicitly previewed MSc-to-MPhil replacement.",
        )

    def read_evidence(self, supplied):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)

        if supplied:
            path = Path(supplied)
            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = root / path
        else:
            candidates = sorted(
                (root / "logs" / "aru").glob(
                    "campus-intakes-*/campus-intake-evidence.json"
                ),
                reverse=True,
            )
            path = None

            for candidate in candidates:
                try:
                    data = json.loads(
                        candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
                    )
                    ids = {
                        item["database_course"]["course_id"]
                        for item in data.get("courses", [])
                    }
                except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
                    continue

                if set(TARGETS).issubset(ids):
                    path = candidate
                    break

            if path is None:
                raise CommandError(
                    "No evidence report containing these four "
                    "courses was found. Supply --evidence."
                )

        try:
            data = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(data, dict)
            or data.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or not isinstance(data.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid ARU evidence report.")

        allowed_ids = {
            "C_UK003_56",
            "C_UK003_46",
            "C_UK003_89",
        }

        for error in data.get("errors", []):
            if (
                error.get("course_id") not in allowed_ids
                or error.get("error")
                != (
                    "No application link found; "
                    "manual route review required."
                )
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Unexpected collection issue: "
                    + json.dumps(error, ensure_ascii=False)
                )

        return path, data

    def validate_page(self, folder, pages, course_id, target):
        url = "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/" + target["slug"]

        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") == url
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course_id}: expected one source capture."
            )

        page = matches[0]
        filename = page.get("html_file")

        if (
            not isinstance(filename, str)
            or Path(filename).name != filename
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid saved HTML filename.")

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            (folder / filename).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()

        if digest != page.get("sha256"):
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course_id}: saved HTML hash mismatch."
            )

        text = " ".join(page.get("text", "").split())

        if target["kind"] == "research_replacement":
            required = [
                "Computing and Information Science MPhil, PhD",
                "January 2027",
                "Cambridge",
                "MPhil: full-time 1-3 years",
                "Bench fees",
            ]
            if not all(value in text for value in required):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Computing award, intake, duration or "
                    "additional-cost evidence changed."
                )

            amounts = {
                money(value.replace(",", ""))
                for value in re.findall(
                    r"International students,\s*2026/27\s*"
                    r"\(per year\)\s*£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                    text,
                )
            }
            if amounts != {"17500.00"}:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected the published GBP 17,500 "
                    "annual international research fee."
                )

        elif target["kind"] == "nursing_correction":
            instances = []

            for script in page.get("scripts", []):
                parsed = script.get("parsed_json")
                if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
                    continue
                values = parsed.get("hasCourseInstance", [])
                if isinstance(values, dict):
                    values = [values]
                if isinstance(values, list):
                    instances.extend(values)

            confirmed = any(
                isinstance(item, dict)
                and item.get("name") == "Full-time"
                and item.get("courseWorkload") == "P3Y"
                and item.get("startdate") == "2027-09"
                and any(
                    isinstance(location, dict)
                    and location.get("name") == "Chelmsford"
                    for location in item.get("location", [])
                )
                for item in instances
            )

            if not confirmed or not re.search(
                rf"UCAS course code\s+{target['code']}\b",
                text,
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Standard September 2027 Chelmsford "
                    "Nursing route not confirmed."
                )

            if re.search(
                r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?\s+"
                r"International students starting",
                text,
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "International Nursing fee found; review "
                    "before retaining unavailable status."
                )

        else:
            configs = []

            for script in page.get("scripts", []):
                body = script.get("text", "")
                match = re.search(
                    r"\b(?:var\s+)?configOptions\s*=\s*",
                    body,
                )
                if match:
                    try:
                        config, _ = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(
                            body[match.end():].lstrip()
                        )
                    except ValueError:
                        continue
                    if isinstance(config, dict):
                        configs.append(config)

            if len(configs) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected one Horticulture configuration."
                )

            options = configs[0].get("CourseOptions", [])

            if len(options) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Horticulture route options changed."
                )

            option = options[0]
            if (
                option.get("Duration", {}).get("Name")
                != "3 years part-time"
                or {
                    date.get("Name")
                    for date in option.get("StartDate", [])
                } != {"September"}
                or not any(
                    location.get("ShortName") == "Writtle"
                    for location in option.get("Location", [])
                )
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Horticulture part-time evidence changed."
                )

            fees = option.get("TuitionFees", [])
            if (
                len(fees) != 1
                or fees[0].get("FeeBand", {}).get("Description")
                != "UK students starting 2025/26 (part-time, per year)"
                or money(
                    fees[0].get("FeeBand", {}).get("Value")
                ) != "3118.00"
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Horticulture fee schedule changed; review required."
                )

        return page

    def plan(self, course, tuition, source, page, target):
        if (
            course.title
            not in {target["old_title"], target["title"]}
            or course.location != target["location"]
            or course.work_placement
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course.course_id}: unexpected stored route."
            )

        expected_levels = (
            {"MRES", "PG"}
            if target["kind"] == "research_replacement"
            else {"UG"}
            if target["kind"] == "nursing_correction"
            else {"PG"}
        )
        if course.level not in expected_levels:
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course.course_id}: unexpected stored level."
            )

        before = {
            "course": {
                field: getattr(course, field)
                for field in FIELDS
            },
            "tuition": {
                "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
                "currency": tuition.currency,
            },
            "source": (
                {
                    "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                    "source_url": source.source_url,
                    "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                    "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                    "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                    "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                }
                if source
                else None
            ),
        }

        after = copy.deepcopy(before)
        after["course"]["course_url"] = page["source_url"]

        verified = target["kind"] == "research_replacement"
        academic_year = target.get("academic_year", "")

        raw = {
            "verified": verified,
            "academic_year": academic_year,
            "source_fee_category": "International",
            "currency": "GBP",
            "course_source_url": page["source_url"],
            "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
            "mapping_kind": target["kind"],
            "scholarship_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
            "deposit_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
            "fee_categories": [],
        }

        if verified:
            after["course"].update({
                "title": target["title"],
                "level": "PG",
                "duration": "1 to 3 Years",
                "start_month": "January",
                "start_year": 2027,
                "intake_months": "January",
            })
            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = target["amount"]

            previous_raw = (
                source.raw_fees
                if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                else {}
            )
            raw.update({
                "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                "study_year": 1,
                "course_kind": "postgraduate_research",
                "duration_note": (
                    "Published MPhil full-time completion "
                    "range: one to three years."
                ),
                "route_replacement": previous_raw.get(
                    "route_replacement",
                    {
                        "previous_title": target["old_title"],
                        "replacement_title": target["title"],
                        "note": (
                            "Explicit MSc-to-MPhil replacement; "
                            "not claimed to be a university-confirmed rename."
                        ),
                    },
                ),
                "additional_costs": {
                    "bench_fees_possible": True,
                    "amount": None,
                    "included_in_tuition": False,
                    "note": (
                        "Project-specific bench fees may apply. "
                        "ARU must confirm any additional amount."
                    ),
                },
                "fee_note": (
                    "Published annual international research "
                    "tuition for 2026/27, January 2027 intake. "
                    "Possible project-specific bench fees excluded."
                ),
                "fee_categories": [{
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "academic_year": academic_year,
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                    "amount_requires_review": False,
                }],
            })

        elif target["kind"] == "nursing_correction":
            after["course"].update({
                "title": target["title"],
                "start_month": "September",
                "start_year": 2027,
                "intake_months": "September",
                "ucas_cao_code": target["code"],
            })
            raw.update({
                "course_kind": "undergraduate",
                "advertised_intake": "September 2027",
                "verification_reason": (
                    "The reviewed Nursing course page does not "
                    "provide a confirmed international tuition "
                    "amount. International fee and applicant "
                    "eligibility require confirmation. This "
                    "does not establish that international "
                    "applicants are excluded."
                ),
            })

        else:
            # Preserve existing duration/intake until a current
            # applicable route is established.
            raw.update({
                "course_kind": "postgraduate_taught",
                "observed_route": {
                    "duration": "3 years part-time",
                    "start_month": "September",
                    "start_year": None,
                    "campus": "Writtle",
                    "published_fee": {
                        "category": "UK",
                        "academic_year": "2025/26",
                        "amount": "3118.00",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "basis": "part_time_per_year",
                    },
                },
                "verification_reason": (
                    "The captured MSc Horticulture page only "
                    "provides a three-year part-time option, "
                    "September without an intake year, and a "
                    "2025/26 UK fee. A current applicable "
                    "international route and fee are unconfirmed. "
                    "The stored tuition is not verified."
                ),
            })

        if not verified:
            raw["fee_note"] = raw["verification_reason"]

        after["source"] = {
            "academic_year": academic_year,
            "source_url": page["source_url"],
            "source_course_code": target.get("code", ""),
            "source_course_name": target["title"],
            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition" if verified else "unavailable",
            "raw_fees": raw,
        }

        return {
            "course_id": course.course_id,
            "changed": before != after,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
        }

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        path, evidence = self.read_evidence(options["evidence"])

        try:
            pages = {
                course_id: self.validate_page(
                    path.parent,
                    evidence["pages"],
                    course_id,
                    target,
                )
                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
            }
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Evidence validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "records": [],
        }

        directory = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = directory / (
            "computing-nursing-horticulture-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }
            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError("Expected all four active courses.")

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(course_id__in=TARGETS, residency="INTL")
                .order_by("pk")
            )
            tuition_map = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError("Duplicate international tuition.")
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if (
                set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS)
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            # Check for a duplicate replacement before importing.
            duplicates = list(
                Course.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    is_active=True,
                    title=TARGETS["C_ARU003_RES_02"]["title"],
                    location="Cambridge Campus",
                )
                .exclude(course_id="C_ARU003_RES_02")
                .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
            )
            if duplicates:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Possible existing Computing MPhil duplicate: "
                    + ", ".join(duplicates)
                )

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)

                if (
                    target["kind"] != "research_replacement"
                    and source
                    and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    and source.raw_fees.get("verified") is True
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: already has verified fee "
                        "metadata; review before replacing it."
                    )

                report["records"].append(
                    self.plan(
                        courses[course_id],
                        tuition,
                        source,
                        pages[course_id],
                        target,
                    )
                )

            report["proposed_changes"] = sum(
                entry["changed"] for entry in report["records"]
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            replacement_needed = (
                courses["C_ARU003_RES_02"].title
                != TARGETS["C_ARU003_RES_02"]["title"]
            )
            if (
                options["apply"]
                and replacement_needed
                and not options["accept_replacement"]
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "The preview includes an explicit MSc-to-MPhil "
                    "replacement. Review the report, then use "
                    "--apply --accept-replacement to save it. "
                    "No database records changed."
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for entry in report["records"]:
                    if not entry["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course_id = entry["course_id"]
                    course = courses[course_id]
                    tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                    after = entry["after"]

                    for field, value in after["course"].items():
                        setattr(course, field, value)

                    course.save(
                        update_fields=FIELDS + ["updated_at"]
                    )

                    if TARGETS[course_id].get("amount"):
                        tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                        )
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_changes"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["records"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            after = entry["after"]
            verified = after["source"]["raw_fees"]["verified"]
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['course_id']}: "
                f"{'verified fee' if verified else 'international fee unavailable'}"
                f" — {state}"
            )
            if verified:
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  GBP {after['tuition']['tuition_fee']}; "
                    f"{after['source']['academic_year']}"
                )
            for field, value in after["course"].items():
                previous = entry["before"]["course"][field]
                if previous != value:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {previous} -> {value}"
                    )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed changes: {report['proposed_changes']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed changes saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship rules, stored discounts and deposit "
            "policies unchanged. Their applicability remains pending."
        )

def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")

    return format(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")), ".2f")


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile Games Programming scholarships/deposit and save "
        "MPhil/Animation applicability reviews."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",

    def collect_sources(self):
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            connect=3,
            read=3,
            status=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        collected = {}

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionComparePolicyInspector/1.0"
            )

            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for url in [UG_URL, DEPOSIT_URL, PG_URL, ALUMNI_URL]:
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                response = session.get(
                    url,
                    timeout=(30, 60),
                )
                response.raise_for_status()

                if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                    )

                soup = BeautifulSoup(
                    response.text,
                    "html.parser",
                )

                root = soup.find("main") or soup

                for element in root.find_all(
                    ["script", "style", "nav", "footer"]
                ):
                    element.decompose()

                text = " ".join(
                    root.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
                )

                collected[url] = {
                    "source_url": response.url,
                    "text": text,
                    "text_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        text.encode("utf-8")
                    ).hexdigest(),
                }

        self.verify_sources(collected)
        return collected

    def verify_sources(self, sources):
        checks = {
            UG_URL: [
                r"International Undergraduate Scholarship",
                r"£2,000 in the first year",
                r"£4,000 in the first year",
                r"starting in Year 1",
                r"Cambridge",
                r"Accredited Prior Certified Learning",
                r"conditions of registration",
            ],
            DEPOSIT_URL: [
                r"full fee paying international students",
                r"before being issued with a CAS",
                (
                    r"deposit for Undergraduate and Postgraduate "
                    r"taught courses is £4,000"
                ),
                r"offer letter",
            ],
            PG_URL: [
                r"Up to £4,000",
                r"studying for an MBA or be an ARU graduate",
            ],
            ALUMNI_URL: [
                r"£400 discount",
                r"postgraduate research",
                r"2026-27 academic year",
                r"from the UK or an EU/EEA student",
                r"International students should see",
            ],
        }

        for url, patterns in checks.items():
            text = sources[url]["text"]

            for pattern in patterns:
                if not re.search(
                    pattern,
                    text,
                    re.IGNORECASE,
                ):
                    raise ValueError(
                        "Published policy changed or could not be "
                        f"verified: {url}; missing {pattern!r}"
                    )

    @staticmethod
    def add_update(updates, model_name, obj, after):
        before = {
            field: deepcopy(getattr(obj, field))
            for field in after
        }

        if before != after:
            updates.append({
                "model": model_name,
                "id": obj.pk,
                "before": before,
                "after": deepcopy(after),
            })

    def prepare(self, sources):
        updates = []
        records = {}

        for course_id, expected in EXPECTED.items():

                    f"{course_id}: apply its replacement first."

                    or money(tuition.tuition_fee)
                    != expected["amount"]

                raise CommandError(

    def apply_updates(self, updates):
        models = {
            "ScholarshipRule": ScholarshipRule,
            "DepositPolicy": DepositPolicy,
            "TuitionSource": TuitionSource,
        }

        for update in updates:
            model = models[update["model"]]
            obj = model.objects.get(pk=update["id"])

            current = {
                field: deepcopy(getattr(obj, field))
                for field in update["before"]
            }

            if current != update["before"]:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database state changed during reconciliation."
                )

            for field, value in update["after"].items():
                setattr(obj, field, deepcopy(value))

            fields = list(update["after"])

            if update["model"] == "ScholarshipRule":
                obj.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
                fields.append("reviewed_at")

            elif update["model"] == "TuitionSource":
                fields.append("checked_at")

            elif update["model"] == "DepositPolicy":
                fields.append("updated_at")

            obj.save(update_fields=fields)

            if update["model"] == "TuitionSource":
                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition_id=obj.tuition_id,
                    course_identifier=obj.tuition.course_id,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=update["before"],
                    after=update["after"],
                )

    @staticmethod
    def write_report(path, data):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                data,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            sources = self.collect_sources()
        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"games-health-awards-{stamp}"
        )
        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"

        # The report is written before any mutation. Failure to save
        # that preview prevents database changes.
        with transaction.atomic():
            try:
                updates, summary = self.prepare(sources)
            except (
                ValueError,
                TypeError,
                KeyError,
                ArithmeticError,
                Course.DoesNotExist,
                TuitionSource.DoesNotExist,
            ) as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Saved-rule verification stopped: {exc}. "
                    "No database records changed."
                ) from exc

            report = {
                "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                "university_id": "UK003",
                "mode": "preview",
                "database_changes": False,
                "sources": sources,
                "summary": summary,
                "updates": updates,
            }

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Cannot save preview report: {exc}. "
                    "No database records changed."
                ) from exc

            if options["apply"]:
                self.apply_updates(updates)

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = bool(updates)

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database changes were committed, but the "
                    f"final JSON report could not be updated: {exc}"
                ) from exc

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Lower UG scholarship scope: "
            f"{summary['lower_ug_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Higher UG scholarship scope: "
            f"{summary['higher_ug_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"2027/28 deposit scope: "
            f"{summary['deposit_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Games Programming: conditional £2,000/£4,000 award; "
            "net £16,825/£14,825 if eligible. Deposit £4,000 "
            "subject to payment eligibility."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "MPhil: international scholarship and research deposit "
            "remain pending for 2026/27."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Animation: fee, scholarship and deposit applicability "
            "remain unconfirmed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {len(updates)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    "Scholarship scopes, deposit scope and "
                    "review metadata saved."
                )
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Eligibility questions preserved. Gross tuition and "
            "numeric stored discounts/deposits unchanged. "
            "The comparison calculates eligible deductions "
            "from the saved rules."
        )

        or rules.get("full_fee_paying") is not True
        or rules.get("deduct_scholarship_from_deposit") is not False
        or not isinstance(rules.get("course_ids"), list)
        or not all(
            isinstance(value, str)
            for value in rules["course_ids"]
        )
    ):
        raise CommandError(
            "Saved deposit policy requires review."
        )

    try:
        valid_amount = money(rules["amount"]) == "4000.00"
    except (ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
        valid_amount = False

    if not valid_amount:
        raise CommandError(
            "Expected a GBP 4,000 fixed deposit policy."
        )


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply two January 2027 course corrections, "
        "2026/27 fees and course-specific deposit coverage."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def validate_page(self, folder, pages, target):
        url = (
            "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/"
            + target["slug"]
        )
        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") == url
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Expected one saved course page: {url}"
            )

        page = matches[0]
        filename = page.get("html_file")
        if (
            not isinstance(filename, str)
            or Path(filename).name != filename
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid HTML evidence filename.")

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            (folder / filename).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()
        if digest != page.get("sha256"):
            raise CommandError("Saved HTML hash mismatch.")

        instances = []
        for script in page.get("scripts", []):
            parsed = script.get("parsed_json")
            if not isinstance(parsed, dict):
                continue
            values = parsed.get("hasCourseInstance", [])
            if isinstance(values, dict):
                values = [values]
            if isinstance(values, list):
                instances.extend(values)

        confirmed = any(
            isinstance(item, dict)
            and item.get("name") == "Full-time"
            and item.get("courseWorkload") == "P3Y"
            and item.get("startdate") == "2027-01"
            and item.get("duration", "").casefold() == "3 years"
            and any(
                isinstance(location, dict)
                and location.get("name") == target["campus"]
                for location in item.get("location", [])
            )
            for item in instances
        )
        if not confirmed:
            raise CommandError(
                "Standard January 2027 campus route not confirmed."
            )

        text = " ".join(page.get("text", "").split())

        if not re.search(
            rf"UCAS course code\s+{target['code']}\b",
            text,
        ):
            raise CommandError("Expected UCAS code not found.")

        # Isolate the standard honours fee section, stopping
        # before the next foundation or placement route.
        label = re.escape(target["award_label"])
        section = re.search(
            rf"International students\s+{label}.*?"
            rf"{label}\s+(.*?)"
            r"(?=\s+With (?:foundation year|placement)\b)",
            text,
            flags=re.S,
        )
        if section is None:
            raise CommandError(
                "Cannot isolate the standard-route fee section."
            )

        amounts = {
            money(value.replace(",", ""))
            for value in re.findall(
                r"£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                r"International students starting 2026/27\s+"
                r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                section.group(1),
            )
        }
        if amounts != {target["amount"]}:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected 2026/27 fee: {sorted(amounts)}"
            )

        # Associate the deposit statement with the 2026/27
        # international fee, rather than a different cohort.
        deposit = re.search(
            r"International students starting 2026/27\s+"
            r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)"
            r"(?:(?!International students starting).)*?"
            r"deposit of £4,000 or a sponsorship letter",
            section.group(1),
            flags=re.S,
        )
        if deposit is None:
            raise CommandError(
                "Deposit statement associated with the "
                "2026/27 fee was not confirmed."
            )

        return page

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        path = Path(options["evidence"])
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = root / path

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(evidence, dict)
            or evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or evidence.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(evidence.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid course evidence.")

        try:
            pages = {
                course_id: self.validate_page(
                    path.parent,
                    evidence["pages"],
                    target,
                )
                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
            }
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Evidence validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "records": [],
            "deposit_policy": None,
        }

        directory = root / "logs" / "aru"
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = directory / (
            "january-2027-routes-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }
            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected both active course records."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(course_id__in=TARGETS, residency="INTL")
                .order_by("pk")
            )
            tuition_map = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if (
                set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS)
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            # Preserve existing UG questions as review questions,
            # without treating the 2027/28 award as verified for 2026/27.
            questions = {}
            for rule in ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
                scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                scholarship__level="UG",
                verified=True,
            ).order_by("pk"):
                rules = rule.rules
                if not isinstance(rules, dict):
                    continue

                for question in rules.get(
                    "eligibility_questions", []
                ):
                    if (
                        isinstance(question, dict)
                        and isinstance(question.get("key"), str)
                    ):
                        questions.setdefault(
                            question["key"],
                            copy.deepcopy(question),
                        )

                # Do not override an existing verified 2026/27
                # award covering these records with pending metadata.
                if rules.get("academic_year") == YEAR:
                    conditions = rules.get("conditions", {})
                    scope = (
                        conditions.get("course_id", [])
                        if isinstance(conditions, dict)
                        else []
                    )
                    if isinstance(scope, list) and (
                        set(scope) & set(TARGETS)
                    ):
                        raise CommandError(
                            "A verified 2026/27 scholarship already "
                            "covers this batch. Review it separately."
                        )

            existing_policies = list(
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                )
            )
            if len(existing_policies) > 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Multiple 2026/27 deposit policies found."
                )

            policy = (
                existing_policies[0] if existing_policies else None
            )

            if policy:
                if not policy.verified:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Existing 2026/27 deposit policy is unverified; "
                        "review before extending it."
                    )
                validate_policy(policy.rules)
                old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)
                new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)
            else:
                # Reuse the question wording only. The amount,
                # academic year and course scope come from the
                # validated 2026/27 course-page evidence.
                template = DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year="2027/28",
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                ).first()

                if template is None:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Saved deposit questions/template not found."
                    )
                validate_policy(template.rules)

                old_policy = None
                new_policy = {
                    "schema_version": 1,
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "kind": "fixed",
                    "amount": "4000.00",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "fee_status": "INTL",
                    "payment_stage": "before_cas",
                    "requires_student_visa": True,
                    "full_fee_paying": True,
                    "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit": False,
                    "sponsorship_letter_requires_review": True,
                    "offer_letter_confirmation_required": True,
                    "course_ids": [],
                    "course_kinds": [
                        "undergraduate",
                        "undergraduate_taught",
                    ],
                    "source_period": (
                        "course_page_2026_27_fee_section"
                    ),
                    "eligibility_questions": copy.deepcopy(
                        template.rules.get(
                            "eligibility_questions", []
                        )
                    ),
                    "note": (
                        "The reviewed 2026/27 international course "
                        "fee sections publish a GBP 4,000 deposit "
                        "or sponsorship-letter alternative. "
                        "Confirm payment requirements in the offer. "
                        "The deposit is part of tuition, not an "
                        "additional charge."
                    ),
                }

            new_policy["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(new_policy["course_ids"]) | set(TARGETS)
            )
            new_policy["academic_year"] = YEAR
            source_urls = new_policy.setdefault(
                "course_source_urls", {}
            )
            if not isinstance(source_urls, dict):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Deposit source map requires review."
                )
            for course_id, page in pages.items():
                source_urls[course_id] = page["source_url"]

            policy_changed = old_policy != new_policy
            report["deposit_policy"] = {
                "action": "update" if policy else "create",
                "changed": policy_changed,
                "before": old_policy,
                "after": new_policy,
            }

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                course = courses[course_id]
                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)
                page = pages[course_id]

                if (
                    course.title != target["title"]
                    or course.level != "UG"
                    or course.location != target["location"]
                    or course.duration != "3 Years"
                    or course.work_placement
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unexpected stored route."
                    )

                before = {
                    "course": {
                        field: getattr(course, field)
                        for field in FIELDS
                    },
                    "tuition": {
                        "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
                        "currency": tuition.currency,
                        "scholarship": money(tuition.scholarship),
                        "scholarship_source_id": (
                            tuition.scholarship_source_id
                        ),
                    },
                    "source": (
                        {
                            "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                            "source_url": source.source_url,
                            "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                            "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                            "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                            "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),

                        if source
                        else None
                    ),

                after = copy.deepcopy(before)
                after["course"].update({

                    "intake_months": "January",

                    "ucas_cao_code": target["code"],
                })
                after["tuition"].update({
                    "tuition_fee": target["amount"],
                    "scholarship": "0.00",
                    "scholarship_source_id": None,
                })

                raw = {
                    "verified": True,
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                    "study_year": 1,
                    "course_kind": "undergraduate",
                    "course_source_url": page["source_url"],
                    "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                    "campus": target["campus"],
                    "intake": "January 2027",
                    "mapping_kind": "reviewed_intake_correction",
                    "scholarship_status": (
                        "academic_year_applicability_unconfirmed"
                    ),
                    "scholarship_review": {
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "status": "pending",
                        "note": (
                            "The saved 2027/28 scholarship rule "
                            "has not been copied to this January "

                            "Applicable award terms require confirmation."

                        "eligibility_questions": list(

                    },
                    "deposit_status": (
                        "verified_policy_eligibility_required"

                    "published_deposit_evidence": {
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "amount": "4000.00",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "alternative": "sponsorship_letter",
                        "source_url": page["source_url"],
                    },
                    "fee_note": (
                        "Published annual international tuition "

                    "fee_categories": [{

                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "currency": "GBP",

                }

                after["source"] = {
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": page["source_url"],
                    "source_course_code": target["code"],
                    "source_course_name": target["title"],
                    "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                    "raw_fees": raw,
                }

                report["records"].append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": before != after,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

            report["proposed_items"] = (
                sum(entry["changed"] for entry in report["records"])
                + int(policy_changed)
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for entry in report["records"]:
                    if not entry["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course_id = entry["course_id"]
                    course = courses[course_id]
                    tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                    after = entry["after"]

                    for field, value in after["course"].items():
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=FIELDS + ["updated_at"]
                    )

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                        after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                    )
                    tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                    tuition.scholarship_source_id = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "tuition_fee",
                        "scholarship",
                        "scholarship_source",
                    ])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                    if policy:
                        policy.rules = new_policy
                        policy.save(
                            update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"]
                        )
                    else:
                        primary = pages["C_UK003_12"]
                        DepositPolicy.objects.create(

                            currency="GBP",
                            rules=new_policy,
                            source_url=primary["source_url"],
                            source_text=primary["text"],
                            source_sha256=primary["sha256"],
                            verified=True,
                            checked_at=timezone.now(),
                        )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_items"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["records"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{entry['before']['tuition']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{entry['after']['tuition']['tuition_fee']}; "
                f"January 2027 / {YEAR} — {state}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"2026/27 deposit scope: "
            f"{len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarships: 2026/27 applicability pending; "
            "no deduction verified."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {report['proposed_items']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed fees, intake corrections and deposit scope saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

import copy

YEAR = "2027/28"

UG_ID = "C_UK003_02"
PG_IDS = {"C_UK003_54", "C_UK003_71"}
COURSE_IDS = {UG_ID, *PG_IDS}

UG_URL = (
    "https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/"
    "international-scholarships/"
    "international-undergraduate-scholarship"
)

PG_URL = (
    "https://www.aru.ac.uk/international/"
    "international-scholarships/"
    "international-postgraduate-scholarship"
)


class Command(PolicyInspector):
    help = (
        "Reconcile scholarship and deposit scopes for three "
        "reviewed ARU land/engineering replacements."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--evidence",
            help=(
                "Optional campus-intake evidence path. Otherwise "
                "locate the latest report for these three courses."
            ),
        )
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def fetch_policies(self):
        # Reuse the existing UG/deposit source verification.
        sources = self.fetch_sources()

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {PG_URL}")

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionComparePolicyReview/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )
            response = session.get(PG_URL, timeout=(30, 60))
            response.raise_for_status()

        if response.url.rstrip("/") != PG_URL.rstrip("/"):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Unexpected postgraduate redirect: {response.url}"
            )

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")

        if soup.find("h1") is None:
            raise ValueError("Postgraduate policy has no title.")

        text = " ".join(
            (soup.find("main") or soup)
            .get_text(" ", strip=True)
            .split()
        )

        lower = text.casefold()

        for marker in [
            "£4,000",
            "aru graduate",
            "mba",
            "minimum entry requirements",
            "registration",
        ]:
            if marker not in lower:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Postgraduate scholarship terms changed: {marker}"
                )

        sources["postgraduate"] = {
            "source_url": response.url,
            "text": text,
        }

        return sources

    def find_rule(self, rules, *, level):
        matches = []

        for rule in rules:
            data = rule.rules

            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                continue

            conditions = data.get("conditions", {})

            if not isinstance(conditions, dict):
                continue

            common = (
                rule.verified
                and data.get("academic_year") == YEAR
                and data.get("currency") == "GBP"
                and data.get("benefit") == "tuition"
                and data.get("fee_basis_confirmed") is True
                and data.get("award_status") == "conditional"
                and data.get("study_years") == [1]
                and conditions.get("fee_status") == ["INTL"]
                and isinstance(conditions.get("course_id"), list)
                and isinstance(
                    data.get("eligibility_questions"), list
                )
                and bool(data.get("eligibility_questions"))
                and rule.scholarship.level == level
            )

            if not common:
                continue

            if level == "UG":
                suitable = (
                    rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == UG_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and data.get("kind") == "fixed"
                    and Decimal(str(data.get("value"))) == Decimal("2000")
                    and conditions.get("entry_year") == [1]
                    and conditions.get("aru_ug_award_tier") == ["lower"]
                )
            else:
                suitable = (
                    rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == PG_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and data.get("kind") == "fixed_maximum"
                    and Decimal(str(data.get("value"))) == Decimal("4000")
                    and conditions.get("aru_graduate") == [True]
                )

            if suitable:
                matches.append(rule)

        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Expected one verified {level} scholarship rule; "
                f"found {len(matches)}."
            )

        return matches[0]

    def build_plan(self, evidence, evidence_path, lock=False):
        validator = RouteValidator()

        courses = Course.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=COURSE_IDS,
        ).order_by("course_id")

        tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
            course__university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=COURSE_IDS,
            residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("course_id")

        source_rows = TuitionSource.objects.filter(
            tuition__course__university_id="UK003",
            tuition__course_id__in=COURSE_IDS,
            tuition__residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("tuition_id")

        rule_rows = (
            ScholarshipRule.objects
            .filter(scholarship__university_id="UK003")
            .select_related("scholarship")
            .order_by("pk")
        )

        policies = DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            academic_year=YEAR,
            currency="GBP",
        )

        if lock:
            courses = courses.select_for_update()
            tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            source_rows = source_rows.select_for_update()
            rule_rows = rule_rows.select_for_update()
            policies = policies.select_for_update()

        course_map = {row.course_id: row for row in courses}
        tuition_rows = list(tuitions)
        source_map = {
            row.tuition_id: row for row in source_rows
        }
        rules = list(rule_rows)
        policy_rows = list(policies)

        if set(course_map) != COURSE_IDS:
            raise ValueError("One or more replacement courses are missing.")

        ug_rule = self.find_rule(rules, level="UG")
        pg_rule = self.find_rule(rules, level="PG")

        rule_changes = []

        for rule, additions in [
            (ug_rule, {UG_ID}),
            (pg_rule, PG_IDS),
        ]:
            after = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)
            existing_ids = set(after["conditions"]["course_id"])

            after["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                existing_ids | additions
            )

            if after != rule.rules:
                rule_changes.append({
                    "id": rule.pk,
                    "name": rule.scholarship.name,
                    "before": rule.rules,
                    "after": after,
                })

        if len(policy_rows) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Expected one saved 2027/28 GBP deposit policy."
            )

        policy = policy_rows[0]
        deposit_after = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

        if (
            not policy.verified
            or not isinstance(deposit_after, dict)
            or deposit_after.get("kind") != "fixed"
            or Decimal(str(deposit_after.get("amount"))) != Decimal("4000")
            or deposit_after.get("academic_year") != YEAR
            or deposit_after.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
            or deposit_after.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
            or deposit_after.get("requires_student_visa") is not True
            or deposit_after.get("full_fee_paying") is not True
            or deposit_after.get(
                "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit"
            ) is not False
            or not isinstance(deposit_after.get("course_ids"), list)
            or not deposit_after.get("eligibility_questions")
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Saved deposit policy does not match the reviewed rule."
            )

        deposit_after["course_ids"] = sorted(
            set(deposit_after["course_ids"]) | COURSE_IDS
        )

        kinds = deposit_after.get("course_kinds")

        if not isinstance(kinds, list):
            raise ValueError("Deposit course-kind definitions are invalid.")

        deposit_after["course_kinds"] = sorted(
            set(kinds)
            | {"undergraduate_taught", "postgraduate_taught"}
        )

        course_changes = []

        for course_id in sorted(COURSE_IDS):
            target = TARGETS[course_id]

            page, _, _ = validator.load_page(
                evidence,
                evidence_path,
                course_id,
                target,
            )
            validator.validate_schema(page, target)

            proposal = validator.make_proposal(
                evidence,
                evidence_path,
                course_id,
                target,
            )

            if proposal["course_changes"]:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: apply the reviewed replacement first."
                )

            matches = [
                row for row in tuition_rows
                if row.course_id == course_id
            ]

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: one international tuition is required."
                )

            tuition = matches[0]
            source = source_map.get(tuition.pk)

            if source is None or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: source metadata is missing."
                )

            raw = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)

            if (
                tuition.currency != "GBP"
                or source.academic_year != YEAR
                or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                or raw.get("verified") is not True
                or raw.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or raw.get("source_fee_category") != "International"
                or raw.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or source.source_url.rstrip("/")
                != proposal["evidence"]["source_url"].rstrip("/")
                or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                != Decimal(target["fee"])
                or Decimal(str(raw.get("annual_tuition")))
                != Decimal(target["fee"])
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: verified tuition requires review."
                )

            undergraduate = course_id == UG_ID
            selected_rule = ug_rule if undergraduate else pg_rule

            previous_review = raw.get("scholarship_review")
            if not isinstance(previous_review, dict):
                previous_review = {}

            previous_deposit = raw.get("deposit_review")
            if not isinstance(previous_deposit, dict):
                previous_deposit = {}

            scholarship_status = (
                "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                if undergraduate
                else "verified_maximum_rule_eligibility_required"
            )

            raw.update({
                "scholarship_status": scholarship_status,
                "scholarship_review": {
                    **previous_review,
                    "status": scholarship_status,
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": selected_rule.source_url,
                    "note": (
                        "Lower first-year undergraduate award: £2,000 "
                        "for the reviewed Writtle route, subject to "
                        "the saved eligibility conditions."
                        if undergraduate
                        else (
                            "International postgraduate scholarship: "
                            "up to £4,000 for eligible ARU graduates. "
                            "The maximum is an estimate; ARU confirms "
                            "the applicant's actual award."
                        )
                    ),
                    "eligibility_questions": merge_questions(
                        selected_rule.rules.get(
                            "eligibility_questions", []
                        ),
                        previous_review.get(
                            "eligibility_questions", []
                        ),
                    ),
                },
                "deposit_status": "verified_policy_eligibility_required",
                "deposit_review": {
                    **previous_deposit,
                    "status": "verified_policy_eligibility_required",
                    "policy_academic_year": YEAR,
                    "source_url": policy.source_url,
                    "note": (
                        "Saved £4,000 pre-CAS deposit policy scoped "
                        "to this reviewed route. Visa, full-fee-paying "
                        "and sponsorship conditions still apply. "
                        "Confirm the individual offer."
                    ),
                    "eligibility_questions": merge_questions(
                        deposit_after["eligibility_questions"],
                        previous_deposit.get(
                            "eligibility_questions", []
                        ),
                    ),
                },
            })

            if raw != source.raw_fees:
                course_changes.append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "tuition_id": tuition.pk,
                    "source_id": source.pk,
                    "before": source.raw_fees,
                    "after": raw,
                })

        return {
            "rule_changes": rule_changes,
            "deposit_policy_id": policy.pk,
            "deposit_before": policy.rules,
            "deposit_after": deposit_after,
            "course_changes": course_changes,
            "ug_scope": len(
                set(ug_rule.rules["conditions"]["course_id"]) | {UG_ID}
            ),
            "pg_scope": len(
                set(pg_rule.rules["conditions"]["course_id"]) | PG_IDS
            ),
            "deposit_scope": len(deposit_after["course_ids"]),
        }

    def save_plan(self, plan):
        for change in plan["rule_changes"]:
            rule = ScholarshipRule.objects.get(pk=change["id"])
            rule.rules = change["after"]
            rule.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
            rule.save(update_fields=["rules", "reviewed_at"])

        if plan["deposit_before"] != plan["deposit_after"]:
            policy = DepositPolicy.objects.get(
                pk=plan["deposit_policy_id"]
            )
            policy.rules = plan["deposit_after"]
            policy.save(update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"])

        for change in plan["course_changes"]:
            source = TuitionSource.objects.get(
                pk=change["source_id"]
            )
            source.raw_fees = change["after"]
            source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

            TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                tuition_id=change["tuition_id"],
                course_identifier=change["course_id"],
                residency="INTL",
                before={"raw_fees": change["before"]},
                after={"raw_fees": change["after"]},
            )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        validator = RouteValidator()
        evidence_path = validator.find_evidence(options["evidence"])

        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / (
                "land-engineering-awards-"
                + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            )
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"

        try:
            evidence = validator.read_report(evidence_path)

            if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003":
                raise ValueError("Evidence is not for ARU UK003.")

            sources = self.fetch_policies()

            with transaction.atomic():
                if options["apply"]:
                    University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                        pk="UK003"
                    )

                plan = self.build_plan(
                    evidence,
                    evidence_path,
                    lock=options["apply"],
                )

                report = {
                    "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                    "university_id": "UK003",
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]
                        else "preview"
                    ),
                    "database_changes": False,
                    "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
                    "policy_sources": sources,
                    "plan": plan,
                }

                output.write_text(
                    json.dumps(
                        report,
                        cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                        indent=2,
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    ),
                    encoding="utf-8",
                )

                if options["apply"]:
                    self.save_plan(plan)

        except (
            requests.RequestException,
            OSError,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
            ArithmeticError,
            KeyError,
            University.DoesNotExist,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Reconciliation stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        count = (
            len(plan["rule_changes"])
            + len(plan["course_changes"])
            + int(
                plan["deposit_before"] != plan["deposit_after"]
            )
        )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = count > 0

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Lower UG scholarship scope: {plan['ug_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"ARU-graduate PG scholarship scope: "
            f"{plan['pg_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"£4,000 deposit scope: {plan['deposit_scope']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed/updated items: {count}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Scholarship scopes, deposit scope and course "
                "review metadata saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Eligibility questions preserved. Gross tuition, "
            "replacement history, stored scholarship amounts and "
            "numeric deposit fields unchanged. The comparison "
            "calculates applicable scholarship deductions."
        )

LONDON_IDS = {
    "C_UK003_19",
    "C_UK003_24",
    "C_UK003_29",
    "C_UK003_96",
}

PUBLIC_HEALTH = "C_UK003_26"
RESEARCH = "C_ARU003_RES_07"
ALL_IDS = LONDON_IDS | {PUBLIC_HEALTH, RESEARCH}

SCHOLARSHIP_URL = (
    "https://london.aru.ac.uk/admissions/scholarships"
)

QUESTIONS = [
    {
        "key": "aru_london_alumni",
        "type": "boolean",
        "label": "Did you complete a degree at ARU London?",
        "required": True,

    {
