class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile London/research award review metadata and "
        "extend the existing deposit policy to four London courses."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save the validated reconciliation.",
        )

    def collect_policy(self, folder):
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "UniversityTuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
            )

            self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {SCHOLARSHIP_URL}")
            response = session.get(
                SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                timeout=(30, 60),
            )
            response.raise_for_status()

        if (
            response.url.rstrip("/")
            != SCHOLARSHIP_URL.rstrip("/")
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected policy redirect: {response.url}"
            )

        soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")
        for element in soup(["script", "style"]):
            element.decompose()

        text = " ".join(
            soup.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
        )
        lower = text.casefold()

        start = lower.find("masters scholarship programme")
        end = lower.find("aru alumni scholarship", start)

        if start < 0 or end <= start:
            raise CommandError(
                "Cannot isolate the Master's Scholarship policy."
            )

        masters_section = lower[start:end]

        if (
            "50%" not in masters_section
            or (
                "this scholarship is not available "
                "for international students."
            ) not in masters_section
            or "£2,000" not in text
            or "£1,000" not in text
            or "first class honours degree" not in lower
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Scholarship policy changed; manual review required."
            )

        (folder / "london-scholarships.html").write_bytes(
            response.content
        )

        return {
            "source_url": response.url,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                response.content
            ).hexdigest(),
        }

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / (
                "london-research-awards-"
                + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            )
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        try:
            policy_evidence = self.collect_policy(folder)
        except requests.RequestException as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Policy collection failed: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "policy_evidence": policy_evidence,

            "deposit_policy": None,

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course

                    Course.objects.select_for_update()

                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=ALL_IDS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }

            if set(courses) != ALL_IDS:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected all six active reviewed courses."
                )

                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    course_id__in=ALL_IDS,
                    residency="INTL",

            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in by_course:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                by_course[tuition.course_id] = tuition

                set(by_course) != ALL_IDS
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)

                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."

                source.tuition_id: source

            # This batch must not inherit an unrelated main-campus
            # scholarship merely because it uses the same university ID.

                ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()

                    scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                    verified=True,

            )

            for rule in rules:
                data = rule.rules
                if not isinstance(data, dict):
                    raise CommandError(

                scope = (
                    conditions.get("course_id", [])
                    if isinstance(conditions, dict)

                if not isinstance(scope, list):

                        "A verified ARU award scope requires review."
                    )

                if set(scope) & ALL_IDS:

                    )

            for course_id in sorted(ALL_IDS):
                tuition = by_course[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)
                course = courses[course_id]

                if source is None or not isinstance(
                    source.raw_fees, dict
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: source metadata is required."
                    )

                raw = source.raw_fees

                if course_id in LONDON_IDS:
                    if (
                        course.location != "ARU London"
                        or source.academic_year != "2027/28"
                        or raw.get("verified") is not True
                        or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                        != Decimal("20925.00")
                    ):

                            "London fee import first."
                        )

                    deposit = raw.get(
                        "published_deposit_evidence", {}
                    )
                    if (
                        deposit.get("amount") != "4000.00"

                    or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal("17500.00")
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Apply the reviewed Education MPhil fee first."
                    )

                before = copy.deepcopy(raw)

                if course_id == RESEARCH:

                    )
                    after["deposit_status"] = (

            course_kinds = new.get("course_kinds")

        )

            f"Deposit scope: {len(new['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {report['proposed_items']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Award review metadata and deposit scope saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(

        )

def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {
        key: copy.deepcopy(getattr(obj, key))
        for key in fields
    }


def business_snapshot(value):
    """Ignore refreshed source hashes when checking substantive changes."""
    value = copy.deepcopy(value)
    source = value.get("source")
    if isinstance(source, dict):
        raw = source.get("raw_fees")
        if isinstance(raw, dict):
            raw.pop("source_sha256", None)
            raw.pop("source_checked_at", None)
    return value


class Command(SourceInspector):
    help = (
        "Reconcile ARU Nursing, two MBA fees and the "
        "Life Sciences international-applicant restriction."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs" / "aru" / f"nursing-mba-review-{stamp}"
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "sources": {},
            "records": [],
            "scope_changes": [],
            "blocked": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
                )

                for row in BATCH:
                    url = BASE + row["path"]
                    response, soup = self.get_page(session, url)

                    if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                        )

                    report["sources"][row["id"]] = self.evidence(
                        response, soup
                    )
                    (folder / f"{row['id']}.html").write_bytes(
                        response.content
                    )

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            report["error"] = str(exc)
            save_report()
            raise CommandError(
                f"Collection stopped: {exc}. "
                f"No changes applied. Report: {output}"
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            pending = []

            for row in BATCH:
                course_id = row["id"]

                    body = page["text"].split(

                    set(conditions["course_id"]) | set(additions)

                    "name": name,

                    "before": old,

            new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)

                    after = record["after"]

                            setattr(course, key, value)
                            fields.append(key)

            self.stdout.write(

                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

            + sum(r["changed"] for r in report["scope_changes"])
            + int(old_policy != new_policy)
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nDeposit scope: {len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed/updated items: {changes}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed fees, restriction and rule scopes saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

from decimal import Decimal

def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))

    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")

    return format(amount.quantize(Decimal("0.01")), ".2f")


class Command(PolicyTools):
    """
    Reuse only the existing source collection, verification,
    reporting and update helpers.

    This class supplies its own Politics preparation and handler.
    """

    help = (
        "Reconcile 2027/28 scholarship and deposit applicability "
        "for Politics and International Relations."
    )

    def prepare_politics(self):
        updates = []

        course = Course.objects.select_for_update().get(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id=COURSE_ID,
        )

        expected_course = {
            "title": "BA (Hons) Politics and International Relations",
            "level": "UG",
            "location": "Cambridge Campus",
            "duration": "3 Years",
            "start_month": "September",
            "start_year": 2027,
            "ucas_cao_code": "L203",
        }

        for field, expected in expected_course.items():
            if getattr(course, field) != expected:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Unexpected saved course field: {field}. "
                    "Apply the reviewed replacement first."
                )

        if course.course_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL:
            raise CommandError("Unexpected saved course URL.")

        rows = list(
            Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
        )

        if len(rows) != 1 or rows[0].currency != "GBP":
            raise CommandError(
                "Expected one GBP international tuition."
            )

        tuition = rows[0]

        source = TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update().get(
            tuition=tuition
        )

        raw = deepcopy(source.raw_fees)

        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise CommandError("Invalid tuition source metadata.")

        if (
            source.academic_year != "2027/28"
            or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
            or source.source_url.rstrip("/") != COURSE_URL
            or raw.get("verified") is not True
            or raw.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
            or raw.get("course_kind") != "undergraduate_taught"
            or money(raw.get("annual_tuition")) != "18825.00"
            or money(tuition.tuition_fee) != "18825.00"
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "The saved verified tuition does not match "
                "the reviewed 2027/28 replacement."
            )

        rules = list(
            ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                verified=True,
            )
        )

        summary = {}
        scholarship_questions = None

        for tier, award in [
            ("lower", "2000.00"),
            ("higher", "4000.00"),
        ]:
            matches = []

            for rule in rules:
                data = rule.rules

                if not isinstance(data, dict):
                    continue

                conditions = data.get("conditions", {})

                if not isinstance(conditions, dict):
                    continue

                if (
                    rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == UG_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and data.get("academic_year") == "2027/28"
                    and data.get("kind") == "fixed"
                    and data.get("currency") == "GBP"
                    and money(data.get("value")) == award
                    and conditions.get("aru_ug_award_tier")
                    == [tier]
                ):
                    matches.append(rule)

            if len(matches) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Expected one verified {tier} UG rule "
                    "for 2027/28."
                )

            rule = matches[0]
            data = deepcopy(rule.rules)
            conditions = data["conditions"]

            required_conditions = {
                "fee_status": ["INTL"],
                "new_entrant": [True],
                "full_time": [True],
                "entry_year": [1],
                "apcl": [False],
                "registration_conditions_met": [True],
                "aru_funding_eligibility_confirmed": [True],
                "aru_ug_award_confirmed": [True],
            }

            for key, expected in required_conditions.items():
                if conditions.get(key) != expected:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{tier} rule: unexpected condition {key}."
                    )

            if (
                data.get("stacking") != "exclusive"
                or data.get("study_years") != [1]
                or data.get("fee_basis_confirmed") is not True
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} rule: award scope requires review."
                )

            questions = data.get("eligibility_questions")

            if not isinstance(questions, list) or not questions:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} rule has no saved eligibility questions."
                )

            scope = conditions.get("course_id")

            if not isinstance(scope, list) or not all(
                isinstance(value, str) for value in scope
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{tier} rule has an invalid course scope."
                )

            if COURSE_ID not in scope:
                conditions["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(scope) | {COURSE_ID}
                )

            self.add_update(
                updates,
                "ScholarshipRule",
                rule,
                {"rules": data},
            )

            summary[f"{tier}_ug_scope"] = len(
                conditions["course_id"]
            )

            if tier == "lower":
                scholarship_questions = deepcopy(questions)

        policy = DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().get(
            university_id="UK003",
            academic_year="2027/28",
            currency="GBP",
            verified=True,
        )

        deposit_rules = deepcopy(policy.rules)

        if not isinstance(deposit_rules, dict):
            raise CommandError("Invalid deposit policy.")

        if (
            policy.source_url.rstrip("/")
            != DEPOSIT_URL.rstrip("/")
            or deposit_rules.get("kind") != "fixed"
            or deposit_rules.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
            or deposit_rules.get("currency") != "GBP"
            or money(deposit_rules.get("amount")) != "4000.00"
            or deposit_rules.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
            or deposit_rules.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
            or deposit_rules.get("requires_student_visa") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get("full_fee_paying") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit"
            ) is not False
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "sponsorship_letter_requires_review"
            ) is not True
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "offer_letter_confirmation_required"
            ) is not True
            or "undergraduate_taught"
            not in deposit_rules.get("course_kinds", [])
        ):
            raise CommandError(

def build_rule(course_ids, graduate_required):
    conditions = {
        "course_id": course_ids,
        "fee_status": ["INTL"],
        "aru_pg_entry_requirements_exceeded": [True],
        "registration_conditions_met": [True],
        "aru_funding_eligibility_confirmed": [True],
        "aru_pg_eligibility_confirmed": [True],
    }

    questions = copy.deepcopy(COMMON_QUESTIONS)

    if graduate_required:
        conditions["aru_graduate"] = [True]
        questions.insert(0, {
            "key": "aru_graduate",
            "question": "Are you an ARU graduate?",
            "type": "boolean",
        })

    return {
        "kind": "fixed_maximum",
        "value": "4000.00",
        "currency": "GBP",
        "benefit": "tuition",
        "academic_year": YEAR,
        "study_years": [1],
        "award_status": "conditional",
        "stacking": "exclusive",
        "compatible_ids": [],
        "percentage_basis": "original_tuition",
        "fee_basis_confirmed": True,
        "conditions": conditions,
        "eligibility_questions": questions,
        "scope_note": (
            "Reviewed September 2027 standard campus courses only. "
            "First compared study year. This models the published "
            "maximum, not a confirmed individual award."
        ),
        "combination_note": (
            "No other scholarship is combined automatically. "
            "Payment discounts require separate verification."
        ),
        "source_period_note": (
            "The current scholarship page does not specify an "
            "academic year. Associated with the reviewed 2027/28 "
            "cohort and subject to rechecking before enrolment."
        ),
    }


class Command(SourceInspector):
    help = (
        "Reconcile scholarship applicability and extend the "
        "saved ARU deposit policy to 15 reviewed PG courses."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = root / "logs" / "aru" / f"pg-awards-{stamp}"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "academic_year": YEAR,
            "course_ids": IDS,
            "sources": {},
            "proposals": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
                )

                for name, url in [
                    ("scholarship", SCHOLARSHIP_URL),
                    ("deposit", DEPOSIT_URL),
                ]:
                    response, soup = self.get_page(session, url)

                    if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                        )

                    report["sources"][name] = self.evidence(
                        response, soup
                    )
                    (folder / f"{name}.html").write_bytes(
                        response.content
                    )

            scholarship_text = (
                report["sources"]["scholarship"]["text"].casefold()
            )
            deposit_text = report["sources"]["deposit"]["text"]

            for phrase in [
                "up to £4,000",
                "depending on qualifications",
                "be studying for an mba or be an aru graduate",
                "exceeding the minimum entry requirements",
                "all conditions of registration",
                "federal tuition fee loans",
            ]:
                if phrase not in scholarship_text:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Scholarship source needs review: {phrase}"
                    )

            if (
                "deposit for undergraduate and postgraduate "
                "taught courses is £4,000"
            ) not in deposit_text.casefold():
                raise ValueError(
                    "The published deposit amount needs review."
                )

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            report["error"] = str(exc)
            save_report()
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                f"No changes applied. Report: {output}"
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                university_id="UK003"
            )

            tuitions = {}
            sources = {}

            # Require the reviewed tuition import to be applied first.
            for row in BATCH:
                suffix, slug, title, heading, campus, fee = row
                course_id = f"C_UK003_{suffix}"

                try:
                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university=university,
                            title=title,
                            is_active=True,
                            start_month="September",
                            start_year=2027,
                            level__in=["PG", "PGT"],
                        )
                    )
                except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: apply the reviewed PG "

                    ) from exc

                rows = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if (
                    len(rows) != 1
                    or rows[0].currency != "GBP"
                    or Decimal(str(rows[0].tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(fee)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: reviewed GBP tuition "
                        "does not match."
                    )

                tuition = rows[0]
                source = (

                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                if (
                    source is None

                    or source.fee_basis != "annual_tuition"
                    or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    or source.raw_fees.get("verified") is not True
                    or source.raw_fees.get("course_kind")
                    != "postgraduate_taught"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: verified PG tuition "
                        "source is required."
                    )

                tuitions[course_id] = tuition
                sources[course_id] = source

            policy = (
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    university=university,
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                )
                .first()
            )

            if policy is None:
                raise CommandError(

                )

            old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

            if (
                not isinstance(old_policy, dict)
                or old_policy.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old_policy.get("amount") != "4000.00"
                or old_policy.get("schema_version") != 1
                or old_policy.get("academic_year") != YEAR

                            level="PG",

                        )

                    ScholarshipRule.objects.update_or_create(

RESEARCH_ID = "C_ARU003_RES_04"
DISTANCE_ID = "C_UK003_52"

RULE_NAMES = [
    (
        "ARU International Undergraduate Scholarship "
        "— Lower — Year 1 (2027/28)"
    ),
    (
        "ARU International Undergraduate Scholarship "
        "— Higher — Year 1 (2027/28)"
    ),
]


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile saved award/deposit scopes for the "
        "Psychology and distance-learning batch."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        path = Path(options["evidence"])
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / path

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(evidence, dict)
            or evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or evidence.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(evidence.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid course evidence.")

        validator = RouteValidator()
        try:
            page = validator.validate_page(
                path.parent,
                evidence["pages"],
                TARGETS[UG_ID],
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Undergraduate evidence validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            "deposit of £4,000 or a sponsorship letter"
            not in page.get("text", "")
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Undergraduate Psychology deposit evidence missing."
            )

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / (
            "psychology-distance-awards-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "courses": [],
            "scholarship_rules": [],
            "deposit_policy": None,
        }

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }

            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected all three active reviewed courses."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(course_id__in=TARGETS, residency="INTL")
                .order_by("pk")
            )
            tuition_map = {}

            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if (
                set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS)
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            source_plans = []

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                course = courses[course_id]
                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)

                expected_url = (
                    "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/" + target["slug"]
                )

                if (
                    course.title != target["title"]
                    or course.level != target["level"]
                    or course.location != target["location"]
                    or course.start_month != target["month"]
                    or course.start_year != 2027
                    or source is None
                    or source.source_url.rstrip("/") != expected_url
                    or source.academic_year != target["academic_year"]
                    or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: apply the reviewed route "
                        "and fee import first."
                    )

                verified = target["amount"] is not None
                if source.raw_fees.get("verified") is not verified:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unexpected fee verification status."
                    )

                if verified and (
                    Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(target["amount"])
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: unexpected stored tuition."
                    )

                before = {
                    "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                    "scholarship": (
                        f"{Decimal(str(tuition.scholarship)):.2f}"
                    ),
                    "scholarship_source_id": (
                        tuition.scholarship_source_id
                    ),
                }
                after = copy.deepcopy(before)
                raw = after["raw_fees"]

                if course_id == UG_ID:
                    raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                        "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                    )
                    raw["deposit_status"] = (
                        "verified_policy_eligibility_required"
                    )
                    raw["award_review_note"] = (
                        "Saved first-year undergraduate lower/higher "
                        "rules apply conditionally. ARU must confirm "
                        "the award tier and individual eligibility."
                    )
                    raw["published_deposit_evidence"] = {
                        "amount": "4000.00",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "alternative": "sponsorship_letter",
                        "source_url": page["source_url"],
                        "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                    }

                elif course_id == RESEARCH_ID:
                    raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                        "research_applicability_unconfirmed"
                    )
                    raw["deposit_status"] = (
                        "research_deposit_unconfirmed"
                    )
                    raw["award_review_note"] = (
                        "No applicable MPhil Psychology scholarship "
                        "or research deposit amount has been verified "
                        "for January 2027. Confirm with ARU."
                    )

                else:
                    raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                        "distance_learning_applicability_unconfirmed"
                    )
                    raw["deposit_status"] = (
                        "campus_pre_cas_policy_not_applicable"
                    )
                    raw["award_review_note"] = (
                        "Distance-learning scholarship applicability "
                        "remains unconfirmed. The campus pre-CAS "
                        "deposit rule does not apply; any separate "
                        "online-course payment terms require confirmation."
                    )

                # The comparison should use reviewed eligibility
                # rules rather than an unverified legacy deduction.
                after["scholarship"] = "0.00"
                after["scholarship_source_id"] = None

                changed = before != after
                source_plans.append(
                    (source, tuition, after, changed)
                )
                report["courses"].append({
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

            rule_plans = []

            for name in RULE_NAMES:
                matches = list(
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                        scholarship__name=name,
                        verified=True,
                    )
                )
                if len(matches) != 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Expected one verified rule: {name}"
                    )

                rule = matches[0]
                old = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)

                if (
                    not isinstance(old, dict)
                    or old.get("academic_year") != "2027/28"
                    or old.get("kind") != "fixed"
                    or old.get("study_years") != [1]
                    or not isinstance(old.get("conditions"), dict)
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unsupported saved rule: {name}"
                    )

                scope = old["conditions"].get("course_id")
                if (
                    not isinstance(scope, list)
                    or not all(isinstance(v, str) for v in scope)
                    or set(scope) & {RESEARCH_ID, DISTANCE_ID}
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Unexpected course scope: {name}"
                    )

                new = copy.deepcopy(old)
                new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                    set(scope) | {UG_ID}
                )
                rule_plans.append((rule, new, old != new))
                report["scholarship_rules"].append({
                    "name": name,
                    "changed": old != new,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })

            policies = list(
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year="2027/28",
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                )
            )
            if len(policies) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected one verified ARU deposit policy."
                )

            policy = policies[0]
            old = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

            if (
                not isinstance(old, dict)
                or old.get("schema_version") != 1
                or old.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old.get("currency") != "GBP"
                or old.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
                or old.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
                or not isinstance(old.get("course_ids"), list)
                or not all(
                    isinstance(v, str) for v in old["course_ids"]
                )
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Saved deposit policy requires review."
                )

            try:
                amount = Decimal(str(old["amount"]))
                if not amount.is_finite() or amount != Decimal("4000"):
                    raise ValueError
            except Exception as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected the saved GBP 4,000 deposit."
                ) from exc

            if set(old["course_ids"]) & {RESEARCH_ID, DISTANCE_ID}:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Research or distance-learning course is "
                    "already in the campus deposit scope; review required."
                )

            new = copy.deepcopy(old)
            new["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(old["course_ids"]) | {UG_ID}
            )

            source_urls = new.setdefault("course_source_urls", {})
            if not isinstance(source_urls, dict):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Deposit source map requires review."
                )
            source_urls[UG_ID] = page["source_url"]

            policy_changed = old != new
            report["deposit_policy"] = {
                "changed": policy_changed,
                "before": old,
                "after": new,
            }
            report["proposed_items"] = (
                sum(plan[3] for plan in source_plans)
                + sum(plan[2] for plan in rule_plans)
                + int(policy_changed)
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                for source, tuition, after, changed in source_plans:
                    if not changed:
                        continue

                    source.raw_fees = after["raw_fees"]
                    source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

                    tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                    tuition.scholarship_source_id = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "scholarship",
                        "scholarship_source",
                    ])

                    entry = next(
                        item
                        for item in report["courses"]
                        if item["course_id"] == tuition.course_id
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=tuition.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                for rule, rules, changed in rule_plans:
                    if changed:
                        rule.rules = rules
                        rule.save(update_fields=["rules"])

                if policy_changed:
                    policy.rules = new
                    policy.save(
                        update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"]
                    )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_items"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["scholarship_rules"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['name']}: "
                f"{len(entry['after']['conditions']['course_id'])} "
                f"courses — {state}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Deposit scope: {len(new['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "MPhil Psychology: scholarship and deposit pending."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Distance-learning MSc: scholarship pending; "
            "campus pre-CAS policy not applicable."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {report['proposed_items']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Eligibility questions preserved. Gross tuition "
            "and numeric stored deposits unchanged."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Award/deposit reconciliation saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

    Course,

    TuitionUpdateAudit,
)


TARGETS = {
    "C_UK003_31": {
        "old_title": "BSc (Hons) Psychology with Clinical Psychology",
        "title": "BSc (Hons) Psychology with Clinical Applications",
        "slug": "undergraduate/psychology-with-clinical-applications",
        "kind": "ug",
        "level": "UG",
        "duration": "3 Years",

FIELDS = [
    "title",
    "level",
    "duration",
    "location",
    "start_month",
    "start_year",
    "intake_months",
    "course_url",
    "ucas_cao_code",
    "work_placement",
]


def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))
    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")
    return f"{amount:.2f}"


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile two Psychology routes and a distance-learning "
        "route. Defaults to preview."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacement",
            action="store_true",
            help="Accept the explicit research MSc-to-MPhil replacement.",
        )

    def validate_page(self, folder, pages, target):
        url = "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/" + target["slug"]
        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") == url
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Expected one source capture: {url}"
            )

        page = matches[0]
        filename = page.get("html_file")
        if (
            not isinstance(filename, str)
            or Path(filename).name != filename
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid HTML evidence filename.")

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            (folder / filename).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()
        if digest != page.get("sha256"):
            raise CommandError("Saved HTML hash mismatch.")

        text = " ".join(page.get("text", "").split())

        if target["kind"] == "ug":
            # This exact standard-route overview supplies the
            # September intake. JSON-LD lists January only;
            # that omission is retained in the audit metadata.
            overview = re.search(
                r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+Start date\s+(.*?)\s+"
                r"Location\s+Cambridge\s+UCAS course code\s+"
                r"C842\s+Duration\s+3 years(?=\s|$)",
                text,
            )
            if (
                overview is None
                or "September 2027" not in overview.group(1)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Standard Cambridge September Psychology "
                    "route not confirmed in the overview."
                )

            section = re.search(
                r"International students\s+BSc \(Hons\).*?"
                r"BSc \(Hons\)\s+(.*?)"
                r"(?=\s+With placement\b)",
                text,
                flags=re.S,
            )
            if section is None:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Standard Psychology fee section not found."
                )

            amounts = {
                money(value.replace(",", ""))
                for value in re.findall(
                    r"£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                    r"International students starting 2027/28\s+"
                    r"\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                    section.group(1),
                )
            }
            if amounts != {"19750.00"}:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Unexpected Psychology fee: {sorted(amounts)}"
                )

        elif target["kind"] == "research":
            required = [
                "Psychology MPhil, PhD",
                "Cambridge",
                "January 2027",
                "MPhil: full-time 1-3 years",
            ]
            if not all(value in text for value in required):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Research award, campus, intake or duration "
                    "was not confirmed."
                )

            amounts = {
                money(value.replace(",", ""))
                for value in re.findall(
                    r"International students,\s*2026/27\s*"
                    r"\(per year\)\s*£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                    text,
                )
            }
            if amounts != {"17500.00"}:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected GBP 17,500 annual research fee."
                )

        else:
            overview = re.search(
                r"MSc\s+Start date\s+(.*?)\s+"
                r"Location\s+Distance learning\s+"
                r"Award\s+MSc\s+Duration\s+1 year full-time",
                text,
            )
            if (
                overview is None
                or "September 2027" not in overview.group(1)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "One-year September distance-learning "
                    "route not confirmed."
                )

            amounts = {
                money(value.replace(",", ""))
                for value in re.findall(
                    r"£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)\s+"
                    r"Distance learning students starting "
                    r"2027/28\s+\(total cost\)",
                    text,
                )
            }
            if amounts != {"9450.00"}:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected the published GBP 9,450 "
                    "distance-learning total."
                )

            if re.search(
                r"£[\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?\s+"
                r"International students starting",
                text,
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "An explicitly international fee is present; "
                    "review before retaining unavailable status."
                )

        return page

    def plan(self, course, tuition, source, page, target):
        allowed_levels = (
            {"MRES", "PG"}
            if target["kind"] == "research"
            else {target["level"]}
        )
        allowed_locations = (
            {"Chelmsford Campus", "Distance learning"}
            if target["kind"] == "distance"
            else {"Cambridge Campus"}
        )

        if (
            course.title
            not in {target["old_title"], target["title"]}
            or course.level not in allowed_levels
            or course.location not in allowed_locations
            or course.work_placement
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                f"{course.course_id}: unexpected stored route."
            )

        if target["kind"] != "research":
            if course.duration != target["duration"]:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{course.course_id}: unexpected duration."
                )

        before = {
            "course": {
                field: getattr(course, field)
                for field in FIELDS
            },
            "tuition": {
                "tuition_fee": money(tuition.tuition_fee),
                "currency": tuition.currency,
            },
            "source": (
                {
                    "academic_year": source.academic_year,
                    "source_url": source.source_url,
                    "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
                    "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
                    "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
                    "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
                }
                if source
                else None
            ),
        }

        after = copy.deepcopy(before)
        after["course"].update({
            "title": target["title"],
            "level": target["level"],
            "duration": target["duration"],
            "location": target["location"],
            "start_month": target["month"],
            "start_year": 2027,
            "intake_months": target["month"],
            "course_url": page["source_url"],
            "ucas_cao_code": target["code"],
        })

        verified = target["amount"] is not None
        if verified:
            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = target["amount"]

        raw = {
            "verified": verified,
            "academic_year": target["academic_year"],
            "source_fee_category": "International",
            "currency": "GBP",
            "course_source_url": page["source_url"],
            "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
            "study_year": 1,
            "course_kind": (
                "undergraduate"
                if target["kind"] == "ug"
                else "postgraduate_research"
                if target["kind"] == "research"
                else "postgraduate_taught"
            ),
            "study_mode": (
                "distance_learning"
                if target["kind"] == "distance"
                else "full_time_campus"
            ),
            "scholarship_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
            "deposit_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
            "fee_categories": [],
        }

        if verified:
            raw["annual_tuition"] = target["amount"]
            raw["fee_note"] = (
                "Published annual international tuition for "
                f"{target['academic_year']}, "
                f"{target['month']} 2027 intake."
            )
            raw["fee_categories"] = [{
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "academic_year": target["academic_year"],
                "currency": "GBP",
                "annual_tuition": target["amount"],
                "amount_requires_review": False,
            }]

        if target["kind"] == "ug":
            raw["mapping_kind"] = "reviewed_title_correction"
            raw["intake_evidence"] = {
                "selected_intake": "September 2027",
                "basis": "standard_route_course_overview",
                "ucas_code": "C842",
                "campus": "Cambridge",
                "structured_data_note": (
                    "JSON-LD lists January 2027 only. "
                    "The standard-route overview explicitly "
                    "advertises January and September 2027."
                ),
            }

        elif target["kind"] == "research":
            previous_raw = (
                source.raw_fees
                if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                else {}
            )
            raw["mapping_kind"] = "explicit_replacement"
            raw["route_replacement"] = previous_raw.get(
                "route_replacement",
                {
                    "previous_title": target["old_title"],
                    "replacement_title": target["title"],
                    "note": (
                        "Explicit MSc-to-MPhil replacement; "
                        "not claimed to be a university-confirmed rename."
                    ),
                },
            )
            raw["duration_note"] = (
                "Published full-time MPhil completion range: "
                "one to three years."
            )

        else:
            raw.update({
                "mapping_kind": "distance_learning_correction",
                "published_fee_evidence": {
                    "amount": "9450.00",
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "academic_year": "2027/28",
                    "category": "Distance learning",
                    "basis": "total_course_fee",
                    "international_applicability_confirmed": False,
                },
                "verification_reason": (
                    "A GBP 9,450 total distance-learning course "
                    "fee is published for 2027/28, but its "
                    "applicability to international students "
                    "has not been confirmed. The stored numeric "
                    "tuition is not verified."
                ),
                "deposit_status": (
                    "campus_pre_cas_policy_not_applicable"
                ),
                "deposit_note": (
                    "This is distance learning. Do not apply "
                    "the campus pre-CAS deposit policy. "
                    "Any online-course payment requirements "
                    "must be confirmed separately."
                ),
            })
            raw["fee_note"] = raw["verification_reason"]

        after["source"] = {
            "academic_year": target["academic_year"],
            "source_url": page["source_url"],
            "source_course_code": target["code"],
            "source_course_name": target["title"],
            "fee_basis": (
                "annual_tuition" if verified else "unavailable"
            ),
            "raw_fees": raw,
        }

        return {
            "course_id": course.course_id,
            "changed": before != after,
            "before": before,
            "after": after,
        }

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        path = Path(options["evidence"])
        if not path.is_absolute():
            path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / path

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(evidence, dict)
            or evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or evidence.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(evidence.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid course evidence.")

        try:
            pages = {
                course_id: self.validate_page(
                    path.parent,
                    evidence["pages"],
                    target,
                )
                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
            }
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Evidence validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / (
            "psychology-distance-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "records": [],
        }

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }
            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected all three active course records."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(course_id__in=TARGETS, residency="INTL")
                .order_by("pk")
            )
            tuition_map = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if (
                set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS)
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                duplicates = list(
                    Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        is_active=True,
                        title=target["title"],
                        location=target["location"],
                    )
                    .exclude(course_id=course_id)
                    .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
                )
                if duplicates:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: possible duplicate route: "
                        + ", ".join(duplicates)
                    )

                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                source = sources.get(tuition.pk)

                if (
                    target["kind"] == "distance"
                    and source
                    and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    and source.raw_fees.get("verified") is True
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Distance-learning course already has "
                        "verified fee metadata; review before replacing it."
                    )

                report["records"].append(
                    self.plan(
                        courses[course_id],
                        tuition,
                        source,
                        pages[course_id],
                        target,
                    )
                )

            report["proposed_changes"] = sum(
                entry["changed"] for entry in report["records"]
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            replacement_needed = (
                courses["C_ARU003_RES_04"].title
                != TARGETS["C_ARU003_RES_04"]["title"]
            )
            if (
                options["apply"]
                and replacement_needed
                and not options["accept_replacement"]
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Review the explicit MPhil replacement, then "
                    "use --apply --accept-replacement. "
                    "No database records changed."
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for entry in report["records"]:
                    if not entry["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course_id = entry["course_id"]
                    course = courses[course_id]
                    tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                    after = entry["after"]

                    for field, value in after["course"].items():
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=FIELDS + ["updated_at"]
                    )

                    if TARGETS[course_id]["amount"] is not None:
                        tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(
                            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"]
                        )
                        tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_changes"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["records"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            after = entry["after"]
            verified = after["source"]["raw_fees"]["verified"]

            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['course_id']}: "
                f"{'verified fee' if verified else 'international fee unavailable'}"
                f" — {state}"
            )
            if verified:
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  GBP {after['tuition']['tuition_fee']}; "
                    f"{after['source']['academic_year']}"
                )
            for field, value in after["course"].items():
                previous = entry["before"]["course"][field]
                if previous != value:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {previous} -> {value}"
                    )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed changes: {report['proposed_changes']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed changes saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship rules, stored discounts and deposit "
            "policies unchanged."
        )

def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {
        key: copy.deepcopy(getattr(obj, key))
        for key in fields
    }

                    tuition.scholarship = 0

                    ])

                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                for saved, old, new in pending_rules:
                    if old != new:
                        saved.rules = new
                        saved.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
                        saved.save(update_fields=[
                            "rules", "reviewed_at"
                        ])

                if old_policy != new_policy:
                    policy.rules = new_policy
                    policy.save(update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"])

                report["database_changes"] = (
                    any(r["changed"] for r in report["records"])

def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {

class Command(SourceInspector):
    help = (
        "Reconcile Midwifery and Animation international fees, "
        "Medicine's home-fee restriction and applicable rule scopes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs" / "aru" / f"review-batch-two-{stamp}"
        )
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "sources": {},
            "records": [],
            "scope_changes": [],
            "blocked": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
                )

                for row in BATCH:
                    url = BASE + row["slug"]
                    response, soup = self.get_page(session, url)

                    if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                        )

                    report["sources"][row["id"]] = self.evidence(
                        response, soup
                    )
                    (folder / f"{row['id']}.html").write_bytes(
                        response.content
                    )

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            report["error"] = str(exc)
            save_report()
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source collection stopped: {exc}. "
                f"No changes applied. Report: {output}"
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            pending = []

            for row in BATCH:
                course_id = row["id"]

                try:
                    page = report["sources"][course_id]
                    if page.get("title", "").strip() != row["heading"]:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Published course heading differs."
                        )

                    body = page["text"].split(
                        "End of main navigation."
                    )[-1]

                    if not body.strip().startswith(
                        f"Undergraduate {row['award']}"
                    ):

                            "Published undergraduate award differs."
                        )

                        r"Start date\s+(.*?)\s+Location\s+(.*?)"
                        r"\s+UCAS course code\s+"
                        + re.escape(row["ucas"])
                        + r"\s+Duration\s+"
                        + row["duration"].split()[0]
                        + r"\s+years\b",
                        body,
                    )

                    if (
                        route is None
                        or "September 2027" not in route.group(1)
                        or row["campus"] not in route.group(2).split()
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Standard September 2027 campus "
                            "and UCAS route not confirmed."
                        )

                    restricted = row["fee"] is None

                    if restricted:
                        restriction = (
                            "must have home fee status at the "
                            "point of application"
                        )
                        if restriction not in body.casefold():
                            raise ValueError(
                                "Medicine's home-fee restriction "
                                "needs review."
                            )

                        amount = None
                        note = (
                            "ARU requires home fee status at the "
                            "point of application for MBChB Medicine. "
                            "This course is unavailable for an "
                            "international-fee comparison. "
                            "Fee status is assessed by ARU and "
                            "must not be inferred from nationality "
                            "or residence alone."
                        )
                    else:
                        excerpt = standard_fee_evidence(body)
                        amounts = {
                            Decimal(value.replace(",", ""))
                            for value in re.findall(
                                r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)"
                                r"\s+International students starting"
                                r"\s+2027/28"
                                r"\s+\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                                excerpt,
                            )
                        }

                        amount = Decimal(row["fee"])
                        if amounts != {amount}:
                            raise ValueError(
                                "Published standard-route annual "
                                f"fee differs: {sorted(amounts)}."
                            )

                        note = (
                            "Published annual international tuition "
                            "for the standard three-year September "
                            f"2027 route at {row['campus']}. "
                            "Foundation and placement routes are "
                            "excluded. Living-cost grants and "
                            "bursaries are not automatically "
                            "deducted from tuition."
                        )

                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university_id="UK003",
                        )
                    )

                    if (
                        course.title not in {
                            row["old_title"], row["title"]
                        }
                        or course.level != "UG"
                        or course.duration != row["duration"]
                        or course.location
                        != f"{row['campus']} Campus"
                        or not course.is_active
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Stored course identity needs review."
                        )

                    rows = list(
                        Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                            course=course,
                            residency="INTL",
                        )
                    )
                    if (
                        len(rows) != 1
                        or rows[0].currency != "GBP"
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Exactly one GBP international "
                            "tuition record is required."
                        )

                    tuition = rows[0]
                    source = (
                        TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                        .filter(tuition=tuition).first()
                    )

                    before = {
                        "course": snapshot(course, COURSE_FIELDS),
                        "tuition_fee": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)), ".2f"
                        ),
                        "scholarship": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.scholarship)), ".2f"
                        ),
                        "scholarship_source_id": (
