                        ),
                        "source": snapshot(source, SOURCE_FIELDS),
                    }

                    raw = {
                        "verified": not restricted,
                        "academic_year": "" if restricted else YEAR,
                        "advertised_intake": "September 2027",
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "course_kind": "undergraduate_taught",
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "study_year": 1,
                        "study_mode": "full_time",
                        "campus": row["campus"],
                        "course_source_url": BASE + row["slug"],
                        "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                        "source_checked_at": page.get("checked_at"),
                        "fee_note": note,
                        "unverified_legacy_discount_disabled": True,
                        "scholarship_status": (
                            "not_applicable_to_international_fee_status"
                            if restricted
                            else "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                        ),
                        "deposit_status": (
                            "not_applicable_to_international_fee_status"
                            if restricted
                            else (
                                "verified_current_policy_"
                                "offer_confirmation_required"
                            )
                        ),
                    }

                    if restricted:
                        raw.update({
                            "required_fee_status": "HOME",
                            "verification_reason": note,
                            "fee_categories": [],
                        })
                    else:
                        raw.update({
                            "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                            "fee_method": "reviewed_standard_route_fee",
                            "standard_route_fee_evidence": excerpt,
                            "fee_categories": [{
                                "source_fee_category": "International",
                                "academic_year": YEAR,
                                "currency": "GBP",
                                "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                                "amount_requires_review": False,
                            }],
                        })

                    if row["old_title"] != row["title"]:
                        raw["reviewed_course_corrections"] = {
                            "title": {
                                "before": row["old_title"],
                                "after": row["title"],
                            }
                        }

                    after = {
                        "course": {
                            **before["course"],
                            "title": row["title"],
                            "start_month": "September",
                            "start_year": 2027,
                            "course_url": BASE + row["slug"],
                            "ucas_cao_code": row["ucas"],
                        },
                        "tuition_fee": (
                            before["tuition_fee"]
                            if restricted else str(amount)
                        ),
                        "scholarship": "0.00",
                        "scholarship_source_id": None,
                        "source": {
                            "academic_year": "" if restricted else YEAR,
                            "source_url": BASE + row["slug"],

                except (ValueError, Course.DoesNotExist) as exc:

            if report["blocked"]:

            pending_rules = []

                )
                matches = list(
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                        scholarship__name=name,
                        scholarship__level="UG",

                saved = matches[0]

                    or old.get("kind") != "fixed"
                    or old.get("value") != value
                    or old.get("study_years") != [1]
                    or conditions.get("aru_ug_award_tier")
                    != [tier.lower()]
                    or not isinstance(conditions.get("course_id"), list)
                    or not old.get("eligibility_questions")
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Saved scholarship rule needs review: {name}"
                    )

                new = copy.deepcopy(old)
                new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                    (set(conditions["course_id"]) | set(ELIGIBLE_IDS))
                    - {RESTRICTED_ID}
                )

                report["scope_changes"].append({
                    "name": name,
                    "changed": old != new,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })
                pending_rules.append((saved, old, new))

            policy = (
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                ).first()

            old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules) if policy else None

            if (
                not isinstance(old_policy, dict)
                or old_policy.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old_policy.get("amount") != "4000.00"
                or old_policy.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or not isinstance(old_policy.get("course_ids"), list)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "A valid saved £4,000 ARU deposit policy is required."
                )

            new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)
            new_policy["course_ids"] = sorted(
                (set(old_policy["course_ids"]) | set(ELIGIBLE_IDS))
                - {RESTRICTED_ID}
            )

            report["deposit_scope"] = {
                "changed": old_policy != new_policy,
                "before": old_policy,
                "after": new_policy,
            }

            if options["apply"]:
                for course, tuition, record in pending:
                    if not record["changed"]:
                        continue

                    after = record["after"]
                    fields = []
                    for key, value in after["course"].items():
                        if getattr(course, key) != value:
                            setattr(course, key, value)
                            fields.append(key)

                    if fields:
                        course.save(
                            update_fields=[*fields, "updated_at"]
                        )

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(after["tuition_fee"])
                    tuition.scholarship = 0
                    tuition.scholarship_source = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "tuition_fee", "scholarship", "scholarship_source"
                    ])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                for saved, old, new in pending_rules:
                    if old != new:
                        saved.rules = new
                        saved.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
                        saved.save(update_fields=[
                            "rules", "reviewed_at"
                        ])

                if old_policy != new_policy:
                    policy.rules = new_policy
                    policy.save(update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"])

                report["database_changes"] = (
                    any(r["changed"] for r in report["records"])
                    or any(r["changed"] for r in report["scope_changes"])
                    or old_policy != new_policy
                )

        save_report()

        for record in report["records"]:
            description = (
                "Home fee status required; numeric tuition preserved"
                if record["restricted"]
                else (
                    f"GBP {record['before']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                    f"{record['after']['tuition_fee']}"
                )
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{record['course_id']}: {description} — "
                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )

            old_title = record["before"]["course"]["title"]
            new_title = record["after"]["course"]["title"]
            if old_title != new_title:
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"  title: {old_title} -> {new_title}"
                )

        changes = (
            sum(r["changed"] for r in report["records"])
            + sum(r["changed"] for r in report["scope_changes"])
            + int(old_policy != new_policy)
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nDeposit scope: {len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed/updated items: {changes}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed fees, restriction and rule scopes saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply three reviewed ARU route corrections, "
        "annual fees and applicable saved-rule scope extensions."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        logs = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        files = list(
            logs.glob("remaining-evidence-*/remaining-evidence.json")
        )
        if not files:
            raise CommandError(
                "Run inspect_aru_remaining_evidence first."
            )

        evidence_path = max(
            files, key=lambda path: path.parent.name
        )

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                evidence_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(str(exc)) from exc

        if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003":
            raise CommandError("Evidence is not for UK003.")

        pages = {}
        for page in evidence.get("pages", []):
            key = page.get("requested_url", "").rstrip("/")
            if key in pages:
                raise CommandError(f"Duplicate evidence: {key}")
            pages[key] = page

        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        output = logs / f"route-batch-{stamp}.json"
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(evidence_path.resolve()),
            "records": [],
            "blocked": [],
        }

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        with transaction.atomic():
            pending = []

            for row in BATCH:
                course_id = row["id"]

                try:
                    page = pages.get(row["url"].rstrip("/"))
                    if (
                        page is None
                        or page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/")
                        != row["url"].rstrip("/")
                        or page.get("title") != row["heading"]
                        or not page.get("sha256")
                        or course_id not in page.get(
                            "candidate_course_ids", []
                        )
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Course-page identity needs review."
                        )

                    body = page.get("text", "").split(
                        "End of main navigation."
                    )[-1]

                    if row["level"] == "TOPUP":
                        pattern = (
                            r"Start date\s+(.*?)\s+Location\s+(.*?)"
                            r"\s+UCAS course code\s+(.*?)"
                            r"\s+Duration\s+1 year\b"
                        )
                    else:
                        pattern = (
                            r"Start date\s+(.*?)\s+Location\s+(.*?)"
                            r"\s+Award\s+(.*?)"
                            r"\s+Duration\s+1 year full-time\b"
                        )

                    route = re.search(pattern, body)

                    if (
                        route is None
                        or "September 2027" not in route.group(1)
                        or route.group(2).strip() != row["campus"]
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "September 2027 one-year campus route "
                            "is not confirmed."
                        )

                    expected_route_value = (
                        row["ucas"]
                        if row["level"] == "TOPUP"
                        else row["award"]
                    )
                    if route.group(3).strip() != expected_route_value:
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Published award or UCAS code differs."
                        )

                    expected_prefix = (
                        "Undergraduate BSc (Hons)"
                        if row["level"] == "TOPUP"
                        else "Postgraduate MSc"
                    )
                    if not body.strip().startswith(expected_prefix):
                        raise ValueError("Published award differs.")

                    marker = body.rfind("Fees and funding")
                    if marker < 0:
                        raise ValueError("Fee section is missing.")

                    amounts = {
                        Decimal(value.replace(",", ""))
                        for value in re.findall(
                            r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)"
                            r"\s+International students starting"
                            r"\s+2027/28"
                            r"\s+\(full-time,\s*per year\)",
                            body[marker:],
                        )
                    }
                    amount = Decimal(row["fee"])

                    if amounts != {amount}:
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Annual international fee differs: "
                            f"{sorted(amounts)}."
                        )

                    course = (
                        Course.objects.select_for_update()
                        .get(
                            course_id=course_id,
                            university_id="UK003",
                        )
                    )

                    if (
                        not course.is_active
                        or course.title not in {
                            row["old_title"], row["title"]
                        }
                        or course.duration not in {
                            row["old_duration"], row["duration"]
                        }
                        or course.level != row["level"]
                        or course.location
                        != f"{row['campus']} Campus"
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Stored course identity needs review."
                        )

                    tuitions = list(
                        Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                            course=course,
                            residency="INTL",
                        )
                    )
                    if (
                        len(tuitions) != 1
                        or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Exactly one GBP international "
                            "tuition is required."
                        )

                    tuition = tuitions[0]
                    source = (
                        TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                        .filter(tuition=tuition).first()
                    )

                    before = {
                        "course": snapshot(course, COURSE_FIELDS),
                        "tuition_fee": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)), ".2f"
                        ),
                        "scholarship": format(
                            Decimal(str(tuition.scholarship)), ".2f"
                        ),
                        "scholarship_source_id": (
                            tuition.scholarship_source_id
                        ),
                        "source": snapshot(source, SOURCE_FIELDS),
                    }

                    after_course = {
                        **before["course"],
                        "title": row["title"],
                        "duration": row["duration"],
                        "start_month": "September",
                        "start_year": 2027,
                        "course_url": row["url"],
                    }
                    if row["ucas"]:
                        after_course["ucas_cao_code"] = row["ucas"]

                    old_raw = (
                        source.raw_fees
                        if source and isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                        else {}
                    )
                    history = copy.deepcopy(
                        old_raw.get("reviewed_course_corrections", {})
                    )
                    for field in ("title", "duration"):
                        if before["course"][field] != after_course[field]:
                            history.setdefault(field, {
                                "before": before["course"][field],
                                "after": after_course[field],
                            })

                    raw = {
                        "verified": True,
                        "academic_year": YEAR,
                        "source_fee_category": "International",
                        "course_kind": (
                            "undergraduate_topup"
                            if row["level"] == "TOPUP"
                            else "postgraduate_taught"
                        ),
                        "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                        "currency": "GBP",
                        "study_year": 1,
                        "study_mode": "full_time",
                        "campus": row["campus"],
                        "course_source_url": row["url"],
                        "source_sha256": page["sha256"],
                        "fee_method": "reviewed_named_course_fee",
                        "reviewed_course_corrections": history,
                        "unverified_legacy_discount_disabled": True,
                        "scholarship_status": (
                            "pending_topup_entry_year_confirmation"
                            if row["level"] == "TOPUP"
                            else "verified_maximum_rule_eligibility_required"
                        ),
                        "deposit_status": (
                            "verified_current_policy_offer_confirmation_required"
                        ),
                        "fee_note": (
                            "Published annual international fee for "
                            "the September 2027 one-year full-time "
                            f"route at {row['campus']}."
                        ),
                        "fee_categories": [{
                            "source_fee_category": "International",
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "currency": "GBP",
                            "annual_tuition": str(amount),
                            "amount_requires_review": False,
                        }],
                    }

                    if row["level"] == "TOPUP":
                        raw["course_note"] = (
                            "For qualified, experienced international "
                            "nurses. This course does not lead to "
                            "Nursing and Midwifery Council registration. "
                            "Scholarship entry-year treatment remains "
                            "unconfirmed."
                        )

                    after = {
                        "course": after_course,
                        "tuition_fee": str(amount),
                        "scholarship": "0.00",
                        "scholarship_source_id": None,
                        "source": {
                            "academic_year": YEAR,
                            "source_url": row["url"],
                            "source_course_code": row["ucas"],
                            "source_course_name": row["title"],
                            "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
                            "raw_fees": raw,
                        },
                    }

                    record = {
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "changed": before != after,
                        "before": before,
                        "after": after,
                    }
                    report["records"].append(record)
                    pending.append((course, tuition, record))

                except (ValueError, Course.DoesNotExist) as exc:
                    report["blocked"].append({
                        "course_id": course_id,
                        "reason": str(exc),
                    })

            if report["blocked"]:
                save_report()
                raise CommandError(
                    "No changes applied. "
                    f"Review blocked records in {output}"
                )

            rule_name = (
                "ARU International Postgraduate Scholarship "
                f"— ARU graduate eligibility ({YEAR})"
            )

            rules = list(
                ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    scholarship__university_id="UK003",
                    scholarship__name=rule_name,
                    scholarship__level="PG",
                    verified=True,
                )
            )
            if len(rules) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Exactly one verified ARU graduate rule is required."
                )

            rule = rules[0]
            old_rule = copy.deepcopy(rule.rules)
            conditions = (
                old_rule.get("conditions")
                if isinstance(old_rule, dict) else None
            )

            if (
                not isinstance(conditions, dict)
                or old_rule.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or old_rule.get("kind") != "fixed_maximum"
                or old_rule.get("value") != "4000.00"
                or conditions.get("aru_graduate") != [True]
                or not isinstance(conditions.get("course_id"), list)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "The saved graduate scholarship rule needs review."
                )

            new_rule = copy.deepcopy(old_rule)
            new_rule["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(
                set(conditions["course_id"]) | set(PG_IDS)
            )

            policy = (
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    academic_year=YEAR,
                    currency="GBP",
                    verified=True,
                ).first()
            )
            old_policy = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules) if policy else None

            if (
                not isinstance(old_policy, dict)
                or old_policy.get("kind") != "fixed"
                or old_policy.get("amount") != "4000.00"
                or old_policy.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                or not isinstance(old_policy.get("course_ids"), list)
                or not isinstance(old_policy.get("course_kinds"), list)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "A valid saved £4,000 ARU deposit policy is required."
                )

            new_policy = copy.deepcopy(old_policy)
            new_policy["course_ids"] = sorted(
                set(old_policy["course_ids"]) | set(IDS)
            )
            new_policy["course_kinds"] = sorted(
                set(old_policy["course_kinds"])
                | {"undergraduate_topup", "postgraduate_taught"}
            )

            report["scholarship_scope"] = {
                "changed": old_rule != new_rule,
                "before": old_rule,
                "after": new_rule,
            }
            report["deposit_scope"] = {
                "changed": old_policy != new_policy,
                "before": old_policy,
                "after": new_policy,
            }

            if options["apply"]:
                for course, tuition, record in pending:
                    if not record["changed"]:
                        continue

                    after = record["after"]
                    fields = []
                    for name, value in after["course"].items():
                        if getattr(course, name) != value:
                            setattr(course, name, value)
                            fields.append(name)

                    if fields:
                        course.save(
                            update_fields=[*fields, "updated_at"]
                        )

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal(after["tuition_fee"])
                    tuition.scholarship = 0
                    tuition.scholarship_source = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "tuition_fee", "scholarship", "scholarship_source"
                    ])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course.course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=record["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

                if old_rule != new_rule:
                    rule.rules = new_rule
                    rule.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
                    rule.save(update_fields=["rules", "reviewed_at"])

                if old_policy != new_policy:
                    policy.rules = new_policy
                    policy.save(update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"])

                report["database_changes"] = (
                    any(r["changed"] for r in report["records"])
                    or old_rule != new_rule
                    or old_policy != new_policy
                )

        save_report()

        for record in report["records"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{record['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{record['before']['tuition_fee']} -> "
                f"{record['after']['tuition_fee']} — "
                f"{'update' if record['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
            )
            for field in ("title", "duration"):
                old = record["before"]["course"][field]
                new = record["after"]["course"][field]
                if old != new:
                    self.stdout.write(f"  {field}: {old} -> {new}")

        changes = (
            sum(r["changed"] for r in report["records"])
            + int(old_rule != new_rule)
            + int(old_policy != new_policy)
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nARU graduate scholarship scope: "
            f"{len(new_rule['conditions']['course_id'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Deposit scope: {len(new_policy['course_ids'])} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Proposed/updated items: {changes}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed route, fee and scope updates saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Top-up scholarship remains pending entry-year confirmation. "
            "Numeric deposits unchanged; PG awards remain conditional."
        )

def normal(value):
    return " ".join(str(value).split()).casefold()


def merge_questions(*groups):
    result = {}

    for group in groups:
        for question in group or []:
            if isinstance(question, dict) and question.get("key"):
                result.setdefault(
                    question["key"],
                    copy.deepcopy(question),
                )

    return list(result.values())


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Reconcile scholarship applicability and deposit scope "
        "for six reviewed ARU specialist routes."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence", required=True)
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def fetch_sources(self):
        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
        )

        collected = {}

        with requests.Session() as session:
            session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                "TuitionComparePolicyReview/1.0"
            )
            session.mount(
                "https://",
                HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
            )

            for label, url in {
                "scholarship": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                "deposit": DEPOSIT_URL,
            }.items():
                self.stdout.write(f"Reading: {url}")

                response = session.get(url, timeout=(30, 60))
                response.raise_for_status()

                if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                    )

                soup = BeautifulSoup(response.content, "html.parser")

                if soup.find("h1") is None:
                    raise ValueError(f"No page title: {url}")

                main = soup.find("main") or soup

                text = " ".join(
                    main.get_text(" ", strip=True).split()
                )

                collected[label] = {
                    "source_url": response.url,
                    "text": text,
                    "text_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        text.encode("utf-8")
                    ).hexdigest(),
                    "html_sha256": hashlib.sha256(
                        response.content
                    ).hexdigest(),
                }

        scholarship = normal(collected["scholarship"]["text"])

        for marker in [
            "£2,000",
            "£4,000",
            "writtle",
            "year 2",
            "year 3",
            "apcl",
            "registration",
            "distance learning",
        ]:
            if marker not in scholarship:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Scholarship evidence changed: missing {marker!r}"
                )

        deposit = collected["deposit"]["text"]

        if not re.search(
            r"deposit for Undergraduate and Postgraduate taught "
            r"courses is\s*£\s*4,000",
            deposit,
            re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Cannot verify the current £4,000 taught-course deposit."
            )

        if "before being issued with a cas" not in normal(deposit):
            raise ValueError("Cannot verify the pre-CAS payment stage.")

        return collected

    def build_plan(self, evidence, evidence_path, sources, lock=False):
        validator = RouteValidator()

        courses = Course.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=IDS,
        ).order_by("course_id")

        tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
            course__university_id="UK003",
            course_id__in=IDS,
            residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("course_id")

        source_rows = TuitionSource.objects.filter(
            tuition__course__university_id="UK003",
            tuition__course_id__in=IDS,
            tuition__residency="INTL",
        ).order_by("tuition_id")

        rule_rows = ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
            scholarship__university_id="UK003",
        ).order_by("pk")

        policies = DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            academic_year=YEAR,
            currency="GBP",
        )

        if lock:
            courses = courses.select_for_update()
            tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            source_rows = source_rows.select_for_update()
            rule_rows = rule_rows.select_for_update()
            policies = policies.select_for_update()

        course_map = {row.course_id: row for row in courses}
        tuition_rows = list(tuitions)
        source_map = {
            row.tuition_id: row for row in source_rows
        }
        rules = list(rule_rows)
        policy_rows = list(policies)

        if set(course_map) != IDS:
            raise ValueError("One or more reviewed courses are missing.")

        if len(policy_rows) != 1:
            raise ValueError(
                "Exactly one saved 2027/28 GBP deposit policy is required."
            )

        policy = policy_rows[0]
        deposit_rules = copy.deepcopy(policy.rules)

        if (
            not policy.verified
            or not isinstance(deposit_rules, dict)
            or deposit_rules.get("kind") != "fixed"
            or Decimal(str(deposit_rules.get("amount"))) != Decimal("4000")
            or deposit_rules.get("academic_year") != YEAR
            or deposit_rules.get("fee_status") != "INTL"
            or deposit_rules.get("payment_stage") != "before_cas"
            or deposit_rules.get("requires_student_visa") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get("full_fee_paying") is not True
            or deposit_rules.get(
                "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit"
            ) is not False
            or not isinstance(deposit_rules.get("course_ids"), list)
            or not isinstance(
                deposit_rules.get("eligibility_questions"), list
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "Saved deposit policy does not match the reviewed rule."
            )

        chosen = {}

        for tier, amount in [
            ("lower", Decimal("2000")),
            ("higher", Decimal("4000")),
        ]:
            candidates = []

            for rule in rules:
                data = rule.rules

                if not isinstance(data, dict):
                    continue

                conditions = data.get("conditions", {})

                if (
                    rule.verified
                    and rule.source_url.rstrip("/")
                    == SCHOLARSHIP_URL.rstrip("/")
                    and data.get("academic_year") == YEAR
                    and data.get("kind") == "fixed"
                    and data.get("currency") == "GBP"
                    and str(data.get("value")) in {
                        str(amount),
                        f"{amount:.2f}",
                        str(int(amount)),
                    }
                    and conditions.get("entry_year") == [1]
                    and conditions.get("fee_status") == ["INTL"]
                    and conditions.get("aru_ug_award_tier") == [tier]
                    and data.get("study_years") == [1]
                    and data.get("award_status") == "conditional"
                    and isinstance(
                        conditions.get("course_id"), list
                    )
                    and data.get("eligibility_questions")
                ):
                    candidates.append(rule)

            if len(candidates) != 1:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Expected one verified Year 1 {tier} UG rule."
                )

            chosen[tier] = candidates[0]

        rule_changes = []

        # Remove these reused course IDs from incompatible old scopes.
        # Only the two reviewed undergraduate scopes receive additions.
        for rule in rules:
            old = rule.rules

            if not isinstance(old, dict):
                continue

            conditions = old.get("conditions")

            if not isinstance(conditions, dict):
                continue

            scope = conditions.get("course_id")

            if not isinstance(scope, list):
                continue

            new = copy.deepcopy(old)
            new_scope = set(scope) - IDS

            if rule.pk == chosen["lower"].pk:
                new_scope |= LOWER_IDS

            if rule.pk == chosen["higher"].pk:
                new_scope |= HIGHER_IDS

            new["conditions"]["course_id"] = sorted(new_scope)

            if new != old:
                rule_changes.append({
                    "id": rule.pk,
                    "before": old,
                    "after": new,
                })

        old_scope = set(deposit_rules["course_ids"])
        deposit_rules["course_ids"] = sorted(
            (old_scope - IDS) | DEPOSIT_IDS
        )

        kinds = deposit_rules.get("course_kinds")

        if not isinstance(kinds, list):
            raise ValueError("Deposit course kinds require review.")

        deposit_rules["course_kinds"] = sorted(
            set(kinds)
            | {"undergraduate_taught", "undergraduate_topup"}
        )

        course_changes = []

        base_questions = chosen["lower"].rules["eligibility_questions"]

        for course_id in sorted(IDS):
            proposal = validator.make_proposal(
                evidence,
                evidence_path,
                course_id,
                TARGETS[course_id],
            )

            if proposal["course_changes"]:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: apply the route corrections first."
                )

            matches = [
                row for row in tuition_rows
                if row.course_id == course_id
            ]

            if len(matches) != 1 or matches[0].currency != "GBP":
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: one GBP international tuition required."
                )

            tuition = matches[0]
            source = source_map.get(tuition.pk)

            if source is None or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: reviewed source metadata is missing."
                )

            raw = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
            target_fee = TARGETS[course_id]["fee"]

            if target_fee is not None:
                if (
                    raw.get("verified") is not True
                    or source.academic_year != YEAR
                    or Decimal(str(raw.get("annual_tuition")))
                    != Decimal(target_fee)
                    or Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee))
                    != Decimal(target_fee)
                ):
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"{course_id}: verified tuition does not match."
                    )
            elif raw.get("verified") is not False:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: expected an unavailable-fee outcome."
                )

            if (
                source.source_url.rstrip("/")
                != proposal["evidence"]["source_url"].rstrip("/")
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"{course_id}: saved source URL differs."
                )

            existing_questions = (
                raw.get("scholarship_review", {})
                .get("eligibility_questions", [])
            )

            if course_id in LOWER_IDS:
                scholarship_status = (
                    "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                )
                tiers = (
                    ["lower", "higher"]
                    if course_id in HIGHER_IDS
                    else ["lower"]
                )
            else:
                scholarship_status = "applicability_unconfirmed"
                tiers = []

            deposit_status = (

                    "eligibility_questions": merge_questions(
                        existing_questions,
                        base_questions,
                        EXTRA_QUESTIONS,
                    ),

                    "note": (

                        "to visa, full-fee-paying and sponsorship "

                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "tuition_id": tuition.pk,
                    "source_id": source.pk,

                    "after": after,

            "deposit_policy_id": policy.pk,
            "deposit_before": policy.rules,
            "deposit_after": deposit_rules,
            "course_changes": course_changes,
            "deposit_scope_count": len(

    def save_plan(self, plan):
        for change in plan["rule_changes"]:
            rule = ScholarshipRule.objects.get(pk=change["id"])
            rule.rules = change["after"]
            rule.reviewed_at = timezone.now()
            rule.save(update_fields=["rules", "reviewed_at"])

        if plan["deposit_before"] != plan["deposit_after"]:
            policy = DepositPolicy.objects.get(
                pk=plan["deposit_policy_id"]
            )
            policy.rules = plan["deposit_after"]
            policy.save(update_fields=["rules", "updated_at"])

        for change in plan["course_changes"]:
            tuition = Tuition.objects.get(pk=change["tuition_id"])
            source = TuitionSource.objects.get(pk=change["source_id"])

            source.raw_fees = change["after"]["raw_fees"]
            source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

            if (
                tuition.scholarship != 0
                or tuition.scholarship_source_id is not None
            ):
                tuition.scholarship = Decimal("0.00")
                tuition.scholarship_source = None
                tuition.save(update_fields=[
                    "scholarship",
                    "scholarship_source",
                ])

            TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                tuition=tuition,
                course_identifier=change["course_id"],
                residency="INTL",
                before=change["before"],
                after=change["after"],
            )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        evidence_path = Path(options["evidence"])

        if not evidence_path.is_absolute():
            evidence_path = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / evidence_path

        try:
            evidence = json.loads(
                evidence_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )

            if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK003":
                raise ValueError("Evidence is not for ARU UK003.")

            sources = self.fetch_sources()

            with transaction.atomic():
                plan = self.build_plan(
                    evidence,
                    evidence_path,
                    sources,
                    lock=options["apply"],
                )

                stamp = timezone.now().strftime(
                    "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
                )
                folder = (
                    Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
                    / "logs"
                    / "aru"
                    / f"specialist-awards-{stamp}"
                )
                folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

                output = folder / "reconciliation.json"

                report = {

                    "policy_sources": sources,

                        report,
                        cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                        indent=2,
                        ensure_ascii=False,
                    ),
                    encoding="utf-8",
                )

                if options["apply"]:
                    self.save_plan(plan)

        except (
            OSError,
            ValueError,
            TypeError,
            KeyError,
            requests.RequestException,
        ) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Reconciliation stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        changed = (
            len(plan["rule_changes"])
            + len(plan["course_changes"])
            + int(
                plan["deposit_before"] != plan["deposit_after"]
            )
        )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = changed > 0

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    report,
                    cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "MOptom: lower/higher UG rules; eligibility required."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Equine Science: lower UG rule; eligibility required."
        )
        self.stdout.write(

        )

            "Early Childhood, Social Work and Global Public Health: "
            "scholarship/deposit applicability pending."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"2027/28 deposit scope: "
            f"{plan['deposit_scope_count']} courses"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated items: {changed}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Scholarship scopes, deposit scope and review "
                "metadata saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

            "Eligibility questions preserved. Gross tuition and "
            "numeric deposit fields unchanged. Unverified stored "
            "scholarship deductions are cleared on apply."
        )

def money(value):
    amount = Decimal(str(value))
    if not amount.is_finite() or amount < 0:
        raise ValueError("Invalid monetary amount.")
    return f"{amount:.2f}"


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or apply three explicit ARU MPhil replacements "
        "with January 2027 international research fees."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--evidence")
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")
        parser.add_argument(
            "--accept-replacements",

    def read_evidence(self, supplied):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)

        if supplied:
            path = Path(supplied)
            if not path.is_absolute():
                path = root / path
        else:
            path = None
            candidates = sorted(
                (root / "logs" / "aru").glob(
                    "campus-intakes-*/campus-intake-evidence.json"
                ),
                reverse=True,
            )

            for candidate in candidates:
                try:
                    data = json.loads(
                        candidate.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
                    )
                    ids = {
                        item["database_course"]["course_id"]
                        for item in data.get("courses", [])
                    }
                except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError):
                    continue

                if set(TARGETS).issubset(ids):
                    path = candidate
                    break

            if path is None:
                raise CommandError(
                    "No matching three-course evidence found. "
                    "Supply --evidence."
                )

        try:
            data = json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read evidence: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        if (
            not isinstance(data, dict)
            or data.get("university_id") != "UK003"
            or data.get("errors")
            or not isinstance(data.get("pages"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Invalid evidence or collection errors present."
            )

        return path, data

    def validate_page(self, folder, pages, target):
        url = (
            "https://www.aru.ac.uk/study/postgraduate/"
            + target["slug"]
        )

        matches = [
            page
            for page in pages
            if page.get("source_url", "").rstrip("/") == url
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Expected one source capture: {url}"
            )

        page = matches[0]
        filename = page.get("html_file")
        if (
            not isinstance(filename, str)
            or Path(filename).name != filename
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid HTML evidence filename.")

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            (folder / filename).read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()

        if digest != page.get("sha256"):
            raise CommandError("Saved HTML hash mismatch.")

        text = " ".join(page.get("text", "").split())
        marker = "End of main navigation."

        if marker not in text:
            raise CommandError(
                "Cannot isolate the research course page."
            )

        overview = text.split(marker, 1)[1].split(
            "Apply online", 1
        )[0]

        campus = target["location"].replace(" Campus", "")
        required = [
            target["source_heading"],
            campus,
            "January 2027",
        ]

        if not all(value in overview for value in required):
            raise CommandError(
                "Research award, campus or intake not confirmed."
            )

        if "MPhil: full-time 1-3 years" not in text:
            raise CommandError(
                "Published MPhil duration range not confirmed."
            )

        amounts = {
            money(value.replace(",", ""))
            for value in re.findall(
                r"International students,\s*2026/27\s*"
                r"\(per year\)\s*£([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                text,
            )
        }

        if amounts != {"17500.00"}:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Unexpected international research fee: "
                f"{sorted(amounts)}"
            )

        if "Bench fees" not in text:
            raise CommandError(
                "Expected project-specific bench-fee note missing."
            )

        return page

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        path, evidence = self.read_evidence(options["evidence"])

        try:
            pages = {
                course_id: self.validate_page(
                    path.parent,
                    evidence["pages"],
                    target,
                )
                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
            }
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError, KeyError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Evidence validation failed: {exc}"
            ) from exc

        folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aru"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        output = folder / (
            "three-research-routes-"
            + timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
            + ".json"
        )
        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "evidence_report": str(path),
            "records": [],
        }

        with transaction.atomic():
            courses = {
                course.course_id: course
                for course in (
                    Course.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        course_id__in=TARGETS,
                        is_active=True,
                    )
                    .order_by("course_id")
                )
            }

            if set(courses) != set(TARGETS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Expected all three active research records."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(course_id__in=TARGETS, residency="INTL")
                .order_by("pk")
            )
            tuition_map = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                if tuition.course_id in tuition_map:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Duplicate international tuition found."
                    )
                tuition_map[tuition.course_id] = tuition

            if (
                set(tuition_map) != set(TARGETS)
                or any(t.currency != "GBP" for t in tuitions)
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Each course requires one GBP international tuition."
                )

            sources = {
                source.tuition_id: source
                for source in (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition__in=tuitions)
                    .order_by("pk")
                )
            }

            for course_id, target in TARGETS.items():
                duplicates = list(
                    Course.objects.filter(
                        university_id="UK003",
                        is_active=True,
                        title=target["title"],
                        location=target["location"],
                    )
                    .exclude(course_id=course_id)
                    .values_list("course_id", flat=True)
                )
                if duplicates:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: possible duplicate: "
                        + ", ".join(duplicates)
                    )

                tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                report["records"].append(
                    self.plan_record(
                        courses[course_id],
                        tuition,
                        sources.get(tuition.pk),
                        pages[course_id],
                        target,
                    )
                )

            report["proposed_changes"] = sum(
                entry["changed"] for entry in report["records"]
            )

            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            replacements_needed = any(
                courses[course_id].title != target["title"]
                for course_id, target in TARGETS.items()
            )

            if (
                options["apply"]
                and replacements_needed
                and not options["accept_replacements"]
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Review the three explicit replacements, then "
                    "use --apply --accept-replacements. "
                    "No database records changed."
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for entry in report["records"]:
                    if not entry["changed"]:
                        continue

                    course_id = entry["course_id"]
                    course = courses[course_id]
                    tuition = tuition_map[course_id]
                    after = entry["after"]

                    for field, value in after["course"].items():
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=FIELDS + ["updated_at"]
                    )

                    tuition.tuition_fee = Decimal("17500.00")
                    tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        defaults=after["source"],
                    )
                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=entry["before"],
                        after=after,
                    )

        report["database_changes"] = bool(
            options["apply"] and report["proposed_changes"]
        )
        report["completed"] = True
        output.write_text(
            json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        for entry in report["records"]:
            state = "update" if entry["changed"] else "unchanged"
            self.stdout.write(
                f"{entry['course_id']}: GBP "
                f"{entry['before']['tuition']['tuition_fee']} "
                f"-> 17500.00; January 2027 / 2026/27 — {state}"
            )
            for field, value in entry["after"]["course"].items():
                old = entry["before"]["course"][field]
                if old != value:
                    self.stdout.write(
                        f"  {field}: {old} -> {value}"
                    )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed changes: {report['proposed_changes']}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Reviewed replacements and research fees saved."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Scholarship and research deposit applicability "
            "recorded as pending. Stored discounts and "
            "deposit policies unchanged."

    {
        "key": "registration_conditions_met",
        "question": "Have all ARU registration conditions been met?",
        "type": "boolean",
    },
    {
        "key": "aru_funding_eligibility_confirmed",
        "question": (
            "Is your funding arrangement eligible for this award, "
            "including any sponsorship or federal tuition loan?"
        ),
        "type": "boolean",
        "note": (
            "Sponsored students and federal loan recipients may "
            "need confirmation from ARU and their funding body."
        ),
    },
    {
        "key": "aru_ug_award_confirmed",
        "question": "Has ARU confirmed your undergraduate scholarship?",
        "type": "boolean",
    },
    {
        "key": "aru_ug_award_tier",
        "question": "Which first-year award has ARU confirmed?",
        "type": "choice",
        "choices": [
            {"value": "lower", "label": "£2,000"},
            {"value": "higher", "label": "£4,000"},
        ],
        "note": "Exceeding entry requirements does not confirm a tier.",
    },
]


def snapshot(obj, fields):
    if obj is None:
        return None
    return {
        name: copy.deepcopy(getattr(obj, name))
        for name in fields
    }


def rule_data(course_ids, amount, tier):
    return {
        "kind": "fixed",
        "value": amount,
        "benefit": "tuition",
        "currency": "GBP",
        "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
        "study_years": [1],
        "award_status": "conditional",
        "stacking": "exclusive",
        "compatible_ids": [],
        "percentage_basis": "original_tuition",
        "fee_basis_confirmed": True,
        "conditions": {
            "course_id": course_ids,
            "fee_status": ["INTL"],
            "new_entrant": [True],
            "full_time": [True],
            "entry_year": [1],
            "apcl": [False],
            "registration_conditions_met": [True],
            "aru_funding_eligibility_confirmed": [True],
            "aru_ug_award_confirmed": [True],
            "aru_ug_award_tier": [tier],
        },
        "scope_note": (
            "Reviewed standard campus undergraduate routes only. "
            "First compared study year and Year 1 entrants only. "
            "Unknown eligibility answers do not qualify."
        ),
        "combination_note": (
            "Do not combine with another scholarship. "
            "A Full Payment Discount may be permitted in Year 1, "
            "but is not modelled until its deadline and payment "
            "conditions have been separately verified."
        ),
        "future_year_note": (
            "ARU publishes £1,000 in subsequent years, for up to "
            "three subsequent years, subject to successful completion. "
            "Those future-year rules are not imported by this command."
        ),
        "source_period_note": (
            "Current published policy does not name an academic year. "
            "Saved against the reviewed 2027/28 course cohort; "
            "recheck before enrolment."
        ),
        "eligibility_questions": QUESTIONS,
    }


class Command(SourceInspector):
    help = (
        "Reconcile ARU first-year undergraduate scholarship rules "
        "and the current published deposit policy for 24 courses."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        folder = root / "logs" / "aru" / f"awards-{stamp}"
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)

        report = {
            "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "database_changes": False,
            "university_id": "UK003",
            "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
            "course_ids": IDS,
            "proposals": [],
            "sources": {},
        }

        output = folder / "reconciliation.json"

        def save_report():
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://", HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry)
                )

                for name, url in [
                    ("scholarship", SCHOLARSHIP_URL),
                    ("deposit", DEPOSIT_URL),
                ]:
                    response, soup = self.get_page(session, url)

                    if response.url.rstrip("/") != url.rstrip("/"):
                        raise ValueError(
                            f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                        )

                    report["sources"][name] = self.evidence(
                        response, soup
                    )
                    (folder / f"{name}.html").write_bytes(
                        response.content
                    )

            scholarship_text = report["sources"]["scholarship"]["text"]
            deposit_text = report["sources"]["deposit"]["text"]

            required = [
                "£2,000 in the first year",
                "£4,000 in the first year",
                "£1,000 in each subsequent year",
                "all conditions of registration",
                "Accredited Prior Certified Learning",
                "cannot be combined with any other scholarships",
            ]

            normalised = scholarship_text.casefold()

            for phrase in required:
                if phrase.casefold() not in normalised:
                    raise ValueError(
                        f"Scholarship source needs review: {phrase}"
                    )

            if (
                "writtle" not in normalised
                or "automatically get £2,000" not in normalised
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "The Writtle first-year award needs review."
                )

            if (
                "deposit for undergraduate and postgraduate "
                "taught courses is £4,000"
            ) not in deposit_text.casefold():
                raise ValueError(
                    "The published £4,000 deposit needs review."
                )

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            report["error"] = str(exc)
            save_report()
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                f"No database changes. Report: {output}"
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                university_id="UK003"
            )

            courses = list(
                Course.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    university=university,
                    course_id__in=IDS,
                    is_active=True,
                    level="UG",
                    start_year=2027,
                    start_month="September",
                )
            )

            if len(courses) != len(IDS):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Apply the reviewed 24-course tuition batch first. "
                    "One or more course records do not match."
                )

            tuitions = list(
                Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                    course_id__in=IDS,
                    residency="INTL",
                )
            )

            by_course = {}
            for tuition in tuitions:
                by_course.setdefault(tuition.course_id, []).append(tuition)

            sources = {}

            for course_id in IDS:
                rows = by_course.get(course_id, [])

                if len(rows) != 1 or rows[0].currency != "GBP":
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: exactly one GBP INTL "
                        "tuition is required."
                    )

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=rows[0])
                    .first()
                )

                if (
                    source is None
                    or source.academic_year != ACADEMIC_YEAR
                    or not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict)
                    or source.raw_fees.get("verified") is not True
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: verified 2027/28 tuition "
                        "source is required."
                    )

                sources[course_id] = source

            tiers = [
                ("lower", "2000.00", IDS),
                (
                    "higher",
                    "4000.00",
                    sorted(set(IDS) - set(WRITTLE_IDS)),
                ),
            ]

            for tier, amount, scope in tiers:
                name = (
                    "ARU International Undergraduate Scholarship "
                    f"— {tier.title()} — Year 1 ({ACADEMIC_YEAR})"
                )

                matches = list(
                    Scholarship.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        university=university,
                        name=name,
                        level="UG",
                    )
                )

                if len(matches) > 1:
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Duplicate scholarship records: {name}"
                    )

                award = matches[0] if matches else None
                existing_rule = (
                    ScholarshipRule.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(scholarship=award)
                    .first()
                    if award else None
                )

                fields = {
                    "award_type": "Tuition Reduction",
                    "award_value": amount,
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "deadline": None,
                    "eligibility": (
                        "Eligible new international campus "
                        "undergraduate students entering Year 1."
                    ),
                    "requirements": (
                        "ARU-confirmed award tier; registration "
                        "conditions met; eligible funding; full-time; "
                        "no APCL adjustment required."
                    ),
                    "description": (
                        f"Conditional £{amount} first-year tuition "
                        "reduction. Later years and payment discounts "
                        "require separate rules."
                    ),
                    "url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                }

                rules = rule_data(scope, amount, tier)

                before = {
                    "scholarship": snapshot(award, fields),
                    "rule": snapshot(
                        existing_rule,
                        ["verified", "source_url", "rules"],
                    ),
                }
                after = {
                    "scholarship": fields,
                    "rule": {
                        "verified": True,
                        "source_url": SCHOLARSHIP_URL,
                        "rules": rules,
                    },
                }
                changed = before != after

                report["proposals"].append({
                    "type": "scholarship",
                    "name": name,
                    "course_count": len(scope),
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

                if options["apply"] and changed:
                    if award is None:
                        award = Scholarship.objects.create(
                            university=university,
                            name=name,
                            level="UG",
                            **fields,
                        )
                    else:
                        for key, value in fields.items():
                            setattr(award, key, value)
                        award.save(update_fields=list(fields))

                    ScholarshipRule.objects.update_or_create(
                        scholarship=award,
                        defaults={
                            **after["rule"],
                            "reviewed_at": timezone.now(),
                        },
                    )

            deposit_rules = {
                "schema_version": 1,
                "kind": "fixed",
                "amount": "4000.00",
                "currency": "GBP",
                "fee_status": "INTL",
                "payment_stage": "before_cas",
                "course_ids": IDS,
                "course_kinds": ["undergraduate_taught"],
                "requires_student_visa": True,
                "full_fee_paying": True,
                "sponsorship_letter_requires_review": True,
                "deduct_scholarship_from_deposit": False,
                "offer_letter_confirmation_required": True,
                "source_period": "current_undated_policy",
                "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                "note": (
                    "Current published pre-CAS deposit: £4,000 "
                    "for full-fee-paying international taught "
                    "students. Confirm the requirement in the "
                    "individual offer. Sponsored arrangements "
                    "require separate assessment. Recheck the "
                    "current policy before payment."
                ),
                "eligibility_questions": [
                    {
                        "key": "requires_student_visa",
                        "question": "Do you require a Student visa?",
                        "type": "boolean",
                    },
                    {
                        "key": "full_fee_paying",
                        "question": (
                            "Are you a full-fee-paying international "
                            "student under ARU's payment arrangements?"
                        ),
                        "type": "boolean",
                    },
                    {
                        "key": "sponsored",
                        "question": (
                            "Will a sponsor provide a sponsorship letter?"
                        ),
                        "type": "boolean",
                    },
                ],
            }

            policy = (
                DepositPolicy.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    university=university,
                    academic_year=ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                )
                .first()
            )

            policy_fields = {
                "currency": "GBP",
                "rules": deposit_rules,
                "source_url": DEPOSIT_URL,
                "verified": True,
            }

            policy_before = snapshot(policy, policy_fields)
            policy_changed = policy_before != policy_fields

            report["proposals"].append({
                "type": "deposit_policy",
                "changed": policy_changed,
                "before": policy_before,
                "after": policy_fields,
            })

            if options["apply"] and policy_changed:
                DepositPolicy.objects.update_or_create(
                    university=university,
                    academic_year=ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                    defaults={
                        **policy_fields,
                        "source_text": deposit_text,
                        "source_sha256": (
                            report["sources"]["deposit"]["sha256"]
                        ),
                        "checked_at": timezone.now(),
                    },
                )

            for course_id in IDS:
                tuition = by_course[course_id][0]
                source = sources[course_id]

                old_raw = copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
                new_raw = {
                    **old_raw,
                    "scholarship_status": (
                        "verified_rule_eligibility_required"
                    ),
                    "deposit_status": (
                        "verified_current_policy_offer_confirmation_required"
                    ),
                    "unverified_legacy_discount_disabled": True,
                }

                before = {
                    "scholarship": str(tuition.scholarship),
                    "scholarship_source_id": (
                        tuition.scholarship_source_id
                    ),
                    "raw_fees": old_raw,
                }
                after = {
                    "scholarship": "0.00",
                    "scholarship_source_id": None,
                    "raw_fees": new_raw,
                }

                changed = (
                    tuition.scholarship != 0
                    or tuition.scholarship_source_id is not None
                    or old_raw != new_raw
                )

                report["proposals"].append({
                    "type": "course_metadata_and_legacy_discount",
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                })

                if options["apply"] and changed:
                    tuition.scholarship = 0
                    tuition.scholarship_source = None
                    tuition.save(update_fields=[
                        "scholarship", "scholarship_source"
                    ])

                    source.raw_fees = new_raw
                    source.save(update_fields=[
                        "raw_fees", "checked_at"
                    ])

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=course_id,
                        residency="INTL",
                        before=before,
                        after=after,
                    )

            report["database_changes"] = (
                options["apply"]
                and any(
                    item["changed"]
                    for item in report["proposals"]
                )
            )

        save_report()

        for item in report["proposals"]:
            if item["type"] == "scholarship":
                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{item['name']}: "
                    f"{item['course_count']} courses — "
                    f"{'update' if item['changed'] else 'unchanged'}"
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            "£4,000 deposit policy: "
            f"{'update' if policy_changed else 'unchanged'}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Proposed/updated items: "
            f"{sum(p['changed'] for p in report['proposals'])}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Scholarship rules, deposit policy and "
                "course review metadata saved."
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Gross tuition and numeric stored deposits unchanged. "
            "Scholarship deductions require confirmed eligibility."
        )
