import copy
import json
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import requests
from requests.adapters import HTTPAdapter
from urllib3.util.retry import Retry

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Q

from app.models import (
    Course,
    Tuition,
    TuitionSource,
    TuitionUpdateAudit,
    University,
)

from .import_aberystwyth_welsh_education_fees import download, text


COURSE_ID = "C_UK002_83"
OLD_TITLE = "BSc (Hons) Physics with Astronomy"
NEW_TITLE = "BSc (Hons) Astrophysics"

COURSE_URL = (
    "https://courses.aber.ac.uk/undergraduate/astrophysics-degree/"
)
FEE_URL = (
    "https://www.aber.ac.uk/en/study-with-us/"
    "fees/undergrad/tuition-fees/"
)

YEAR = "2027/28"
FEE = Decimal("23255.00")

FIELDS = (
    "title",
    "level",
    "duration",
    "start_month",
    "start_year",
    "course_url",
    "ucas_cao_code",
)


def verify_sources(session):
    course, course_evidence = download(session, COURSE_URL)
    fees, fee_evidence = download(session, FEE_URL)

    heading = course.find("h1")
    if heading is None or text(heading) != "Astrophysics":
        raise ValueError("Official course title does not match.")

    content = text(course)

    for pattern in (
        r"\bAstrophysics\s+Code\s+F510\b",
        r"\bCourse duration\s+3\s+years\b",
        r"\bSeptember\s+start\s+2027\b",
        r"\bDepartment of Physics\b",
    ):
        if not re.search(pattern, content, re.I):
            raise ValueError(
                f"Required Astrophysics evidence missing: {pattern}"
            )

    current_year = False
    international_section = False
    amounts = []
    physics_classified = False

    for node in fees.find_all(["h2", "h3", "table"]):
        if node.name == "h2":
            current_year = (
                text(node).casefold()
                == "tuition fees for september 2027"
            )
            international_section = False
            continue

        if node.name == "h3":
            international_section = (
                current_year
                and "fee information for international students"
                in text(node).casefold()
            )
            continue

        if not (current_year and international_section):
            continue

        for row in node.find_all("tr"):
            cells = [
                text(cell)
                for cell in row.find_all(["th", "td"], recursive=False)
            ]
            if len(cells) < 2:
                continue

            label = cells[0].casefold()

            if label == "science courses":
                if re.search(r"\bPhysics\b", cells[1], re.I):
                    physics_classified = True

            if label == "full-time science":
                match = re.fullmatch(
                    r"£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
                    cells[1],
                )
                if match:
                    amounts.append(
                        Decimal(
                            match.group(1).replace(",", "")
                        ).quantize(Decimal("0.01"))
                    )

    if amounts != [FEE] or not physics_classified:
        raise ValueError(
            "Expected one £23,255 international science fee "
            "and an explicit Physics science classification."
        )

    return {
        "course": course_evidence,
        "fee_schedule": fee_evidence,
    }


def snapshot(course, tuition, source):
    return {
        "course": {
            field: getattr(course, field)
            for field in FIELDS
        },
        "tuition": {
            "tuition_fee": str(
                Decimal(str(tuition.tuition_fee)).quantize(
                    Decimal("0.01")
                )
            ),
            "currency": tuition.currency,
        },
        "source": {
            "academic_year": source.academic_year,
            "source_url": source.source_url,
            "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
            "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
            "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
            "raw_fees": copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
        },
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Replace the stored Physics with Astronomy listing with "
        "the accepted current Astrophysics route and verified fee."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareSourceInspector/1.0"
                )
                retry = Retry(
                    total=3,
                    connect=3,
                    read=3,
                    status=3,
                    backoff_factor=1,
                    status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
                    allowed_methods=["GET"],
                    respect_retry_after_header=True,
                )
                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )
                evidence = verify_sources(session)

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Source verification stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        with transaction.atomic():
            if options["apply"]:
                University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK002"
                )

            courses = Course.objects.filter(
                course_id=COURSE_ID,
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                courses = courses.select_for_update()

            try:
                course = courses.get()
            except Course.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError("Active course not found.") from exc

            if (
                course.title not in {OLD_TITLE, NEW_TITLE}
                or course.level != "UG"
                or course.duration != "3 Years"
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "Stored course differs from the reviewed replacement."
                )

            duplicates = Course.objects.filter(
                university_id="UK002",
                is_active=True,
            ).exclude(course_id=COURSE_ID).filter(
                Q(course_url=COURSE_URL)
                | Q(ucas_cao_code="F510")
                | Q(title=NEW_TITLE)
            )

            if duplicates.exists():
                raise CommandError(
                    "Another active record already represents Astrophysics. "
                    "Review duplication before replacement."
                )

            tuitions = Tuition.objects.filter(
                course=course,
                residency="INTL",
            )
            if options["apply"]:
                tuitions = tuitions.select_for_update()
            tuitions = list(tuitions)

            if len(tuitions) != 1 or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP":
                raise CommandError(
                    "A unique GBP international tuition is required."
                )

            tuition = tuitions[0]
            sources = TuitionSource.objects.filter(tuition=tuition)
            if options["apply"]:
                sources = sources.select_for_update()

            try:
                source = sources.get()
            except TuitionSource.DoesNotExist as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Existing course review metadata is missing."
                ) from exc

            if not isinstance(source.raw_fees, dict):
                raise CommandError("Invalid source metadata.")

            already_replaced = (
                source.raw_fees.get("course_identity", {}).get("status")
                == "accepted_current_catalogue_replacement"
                and source.source_course_code == "F510"
            )

            if (
                source.raw_fees.get("verified") is True
                and not already_replaced
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    "An unrelated verified fee already exists. "
                    "No overwrite performed."
                )

            before = snapshot(course, tuition, source)
            after = copy.deepcopy(before)

            after["course"].update({
                "title": NEW_TITLE,
                "level": "UG",
                "duration": "3 Years",
                "start_month": "September",
                "start_year": 2027,
                "course_url": COURSE_URL,
                "ucas_cao_code": "F510",
            })
            after["tuition"]["tuition_fee"] = str(FEE)

            raw = after["source"]["raw_fees"]
            raw.update({
                "verified": True,
                "fee_verification_status": "verified",
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "source_fee_category": "International",
                "annual_tuition": str(FEE),
                "currency": "GBP",
                "fee_band": "Sciences",
                "programme_fee_group": "bachelors",
                "course_kind": "undergraduate",
                "course_source_url": COURSE_URL,
                "study_year": 1,
                "fee_method": (
                    "accepted_replacement_and_published_subject_band"
                ),
                "course_identity": {
                    "status": "accepted_current_catalogue_replacement",
                    "replaces_title": OLD_TITLE,
                    "official_title": "Astrophysics",
                    "official_code": "F510",
                    "official_award": "BSC",
                    "source_url": COURSE_URL,
                    "note": (
                        "User accepted replacing the stored listing with "
                        "the current Astrophysics route. This does not "
                        "assert historical course equivalence."
                    ),
                },
                "fee_review": {
                    "status": "resolved",
                    "reason": (
                        "Astrophysics is taught in Physics, classified "
                        "under the published undergraduate science fee."
                    ),
                },
                "fee_evidence": evidence,
                "fee_categories": [{
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "academic_year": YEAR,
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "annual_tuition": str(FEE),
                    "raw_annual_fee": "£23,255",
                    "annotation": (
                        "Annual full-time undergraduate science tuition."
                    ),
                    "footnote_marker": "",
                    "amount_requires_review": False,
                }],
            })

            notes = raw.get("display_notes", {})
            if not isinstance(notes, dict):
                notes = {}

            notes.pop("fee", None)

            # Preserve later scholarship reconciliation on repeat imports.
            if not already_replaced:
                raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                    "pending_separate_reconciliation"
                )
                raw["scholarship_review"] = {
                    "status": "pending",
                    "reason": (
                        "Scholarship applicability for the replacement "
                        "course requires separate reconciliation."
                    ),
                }
                notes["scholarship"] = (
                    "Scholarship eligibility has not yet been confirmed "
                    "for this replacement course."
                )

            raw["deposit_status"] = "offer_letter_amount_required"
            notes["deposit"] = (
                "Deposit amount is specified in your individual offer letter."
            )
            raw["display_notes"] = notes

            after["source"].update({
                "academic_year": YEAR,
                "source_url": FEE_URL,
                "source_course_name": "Astrophysics",
                "source_course_code": "F510",
                "fee_basis": "annual_tuition",
            })

            changed = before != after
            now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            folder = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

            report_path = folder / (
                "astrophysics-replacement-"
                + now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
                + ".json"
            )

            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps({
                    "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                    "mode": (
                        "apply_requested"
                        if options["apply"]
                        else "preview"
                    ),
                    "course_id": COURSE_ID,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            self.stdout.write(
                f"{COURSE_ID}: "
                f"{'update' if changed else 'unchanged'}"
            )

            for field in FIELDS:
                old = before["course"][field]
                new = after["course"][field]
                if old != new:
                    self.stdout.write(f"  {field}: {old} -> {new}")

            self.stdout.write(
                f"International tuition: GBP "
                f"{before['tuition']['tuition_fee']} -> {FEE}; {YEAR}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(f"Proposed changes: {int(changed)}")
            self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

            if not options["apply"]:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "Preview only. No database records changed."
                )
                return

            if changed:
                changed_fields = []
                for field, value in after["course"].items():
                    if getattr(course, field) != value:
                        setattr(course, field, value)
                        changed_fields.append(field)

                if changed_fields:
                    course.save(
                        update_fields=[*changed_fields, "updated_at"]
                    )

                tuition.tuition_fee = FEE
                tuition.save(update_fields=["tuition_fee"])

                for field, value in after["source"].items():
                    setattr(source, field, value)

                source.save(
                    update_fields=[
                        *after["source"].keys(),
                        "checked_at",
                    ]
                )

                TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                    tuition=tuition,
                    course_identifier=COURSE_ID,
                    residency="INTL",
                    before=before,
                    after=after,
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            self.style.SUCCESS(
                "Accepted Astrophysics replacement and verified fee saved."
                if changed
                else "Already current. No database updates needed."
            )
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            "Stored scholarships and numeric deposits unchanged. "
            "Other unresolved courses were not modified."
        )

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview/save evidence-based review statuses for remaining "
        "Aberystwyth courses. Does not change tuition prices."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        directory = Path(settings.BASE_DIR) / "logs" / "aberystwyth"
        paths = list(
            directory.glob(
                "remaining-review-*/remaining-course-review.json"
            )
        )

        if not paths:
            raise CommandError("Remaining-course evidence report not found.")

        evidence_path = max(paths, key=lambda path: path.parent.name)
        evidence = read_json(evidence_path)

        if evidence.get("university_id") != "UK002":
            raise CommandError("University evidence mismatch.")

        validate_age(evidence)

        evidence_records = {
            row["course_id"]: row
            for row in evidence.get("records", [])
        }

        now = timezone.now()
        stamp = now.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")
        output = directory / f"unresolved-review-{stamp}.json"

        proposals = []
        skipped_verified = []
        blocked = []
        locked = {}

        with transaction.atomic():
            university = University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                pk="UK002",
                country="UK",
            )

            if university.name.strip().casefold() != "aberystwyth university":
                raise CommandError("University identity mismatch.")

            courses = (
                Course.objects.select_for_update()
                .filter(
                    university=university,
                    is_active=True,
                    pk__in=evidence_records,
                )
                .order_by("course_id")
            )

            for course in courses:
                tuitions = list(
                    course.tuitions.select_for_update().filter(
                        residency="INTL"
                    )
                )

                if len(tuitions) != 1:
                    blocked.append({
                        "course_id": course.pk,
                        "reason": (
                            "A unique international tuition record is "
                            "required before saving review metadata."
                        ),
                    })
                    continue

                tuition = tuitions[0]
                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                before_raw = (
                    copy.deepcopy(source.raw_fees)
                    if source else {}
                )

                if not isinstance(before_raw, dict):
                    blocked.append({
                        "course_id": course.pk,
                        "reason": "Existing source metadata is not an object.",
                    })
                    continue

                # Never downgrade a fee already verified by another batch.
                if before_raw.get("verified") is True:
                    skipped_verified.append(course.pk)
                    continue

                record = evidence_records[course.pk]
                candidates = record.get("candidates", [])

                reason = SPECIAL_REASONS.get(
                    course.pk,
                    (
                        "No confirmed exact course/award match was established. "
                        "Similar-title candidates do not justify a fee update."
                        if candidates else
                        "No official catalogue candidate was found in this "
                        "collection. This does not establish discontinuation."
                    ),
                )

                candidate_urls = sorted({
                    candidate["source_url"]
                    for candidate in candidates
                    if candidate.get("source_url")
                })

                after_raw = copy.deepcopy(before_raw)
                after_raw.update({
                    "verified": False,
                    "fee_verification_status": "needs_review",
                    "fee_review": {
                        "status": "pending",
                        "reason": reason,
                        "candidate_urls": candidate_urls,
                        "evidence_generated_at": evidence["generated_at"],
                    },
                    "scholarship_status": "applicability_unconfirmed",
                    "deposit_status": "offer_letter_amount_required",
                    "display_notes": {
                        "fee": (
                            "International tuition has not been verified "
                            "for this course and intake."
                        ),
                        "scholarship": SCHOLARSHIP_MESSAGE,
                        "deposit": DEPOSIT_MESSAGE,
                    },
                })

                changed = before_raw != after_raw

                proposals.append({
                    "course_id": course.pk,
                    "title": course.title,
                    "changed": changed,
                    "reason": reason,
                    "before": before_raw,
                    "after": after_raw,
                    "source_record_to_create": source is None,
                })
                locked[course.pk] = (tuition, source)

                self.stdout.write(
                    f"{course.pk}: "
                    f"{'save review' if changed else 'unchanged'}"
                )

            output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output.write_text(
                json.dumps(
                    {
                        "generated_at": now.isoformat(),
                        "university_id": "UK002",
                        "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                        "evidence_report": str(evidence_path),
                        "proposals": proposals,
                        "blocked": blocked,
                        "skipped_verified": skipped_verified,
                        "tuition_prices_changed": False,
                        "courses_deactivated": False,
                        "scholarship_amounts_changed": False,
                        "deposit_amounts_changed": False,
                    },
                    indent=2,
                    ensure_ascii=False,
                ),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"] and blocked:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"{len(blocked)} records are blocked. "
                    f"No review updates applied. See {output}"
                )

            if options["apply"]:
                for proposal in proposals:
                    if not proposal["changed"]:
                        continue

                    tuition, source = locked[proposal["course_id"]]

                    if source is None:
                        source = TuitionSource.objects.create(
                            tuition=tuition,
                            academic_year="",
                            source_url="",
                            source_course_name=proposal["title"],
                            source_course_code="",
                            fee_basis="unverified",
                            raw_fees=proposal["after"],
                        )
                    else:
                        source.raw_fees = proposal["after"]
                        source.save(update_fields=["raw_fees"])

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition=tuition,
                        course_identifier=proposal["course_id"],
                        residency="INTL",
                        before={"raw_fees": proposal["before"]},
                        after={"raw_fees": proposal["after"]},
                    )

        self.stdout.write(f"\nUnresolved records reviewed: {len(proposals)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Already verified and skipped: {len(skipped_verified)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Blocked: {len(blocked)}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")
        self.stdout.write(
            "Saved review metadata. Tuition prices remain unchanged."
            if options["apply"]
            else "Preview only. No database records changed."
        )

class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Preview or save unavailable-fee review metadata for "
        "15 unresolved ARU records."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Save review metadata without changing prices.",
        )

    @staticmethod
    def check_saved_scopes():
        target_ids = set(REVIEWS)

        for rule in ScholarshipRule.objects.filter(
            scholarship__university_id="UK003",
            verified=True,
        ):
            data = rule.rules

            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                continue

            conditions = data.get("conditions", {})

            if not isinstance(conditions, dict):
                continue

            scope = conditions.get("course_id", [])

            if isinstance(scope, list):
                overlap = target_ids.intersection(scope)

                if overlap:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Pending courses appear in verified scholarship "
                        f"rule {rule.pk}: {sorted(overlap)}. "
                        "Review that scope before applying this batch."
                    )

        for policy in DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
            university_id="UK003",
            verified=True,
        ):
            data = policy.rules

            if not isinstance(data, dict):
                continue

            scope = data.get("course_ids", [])

            if isinstance(scope, list):
                overlap = target_ids.intersection(scope)

                if overlap:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Pending courses appear in verified deposit "
                        f"policy {policy.pk}: {sorted(overlap)}. "
                        "Review that scope before applying this batch."
                    )

    @staticmethod
    def source_snapshot(source):
        if source is None:
            return None

        return {
            "academic_year": source.academic_year,
            "source_url": source.source_url,
            "source_course_name": source.source_course_name,
            "source_course_code": source.source_course_code,
            "fee_basis": source.fee_basis,
            "raw_fees": deepcopy(source.raw_fees),
        }

    @staticmethod
    def write_report(path, report):
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        path.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                report,
                cls=DjangoJSONEncoder,
                indent=2,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        stamp = timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ")

        output = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "aru"
            / f"remaining-15-review-{stamp}.json"
        )

        plans = []
        skipped = []

        with transaction.atomic():
            self.check_saved_scopes()

            for course_id, review in sorted(REVIEWS.items()):
                course = Course.objects.select_for_update().get(
                    university_id="UK003",
                    course_id=course_id,
                )

                tuitions = list(
                    Tuition.objects.select_for_update().filter(
                        course=course,
                        residency="INTL",
                    )
                )

                if (
                    len(tuitions) != 1
                    or tuitions[0].currency != "GBP"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: expected one GBP "
                        "international tuition. No changes committed."
                    )

                tuition = tuitions[0]

                source = (
                    TuitionSource.objects.select_for_update()
                    .filter(tuition=tuition)
                    .first()
                )

                if source is not None and not isinstance(
                    source.raw_fees, dict
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"{course_id}: invalid source metadata. "
                        "No changes committed."
                    )

                # Never downgrade a subsequently verified course.
                if (
                    source is not None
                    and source.raw_fees.get("verified") is True
                ):
                    skipped.append(course_id)
                    continue

                before = self.source_snapshot(source)
                raw = deepcopy(source.raw_fees) if source else {}

                raw.update({
                    "verified": False,
                    "annual_tuition": None,
                    "currency": "GBP",
                    "source_fee_category": "International",
                    "fee_basis": "unavailable",
                    "fee_categories": [],
                    "fee_note": review["note"],
                    "verification_reason": review["note"],
                    "review_status": "pending_confirmation",
                    "review_reason_code": review["reason"],
                })

                # Retain existing eligibility questions and notes.
                # Saving a review does not establish an award.
                raw["scholarship_status"] = (
                    "applicability_unconfirmed"
                )

                if course_id == "C_UK003_52":
                    raw["deposit_status"] = (
                        "campus_pre_cas_policy_not_applicable"
                    )
                else:
                    raw["deposit_status"] = (
                        "applicability_unconfirmed"
                    )

                after = {
                    "academic_year": (
                        source.academic_year if source else ""
                    ),
                    "source_url": (
                        source.source_url if source else ""
                    ),
                    "source_course_name": (
                        source.source_course_name
                        if source else course.title
                    ),
                    "source_course_code": (
                        source.source_course_code if source else ""
                    ),
                    "fee_basis": "unavailable",
                    "raw_fees": raw,
                }

                plan = {
                    "course_id": course_id,
                    "tuition_id": tuition.pk,
                    "title": course.title,
                    "reason": review["reason"],
                    "note": review["note"],
                    "stored_tuition_preserved": str(
                        tuition.tuition_fee
                    ),
                    "before": before,
                    "after": after,
                    "changed": before != after,
                }

                plans.append(plan)

            changed_count = sum(
                plan["changed"] for plan in plans
            )

            report = {
                "generated_at": timezone.now().isoformat(),
                "university_id": "UK003",
                "mode": "preview",
                "database_changes": False,
                "reviewed_records": len(plans),
                "proposed_changes": changed_count,
                "already_verified_and_skipped": skipped,
                "reviews": plans,
                "fees_newly_verified": 0,
                "scholarship_rules_changed": False,
                "deposit_policies_changed": False,
            }

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Cannot save preview report: {exc}. "
                    "No database changes committed."
                ) from exc

            if options["apply"]:
                for plan in plans:
                    if not plan["changed"]:
                        continue

                    TuitionSource.objects.update_or_create(
                        tuition_id=plan["tuition_id"],
                        defaults=plan["after"],
                    )

                    TuitionUpdateAudit.objects.create(
                        tuition_id=plan["tuition_id"],
                        course_identifier=plan["course_id"],
                        residency="INTL",
                        before={"source": plan["before"]},
                        after={"source": plan["after"]},
                    )

        if options["apply"]:
            report["mode"] = "apply"
            report["database_changes"] = changed_count > 0

            try:
                self.write_report(output, report)
            except OSError as exc:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Database changes were committed, but the "
                    f"final report could not be updated: {exc}"
                ) from exc

        for plan in plans:
            state = "save review" if plan["changed"] else "unchanged"

            self.stdout.write(
                f"{plan['course_id']}: {state} "
                f"— {plan['reason']}"
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            f"\nRecords reviewed: {len(plans)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Already verified and skipped: {len(skipped)}"
        )
        self.stdout.write(
            f"Proposed/updated records: {changed_count}"
        )
        self.stdout.write("Newly verified fees: 0")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {output}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    "Unavailable-fee review metadata and audits saved."
                )
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )

        self.stdout.write(
            "Course identities, active status, numeric tuition, "
            "stored discounts and deposits preserved. "
            "These records remain pending confirmation."
        )

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management import call_command, get_commands
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand, CommandError
from django.db import transaction

from app.models import Course, TuitionSource
from app.views import abertay_fee_verification_error


YEAR = "2026/27"

POLICY_URL = (
    "https://www.abertay.ac.uk/study-apply/"
    "money-fees-and-funding/tuition-fees-2026-2027/"
)

IMPORT_COMMANDS = (
    "import_abertay_fees",
    "import_abertay_remaining_fees",
    "reconcile_abertay_early_2026_fees",
    "reconcile_abertay_research_batch",
)

SCHOLARSHIP_COMMAND = "extend_abertay_scholarship_scope"


def write_json(path, data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")

    temporary.write_text(
        json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    temporary.replace(path)


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Refresh Abertay source evidence and preview/apply "
        "reviewed international fees and scholarship scope."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            "--apply",
            action="store_true",
            help="Apply validated database updates.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--skip-ug-refresh",
            action="store_true",
            help="Reuse existing undergraduate source files.",
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            "--skip-pg-refresh",
            action="store_true",
            help="Reuse existing postgraduate and policy files.",
        )

    def read_json(self, path):
        try:
            return json.loads(
                path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
            )
        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Cannot read {path.name}: {exc}"
            ) from exc

    def acquire_lock(self, path):
        handle = path.open("a+b")
        handle.seek(0, 2)

        if handle.tell() == 0:
            handle.write(b"0")
            handle.flush()

        handle.seek(0)

        try:
            if os.name == "nt":
                import msvcrt

                msvcrt.locking(
                    handle.fileno(),
                    msvcrt.LK_NBLCK,
                    1,
                )
            else:
                import fcntl

                fcntl.flock(
                    handle.fileno(),
                    fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB,
                )

        except OSError as exc:
            handle.close()
            raise CommandError(
                "Another Abertay workflow may already be running."
            ) from exc

        return handle

    def run_script(self, root, filename, *arguments):
        script = root / filename

        if not script.is_file():
            raise CommandError(f"Missing script: {script}")

        self.stdout.write(f"\nRunning {filename}...")
        self.stdout.flush()

        environment = dict(
            os.environ,
            PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1",
            PYTHONIOENCODING="utf-8",
        )

        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(script), *arguments],
                cwd=root,
                env=environment,
                timeout=1800,
                check=False,
            )
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"{filename} exceeded the 30-minute limit."
            ) from exc

        if result.returncode:
            raise CommandError(
                f"{filename} failed with exit code "
                f"{result.returncode}. Imports were not started."
            )

    def validate_undergraduate_sources(self, root):
        catalogue = self.read_json(
            root / "abertay_course_urls.json"
        )
        extraction = self.read_json(
            root / "abertay_courses_preview.json"
        )
        mapping = self.read_json(
            root / "abertay_course_mapping.json"
        )

        if not isinstance(catalogue, list) or not catalogue:
            raise CommandError(
                "Undergraduate catalogue is empty or invalid."
            )

        urls = [
            row.get("course_url")
            if isinstance(row, dict) else None
            for row in catalogue
        ]

        if (
            any(not isinstance(url, str) or not url for url in urls)
            or len(urls) != len(set(urls))
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Invalid or duplicate undergraduate URLs."
            )

        records = (
            extraction.get("records")
            if isinstance(extraction, dict) else None
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(records, list)
            or extraction.get("academic_year") != YEAR
            or len(records) != len(catalogue)
            or any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in records)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Undergraduate extraction coverage is incomplete."
            )

        extracted_urls = [
            row.get("source_url") for row in records
        ]

        if (
            any(
                not isinstance(url, str) or not url
                for url in extracted_urls
            )
            or len(set(extracted_urls)) != len(extracted_urls)
            or set(extracted_urls) != set(urls)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Undergraduate extraction URLs do not match "
                "the catalogue."
            )

        failures = [
            row for row in records
            if row.get("status") != "extracted"
        ]

        if failures:
            for row in failures:
                self.stderr.write(
                    f"{row.get('source_url')}: "
                    f"{row.get('error', 'Extraction incomplete')}"
                )

            raise CommandError(
                f"{len(failures)} undergraduate pages need review."
            )

        entries = (
            mapping.get("mappings")
            if isinstance(mapping, dict) else None
        )

        if (
            not isinstance(entries, list)
            or any(
                not isinstance(entry, dict)
                or not isinstance(entry.get("source_url"), str)
                or not entry["source_url"]
                for entry in entries
            )
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid course mapping file.")

        mapped_urls = {
            entry["source_url"] for entry in entries
        }
        missing = mapped_urls - set(urls)

        if missing:
            raise CommandError(
                "Mapped UG pages are missing: "
                + ", ".join(sorted(missing))
            )

        return {
            "extracted_pages": len(records),
            "mapped_source_pages": len(mapped_urls),
            "unmapped_source_pages": len(set(urls) - mapped_urls),
        }

    def validate_postgraduate_sources(
        self,
        preview_path,
        policy_path,
        previous=None,
    ):
        report = self.read_json(preview_path)
        policy = self.read_json(policy_path)

        if (
            not isinstance(report, dict)
            or report.get("academic_year") != YEAR
            or report.get("collection_complete") is not True
            or report.get("catalogue_errors")
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Postgraduate collection is incomplete or invalid."
            )

        prefixes = {
            "postgraduate_taught":
                "/course-search/postgraduate-taught/",
            "postgraduate_research":
                "/course-search/postgraduate-research/",
        }

        counts = report.get("catalogue_counts")
        records = report.get("postgraduate")

        if (
            not isinstance(counts, dict)
            or set(counts) != set(prefixes)
            or not isinstance(records, list)
        ):
            raise CommandError(
                "Missing postgraduate catalogue coverage."
            )

        indexed = {}
        actual_counts = {
            kind: 0 for kind in prefixes
        }

        for record in records:
            if not isinstance(record, dict):
                raise CommandError("Invalid PG record.")

            kind = record.get("kind")
            url = record.get("source_url")

            if kind not in prefixes or not isinstance(url, str):
                raise CommandError("Invalid PG source identity.")

            parsed = urlsplit(url)
            prefix = prefixes[kind]

            if (
                parsed.scheme != "https"
                or parsed.netloc != "www.abertay.ac.uk"
                or not parsed.path.startswith(prefix)
                or parsed.path.rstrip("/") == prefix.rstrip("/")
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Unexpected postgraduate URL: {url}"
                )

            if url in indexed:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Duplicate postgraduate source: {url}"
                )

            indexed[url] = record
            actual_counts[kind] += 1

            if not record.get("source_title"):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Missing postgraduate title: {url}"
                )

            if record.get("status") == "extracted":
                data = record.get("data")

                if (
                    not isinstance(data, dict)
                    or data.get("academic_year") != YEAR
                    or data.get("currency") != "GBP"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        f"Invalid extracted PG evidence: {url}"
                    )

            elif not (
                record.get("status") == "needs_review"
                and record.get("error_code") == "missing_fee_table"
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"PG page failed validation: {url}"
                )

        for kind, actual in actual_counts.items():
            if (
                type(counts.get(kind)) is not int
                or counts[kind] <= 0
                or actual != counts[kind]
            ):
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Incomplete catalogue: {kind}"
                )

        # Previously extracted fees cannot silently disappear.
        if isinstance(previous, dict):
            for old in previous.get("postgraduate", []):
                if (
                    not isinstance(old, dict)
                    or old.get("status") != "extracted"
                ):
                    continue

                url = old.get("source_url")
                current = indexed.get(url)

                if (
                    current is None
                    or current.get("status") != "extracted"
                ):
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Previously extracted PG fee evidence "
                        f"is missing: {url}. Imports stopped."
                    )

        if (
            not isinstance(policy, dict)
            or policy.get("source_url") != POLICY_URL
            or policy.get("page_title")
            != "Tuition Fees (2026-2027)"
            or not isinstance(policy.get("sections"), list)
        ):
            raise CommandError("Invalid central fee policy.")

        required_sections = {
            "Undergraduate Tuition Fees - "
            "International Students 2026/27":
                "UNDERGRADUATE DEGREE COURSES",

            "Postgraduate Tuition Fees - "
            "International Students 2026/27":
                "POSTGRADUATE COURSES",
        }

        for heading, first_header in required_sections.items():
            sections = [
                item
                for item in policy["sections"]
                if isinstance(item, dict)
                and item.get("heading") == heading
            ]

            if len(sections) != 1:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Missing or ambiguous policy section: {heading}"
                )

            tables = [
                table
                for table in sections[0].get("tables", [])
                if isinstance(table, list)
                and table
                and isinstance(table[0], list)
                and table[0]
                and isinstance(table[0][0], str)
                and table[0][0].casefold()
                == first_header.casefold()
            ]

            if len(tables) != 1 or len(tables[0]) < 2:
                raise CommandError(
                    f"Missing or ambiguous policy table: {heading}"
                )

        return {
            "catalogue_counts": actual_counts,
            "extracted_fees": sum(
                row.get("status") == "extracted"
                for row in records
            ),
            "central_fee_evidence_required": sum(
                row.get("error_code") == "missing_fee_table"
                for row in records
            ),
        }

    def promote_source_pair(self, pairs):
        """Install validated files; restore originals on an IO failure."""
        originals = {
            destination: (
                destination.read_bytes()
                if destination.exists() else None
            )
            for _, destination in pairs
        }

        try:
            for staged, destination in pairs:
                staged.replace(destination)
        except OSError:
            for destination, original in originals.items():
                if original is None:
                    destination.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                else:
                    temporary = destination.with_suffix(
                        destination.suffix + ".restore"
                    )
                    temporary.write_bytes(original)
                    temporary.replace(destination)
            raise

    def coverage(self):
        courses = (
            Course.objects.filter(
                university__name__iexact="Abertay University",
                university__country="UK",
                is_active=True,
            )
            .prefetch_related(
                "tuitions",
                "tuitions__source_metadata",
            )
            .order_by("course_id")
        )

        verified = []
        unresolved = []
        years = {}
        restricted = []

        for course in courses:
            row = {
                "course_id": course.course_id,
                "title": course.title,
                "level": course.level,
                "start_month": course.start_month,
                "start_year": course.start_year,
            }

            tuitions = [
                tuition
                for tuition in course.tuitions.all()
                if tuition.residency == "INTL"
            ]

            if len(tuitions) != 1:
                row["reason"] = (
                    f"Expected one INTL tuition; found {len(tuitions)}."
                )
                unresolved.append(row)
                continue

            tuition = tuitions[0]

            try:
                source = tuition.source_metadata
            except TuitionSource.DoesNotExist:
                source = None

            reason = abertay_fee_verification_error(
                tuition, source
            )

            if reason:
                row["reason"] = reason
                unresolved.append(row)
                continue

            row["academic_year"] = source.academic_year
            row["tuition_fee"] = str(tuition.tuition_fee)
            row["source_url"] = source.source_url
            verified.append(row)

            years[source.academic_year] = (
                years.get(source.academic_year, 0) + 1
            )

            if (
                source.raw_fees.get(
                    "international_applications_open"
                ) is False
            ):
                restricted.append(course.course_id)

        return {
            "active_courses": len(verified) + len(unresolved),
            "verified_fees": len(verified),
            "unresolved_fees": len(unresolved),
            "verified_by_academic_year": years,
            "application_restricted_course_ids": restricted,
            "unresolved": unresolved,
        }

    def run_importer(self, name, apply):
        mode = "APPLY" if apply else "PREVIEW"
        self.stdout.write(f"\n[{mode}] {name}")
        self.stdout.flush()

        call_command(
            name,
            apply=apply,
            stdout=self.stdout,
            stderr=self.stderr,
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        root = Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
        log_dir = root / "logs" / "abertay"
        log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime(
            "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ"
        )
        report_path = log_dir / f"workflow-{timestamp}.json"

        report = {
            "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
            "status": "started",
            "database_transaction_committed": False,
            "undergraduate_refreshed": False,
            "postgraduate_refreshed": False,
            "postgraduate_refresh_integrated": True,
            "historical_scholarship_rules_verified": False,
            "deposits_verified_by_this_workflow": False,
            "completed_commands": [],
        }

        lock = self.acquire_lock(log_dir / "workflow.lock")

        try:
            importers = [
                *IMPORT_COMMANDS,
                SCHOLARSHIP_COMMAND,
            ]
            required = [
                *importers,
                "preview_abertay_remaining",
            ]
            available = get_commands()

            missing = [
                name for name in required
                if name not in available
            ]

            if missing:
                raise CommandError(
                    "Missing management commands: "
                    + ", ".join(missing)
                )

            if not options["skip_ug_refresh"]:
                self.run_script(root, "discover_abertay.py")

                catalogue = self.read_json(
                    root / "abertay_course_urls.json"
                )

                if not isinstance(catalogue, list) or not catalogue:
                    raise CommandError(
                        "Discovered undergraduate catalogue is empty."
                    )

                self.run_script(
                    root,
                    "preview_abertay_courses.py",
                    "--limit",
                    str(len(catalogue)),
                    "--academic-year",
                    YEAR,
                )

                report["undergraduate_refreshed"] = True
            else:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "\nUsing existing undergraduate extraction files."
                )

            report["undergraduate_sources"] = (
                self.validate_undergraduate_sources(root)
            )

            preview_path = root / "abertay_remaining_preview.json"
            policy_path = root / "abertay_remaining_policy.json"

            previous = (
                self.read_json(preview_path)
                if preview_path.exists()
                else None
            )

            if not options["skip_pg_refresh"]:
                # Both files are collected and validated in staging
                # before replacing the successful source files.
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(
                    prefix="abertay-stage-",
                    dir=root,
                ) as directory:
                    stage = Path(directory)
                    staged_policy = stage / policy_path.name
                    staged_preview = stage / preview_path.name

                    self.run_script(
                        root,
                        "inspect_abertay_remaining_policy.py",
                        "--output",
                        str(staged_policy),
                    )

                    self.stdout.write(
                        "\nRefreshing postgraduate catalogues..."
                    )
                    self.stdout.flush()

                    call_command(
                        "preview_abertay_remaining",
                        output=str(staged_preview),
                        stdout=self.stdout,
                        stderr=self.stderr,
                    )

                    # Preserve the collected evidence, including
                    # when cross-run validation subsequently fails.
                    evidence_policy = (
                        log_dir / f"policy-{timestamp}.json"
                    )
                    evidence_preview = (
                        log_dir / f"pg-preview-{timestamp}.json"
                    )

                    evidence_policy.write_bytes(
                        staged_policy.read_bytes()
                    )
                    evidence_preview.write_bytes(
                        staged_preview.read_bytes()
                    )

                    report["source_snapshots"] = {
                        "policy": str(evidence_policy),
                        "postgraduate": str(evidence_preview),
                    }

                    report["postgraduate_sources"] = (
                        self.validate_postgraduate_sources(
                            staged_preview,
                            staged_policy,
                            previous=previous,
                        )
                    )

                    self.promote_source_pair([
                        (staged_policy, policy_path),
                        (staged_preview, preview_path),
                    ])

                report["postgraduate_refreshed"] = True
            else:
                self.stdout.write(
                    "\nUsing existing postgraduate and policy files."
                )

                report["postgraduate_sources"] = (
                    self.validate_postgraduate_sources(
                        preview_path,
                        policy_path,
                    )
                )

            report["coverage_before"] = self.coverage()

            self.stdout.write(
                "\nCurrent source evidence validated. Historical "
                "2025/26 fees remain handled by their cohort importer. "
                "Missing course-page tables do not automatically "
                "approve a central-fee match."
            )

            # Every importer must pass preview before apply begins.
            for name in importers:
                self.run_importer(name, apply=False)

            if options["apply"]:
                with transaction.atomic():
                    for name in importers:
                        self.run_importer(name, apply=True)
                        report["completed_commands"].append(name)

                report["database_transaction_committed"] = True
                report["status"] = "applied"
            else:
                report["status"] = "preview_complete"

            report["coverage_after"] = self.coverage()
            write_json(report_path, report)

            coverage = report["coverage_after"]

            self.stdout.write(
                "\nCombined active-course coverage"
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Active courses: {coverage['active_courses']}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Verified fees: {coverage['verified_fees']}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Unresolved fees: {coverage['unresolved_fees']}"
            )
            self.stdout.write(
                f"Workflow report: {report_path}"
            )

            self.stdout.write(
                "Database workflow committed successfully."
                if options["apply"]
                else "Preview complete. No database updates applied."
            )

        except Exception as exc:
            report["status"] = "failed"
            report["error"] = str(exc)
            write_json(report_path, report)

            if report["database_transaction_committed"]:
                message = (
                    "Database updates committed, but a later "
                    "reporting step failed."
                )
            else:
                message = (
                    "Workflow failed. Any database changes inside "
                    "the combined apply transaction were rolled back."
                )

            raise CommandError(
                f"{message}\n"
                f"Reason: {exc}\n"
                f"Workflow report: {report_path}"
            ) from exc

        finally:
            lock.close()

def clean_text(element):
    return " ".join(element.get_text(" ", strip=True).split())


def extract_deposit_section(soup, heading_text):
    headings = soup.find_all(
        lambda tag: (
            tag.name in ("h2", "h3", "h4")
            and clean_text(tag) == heading_text
        )
    )

    if len(headings) != 1:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Expected one section: {heading_text!r}; "
            f"found {len(headings)}."
        )

    paragraphs = []
    list_items = []
    stopped = False

    for element in headings[0].next_elements:
        name = getattr(element, "name", None)

        if name in ("h1", "h2", "h3", "h4"):
            label = clean_text(element).casefold()

            if label.startswith("early bird"):
                stopped = True
                break

            if (
                label.startswith("undergraduate tuition fees")
                or label.startswith("postgraduate tuition fees")
                or label.startswith("self-funding")
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Deposit section ended unexpectedly."
                )

        if name == "p":
            paragraphs.append(clean_text(element))

        elif name == "li":
            list_items.append(clean_text(element))

    if not stopped:
        raise ValueError(
            "Could not identify the end of the deposit section."
        )

    if not paragraphs or not list_items:
        raise ValueError("Deposit evidence is incomplete.")

    return paragraphs, list_items


def parse_rules(paragraphs, list_items):
    text = " ".join(paragraphs)

    # Extract the percentage from the published sentence.
    standard = re.findall(
        r"deposit equal to\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%"
        r"\s+of your net tuition fee",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    full_payment = re.findall(
        r"required to pay\s+(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%"
        r"\s+deposit before you can apply for your CAS"
        r"\s+if you legally reside in",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )

    nigeria = re.findall(
        r"Applicants who legally reside in Nigeria"
        r"\s+need to pay a flat deposit of"
        r"\s+£\s*([\d,]+(?:\.\d{2})?)",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    )
    # Repeated identical values are acceptable.
    # Different values still fail the ambiguity check below.
    standard = list(dict.fromkeys(standard))
    full_payment = list(dict.fromkeys(full_payment))

    nigeria = list(dict.fromkeys(
        value.replace(",", "")
        for value in nigeria
    ))
    if not (
        len(standard) == 1
        and len(full_payment) == 1
        and len(nigeria) == 1
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Deposit extraction needs review: "
            f"standard percentage matches={standard!r}; "
            f"full-payment matches={full_payment!r}; "
            f"Nigeria amount matches={nigeria!r}."
        )

    standard_percent = standard[0]
    full_percent = full_payment[0]
    nigeria_amount = nigeria[0].replace(",", "")

    # Changes to the reviewed policy require inspection.
    if (
        standard_percent != "50"
        or full_percent != "100"
        or nigeria_amount not in ("4500", "4500.00")
    ):
        raise ValueError(
            "Published deposit amounts changed. "
            "Review the source before importing."
        )

    if not re.search(
        r"net tuition fee is calculated after deducting"
        r"\s+any University scholarships from the gross fee",
        text,
        flags=re.IGNORECASE,
    ):
        raise ValueError("The net-tuition basis was not confirmed.")

    if "risk factors" not in text.casefold():
        raise ValueError(
            "Individual deposit assessment wording needs review."
        )

    countries = set()
    states = set()

    for item in list_items:
        label = item.strip().rstrip(".").casefold()

        if label in COUNTRY_CODES:
            countries.add(COUNTRY_CODES[label])
            continue

        if label.startswith("the indian states of "):
            state_text = label.removeprefix(
                "the indian states of "
            )

            states.update(
                part.strip()
                for part in re.split(
                    r",\s*(?:and\s+)?|\s+and\s+",
                    state_text,
                )
                if part.strip()
            )

            continue

        # The September/January instalment bullet is not an exception.
        if re.match(r"a 50% deposit is due\b", label):
            continue

        raise ValueError(
            f"Unrecognised deposit list item: {item!r}"
        )

    if countries != set(COUNTRY_CODES.values()):
        raise ValueError(
            "Country exceptions changed; manual review required."
        )

    if states != REVIEWED_INDIAN_STATES:
        raise ValueError(
            "Indian state exceptions changed; manual review required."
        )

    return {
        "schema_version": 1,
        "fee_status": "INTL",
        "payment_stage": "before_cas",
        "self_funded": True,
        "requires_student_visa": True,
        "basis": "net_tuition",
        "standard_percentage": standard_percent,
        "country_fixed_amounts": {
            "NG": f"{float(nigeria_amount):.2f}",
        },
        "full_payment_percentage": full_percent,
        "full_payment_countries": sorted(countries),
        "full_payment_regions": {
            "IN": sorted(states),
        },
        "individual_override_possible": True,
        "early_payment_discounts_included": False,
    }


def snapshot(policy):
    if policy is None:
        return None

    return {
        "academic_year": policy.academic_year,
        "currency": policy.currency,
        "rules": policy.rules,
        "source_url": policy.source_url,
        "source_sha256": policy.source_sha256,
        "verified": policy.verified,
    }


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = (
        "Scrape and preview/save Abertay's reviewed "
        "2026/27 international deposit policy."
    )

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument("--apply", action="store_true")

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        try:
            university = University.objects.get(
                pk="UK001",
                country="UK",
            )
        except University.DoesNotExist as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                "Abertay university UK001 was not found."
            ) from exc

        if university.name.casefold() != "abertay university":
            raise CommandError(
                "UK001 does not identify Abertay University."
            )

        retry = Retry(
            total=3,
            backoff_factor=1,
            status_forcelist=[429, 500, 502, 503, 504],
            allowed_methods=["GET"],
            respect_retry_after_header=True,
        )

        try:
            with requests.Session() as session:
                session.headers["User-Agent"] = (
                    "TuitionCompareDepositInspector/1.0"
                )

                session.mount(
                    "https://",
                    HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retry),
                )

                response = session.get(
                    SOURCE_URL,
                    timeout=(30, 60),
                )
                response.raise_for_status()

            if response.url.rstrip("/") != SOURCE_URL.rstrip("/"):
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Unexpected redirect: {response.url}"
                )
            # Decode explicitly so £ and other characters remain intact.
            try:
                html = response.content.decode("utf-8-sig")
            except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
                raise ValueError(
                    "The source page encoding changed; review required."
                ) from exc

            soup = BeautifulSoup(html, "html.parser")
            
            heading = soup.find("h1")

            if (
                heading is None
                or clean_text(heading) != "Tuition Fees (2026-2027)"
            ):
                raise ValueError(
                    "Unexpected fee-page title or academic year."
                )

            extracted_rules = []
            evidence = []

            for section_heading in SECTION_HEADINGS:
                paragraphs, list_items = extract_deposit_section(
                    soup,
                    section_heading,
                )

                extracted_rules.append(
                    parse_rules(paragraphs, list_items)
                )

                evidence.append({
                    "heading": section_heading,
                    "paragraphs": paragraphs,
                    "list_items": list_items,
                })

            if extracted_rules[0] != extracted_rules[1]:
                raise ValueError(
                    "UG and PG deposit rules differ; review required."
                )

        except (requests.RequestException, ValueError) as exc:
            raise CommandError(
                f"Deposit import stopped: {exc}. "
                "No database records changed."
            ) from exc

        source_text = json.dumps(
            evidence,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            sort_keys=True,
            indent=2,
        )

        digest = hashlib.sha256(
            source_text.encode("utf-8")
        ).hexdigest()

        defaults = {
            "currency": "GBP",
            "rules": extracted_rules[0],
            "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
            "source_text": source_text,
            "source_sha256": digest,
            "verified": True,
        }

        checked_at = timezone.now()

        log_directory = (
            Path(settings.BASE_DIR)
            / "logs"
            / "abertay-deposits"
        )
        log_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

        report_path = log_directory / (
            f"deposit-{checked_at.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S%fZ')}.json"
        )

        # Lock the university row to serialize this policy update.
        with transaction.atomic():
            University.objects.select_for_update().get(
                pk=university.pk
            )

            policy = DepositPolicy.objects.filter(
                university=university,
                academic_year=ACADEMIC_YEAR,
            ).first()

            before = snapshot(policy)

            after = {
                "academic_year": ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                "currency": "GBP",
                "rules": defaults["rules"],
                "source_url": SOURCE_URL,
                "source_sha256": digest,
                "verified": True,
            }

            changed = before != after

            report = {
                "generated_at": checked_at.isoformat(),
                "mode": "apply" if options["apply"] else "preview",
                "university_id": university.pk,
                "changed": changed,
                "before": before,
                "after": after,
                "source_evidence": evidence,
            }

            # Save the review evidence before database writes.
            report_path.write_text(
                json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )

            if options["apply"]:
                DepositPolicy.objects.update_or_create(
                    university=university,
                    academic_year=ACADEMIC_YEAR,
                    defaults={
                        **defaults,
                        "checked_at": checked_at,
                    },
                )

        self.stdout.write(
            json.dumps(after, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        )
        self.stdout.write(f"\nPolicy changed: {changed}")
        self.stdout.write(f"Report: {report_path}")

        if options["apply"]:
            self.stdout.write(
                self.style.SUCCESS(
                    "Deposit policy saved to the database. "
                    "Tuition prices and scholarships unchanged."
                )
            )
        else:
            self.stdout.write(
                "Preview only. No database records changed."
            )
